+    C: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    V: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    TPP: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    PPL: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    BT: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    KC: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    KS: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    CPC: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    it_ty: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    et: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    Mf: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    has_beta: cutlass.Constexpr,
+) -> None:
+    tid, _, _ = cute.arch.thread_idx()
+    cx, my, _ = cute.arch.block_idx()
+    NSEG: cutlass.Constexpr = V // 4
+
+    smem = SmemAllocator()
+    # Two staging planes so BOTH accumulators reduce in ONE shared round: the
+    # tp-reduction is cross-WARP (TPP=32 means a warp is exactly one pixel group),
+    # so it cannot use shuffles and every round costs two barriers. Fusing the
+    # pairs takes the kernel from 8 barriers to 4.
+    red = smem.allocate_tensor(cutlass.Float32, cute.make_layout(2 * BT * V), byte_alignment=16)
+    stat = smem.allocate_tensor(cutlass.Float32, cute.make_layout(2 * CPC), byte_alignment=16)
+    scx = None
+    scd = None
+    if cutlass.const_expr(KS > 0):
+        scx = smem.allocate_tensor(it_ty, cute.make_layout(BT * KS * V), byte_alignment=16)
+        scd = smem.allocate_tensor(it_ty, cute.make_layout(BT * KS * V), byte_alignment=16)
+
+    lane = tid % TPP
+    tp = tid // TPP
+    c0 = cx * (TPP * V) + lane * V
+    per = (M + mparts - 1) // mparts
+    r0 = my * per
+    r1 = r0 + per
+    if r1 > M:
+        r1 = M
+
+    mn = []
+    rs = []
+    for e in cutlass.range_constexpr(V):
+        mn.append(mMean[c0 + e])
+        rs.append(mRstd[c0 + e])
+
+    s = [cutlass.Float32(0.0)] * V  # sum(dy)
+    sq = [cutlass.Float32(0.0)] * V  # sum(dy*xhat)
+    xc = [cutlass.Float32(0.0)] * (KC * V)
+    dc = [cutlass.Float32(0.0)] * (KC * V)
+
+    # ---- pass 1: reduce; cache BOTH streams, KC pixels in regs then KS in smem ----
+    for kk in cutlass.range_constexpr(KC):
+        rk = r0 + tp + kk * PPL
+        if rk < r1:
+            xv = nvvm.load_ext(mXi.iterator + (cutlass.Int64(rk) * C + c0), dtype=it_ty, count=V).bitcast(et)
+            dv = nvvm.load_ext(mDYi.iterator + (cutlass.Int64(rk) * C + c0), dtype=it_ty, count=V).bitcast(et)
+            for e in cutlass.range_constexpr(V):
+                x = xv[e].to(cutlass.Float32)
+                d = dv[e].to(cutlass.Float32)
+                s[e] = s[e] + d
+                sq[e] = sq[e] + d * ((x - mn[e]) * rs[e])
+                xc[kk * V + e] = x
+                dc[kk * V + e] = d
+    for ks in cutlass.range_constexpr(KS):
+        rk = r0 + tp + (KC + ks) * PPL
+        if rk < r1:
+            rx = nvvm.load_ext(mXi.iterator + (cutlass.Int64(rk) * C + c0), dtype=it_ty, count=V)
+            rd = nvvm.load_ext(mDYi.iterator + (cutlass.Int64(rk) * C + c0), dtype=it_ty, count=V)
+            xv = rx.bitcast(et)
+            dv = rd.bitcast(et)
+            for e in cutlass.range_constexpr(V):
+                x = xv[e].to(cutlass.Float32)
+                d = dv[e].to(cutlass.Float32)
+                s[e] = s[e] + d
+                sq[e] = sq[e] + d * ((x - mn[e]) * rs[e])
+            nvvm.store_ext(rx, scx.iterator + (tid * KS + ks) * V, shared_space=_CTA_SS)
+            nvvm.store_ext(rd, scd.iterator + (tid * KS + ks) * V, shared_space=_CTA_SS)
+    row = r0 + tp + (KC + KS) * PPL
+    while row < r1:
+        xv = nvvm.load_ext(mXi.iterator + (cutlass.Int64(row) * C + c0), dtype=it_ty, count=V).bitcast(et)
+        dv = nvvm.load_ext(mDYi.iterator + (cutlass.Int64(row) * C + c0), dtype=it_ty, count=V).bitcast(et)
+        for e in cutlass.range_constexpr(V):
+            x = xv[e].to(cutlass.Float32)
+            d = dv[e].to(cutlass.Float32)
+            s[e] = s[e] + d
+            sq[e] = sq[e] + d * ((x - mn[e]) * rs[e])
+        row = row + PPL
+
+    def _reduce2(va, vb):
+        """Reduce BOTH accumulators across the PPL pixel groups in one shared round."""
+        if cutlass.const_expr(PPL > 1):
+            for e in cutlass.range_constexpr(V):
+                red[(tp * TPP + lane) * V + e] = va[e]
+                red[BT * V + (tp * TPP + lane) * V + e] = vb[e]
+            nvvm.barrier_cta_sync_aligned(0)
+            if tp == 0:
+                for e in cutlass.range_constexpr(V):
+                    aa_ = va[e]
+                    bb_ = vb[e]
+                    for j in cutlass.range_constexpr(PPL - 1):
+                        aa_ = aa_ + red[((j + 1) * TPP + lane) * V + e]
+                        bb_ = bb_ + red[BT * V + ((j + 1) * TPP + lane) * V + e]
+                    va[e] = aa_
+                    vb[e] = bb_
+            nvvm.barrier_cta_sync_aligned(0)
+        return va, vb
+
+    s, sq = _reduce2(s, sq)
+
+    psum = cx * (mparts * TPP * V * 2)
+    psq = psum + mparts * TPP * V
+    if tp == 0:
+        off = (my * TPP + lane) * V
+        for h in cutlass.range_constexpr(NSEG):
+            sseg = cutlass.Vector.from_elements(tuple(s[h * 4 + j] for j in range(4)), cutlass.Float32)
+            qseg = cutlass.Vector.from_elements(tuple(sq[h * 4 + j] for j in range(4)), cutlass.Float32)
+            nvvm.store_ext(sseg, mP.iterator + (psum + off + h * 4))
+            nvvm.store_ext(qseg, mP.iterator + (psq + off + h * 4))
+
+    nvvm.fence_acq_rel(nvvm.MemScope.GPU)
+    nvvm.barrier_cta_sync_aligned(0)
+    if tid == 0:
+        nvvm.atomicrmw(nvvm.AtomicOp.ADD, mRet.iterator + cx, cutlass.Int32(1), mem_order=nvvm.MemOrder.RELEASE, syncscope=nvvm.MemScope.GPU)
+        done = False
+        while not done:
+            v = nvvm.atomicrmw(nvvm.AtomicOp.ADD, mRet.iterator + cx, cutlass.Int32(0), mem_order=nvvm.MemOrder.ACQUIRE, syncscope=nvvm.MemScope.GPU)
+            if v >= mparts:
+                done = True
+    nvvm.barrier_cta_sync_aligned(0)
+
+    # ---- redundant finalize across all part-CTAs of this channel tile ----
+    facc = [cutlass.Float32(0.0)] * V
+    faccsq = [cutlass.Float32(0.0)] * V
+    part = tp
+    while part < mparts:
+        off = (part * TPP + lane) * V
+        for h in cutlass.range_constexpr(NSEG):
+            sv = nvvm.load_ext(mP.iterator + (psum + off + h * 4), dtype=cutlass.Float32, count=4)
+            qv = nvvm.load_ext(mP.iterator + (psq + off + h * 4), dtype=cutlass.Float32, count=4)
+            for j in cutlass.range_constexpr(4):
+                facc[h * 4 + j] = facc[h * 4 + j] + sv[j]
+                faccsq[h * 4 + j] = faccsq[h * 4 + j] + qv[j]
+        part = part + PPL
+    facc, faccsq = _reduce2(facc, faccsq)
+
+    if tp == 0:
+        for e in cutlass.range_constexpr(V):
+            stat[lane * V + e] = facc[e] / Mf  # a = dbeta / M
+            stat[CPC + lane * V + e] = faccsq[e] / Mf  # b = dgamma / M
+            if my == 0:
+                mDGamma[c0 + e] = faccsq[e]
+                if cutlass.const_expr(has_beta):
+                    mDBeta[c0 + e] = facc[e]
+    nvvm.barrier_cta_sync_aligned(0)
+
+    aa = []
+    bb = []
+    ga = []
+    for e in cutlass.range_constexpr(V):
+        aa.append(stat[lane * V + e])
+        bb.append(stat[CPC + lane * V + e])
+        ga.append(mG[c0 + e].to(cutlass.Float32) * rs[e])
+
+    # ---- pass 2: dx from the register cache, then smem, then re-read ----
+    for kk in cutlass.range_constexpr(KC):
+        rk = r0 + tp + kk * PPL
+        if rk < r1:
+            ys = []
+            for e in cutlass.range_constexpr(V):
+                xh = (xc[kk * V + e] - mn[e]) * rs[e]
+                ys.append((ga[e] * (dc[kk * V + e] - aa[e] - xh * bb[e])).to(et))
+            nvvm.store_ext(cutlass.Vector.from_elements(tuple(ys), et).bitcast(it_ty), mDXi.iterator + (cutlass.Int64(rk) * C + c0))
+    for ks in cutlass.range_constexpr(KS):
+        rk = r0 + tp + (KC + ks) * PPL
+        if rk < r1:
+            xv = nvvm.load_ext(scx.iterator + (tid * KS + ks) * V, dtype=it_ty, count=V, shared_space=_CTA_SS).bitcast(et)
+            dv = nvvm.load_ext(scd.iterator + (tid * KS + ks) * V, dtype=it_ty, count=V, shared_space=_CTA_SS).bitcast(et)
+            ys = []
+            for e in cutlass.range_constexpr(V):
+                xh = (xv[e].to(cutlass.Float32) - mn[e]) * rs[e]
+                ys.append((ga[e] * (dv[e].to(cutlass.Float32) - aa[e] - xh * bb[e])).to(et))
+            nvvm.store_ext(cutlass.Vector.from_elements(tuple(ys), et).bitcast(it_ty), mDXi.iterator + (cutlass.Int64(rk) * C + c0))
+    row = r0 + tp + (KC + KS) * PPL
+    while row < r1:
+        xv = nvvm.load_ext(mXi.iterator + (cutlass.Int64(row) * C + c0), dtype=it_ty, count=V).bitcast(et)
+        dv = nvvm.load_ext(mDYi.iterator + (cutlass.Int64(row) * C + c0), dtype=it_ty, count=V).bitcast(et)
+        ys = []
+        for e in cutlass.range_constexpr(V):
+            xh = (xv[e].to(cutlass.Float32) - mn[e]) * rs[e]
+            ys.append((ga[e] * (dv[e].to(cutlass.Float32) - aa[e] - xh * bb[e])).to(et))
+        nvvm.store_ext(cutlass.Vector.from_elements(tuple(ys), et).bitcast(it_ty), mDXi.iterator + (cutlass.Int64(row) * C + c0))
+        row = row + PPL
+
+
+_bn_bwd_nhwc_kernel.set_name_prefix("cudnn", remove_cutlass_symbol=True)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _bn_bwd_nhwc_host(
+    mDY,
+    mX,
+    mDX,
+    mG,
+    mMean,
+    mRstd,
+    mP,
+    mRet,
+    mDGamma,
+    mDBeta,
+    M,
+    mparts,
+    C: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    V: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    TPP: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    PPL: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    BT: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    KC: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    KS: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    CPC: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    cblks: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    it_ty: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    et: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    Mf: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    has_beta: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    smem_bytes: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    mbpm: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    stream: cuda.CUstream,
+) -> None:
+    mDYi = cute.recast_tensor(mDY, it_ty)
+    mXi = cute.recast_tensor(mX, it_ty)
+    mDXi = cute.recast_tensor(mDX, it_ty)
+    _bn_bwd_nhwc_kernel(
+        mDYi,
+        mXi,
+        mDXi,
+        mG,
+        mMean,
+        mRstd,
+        mP,
+        mRet,
+        mDGamma,
+        mDBeta,
+        M,
+        mparts,
+        C,
+        V,
+        TPP,
+        PPL,
+        BT,
+        KC,
+        KS,
+        CPC,
+        it_ty,
+        et,
+        Mf,
+        has_beta,
+    ).launch(stream=stream, grid=(cblks, mparts, 1), block=(BT, 1, 1), smem=smem_bytes, cooperative=True, min_blocks_per_mp=mbpm)
+
+
+_KCACHE = {}
+_OCC = {}
+
+# (min_blocks_per_mp, KC regs, KS smem pixels), measured per shape on the RN50 set.
+# The backward caches TWO streams, so for a given budget each is half the forward's
+# depth -- which is why the winning configs here are shallower than the forward's.
+#   large M  -> occ=2 with a small smem cache (the slice is long, occupancy wins)
+#   small M  -> occ=1 with a 2-pixel register cache and a big L1
+_KNOB_BIG = (2, 0, 3)
+_KNOB_SMALL = (0, 2, 0)
+_BIG_M = 65536
+
+
+def _knobs_for(M, C):
+    return _KNOB_BIG if M > _BIG_M else _KNOB_SMALL
+
+
+def _smem_bytes(BT, V, CPC, KS, eb):
+    return 2 * BT * V * 4 + 2 * CPC * 4 + 2 * BT * KS * V * eb + 128
+
+
+def scratch_bytes(spec, params, shape, has_beta=False, knobs=None):
+    """Upper bound on the workspace this launch may carve.
+
+    Evaluated at the highest occupancy the cooperative probe can pick, because
+    the partial count only grows with it. Over-reporting costs address space;
+    under-reporting would push the carve back onto torch and reintroduce the
+    allocation the workspace exists to remove.
+    """
+    M, C = (int(v) for v in shape)
+    geo = nhwc_cfg(C, DTYPE_BYTES[params.io_dtype])
+    if geo is None:
+        return 0
+    V, _CPC, TPP, PPL, cblks, _BTg = geo
+    mparts = max(1, min(2 * _nsm() // max(1, cblks), (M + PPL - 1) // PPL))
+    return ws_bytes((cblks * mparts * TPP * V * 2, 4), (cblks, 4))
+
+
+def backward(spec, dy2d, x2d, gamma, saved_mean, saved_rstd, *, has_beta, cfg, params, knobs=None, out_dx=None, out_dgamma=None, out_dbeta=None, ws=None):
+    """Launch the NHWC BatchNorm backward on views of shape ``[M, C]``."""
+    import torch
+
+    M, C = int(x2d.shape[0]), int(x2d.shape[1])
+    eb = DTYPE_BYTES[params.io_dtype]
+    et = DTYPE_TO_CUTLASS[params.io_dtype]
+    it_ty = _INT_TY[eb]
+    geo = nhwc_cfg(C, eb)
+    if geo is None:
+        raise ValueError(f"NHWC BatchNorm backward: C={C} is not 128-bit tileable")
+    V, CPC, TPP, PPL, cblks, BT = geo
+
+    dx = torch.empty_like(x2d) if out_dx is None else out_dx
+    dgamma = torch.empty(C, dtype=torch.float32, device=x2d.device) if out_dgamma is None else out_dgamma
+    dbeta = torch.empty(C, dtype=torch.float32, device=x2d.device) if out_dbeta is None else out_dbeta
+
+    mbpm, KC, KS = knobs if knobs is not None else _knobs_for(M, C)
+    smem_bytes = _smem_bytes(BT, V, CPC, KS, eb)
+
+    ce = (C, V, TPP, PPL, BT, KC, KS, CPC, cblks, it_ty, et, float(M), has_beta, smem_bytes, mbpm)
+    key = (params.io_dtype,) + ce
+    okey = key + (M,)
+    occ0 = _OCC.get(okey, 2 if mbpm != 1 else 1)
+    can2 = smem_bytes * 2 <= smem_budget(224 * 1024)
+    fn = _KCACHE.get(key)
+    for occ in ([2, 1] if (occ0 == 2 and can2) else [1]):
+        mparts = max(1, min(occ * _nsm() // max(1, cblks), (M + PPL - 1) // PPL))
+        ws_reset(ws)  # this block is retried at a lower occupancy
+        pbuf = ws_empty(ws, cblks * mparts * TPP * V * 2, torch.float32, x2d.device)
+        ret = ws_zeros(ws, cblks, torch.int32, x2d.device)
+        args = (
+            dyn(dy2d),
+            dyn(x2d),
+            dyn(dx),
+            dyn(gamma),
+            dyn(saved_mean),
+            dyn(saved_rstd),
+            dyn(pbuf),
+            dyn(ret),
+            dyn(dgamma),
+            dyn(dbeta),
+            cutlass.Int32(M),
+            cutlass.Int32(mparts),
+        )
+        if fn is None:
+            fn = cute.compile(_bn_bwd_nhwc_host, *args, *ce, fake_stream())
+            _KCACHE[key] = fn
+        try:
+            fn(*args, cur_stream())
+            _OCC[okey] = occ
+            return dx, dgamma, (dbeta if has_beta else None)
+        except Exception as e:
+            if "TOO_LARGE" in str(e) and occ == 2:
+                continue
+            raise
+    return dx, dgamma, (dbeta if has_beta else None)

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+
+"""BatchNorm backward, sm_100, CUTLASS primitives.
+
+Per channel ``c`` (one CTA), with ``xhat = (x-mean)*rstd``::
+
+    dbeta_c  = sum_{n,s} dy
+    dgamma_c = sum_{n,s} dy * xhat
+    dx = gamma_c * rstd * (dy - dbeta_c/count - xhat * dgamma_c/count)
+
+Because each channel is reduced by a single CTA, ``dgamma``/``dbeta`` need no
+atomics. Reductions go through the shared ``block_reduce_sum2``
+(``SmemAllocator`` scratch). Input viewed as ``[N, C, S]``.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import cuda.bindings.driver as cuda
+import cutlass
+import cutlass.cute as cute
+from cutlass.memory import SmemAllocator
+
+from cudnn.norm.utils import cur_stream, dyn, fake_stream
+from cudnn.norm._common_sm100 import block_reduce_sum2, red_scratch_len
+
+
+@cute.kernel
+def _bn_bwd_kernel(
+    mDY: cute.Tensor,
+    mX: cute.Tensor,
+    mGamma: cute.Tensor,
+    mMean: cute.Tensor,
+    mRstd: cute.Tensor,
+    mDX: cute.Tensor,
+    mDGamma: cute.Tensor,
+    mDBeta: cute.Tensor,
+    N: cutlass.Int32,
+    S: cutlass.Int32,
+    bt: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    has_beta: cutlass.Constexpr,
+) -> None:
+    tid, _, _ = cute.arch.thread_idx()
+    c, _, _ = cute.arch.block_idx()
+    count = N * S
+    countf = cutlass.Float32(count)
+
+    smem = SmemAllocator()
+    red = smem.allocate_tensor(cutlass.Float32, cute.make_layout(red_scratch_len(bt)), byte_alignment=8)
+
+    mean = mMean[c].to(cutlass.Float32)
+    rstd = mRstd[c].to(cutlass.Float32)
+    g = mGamma[c].to(cutlass.Float32)
+
+    # --- reduce dy and dy*xhat over the channel ---
+    s_dy = cutlass.Float32(0.0)
+    s_dy_xhat = cutlass.Float32(0.0)
+    i = tid
+    while i < count:
+        n = i // S
+        s = i % S
+        x = mX[n, c, s].to(cutlass.Float32)
+        dy = mDY[n, c, s].to(cutlass.Float32)
+        xhat = (x - mean) * rstd
+        s_dy = s_dy + dy
+        s_dy_xhat = s_dy_xhat + dy * xhat
+        i = i + bt
+    s_dy, s_dy_xhat = block_reduce_sum2(s_dy, s_dy_xhat, tid, red, bt)
+
+    if tid == 0:
+        mDGamma[c] = s_dy_xhat
+        if cutlass.const_expr(has_beta):
+            mDBeta[c] = s_dy
+
+    a = s_dy / countf
+    b = s_dy_xhat / countf
+    i = tid
+    while i < count:
+        n = i // S
+        s = i % S
+        x = mX[n, c, s].to(cutlass.Float32)
+        dy = mDY[n, c, s].to(cutlass.Float32)
+        xhat = (x - mean) * rstd
+        dx = g * rstd * (dy - a - xhat * b)
+        mDX[n, c, s] = dx.to(mDX.element_type)
+        i = i + bt
+
+
+_bn_bwd_kernel.set_name_prefix("cudnn", remove_cutlass_symbol=True)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _bn_bwd_host(
+    mDY,
+    mX,
+    mGamma,
+    mMean,
+    mRstd,
+    mDX,
+    mDGamma,
+    mDBeta,
+    C: cutlass.Int32,
+    N: cutlass.Int32,
+    S: cutlass.Int32,
+    bt: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    has_beta: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    stream: cuda.CUstream,
+) -> None:
+    _bn_bwd_kernel(
+        mDY,
+        mX,
+        mGamma,
+        mMean,
+        mRstd,
+        mDX,
+        mDGamma,
+        mDBeta,
+        N,
+        S,
+        bt,
+        has_beta,
+    ).launch(stream=stream, grid=(C, 1, 1), block=(bt, 1, 1))
+
+
+_KCACHE = {}
+
+
+def backward(spec, dy3d, x3d, gamma, saved_mean, saved_rstd, *, has_beta, cfg, params, out_dx=None, out_dgamma=None, out_dbeta=None, ws=None):
+    """Launch BatchNorm backward. Returns ``(dx, dgamma, dbeta)``."""
+    import torch
+
+    dx = torch.empty_like(x3d) if out_dx is None else out_dx
+    dgamma = torch.zeros(spec.C, dtype=torch.float32, device=x3d.device) if out_dgamma is None else out_dgamma.zero_()
+    dbeta = torch.zeros(spec.C, dtype=torch.float32, device=x3d.device) if out_dbeta is None else out_dbeta.zero_()
+
+    args = (
+        dyn(dy3d),
+        dyn(x3d),
+        dyn(gamma),
+        dyn(saved_mean),
+        dyn(saved_rstd),
+        dyn(dx),
+        dyn(dgamma),
+        dyn(dbeta),
+        cutlass.Int32(spec.C),
+        cutlass.Int32(spec.N),
+        cutlass.Int32(spec.S),
+    )
+    ce = (cfg.block_threads, has_beta)
+    key = (params.io_dtype,) + ce
+    fn = _KCACHE.get(key)
+    if fn is None:
+        fn = cute.compile(_bn_bwd_host, *args, *ce, fake_stream())
+        _KCACHE[key] = fn
+    fn(*args, cur_stream())
+    return dx, dgamma, (dbeta if has_beta else None)

+"""GroupNorm / InstanceNorm backward for long rows and few rows, sm_100.
+
+:mod:`groupnorm_fast_sm100` is the good atomic-free backward, and it declines in two
+situations that together leave the worst shapes on the ORIGINAL one-atomic-per-element
+kernel at 0.00-0.01 of achievable:
+
+* **The row does not fit shared memory.** It stages the whole row so the dx pass does
+  not re-read global, which needs ``2*M*eb`` bytes -- 1.6 MB at ``M=401408``.
+* **Too few rows.** Even when it fits, ``ctas`` is capped at ``R``, so GroupNorm with
+  ``N=2, C=256, G=2`` would run 4 CTAs on 148 SMs.
+
+This kernel keeps the thing that makes the fast kernel work -- the map that fixes a
+CTA's channel set, so per-channel gradients stay register-local and no atomics are
+needed -- and relaxes both limits:
+
+* staging is **bounded**, ``KS`` vectors per thread under a byte budget, with the
+  remainder re-read in pass 2;
+* a row is split across a **cluster** of ``CGA`` CTAs along its span, with the
+  row-wide ``sum(dxhat)`` / ``sum(dxhat*xhat)`` reduced through distributed shared
+  memory.
+
+The partials layout is what lets the EXISTING finalize be reused untouched. It sums
+contributors at stride ``GPS`` over a ``[parts, CPG]`` buffer, which works because a
+CTA's group index is ``cta % GPS``. Writing partition ``p = rank * ncta_rows + cl``
+with ``ncta_rows`` a multiple of ``GPS`` preserves exactly that: ``p % GPS == cl % GPS``,
+the group of every row that cluster slot touches. Every rank of every cluster lands in
+the right residue class, so ``nparts = ncta_rows * CGA`` and nothing else changes.
+
+``CGA == 1`` is a supported configuration, not a degenerate one: it covers the
+row-too-big-but-enough-rows case, where the bounded staging alone is the fix.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import cuda.bindings.driver as cuda
+import cutlass
+import cutlass.cute as cute
+import cutlass.primitives as nvvm
+from cutlass.memory import SmemAllocator
+
+from cudnn.norm.dtypes import DTYPE_BYTES, DTYPE_TO_CUTLASS
+from cudnn.norm.utils import ws_bytes, ws_empty, ws_zeros, cur_stream, dyn, fake_stream, sm_count, smem_capacity
+
+from .groupnorm_fast_sm100 import _gn_bwd_finalize_kernel, _vec_for, red_scratch_len
+
+_CTA_SS = nvvm.SharedSpace.shared_cta
+_INT_TY = {2: cutlass.Int16, 4: cutlass.Int32}
+_FULL = 0xFFFFFFFF
+_BFLY_CLAMP = 0x1F
+_MAX_CGA = 8
+_STAGE_CAP = 64 * 1024  # bounded smem stage; ~3 CTAs/SM at this size
+_FILL_TARGET = 4
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _block_sum2(v1, v2, tid, red, bt: cutlass.Constexpr):
+    """Reduce two fp32 partials across the CTA; nvvm primitives only."""
+    nwarps: cutlass.Constexpr = bt // 32
+    warp = tid // 32
+    lane = tid % 32
+    for d in cutlass.range_constexpr(5):
+        off = 1 << d
+        v1 = v1 + nvvm.shfl_sync(_FULL, v1, off, _BFLY_CLAMP, nvvm.Shfl.BFLY)
+        v2 = v2 + nvvm.shfl_sync(_FULL, v2, off, _BFLY_CLAMP, nvvm.Shfl.BFLY)
+    if cutlass.const_expr(nwarps == 1):
+        return v1, v2
+    if lane == 0:
+        red[warp] = v1
+        red[nwarps + warp] = v2
+    nvvm.barrier_cta_sync_aligned(0)
+    a = cutlass.Float32(0.0)
+    b = cutlass.Float32(0.0)
+    for w in cutlass.range_constexpr(nwarps):
+        a = a + red[w]
+        b = b + red[nwarps + w]
+    nvvm.barrier_cta_sync_aligned(0)
+    return a, b
+
+
+def cga_cfg(spec, eb):
+    """``(V, bt, CGA, ncta_rows, PER, KS, NVS)`` or None when this does not apply."""
+    CPG = int(spec.channels_per_group)
+    SPAN = int(spec.gamma_inner_span)
+    GPS = int(spec.groups_per_sample)
+    R = int(spec.R)
+    if CPG < 1 or CPG > 1024 or SPAN < 1:
+        return None
+    V = _vec_for(SPAN, eb)
+    if V < 2 or SPAN % V:  # scalar spans keep the existing path
+        return None
+    NVS = SPAN // V
+
+    bt = min(256, max(32, ((max(1, int(spec.M) // V) + 31) // 32) * 32))
+    if bt < CPG:
+        bt = CPG
+    if bt % CPG:
+        bt = ((bt + CPG - 1) // CPG) * CPG
+    bt = min(bt, 1024)
+    if bt % 32:
+        return None
+
+    sm = sm_count()
+    ncta_rows = max(GPS, (min(_FILL_TARGET * sm, R) // GPS) * GPS)
+    if ncta_rows > R:
+        ncta_rows = max(GPS, (R // GPS) * GPS) or GPS
+    cga = 1
+    while cga < _MAX_CGA and ncta_rows * cga < _FILL_TARGET * sm:
+        cga *= 2
+    # Each rank needs real work, else the extra CTAs are only barrier participants.
+    while cga > 1 and (NVS + cga - 1) // cga < (bt // CPG):
+        cga //= 2
+    per = (NVS + cga - 1) // cga
+    ks = min(per, max(1, _STAGE_CAP // (2 * bt * V * eb)))
+    return V, bt, cga, ncta_rows, per, ks, NVS
+
+
+def eligible(spec, eb):
+    return cga_cfg(spec, eb) is not None
+
+
+def should_use(spec, eb):
+    """True only where groupnorm_fast_sm100 does badly or not at all.
+
+    Where the fast kernel applies AND has rows to work with it stays ahead -- it
+    stages the entire row, so its dx pass never returns to global. Measured on
+    1024-row shapes: 0.44 against this kernel's 0.41, and 0.36 against 0.28. So this
+    takes over only when the row will not fit that stage, or when there are too few
+    rows to fill the machine (at R=32 it is 0.33 against 0.26).
+    """
+    from .groupnorm_fast_sm100 import eligible as _fast_eligible
+
+    if not eligible(spec, eb):
+        return False
+    return (not _fast_eligible(spec, eb)) or int(spec.R) < _FILL_TARGET * sm_count()
+
+
+@cute.kernel
+def _gn_bwd_cga_kernel(
+    mDYi,
+    mXi,
+    mDXi,
+    mG,
+    mMean,
+    mRstd,
+    mDGp,
+    mDBp,
+    R: cutlass.Int32,
+    ncta_rows: cutlass.Int32,
+    M: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    V: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    CPG: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    SPAN: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    GPS: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    bt: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    CGA: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    PER: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    KS: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    NVS: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    it_ty: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    et: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    has_mean: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    has_beta: cutlass.Constexpr,
+) -> None:
+    tid, _, _ = cute.arch.thread_idx()
+    bid, _, _ = cute.arch.block_idx()
+    TPS: cutlass.Constexpr = bt // CPG  # threads per channel segment
+    Mf = cutlass.Float32(M)
+
+    smem = SmemAllocator()
+    part = smem.allocate_tensor(cutlass.Float32, cute.make_layout(2), byte_alignment=16)
+    red = smem.allocate_tensor(cutlass.Float32, cute.make_layout(red_scratch_len(bt)), byte_alignment=8)
+    seg_red = smem.allocate_tensor(cutlass.Float32, cute.make_layout(2 * bt), byte_alignment=16)
+    sX = smem.allocate_tensor(it_ty, cute.make_layout(KS * bt * V), byte_alignment=16)
+    sD = smem.allocate_tensor(it_ty, cute.make_layout(KS * bt * V), byte_alignment=16)
+
+    if cutlass.const_expr(CGA > 1):
+        rank = nvvm.cluster_ctarank()
+        cl = bid // CGA
+    else:
+        rank = cutlass.Int32(0)
+        cl = bid
+
+    seg = tid // TPS  # which channel of the group this thread serves
+    lane = tid % TPS
+    base_c = (cl % GPS) * CPG  # FIXED for this slot -- that is what kills the atomics
+    g_seg = mG[base_c + seg].to(cutlass.Float32)
+
+    v0 = rank * PER  # this CTA's vector range within one channel's span
+    v1 = v0 + PER
+    if v1 > NVS:
+        v1 = NVS
+
+    dg = cutlass.Float32(0.0)
+    db = cutlass.Float32(0.0)
+

+        s1 = cutlass.Float32(0.0)
+        s2 = cutlass.Float32(0.0)
+
+        # ---- pass 1: row-wide reduction + this thread's channel sums ----
+        kv = v0 + lane
+        ks = cutlass.Int32(0)
+        while kv < v1:
+            off = seg * SPAN + kv * V
+            rx = nvvm.load_ext(mXi.iterator + (base + off), dtype=it_ty, count=V)
+            rd = nvvm.load_ext(mDYi.iterator + (base + off), dtype=it_ty, count=V)
+            xv = rx.bitcast(et)
+            dv = rd.bitcast(et)
+            for e in cutlass.range_constexpr(V):
+                xh = (xv[e].to(cutlass.Float32) - mean) * rstd
+                dy = dv[e].to(cutlass.Float32)
+                dxh = dy * g_seg
+                s1 = s1 + dxh
+                s2 = s2 + dxh * xh
+                dg = dg + dy * xh
+                db = db + dy
+            if ks < KS:
+                nvvm.store_ext(rx, sX.iterator + (tid + ks * bt) * V, shared_space=_CTA_SS)
+                nvvm.store_ext(rd, sD.iterator + (tid + ks * bt) * V, shared_space=_CTA_SS)
+            ks = ks + 1
+            kv = kv + TPS
+
+        s1, s2 = _block_sum2(s1, s2, tid, red, bt)
+        if cutlass.const_expr(CGA > 1):
+            if tid == 0:
+                part[0] = s1
+                part[1] = s2
+            nvvm.barrier_cta_sync_aligned(0)
+            nvvm.fence_sc_cluster()
+            nvvm.barrier_cluster_arrive_aligned()
+            nvvm.barrier_cluster_wait_aligned()
+            t1 = cutlass.Float32(0.0)
+            t2 = cutlass.Float32(0.0)
+            for r in cutlass.range_constexpr(CGA):
+                peer = nvvm.mapa(part.iterator, cutlass.Int32(r))
+                t1 = t1 + peer[0]  # indexing, not load_ext: addrspace-7 pointer
+                t2 = t2 + peer[1]
+            # Peers must finish reading before the next row overwrites `part`.
+            nvvm.barrier_cluster_arrive_aligned()
+            nvvm.barrier_cluster_wait_aligned()
+            s1 = t1
+            s2 = t2
+        a = s1 / Mf
+        b = s2 / Mf
+
+        # ---- pass 2: dx, from the bounded stage where it reaches ----
+        kv = v0 + lane
+        ks = cutlass.Int32(0)
+        while kv < v1:
+            off = seg * SPAN + kv * V
+            # Both branches carry the whole body: a value assigned inside a staged
+            # `if` does not escape it, so a shared tail reading `xv` would not compile.
+            if ks < KS:
+                xv = nvvm.load_ext(sX.iterator + (tid + ks * bt) * V, dtype=it_ty, count=V, shared_space=_CTA_SS).bitcast(et)
+                dv = nvvm.load_ext(sD.iterator + (tid + ks * bt) * V, dtype=it_ty, count=V, shared_space=_CTA_SS).bitcast(et)
+                ys = []
+                for e in cutlass.range_constexpr(V):
+                    xh = (xv[e].to(cutlass.Float32) - mean) * rstd
+                    dxh = dv[e].to(cutlass.Float32) * g_seg
+                    ys.append((rstd * (dxh - a - xh * b)).to(et))
+                nvvm.store_ext(cutlass.Vector.from_elements(tuple(ys), et).bitcast(it_ty), mDXi.iterator + (base + off))
+            else:
+                xg = nvvm.load_ext(mXi.iterator + (base + off), dtype=it_ty, count=V).bitcast(et)
+                dg_ = nvvm.load_ext(mDYi.iterator + (base + off), dtype=it_ty, count=V).bitcast(et)
+                zs = []
+                for e in cutlass.range_constexpr(V):
+                    xh = (xg[e].to(cutlass.Float32) - mean) * rstd
+                    dxh = dg_[e].to(cutlass.Float32) * g_seg
+                    zs.append((rstd * (dxh - a - xh * b)).to(et))
+                nvvm.store_ext(cutlass.Vector.from_elements(tuple(zs), et).bitcast(it_ty), mDXi.iterator + (base + off))
+            ks = ks + 1
+            kv = kv + TPS
+        nvvm.barrier_cta_sync_aligned(0)
+        row = row + ncta_rows

+    # ---- flush: reduce each channel segment's TPS threads, write [parts, CPG] ----
+    # p = rank*ncta_rows + cl keeps p % GPS == cl % GPS, which is what the shared
+    # finalize relies on when it sums contributors at stride GPS.
+    seg_red[tid] = dg
+    seg_red[bt + tid] = db
+    nvvm.barrier_cta_sync_aligned(0)

+        aggb = cutlass.Float32(0.0)

+            aggb = aggb + seg_red[bt + tid * TPS + k]

+
+
+_gn_bwd_cga_kernel.set_name_prefix("cudnn", remove_cutlass_symbol=True)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _gn_bwd_cga_host(
+    mDY,
+    mX,
+    mDX,
+    mG,
+    mMean,
+    mRstd,
+    mDGp,
+    mDBp,
+    mDGamma,
+    mDBeta,
+    R,
+    ncta_rows,
+    nparts,
+    M: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    V: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    CPG: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    SPAN: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    GPS: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    bt: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    CGA: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    PER: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    KS: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    NVS: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    it_ty: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    et: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    has_mean: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    has_beta: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    nctas: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    smem_bytes: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    fbt: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    fgrid: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    stream: cuda.CUstream,
+) -> None:
+    mDYi = cute.recast_tensor(mDY, it_ty)
+    mXi = cute.recast_tensor(mX, it_ty)
+    mDXi = cute.recast_tensor(mDX, it_ty)
+    _gn_bwd_cga_kernel(
+        mDYi,
+        mXi,
+        mDXi,
+        mG,
+        mMean,
+        mRstd,
+        mDGp,
+        mDBp,
+        R,
+        ncta_rows,
+        M,
+        V,
+        CPG,
+        SPAN,
+        GPS,
+        bt,
+        CGA,
+        PER,
+        KS,
+        NVS,
+        it_ty,
+        et,
+        has_mean,
+        has_beta,
+    ).launch(stream=stream, grid=(nctas, 1, 1), block=(bt, 1, 1), smem=smem_bytes, cluster=(CGA, 1, 1))

+
+
+_KCACHE = {}
+
+
+def scratch_bytes(spec, params, shape=None, has_beta=False, knobs=None):
+    """Upper bound on the workspace this launch may carve.
+
+    Evaluated at the highest occupancy the cooperative probe can pick, because
+    the partial count only grows with it. Over-reporting costs address space;
+    under-reporting would push the carve back onto torch and reintroduce the
+    allocation the workspace exists to remove.
+    """
+    cfg = cga_cfg(spec, DTYPE_BYTES[params.io_dtype])
+    if cfg is None:
+        return 0
+    _V, _bt, CGA, ncta_rows, _PER, _KS, _NVS = cfg
+    nparts = ncta_rows * CGA
+    n = nparts * int(spec.channels_per_group)
+    return ws_bytes((n, 4), (n, 4))
+
+
+def backward(spec, dy2d, x2d, gamma, mean, rstd, *, has_beta, params, knobs=None, out_dx=None, out_dgamma=None, out_dbeta=None, ws=None):
+    """Launch the long-row / few-row GN/IN backward. Returns ``(dx, dgamma, dbeta)``."""
+    import torch
+
+    eb = DTYPE_BYTES[params.io_dtype]
+    et = DTYPE_TO_CUTLASS[params.io_dtype]
+    it_ty = _INT_TY[eb]
+    cfg = cga_cfg(spec, eb)
+    if cfg is None:
+        raise ValueError("CGA GroupNorm backward: shape not supported")

+    if knobs is not None:
+        KS = min(PER, int(knobs))
+    M = int(spec.M)
+    CPG = int(spec.channels_per_group)
+    SPAN = int(spec.gamma_inner_span)
+    GPS = int(spec.groups_per_sample)
+    R = int(spec.R)
+
+    nparts = ncta_rows * CGA
+    dx = torch.empty_like(x2d) if out_dx is None else out_dx
+    dgamma = torch.empty(spec.gamma_len, dtype=torch.float32, device=x2d.device) if out_dgamma is None else out_dgamma
+    dbeta = torch.empty(spec.gamma_len, dtype=torch.float32, device=x2d.device) if out_dbeta is None else out_dbeta
+    dgp = ws_zeros(ws, nparts * CPG, torch.float32, x2d.device)

+        mean = rstd
+

+    fgrid = (GPS * CPG + fbt - 1) // fbt
+

+        dyn(dy2d.reshape(-1)),
+        dyn(x2d.reshape(-1)),
+        dyn(dx.reshape(-1)),
+        dyn(gamma),
+        dyn(mean),
+        dyn(rstd),
+        dyn(dgp),
+        dyn(dbp),
+        dyn(dgamma),
+        dyn(dbeta),
+        cutlass.Int32(R),
+        cutlass.Int32(ncta_rows),
+        cutlass.Int32(nparts),
+    )

+    key = (params.io_dtype,) + ce
+    fn = _KCACHE.get(key)
+    if fn is None:
+        fn = cute.compile(_gn_bwd_cga_host, *args, *ce, fake_stream())
+        _KCACHE[key] = fn
+    fn(*args, cur_stream())
+    return dx, dgamma, (dbeta if has_beta else None)

+"""Host-only selection and workspace contract for dense d128 backward."""
+
+import math
+import re
+import struct
+
+ACCUMULATION = "accumulation"
+RECOMPUTE = "recompute"
+WORKSPACE_ALIGNMENT = 256
+WORKSPACE_SLACK = WORKSPACE_ALIGNMENT - 16

+
+
+def validate_dense_bounds(batch, heads, sq, skv, window_left=None):
+    """Bound dense MHA declarations before either implementation is selected."""
+    if any(type(n) is not int or n <= 0 for n in (batch, heads, sq, skv)):
+        raise ValueError("dense d128 dimensions must be positive integers")
+    if window_left is not None and (type(window_left) is not int or window_left < 0 or max(sq, skv) + window_left + 129 > 2**31 - 1):
+        raise ValueError("dense d128 sliding-window envelope exceeds safe Int32 tile rounding")
+    # The recompute body uses Int32 sequence coordinates, including the
+    # one-past-tile endpoint and ceil_div(endpoint, 128) in the causal bound.
+    if max(sq, skv) > 2**31 - 128:
+        raise ValueError("dense d128 sequence envelope exceeds safe Int32 tile rounding")
+    # Its one-dimensional grid contains both Q and KV owners. Bounding the
+    # full grid also bounds batch/head coordinates and decoder products.
+    owners = (sq + 127) // 128 + (skv + 127) // 128
+    if batch * heads * owners > 2**31 - 1:
+        raise ValueError("dense d128 launch envelope exceeds the grid or Int32 work-id range")
+    # The recompute Stats coordinates do not explicitly widen before applying
+    # their compact strides; accumulation also uses an Int32 row index.
+    if batch * heads * sq > 2**31 - 1:
+        raise ValueError("dense d128 Stats index exceeds the Int32 range")
+    # Prepared operands normalize singleton pitches to these compact BSHD
+    # strides. Every 16-bit tensor-map byte stride must be strictly below 2**40.
+    if max(sq, skv) * heads * 128 * 2 >= 2**40:
+        raise ValueError("dense d128 BSHD byte stride exceeds the tensor-map stride range")
+
+
+def _float32(value):
+    return struct.unpack("f", struct.pack("f", value))[0]
+
+
+def validate_accumulation_scale(scale):
+    """Check both FP32 scales consumed by the accumulation implementation."""
+    try:
+        if not math.isfinite(scale) or scale <= 0:
+            raise ValueError
+        rounded = _float32(scale)
+        exponent = _float32(rounded * _float32(1.4426950408889634))
+        if not math.isfinite(rounded) or rounded <= 0 or not math.isfinite(exponent) or exponent <= 0:
+            raise ValueError
+    except (TypeError, ValueError, OverflowError, struct.error):
+        raise ValueError("dense d128 accumulation requires scale and scale*log2(e) finite and positive in FP32") from None
+
+
+# Compute capabilities the accumulation chain (dense, THD and grouped) is qualified on.
+ACCUMULATION_CCS = ((10, 0), (10, 3))
+
+
+def select_implementation(cc, dsl_version, batch, heads, sq, skv, scale):
+    """Choose from plan facts; recompute stays the fallback outside the accumulation envelope.
+
+    The accumulation kernels round both sequence lengths up to whole 128-row
+    tiles: TMA zero-fills the tail loads and clips the tail stores and dQ
+    reductions, and the tail Stats rows publish -inf, so unaligned S_q / S_kv
+    take the same path as aligned ones.
+    """
+    if tuple(cc) not in ACCUMULATION_CCS or not dsl_version or dsl_version[0] != "nvidia-cutlass-dsl":
+        return RECOMPUTE
+    match = re.match(r"^(\d+)\.(\d+)\.(\d+)", dsl_version[1])
+    if match is None or tuple(map(int, match.groups())) < (4, 8, 0):
+        return RECOMPUTE
+    if any(type(n) is not int or n <= 0 for n in (batch, heads, sq, skv)):
+        return RECOMPUTE
+    # The tile rounding and the one-past-tile endpoints must stay Int32.
+    if max(sq, skv) > 2**31 - 128:
+        return RECOMPUTE
+    q_tiles, k_tiles = (sq + 127) // 128, (skv + 127) // 128
+    # Stats / delta rows are indexed over the rounded S_q; the grid holds one
+    # work item per (batch, head, KV tile).
+    if batch > 65535 or heads > 65535 or batch * heads * q_tiles * 128 > 2**31 - 1 or batch * heads * k_tiles > 2**31 - 1:
+        return RECOMPUTE
+    # The causal scheduler divides Int32 tile ids by swizzle * num_k_tiles.
+    # Use the compiled host's fixed d128, 16-bit L2 grouping for either mask.
+    heads_per_l2 = (50 * 1024 * 1024) // (sq * (128 + 128) * 2)
+    swizzle = 1 << (heads_per_l2.bit_length() - 1) if heads_per_l2 > 0 else 1
+    if swizzle * k_tiles > 2**31 - 1:
+        return RECOMPUTE
+    if max(sq, skv) * heads * 128 * 2 >= 2**40:
+        return RECOMPUTE
+    try:
+        validate_accumulation_scale(scale)
+    except ValueError:
+        return RECOMPUTE

+
+
+def workspace_layout(batch, heads, sq):
+    """Return aligned-payload-relative regions and advertised allocation bytes."""
+    if any(type(n) is not int or n <= 0 for n in (batch, heads, sq)):
+        raise ValueError("dense d128 workspace dimensions must be positive integers")
+    rounded = (sq + 127) // 128 * 128
+    dq_bytes = 4 * batch * rounded * heads * 128

+        (0, (batch, rounded, heads, 128), (rounded * heads * 128, heads * 128, 128, 1)),
+        (dq_bytes, (batch, heads, rounded), (heads * rounded, rounded, 1)),
+    )
+    total = dq_bytes + delta_bytes + WORKSPACE_SLACK
+    if total > 2**63 - 1:
+        raise ValueError("dense d128 workspace exceeds the signed pointer range")
+    return regions, total
+
+
+def validate_launch(pointers, spans, workspace, workspace_bytes, scale):
+    """Validate current addresses and scale before any of the three launches."""

+                if ptr < pointers[j] + spans[j] and pointers[j] < ptr + span:

+"""Origin-aware THD fold of compact per-Q-head dK/dV partials.
+
+The shared vector reducer owns accumulation and conversion. This module only
+maps sequence-local live rows to compact scratch and each output's independent
+ragged origin; it adds no architecture-specific instructions or repacking.
+"""
+
+import cutlass
+import cutlass.cute as cute
+
+from cudnn.frost.tile_dsl.thd import thd_port_origin
+from .bprop_chain_common import _reduce_group_vec
+
+REDUCE_THREADS = 256
+REDUCE_VECTOR = 8
+
+
+@cute.kernel
+def dkv_reduce_thd_origins_kernel(
+    dk_part: cute.Tensor,
+    dv_part: cute.Tensor,
+    dk: cute.Tensor,
+    dv: cute.Tensor,
+    meta: cute.Tensor,
+    origins: cute.Tensor,
+    n_batch: cutlass.Int32,
+    dk_origin: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    dv_origin: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    D: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    group: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    io_dtype: cutlass.Constexpr,
+):
+    """Each live 16-byte output vector has one owner; both sums are FP32."""
+    block, batch, kv_head = cute.arch.block_idx()
+    tid = cute.arch.thread_idx()[0]
+    local_vec = cutlass.Int64(block) * REDUCE_THREADS + cutlass.Int64(tid)
+    local_pos = local_vec * REDUCE_VECTOR
+    row = local_pos // D
+    col = local_pos % D
+    data = cutlass.make_array_view(meta)
+    length = cutlass.Int64(data[batch])
+    if row < length:
+        start = cutlass.Int64(data[2 * n_batch + 1 + batch])
+        h_kv = dk.shape[2]
+        h_q = dk_part.shape[2]
+        # The shared reducer decodes a compact logical [local row, KV head, D]
+        # vector. Pointer biases place that vector at each physical output's
+        # own origin and strides while its inputs retain compact KV prefixes.
+        index = ((row * h_kv + cutlass.Int64(kv_head)) * D + col) // REDUCE_VECTOR
+        k_token = thd_port_origin(origins, dk_origin, batch, start)
+        v_token = thd_port_origin(origins, dv_origin, batch, start)
+        k_bias = (
+            k_token * cutlass.Int64(dk.stride[1]) + row * (cutlass.Int64(dk.stride[1]) - h_kv * D) + cutlass.Int64(kv_head) * (cutlass.Int64(dk.stride[2]) - D)
+        )
+        v_bias = (
+            v_token * cutlass.Int64(dv.stride[1]) + row * (cutlass.Int64(dv.stride[1]) - h_kv * D) + cutlass.Int64(kv_head) * (cutlass.Int64(dv.stride[2]) - D)
+        )
+        _reduce_group_vec(
+            dk_part.iterator.raw_ptr() + start * cutlass.Int64(dk_part.stride[1]),
+            dk.iterator.raw_ptr() + k_bias,
+            index,
+            h_kv,
+            h_q,
+            D=D,
+            group=group,
+            io_dtype=io_dtype,
+            wide=True,
+        )
+        _reduce_group_vec(
+            dv_part.iterator.raw_ptr() + start * cutlass.Int64(dv_part.stride[1]),
+            dv.iterator.raw_ptr() + v_bias,
+            index,
+            h_kv,
+            h_q,
+            D=D,
+            group=group,
+            io_dtype=io_dtype,
+            wide=True,
+        )
+
+
+dkv_reduce_thd_origins_kernel.set_name_prefix("cudnn", remove_cutlass_symbol=True)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def dkv_reduce_thd_origins_host(
+    dk_part,
+    dv_part,
+    dk,
+    dv,
+    meta,
+    origins,
+    n_batch,
+    max_skv,
+    dk_origin: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    dv_origin: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    D: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    group: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    io_dtype: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    stream,
+):
+    """One fold launch; device lengths guard every input read and output write.
+
+    Partials are compact [1,T,Hq,D] and outputs [1,Tphys,Hkv,D] with unit
+    feature stride and vector-aligned token/head strides. D is shared by dK
+    and dV and divisible by eight. The output origins may differ independently.
+    """
+    blocks = cute.math.max((cutlass.Int64(max_skv) * (D // REDUCE_VECTOR) + REDUCE_THREADS - 1) // REDUCE_THREADS, cutlass.Int64(1))
+    dkv_reduce_thd_origins_kernel(dk_part, dv_part, dk, dv, meta, origins, n_batch, dk_origin, dv_origin, D, group, io_dtype).launch(
+        grid=(blocks, n_batch, dk.shape[2]), block=(REDUCE_THREADS, 1, 1), stream=stream
+    )

+# Copyright (c) 2026 NVIDIA CORPORATION & AFFILIATES. All rights reserved.
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
+"""Dense d128 backward with FP32 dQ accumulation and native dK/dV stores.
+
+The five-product pipeline retains 33 live mbarriers. Native output TMA stores
+are warp-uniform, dQ reductions elected; both return 32-lane credits.
+
+Sequence lengths need not be tile multiples: the tail Q / K / V / dO boxes
+zero-fill, the tail dK / dV stores and dQ reductions clip, the tail Stats rows
+publish -inf and the tail key rows are masked before the exponent, so every tail
+P and dS entry is exactly zero (a zero-filled key row must not exponentiate
+exp(-LSE), which overflows for a very negative LSE).
+"""
+
+from typing import NamedTuple
+
+import cuda.bindings.driver as cuda
+import cutlass
+import cutlass.cute as cute
+from cutlass._mlir.dialects import arith
+from cutlass.base_dsl.typing import Pointer
+from cutlass.experimental import primitives as nvvm
+from cutlass.experimental.cuda import tensor_map as tmap
+
+from cudnn.frost.tile_dsl.barrier import MBarrier, PipelineState, Producer, advance, named_barrier_fence
+from cudnn.frost.tile_dsl.handles import GmemTileTma, MmaDesc, SmemTile
+from cudnn.frost.tile_dsl.mma import mma_ss, mma_ts_step
+from cudnn.frost.tile_dsl.pointwise import ffma2, fmul2, fp32_to_fp16
+from cudnn.frost.tile_dsl.scheduler import Sched, read_clc_payload
+from cudnn.frost.tile_dsl.tma import tma_load_subtiles, tma_load_tile, tma_store_commit, tma_store_tile, tma_store_wait
+
+from ...config_sm100_d128_accum import BAR_LAYOUT, CFG
+
+LOG2E = 1.4426950408889634
+
+
+class Bars(NamedTuple):
+    k_empty: MBarrier
+    k_full: MBarrier
+    v_empty: MBarrier
+    v_full: MBarrier
+    do_empty: MBarrier
+    do_full: MBarrier
+    q_empty: MBarrier
+    q_full: MBarrier
+    s_done: MBarrier
+    dp_done: MBarrier
+    dq_done: MBarrier
+    dp_empty: MBarrier
+    p_ready: MBarrier
+    ds_ready: MBarrier
+    ds_smem: MBarrier
+    dq_empty: MBarrier
+    dq_full: MBarrier
+    dv_full: MBarrier
+    dk_full: MBarrier
+    dvk_empty: MBarrier
+    sched_full: MBarrier
+    sched_empty: MBarrier
+
+
+def _view(slab, offset, dtype, count, alignment=16):
+    ptr = Pointer(slab.data_ptr() + offset, dtype=dtype)
+    return cutlass.Array(ptr.ir_value(), shape=count, dtype=dtype, alignment=alignment)
+
+
+def _bars(slab):
+    kinds = {"mma": Producer.MMA_COMMIT, "tma": Producer.TMA_LOAD, "thread": Producer.THREAD}
+    return Bars(
+        *(
+            MBarrier(_view(slab, off, cutlass.Int64, slots), stages=slots, init_count=count, producer=kinds[kind], try_wait=True)
+            for _, off, slots, count, kind in BAR_LAYOUT
+        )
+    )
+
+
+def _operand(slab, offset, dtype, *, transpose=False, fp32=False):
+    box = CFG.DQ_BOX if fp32 else CFG.HEAD_BOX
+    bpe = 4 if fp32 else CFG.BPE
+    return SmemTile(
+        base=_view(slab, offset, dtype, CFG.M * CFG.D, alignment=1024),
+        elems_per_stage=CFG.M * CFG.D,
+        leading_byte_offset=CFG.M * CFG.SWIZZLE_BYTES if transpose else 16,
+        stride_byte_offset=8 * CFG.SWIZZLE_BYTES,
+        layout=CFG.SWIZZLE_LAYOUT,
+        tma_loads_per_tile=CFG.D // box,
+        tma_granu_elems=box,
+        tma_subtile_stride_elems=CFG.M * box,
+        desc_version=CFG.DESC_VERSION,
+    )
+
+
+def _mma_desc(dtype, *, atranspose=False, btranspose=False):
+    return MmaDesc(
+        M=CFG.M,
+        N=CFG.N,
+        K=CFG.D,
+        bpe_a=CFG.BPE,
+        bpe_b=CFG.BPE,
+        tile_k_hw=CFG.K_HW,
+        atranspose=atranspose,
+        btranspose=btranspose,
+        cta_group=1,
+        idesc=nvvm.Tcgen05InstrDesc.build(
+            c_dtype=cutlass.Float32, a_dtype=dtype, b_dtype=dtype, m_dim=CFG.M, n_dim=CFG.N, a_major=int(atranspose), b_major=int(btranspose)
+        ),
+        kind=nvvm.Tcgen05MMAKind.F16,
+    )
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _wait(bar, phase):
+    bar.wait(phase)
+    # All full-warp consumers reconverge before any elected credit/issue.
+    nvvm.bar_warp_sync(cute.arch.FULL_MASK)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _wait_tcgen(bar, phase):
+    _wait(bar, phase)
+    nvvm.tcgen05_fence(nvvm.Tcgen05Fence.AFTER_THREAD_SYNC)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _commit(bar):
+    if nvvm.elect_sync():
+        bar.arrive(cta_group=1)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _credit(bar):
+    if nvvm.elect_sync():
+        bar.arrive()
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _tmem_load(address, n: cutlass.Constexpr[int], dtype: cutlass.Constexpr = cutlass.Float32):
+    return nvvm.tcgen05_ld("32x32b", nvvm.make_tmem_ptr(address, dtype), num=n)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _tmem_store(address, values):
+    nvvm.tcgen05_st("32x32b", nvvm.make_tmem_ptr(address, cutlass.Int32), values)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def tma_reduce_subtile(smem_tile, gmem_slice, subtile: cutlass.Constexpr[int]):
+    """One elected source-sized FP32 add; caller owns commit and wait/credit."""
+    desc = gmem_slice.tma_desc.get_ptr()
+    coords = [gmem_slice.coord_d + cutlass.Int32(subtile * smem_tile.tma_granu_elems)] + list(gmem_slice.coords[1:])
+    src = smem_tile.base.subview(subtile * smem_tile.tma_subtile_stride_elems)
+    if nvvm.elect_sync():
+        nvvm.cp_async_bulk_tensor_reduce(desc, src, "add", coords)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _decode_flat(tile, nheads, nk, swizzle: cutlass.Constexpr[int], batch_heads: cutlass.Constexpr[int]):
+    group = tile // (swizzle * nk)
+    inner = tile % (swizzle * nk)
+    block = cutlass.Int32(0)
+    residual = cutlass.Int32(0)
+    if group < batch_heads // swizzle:
+        block = inner // swizzle
+        residual = inner % swizzle
+    else:
+        block = inner // max(batch_heads % swizzle, 1)
+        residual = inner % max(batch_heads % swizzle, 1)
+    hb = group * swizzle + residual
+    return block, hb % nheads, hb // nheads
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _next_tile(sched, bars, state, nheads, nk, causal: cutlass.Constexpr[bool], swizzle: cutlass.Constexpr[int], batch_heads: cutlass.Constexpr[int]):
+    _wait(bars.sched_full[state.idx], state.phase)
+    x, yz, valid = read_clc_payload(sched, state.idx * 8, warp_broadcast=True)
+    if cutlass.const_expr(causal):
+        block, head, batch = _decode_flat(x, nheads, nk, swizzle, batch_heads)
+    else:
+        block = x
+        head = yz & 0xFFFF
+        batch = (yz >> 16) & 0xFFFF
+    return block, head, batch, valid, advance(state, CFG.SCHED_STAGES)
+
+
+def _tensor_map(tensor, box):
+    # Logical TMA coordinates (d, sequence, head, batch), source-proved order.
+    return tmap.create_tensor_map_tiled_from_view(tensor, box_dims=(1, CFG.M, 1, box), stride_order=(3, 1, 2, 0), swizzle=tmap.TensorMapSwizzle.s128b)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _bounds(block, sq, causal: cutlass.Constexpr[bool]):
+    lo = cutlass.Int32(0)
+    if cutlass.const_expr(causal):
+        lo = block
+    return lo, (sq + CFG.N - 1) // CFG.N

+@cute.jit
+def _stats(slab, lse, delta, row, group, qbase, sq, batch, head, scale):
+    # Every one of256 lanes participates in both named barriers. Each group
+    # writes a different128-float vector, one row per lane.
+    named_barrier_fence(CFG.SOFTMAX_BARRIER, CFG.SOFTMAX_LANES)
+    idx = qbase + row
+    valid = idx < sq
+    if group == 0:
+        # Tail rows past S_q read the last Stats row (in bounds) and publish
+        # -inf: their zero-filled Q / dO columns then yield exp2(-inf) = 0.
+        clamped = cutlass.Int32(arith.select(valid.ir_value(), idx.ir_value(), (sq - 1).ir_value()))
+        val = cutlass.Float32(lse[batch, head, clamped])
+        stat = -cutlass.Float32(LOG2E) * val
+        if val == cutlass.Float32(float("-inf")):
+            stat = cutlass.Float32(0.0)
+        stat = cutlass.Float32(arith.select(valid.ir_value(), stat.ir_value(), cutlass.Float32(float("-inf")).ir_value()))
+        _view(slab, CFG.STATS, cutlass.Float32, CFG.N).subview(row).store(stat)
+    else:
+        # delta spans the rounded S_q; dot_do_o_kernel zeroes its tail rows.
+        stat = -scale * cutlass.Float32(delta[batch, head, idx])
+        _view(slab, CFG.DELTA, cutlass.Float32, CFG.N).subview(row).store(stat)
+    named_barrier_fence(CFG.SOFTMAX_BARRIER, CFG.SOFTMAX_LANES)
+

+@cute.jit
+def _p_values(slab, tmem_base, row, group, block, qtile, lo, skv, scale, causal: cutlass.Constexpr[bool], dtype: cutlass.Constexpr):
+    address = tmem_base + group * 64
+    a = _tmem_load(address, 32)
+    b = _tmem_load(address + 32, 32)
+    nvvm.tcgen05_wait(kind=nvvm.Tcgen05Wait.LOAD)
+    scores = cutlass.Vector.from_elements(tuple(a[i] for i in range(32)) + tuple(b[i] for i in range(32)), cutlass.Float32)
+    p = []
+    packed = []
+    scaled = scale * cutlass.Float32(LOG2E)
+    neg_inf = cutlass.Float32(float("-inf"))
+    kr = block * CFG.M + row
+    # The tail KV tile's zero-filled key rows (kr >= skv) must not exponentiate:
+    # exp2(-stat) overflows for a very negative LSE, and inf times their zero K
+    # would put NaN into dQ.  Only the last KV tile pays the select.
+    key_tail = (block + 1) * CFG.M > skv
+    key_valid = kr < skv
+    for chunk in cutlass.range_constexpr(16):
+        stat = _view(slab, CFG.STATS, cutlass.Float32, CFG.N).subview(group * 64 + chunk * 4).load(vector_size=4, alignment=16)
+        for pair in cutlass.range_constexpr(2):
+            i = chunk * 4 + pair * 2
+            s0, s1 = scores[i], scores[i + 1]
+            if cutlass.const_expr(causal):
+                if qtile == lo:
+                    qc = qtile * CFG.N + group * 64 + i
+                    s0 = cutlass.Float32(arith.select((kr <= qc).ir_value(), s0.ir_value(), neg_inf.ir_value()))
+                    s1 = cutlass.Float32(arith.select((kr <= qc + 1).ir_value(), s1.ir_value(), neg_inf.ir_value()))
+            if key_tail:
+                s0 = cutlass.Float32(arith.select(key_valid.ir_value(), s0.ir_value(), neg_inf.ir_value()))
+                s1 = cutlass.Float32(arith.select(key_valid.ir_value(), s1.ir_value(), neg_inf.ir_value()))
+            e0, e1 = ffma2(scaled, scaled, s0, s1, stat[pair * 2], stat[pair * 2 + 1])
+            p0 = cute.math.exp2(e0, fastmath=True)
+            p1 = cute.math.exp2(e1, fastmath=True)
+            p.extend((p0, p1))
+            packed.append(fp32_to_fp16(p0, p1, dtype=dtype))
+    _tmem_store(address, cutlass.Vector.from_elements(tuple(packed), cutlass.Int32))
+    return cutlass.Vector.from_elements(tuple(p), cutlass.Float32)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _ds_values(slab, tmem_base, group, p, scale, dtype: cutlass.Constexpr):
+    address = tmem_base + 128 + group * 64
+    a = _tmem_load(address, 32)
+    b = _tmem_load(address + 32, 32)
+    nvvm.tcgen05_wait(kind=nvvm.Tcgen05Wait.LOAD)
+    dp = cutlass.Vector.from_elements(tuple(a[i] for i in range(32)) + tuple(b[i] for i in range(32)), cutlass.Float32)
+    packed = []
+    for chunk in cutlass.range_constexpr(16):
+        stat = _view(slab, CFG.DELTA, cutlass.Float32, CFG.N).subview(group * 64 + chunk * 4).load(vector_size=4, alignment=16)
+        for pair in cutlass.range_constexpr(2):
+            i = chunk * 4 + pair * 2
+            d0, d1 = ffma2(scale, scale, dp[i], dp[i + 1], stat[pair * 2], stat[pair * 2 + 1])
+            d0, d1 = fmul2(d0, d1, p[i], p[i + 1])
+            packed.append(fp32_to_fp16(d0, d1, dtype=dtype))
+    _tmem_store(address, cutlass.Vector.from_elements(tuple(packed), cutlass.Int32))
+

+@cute.jit
+def _softmax_loop(
+    slab,
+    bars,
+    sched,
+    tmem_base,
+    lse,
+    delta,
+    block,
+    head,
+    batch,
+    sq,
+    skv,
+    nk,
+    nheads,
+    batch_heads: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    swizzle: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    scale,
+    causal: cutlass.Constexpr[bool],
+    dtype: cutlass.Constexpr,
+):
+    nvvm.setmaxregister(CFG.SOFTMAX_REGS, nvvm.SetMaxRegisterAction.INCREASE)
+    tid = cute.arch.thread_idx()[0]
+    row = tid % CFG.M
+    group = tid // CFG.M
+    state = PipelineState.start()
+    sched_state = PipelineState.start()
+    valid = cutlass.Int32(1)
+    while valid != 0:
+        if cutlass.const_expr(not causal):
+            _credit(bars.sched_empty[sched_state.idx])
+        lo, hi = _bounds(block, sq, causal)
+        if lo < hi:
+            _stats(slab, lse, delta, row, group, lo * CFG.N, sq, batch, head, scale)
+        for qtile in cutlass.range(lo, hi, 1, unroll=1):
+            _wait_tcgen(bars.s_done, state.phase)
+            p = _p_values(slab, tmem_base, row, group, block, qtile, lo, skv, scale, causal, dtype)
+            nvvm.tcgen05_wait(kind=nvvm.Tcgen05Wait.STORE)
+            nvvm.tcgen05_fence(nvvm.Tcgen05Fence.BEFORE_THREAD_SYNC)
+            bars.p_ready.arrive()
+            _wait_tcgen(bars.dp_done, state.phase)
+            _ds_values(slab, tmem_base, group, p, scale, dtype)
+            nvvm.tcgen05_wait(kind=nvvm.Tcgen05Wait.STORE)
+            nvvm.tcgen05_fence(nvvm.Tcgen05Fence.BEFORE_THREAD_SYNC)
+            bars.ds_ready.arrive()
+            if qtile + 1 < hi:
+                _stats(slab, lse, delta, row, group, (qtile + 1) * CFG.N, sq, batch, head, scale)
+            state = advance(state, 1)
+        if cutlass.const_expr(causal):
+            _credit(bars.sched_empty[sched_state.idx])
+        block, head, batch, valid, sched_state = _next_tile(sched, bars, sched_state, nheads, nk, causal, swizzle, batch_heads)
+

+@cute.jit
+def _store_words(slab, byte_offset, row, words):
+    for vec in cutlass.range_constexpr(8):
+        off = byte_offset + row * CFG.SWIZZLE_BYTES + ((row % 8) ^ vec) * 16
+        values = cutlass.Vector.from_elements(tuple(words[vec * 4 + k] for k in range(4)), cutlass.Int32)
+        Pointer(slab.data_ptr() + off, dtype=cutlass.Int32).store(values, alignment=16)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _store_dq_slice(slab, row, values, index: cutlass.Constexpr[int]):
+    for vec in cutlass.range_constexpr(8):
+        off = CFG.ALIAS + index * CFG.SLICE_BYTES + row * CFG.SWIZZLE_BYTES + ((row % 8) ^ vec) * 16
+        v = cutlass.Vector.from_elements(tuple(values[index * 32 + vec * 4 + k] for k in range(4)), cutlass.Float32)
+        Pointer(slab.data_ptr() + off, dtype=cutlass.Float32).store(v, alignment=16)

+@cute.jit
+def _native_epilogue(slab, tmem_base, bars, row, live, empty_phase, dtype: cutlass.Constexpr, dk: cutlass.Constexpr[bool]):
+    plane = 384 if cutlass.const_expr(dk) else 256
+    base = CFG.ALIAS + (CFG.OPERAND_BYTES if cutlass.const_expr(dk) else 0)
+    last_slice = 3 if cutlass.const_expr(dk) else 1
+    for half in cutlass.range_constexpr(2):
+        vals = cutlass.Vector.from_elements(tuple(cutlass.Float32(0.0) for _ in range(64)), cutlass.Float32)
+        if live:
+            vals = _tmem_load(tmem_base + plane + half * 64, 64)
+            nvvm.tcgen05_wait(kind=nvvm.Tcgen05Wait.LOAD)
+        words = cutlass.Vector.from_elements(tuple(fp32_to_fp16(vals[2 * i], vals[2 * i + 1], dtype=dtype) for i in range(32)), cutlass.Int32)
+        if cutlass.const_expr(half == 0):
+            _wait(bars.dq_empty[last_slice], empty_phase)
+        _store_words(slab, base + half * CFG.SLICE_BYTES, row, words)
+    nvvm.fence_proxy("async.shared", space="cta")
+    nvvm.tcgen05_fence(nvvm.Tcgen05Fence.BEFORE_THREAD_SYNC)
+    if cutlass.const_expr(dk):
+        bars.dk_full.arrive()
+    else:
+        bars.dv_full.arrive()
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _epilogue_loop(
+    slab,
+    bars,
+    sched,
+    tmem_base,
+    block,
+    head,
+    batch,
+    sq,
+    nk,
+    nheads,
+    batch_heads: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    swizzle: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    causal: cutlass.Constexpr[bool],
+    dtype: cutlass.Constexpr,
+):
+    nvvm.setmaxregister(CFG.EPILOGUE_REGS, nvvm.SetMaxRegisterAction.INCREASE)
+    row = cute.arch.thread_idx()[0] % CFG.M
+    ds_state = PipelineState.start()
+    dq_state = PipelineState.start()
+    empty_state = PipelineState.start()
+    sched_state = PipelineState.start()
+    valid = cutlass.Int32(1)
+    while valid != 0:
+        _credit(bars.sched_empty[sched_state.idx])
+        lo, hi = _bounds(block, sq, causal)
+        for qtile in cutlass.range(lo, hi, 1, unroll=1):
+            _wait_tcgen(bars.ds_ready, ds_state.phase)
+            ds0 = _tmem_load(tmem_base + 128, 32, cutlass.Int32)
+            ds1 = _tmem_load(tmem_base + 192, 32, cutlass.Int32)
+            nvvm.tcgen05_wait(kind=nvvm.Tcgen05Wait.LOAD)
+            _wait(bars.dq_empty[0], empty_state.phase)
+            _store_words(slab, CFG.ALIAS, row, ds0)
+            _wait(bars.dq_empty[1], empty_state.phase)
+            _store_words(slab, CFG.ALIAS + CFG.SLICE_BYTES, row, ds1)
+            nvvm.fence_proxy("async.shared", space="cta")
+            nvvm.tcgen05_fence(nvvm.Tcgen05Fence.BEFORE_THREAD_SYNC)
+            bars.ds_smem.arrive()
+            _wait_tcgen(bars.dq_done, dq_state.phase)
+            dq0 = _tmem_load(tmem_base + 128, 64)
+            dq1 = _tmem_load(tmem_base + 192, 64)
+            nvvm.tcgen05_wait(kind=nvvm.Tcgen05Wait.LOAD)
+            nvvm.tcgen05_fence(nvvm.Tcgen05Fence.BEFORE_THREAD_SYNC)
+            bars.dp_empty.arrive()
+            vals = cutlass.Vector.from_elements(tuple(dq0[i] for i in range(64)) + tuple(dq1[i] for i in range(64)), cutlass.Float32)
+            for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(4):
+                _wait(bars.dq_empty[i], empty_state.phase)
+                _store_dq_slice(slab, row, vals, i)
+                nvvm.fence_proxy("async.shared", space="cta")
+                bars.dq_full[i].arrive()
+            ds_state = advance(ds_state, 1)
+            dq_state = advance(dq_state, 1)
+            empty_state = advance(empty_state, 1)
+        if lo >= hi:
+            _wait_tcgen(bars.dq_done, dq_state.phase)
+            dq_state = advance(dq_state, 1)
+        # Observe every terminal source-credit phase before the next CLC
+        # owner bootstraps these barriers again. Native dV/dK alone wait on
+        # slices 1/3, leaving slices 0/2 unobserved after the final dQ or a
+        # zero-trip owner. Each completed mbarrier phase needs a successful
+        # wait before an arrival in its next phase.
+        for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(4):
+            _wait(bars.dq_empty[i], empty_state.phase)
+        _native_epilogue(slab, tmem_base, bars, row, lo < hi, empty_state.phase, dtype, False)
+        _native_epilogue(slab, tmem_base, bars, row, lo < hi, empty_state.phase, dtype, True)
+        empty_state = advance(empty_state, 1)
+        block, head, batch, valid, sched_state = _next_tile(sched, bars, sched_state, nheads, nk, causal, swizzle, batch_heads)
+

+@cute.jit
+def _ts(desc, plane, bdesc, dst, accum):
+    for k in cutlass.range_constexpr(CFG.D // CFG.K_HW):
+        mma_ts_step(
+            desc, nvvm.make_tmem_ptr(plane + (k // 4) * 32, cutlass.Int8), bdesc, dst, k_idx=k, accumulate=accum if cutlass.const_expr(k == 0) else True
+        )

+@cute.jit
+def _mma_loop(
+    slab,
+    bars,
+    sched,
+    tmem_base,
+    block,
+    head,
+    batch,
+    sq,
+    nk,
+    nheads,
+    batch_heads: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    swizzle: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    causal: cutlass.Constexpr[bool],
+    dtype: cutlass.Constexpr,
+):
+    nvvm.setmaxregister(CFG.SERVICE_REGS, nvvm.SetMaxRegisterAction.DECREASE)
+    score = _mma_desc(dtype)
+    grad = _mma_desc(dtype, btranspose=True)
+    dqdesc = _mma_desc(dtype, atranspose=True, btranspose=True)
+    kd = _operand(slab, CFG.K, dtype).desc()
+    vd = _operand(slab, CFG.V, dtype).desc()
+    dod = _operand(slab, CFG.DO, dtype).desc()
+    dot = _operand(slab, CFG.DO, dtype, transpose=True).desc()
+    dst = _operand(slab, CFG.ALIAS, dtype, transpose=True).desc()
+    kt = _operand(slab, CFG.K, dtype, transpose=True).desc()
+    s = nvvm.make_tmem_ptr(tmem_base, cutlass.Float32)
+    dp = nvvm.make_tmem_ptr(tmem_base + 128, cutlass.Float32)
+    dv = nvvm.make_tmem_ptr(tmem_base + 256, cutlass.Float32)
+    dk = nvvm.make_tmem_ptr(tmem_base + 384, cutlass.Float32)
+    q_state = PipelineState.start()
+    do_state = PipelineState.start()
+    kv_state = PipelineState.start()
+    ready_state = PipelineState.start()
+    dp_empty = PipelineState.start(phase=1)
+    out_empty = PipelineState.start(phase=1)
+    sched_state = PipelineState.start()
+    valid = cutlass.Int32(1)
+    while valid != 0:
+        _credit(bars.sched_empty[sched_state.idx])
+        lo, hi = _bounds(block, sq, causal)
+        if lo < hi:
+            _wait_tcgen(bars.k_full, kv_state.phase)
+            _wait_tcgen(bars.q_full[q_state.idx], q_state.phase)
+            qd = _operand(slab, CFG.Q + q_state.idx * CFG.OPERAND_BYTES, dtype).desc()
+            mma_ss(score, kd, qd, s)
+            _commit(bars.s_done)
+            _wait_tcgen(bars.v_full, kv_state.phase)
+        _wait_tcgen(bars.dvk_empty, out_empty.phase)
+        out_empty = advance(out_empty, 1)
+        for qtile in cutlass.range(lo, hi, 1, unroll=1):
+            _wait_tcgen(bars.dp_empty, dp_empty.phase)
+            _wait_tcgen(bars.do_full[0], do_state.phase)
+            mma_ss(score, vd, dod, dp, k_start=0, k_count=4)
+            _wait_tcgen(bars.do_full[1], do_state.phase)
+            mma_ss(score, vd, dod, dp, k_start=4, k_count=4, accumulate=True)
+            _commit(bars.dp_done)
+            _wait_tcgen(bars.p_ready, ready_state.phase)
+            _ts(grad, tmem_base, dot, dv, qtile > lo)
+            _commit(bars.do_empty)
+            q_next = advance(q_state, CFG.Q_STAGES)
+            if qtile + 1 < hi:
+                _wait_tcgen(bars.q_full[q_next.idx], q_next.phase)
+                qd_next = _operand(slab, CFG.Q + q_next.idx * CFG.OPERAND_BYTES, dtype).desc()
+                mma_ss(score, kd, qd_next, s)
+                _commit(bars.s_done)
+            _wait_tcgen(bars.ds_ready, ready_state.phase)
+            qt = _operand(slab, CFG.Q + q_state.idx * CFG.OPERAND_BYTES, dtype, transpose=True).desc()
+            _ts(grad, tmem_base + 128, qt, dk, qtile > lo)
+            _commit(bars.q_empty[q_state.idx])
+            _wait_tcgen(bars.ds_smem, ready_state.phase)
+            mma_ss(dqdesc, dst, kt, dp)
+            _commit(bars.dq_done)
+            q_state = q_next
+            do_state = advance(do_state, 1)
+            ready_state = advance(ready_state, 1)
+            dp_empty = advance(dp_empty, 1)
+        if lo < hi:
+            _commit(bars.k_empty)
+            _commit(bars.v_empty)
+            kv_state = advance(kv_state, 1)
+        else:
+            _commit(bars.dq_done)
+        block, head, batch, valid, sched_state = _next_tile(sched, bars, sched_state, nheads, nk, causal, swizzle, batch_heads)

+def _store_loop(
+    slab,
+    bars,
+    sched,
+    dq_desc,
+    dk_desc,
+    dv_desc,
+    block,
+    head,
+    batch,

+    dq_state = PipelineState.start()
+    out_state = PipelineState.start()
+    sched_state = PipelineState.start()
+    valid = cutlass.Int32(1)

+        for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(4):
+            bars.dq_empty[i].arrive()  # all32 lanes, one bootstrap per KV tile
+        lo, hi = _bounds(block, sq, causal)
+        for qtile in cutlass.range(lo, hi, 1, unroll=1):
+            for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(4):
