+"""Native packed THD MHA d128 backward with FP32 dQ accumulation.
+
+Sequence-local tensor maps clip every input and output tail, including caller
+ports with independent ragged origins. The dense five-product pipeline and all
+33 mbarriers retain their lane counts. Natural CLC visits a declared envelope;
+invalid owners take the complete zero-trip protocol without touching a map.
+"""
+
+from typing import NamedTuple
+
+import cuda.bindings.driver as cuda
+import cutlass
+import cutlass.cute as cute
+from cutlass._mlir.dialects import arith
+from cutlass.base_dsl.typing import Pointer
+from cutlass.experimental import primitives as nvvm
+from cutlass.experimental.cuda import tensor_map as tmap
+
+from cudnn.frost.tile_dsl.barrier import MBarrier, PipelineState, Producer, advance, named_barrier_fence
+from cudnn.frost.tile_dsl.handles import MmaDesc, SmemTile, tma_slice_runtime_desc
+from cudnn.frost.tile_dsl.mask import apply_mask_words, band_mask_words
+from cudnn.frost.tile_dsl.thd import TENSOR_MAP_QWORDS, thd_port_origin
+from cudnn.frost.tile_dsl.mma import mma_ss, mma_ts_step
+from cudnn.frost.tile_dsl.pointwise import ffma2, fmul2, fp32_to_fp16
+from cudnn.frost.tile_dsl.scheduler import Sched, read_clc_payload
+from cudnn.frost.tile_dsl.tma import (
+    tma_load_subtiles,
+    tma_load_tile,
+    tma_reduce_add_subtile,
+    tma_store_commit,
+    tma_store_tile,
+    tma_store_wait,
+    tma_tensormap_acquire,
+)
+
+from ...config_sm100_d128_accum import BAR_LAYOUT, CFG
+
+LOG2E = 1.4426950408889634
+MAP_Q, MAP_K, MAP_V, MAP_DO, MAP_DQ, MAP_DK, MAP_DV = range(7)
+MAP_COUNT = 7
+
+
+class Bars(NamedTuple):
+    k_empty: MBarrier
+    k_full: MBarrier
+    v_empty: MBarrier
+    v_full: MBarrier
+    do_empty: MBarrier
+    do_full: MBarrier
+    q_empty: MBarrier
+    q_full: MBarrier
+    s_done: MBarrier
+    dp_done: MBarrier
+    dq_done: MBarrier
+    dp_empty: MBarrier
+    p_ready: MBarrier
+    ds_ready: MBarrier
+    ds_smem: MBarrier
+    dq_empty: MBarrier
+    dq_full: MBarrier
+    dv_full: MBarrier
+    dk_full: MBarrier
+    dvk_empty: MBarrier
+    sched_full: MBarrier
+    sched_empty: MBarrier
+
+
+def _view(slab, offset, dtype, count, alignment=16):
+    ptr = Pointer(slab.data_ptr() + offset, dtype=dtype)
+    return cutlass.Array(ptr.ir_value(), shape=count, dtype=dtype, alignment=alignment)
+
+
+def _bars(slab):
+    kinds = {"mma": Producer.MMA_COMMIT, "tma": Producer.TMA_LOAD, "thread": Producer.THREAD}
+    return Bars(
+        *(
+            MBarrier(_view(slab, off, cutlass.Int64, slots), stages=slots, init_count=count, producer=kinds[kind], try_wait=True)
+            for _, off, slots, count, kind in BAR_LAYOUT
+        )
+    )
+
+
+def _operand(slab, offset, dtype, *, transpose=False, fp32=False):
+    box = CFG.DQ_BOX if fp32 else CFG.HEAD_BOX
+    bpe = 4 if fp32 else CFG.BPE
+    return SmemTile(
+        base=_view(slab, offset, dtype, CFG.M * CFG.D, alignment=1024),
+        elems_per_stage=CFG.M * CFG.D,
+        leading_byte_offset=CFG.M * CFG.SWIZZLE_BYTES if transpose else 16,
+        stride_byte_offset=8 * CFG.SWIZZLE_BYTES,
+        layout=CFG.SWIZZLE_LAYOUT,
+        tma_loads_per_tile=CFG.D // box,
+        tma_granu_elems=box,
+        tma_subtile_stride_elems=CFG.M * box,
+        desc_version=CFG.DESC_VERSION,
+    )
+
+
+def _mma_desc(dtype, *, atranspose=False, btranspose=False):
+    return MmaDesc(
+        M=CFG.M,
+        N=CFG.N,
+        K=CFG.D,
+        bpe_a=CFG.BPE,
+        bpe_b=CFG.BPE,
+        tile_k_hw=CFG.K_HW,
+        atranspose=atranspose,
+        btranspose=btranspose,
+        cta_group=1,
+        idesc=nvvm.Tcgen05InstrDesc.build(
+            c_dtype=cutlass.Float32, a_dtype=dtype, b_dtype=dtype, m_dim=CFG.M, n_dim=CFG.N, a_major=int(atranspose), b_major=int(btranspose)
+        ),
+        kind=nvvm.Tcgen05MMAKind.F16,
+    )
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _wait(bar, phase):
+    bar.wait(phase)
+    # All full-warp consumers reconverge before any elected credit/issue.
+    nvvm.bar_warp_sync(cute.arch.FULL_MASK)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _wait_tcgen(bar, phase):
+    _wait(bar, phase)
+    nvvm.tcgen05_fence(nvvm.Tcgen05Fence.AFTER_THREAD_SYNC)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _commit(bar):
+    if nvvm.elect_sync():
+        bar.arrive(cta_group=1)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _credit(bar):
+    if nvvm.elect_sync():
+        bar.arrive()
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _tmem_load(address, n: cutlass.Constexpr[int], dtype: cutlass.Constexpr = cutlass.Float32):
+    return nvvm.tcgen05_ld("32x32b", nvvm.make_tmem_ptr(address, dtype), num=n)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _tmem_store(address, values):
+    nvvm.tcgen05_st("32x32b", nvvm.make_tmem_ptr(address, cutlass.Int32), values)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _map_ptr(maps, batch, n_batch, slot: cutlass.Constexpr[int]):
+    return (maps.iterator.raw_ptr() + (cutlass.Int64(slot) * n_batch + batch) * TENSOR_MAP_QWORDS).tospace(cutlass.AddressSpace.generic)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _next_tile(sched, bars, state):
+    _wait(bars.sched_full[state.idx], state.phase)
+    x, yz, valid = read_clc_payload(sched, state.idx * 8, warp_broadcast=True)
+    return x, yz & 0xFFFF, (yz >> 16) & 0xFFFF, valid, advance(state, CFG.SCHED_STAGES)
+
+
+def _tensor_map(tensor, box):
+    # Logical TMA coordinates (d, sequence, head, batch), source-proved order.
+    return tmap.create_tensor_map_tiled_from_view(tensor, box_dims=(1, CFG.M, 1, box), stride_order=(3, 1, 2, 0), swizzle=tmap.TensorMapSwizzle.s128b)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _bounds(block, meta, batch, n_batch, causal: cutlass.Constexpr[bool]):
+    data = cutlass.make_array_view(meta)
+    q_start = cutlass.Int32(data[n_batch + batch])
+    seq_q = cutlass.Int32(data[n_batch + batch + 1]) - q_start
+    seq_k = cutlass.Int32(data[batch])
+    lo = block if cutlass.const_expr(causal) else cutlass.Int32(0)
+    hi = (seq_q + CFG.N - 1) // CFG.N
+    if block * CFG.M >= seq_k:
+        lo = cutlass.Int32(0)
+        hi = cutlass.Int32(0)
+    return lo, hi, seq_q, seq_k, q_start
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _stats(slab, lse, delta, row, group, qbase, batch, head, scale, q_start, seq_q, origins, stats_origin: cutlass.Constexpr[int]):
+    # Full 256-lane named barriers also cover inactive tail rows. Invalid rows
+    # never dereference a Stats/Delta address, including an all-empty carrier.
+    named_barrier_fence(CFG.SOFTMAX_BARRIER, CFG.SOFTMAX_LANES)
+    local_row = qbase + row
+    if group == 0:
+        stat = cutlass.Float32(0.0)
+        if local_row < seq_q:
+            token = thd_port_origin(origins, stats_origin, batch, q_start) + cutlass.Int64(local_row)
+            if cutlass.const_expr(len(lse.shape) == 2):
+                val = cutlass.Float32(lse[token, head])
+            else:
+                val = cutlass.Float32(lse[0, head, token])
+            stat = -cutlass.Float32(LOG2E) * val
+            if val == cutlass.Float32(float("-inf")):
+                stat = cutlass.Float32(0.0)
+        _view(slab, CFG.STATS, cutlass.Float32, CFG.N).subview(row).store(stat)
+    else:
+        stat = cutlass.Float32(0.0)
+        if local_row < seq_q:
+            stat = -scale * cutlass.Float32(delta[0, head, cutlass.Int64(q_start) + local_row])
+        _view(slab, CFG.DELTA, cutlass.Float32, CFG.N).subview(row).store(stat)
+    named_barrier_fence(CFG.SOFTMAX_BARRIER, CFG.SOFTMAX_LANES)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _p_values(slab, tmem_base, row, group, block, qtile, seq_q, seq_k, scale, causal: cutlass.Constexpr[bool], dtype: cutlass.Constexpr):
+    address = tmem_base + group * 64
+    a = _tmem_load(address, 32)
+    b = _tmem_load(address + 32, 32)
+    nvvm.tcgen05_wait(kind=nvvm.Tcgen05Wait.LOAD)
+    scores = cutlass.Vector.from_elements(tuple(a[i] for i in range(32)) + tuple(b[i] for i in range(32)), cutlass.Float32)
+    values = []
+    scaled = scale * cutlass.Float32(LOG2E)
+    for chunk in cutlass.range_constexpr(16):
+        stat = _view(slab, CFG.STATS, cutlass.Float32, CFG.N).subview(group * 64 + chunk * 4).load(vector_size=4, alignment=16)
+        for pair in cutlass.range_constexpr(2):
+            i = chunk * 4 + pair * 2
+            e0, e1 = ffma2(scaled, scaled, scores[i], scores[i + 1], stat[pair * 2], stat[pair * 2 + 1])
+            values.extend((cute.math.exp2(e0, fastmath=True), cute.math.exp2(e1, fastmath=True)))
+    # KV-major transpose of the shared mask band: Q columns >= key for causal,
+    # below the actual Q length, and entirely dead for a padded KV row. Select
+    # exact zero AFTER exp2 (also safe for a no-key row whose LSE is -inf).
+    key = block * CFG.M + row
+    qbase = qtile * CFG.N + group * 64
+    lo = key if cutlass.const_expr(causal) else None
+    hi = cutlass.Int32(arith.select((key < seq_k).ir_value(), seq_q.ir_value(), cutlass.Int32(0).ir_value()))
+    words = band_mask_words(lo, hi, qbase, 64)
+    p = apply_mask_words(cutlass.Vector.from_elements(tuple(values), cutlass.Float32), words, mask_value=0.0, n_cols=64)
+    packed = cutlass.Vector.from_elements(tuple(fp32_to_fp16(p[2 * i], p[2 * i + 1], dtype=dtype) for i in range(32)), cutlass.Int32)
+    _tmem_store(address, packed)
+    return p
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _ds_values(slab, tmem_base, group, p, scale, dtype: cutlass.Constexpr):
+    address = tmem_base + 128 + group * 64
+    a = _tmem_load(address, 32)
+    b = _tmem_load(address + 32, 32)
+    nvvm.tcgen05_wait(kind=nvvm.Tcgen05Wait.LOAD)
+    dp = cutlass.Vector.from_elements(tuple(a[i] for i in range(32)) + tuple(b[i] for i in range(32)), cutlass.Float32)
+    packed = []
+    for chunk in cutlass.range_constexpr(16):
+        stat = _view(slab, CFG.DELTA, cutlass.Float32, CFG.N).subview(group * 64 + chunk * 4).load(vector_size=4, alignment=16)
+        for pair in cutlass.range_constexpr(2):
+            i = chunk * 4 + pair * 2
+            d0, d1 = ffma2(scale, scale, dp[i], dp[i + 1], stat[pair * 2], stat[pair * 2 + 1])
+            d0, d1 = fmul2(d0, d1, p[i], p[i + 1])
+            packed.append(fp32_to_fp16(d0, d1, dtype=dtype))
+    _tmem_store(address, cutlass.Vector.from_elements(tuple(packed), cutlass.Int32))
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _softmax_loop(
+    slab,
+    bars,
+    sched,
+    tmem_base,
+    lse,
+    delta,
+    origins,
+    stats_origin: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    block,
+    head,
+    batch,
+    meta,
+    n_batch,
+    scale,
+    causal: cutlass.Constexpr[bool],
+    dtype: cutlass.Constexpr,
+):
+    nvvm.setmaxregister(CFG.SOFTMAX_REGS, nvvm.SetMaxRegisterAction.INCREASE)
+    tid = cute.arch.thread_idx()[0]
+    row = tid % CFG.M
+    group = tid // CFG.M
+    state = PipelineState.start()
+    sched_state = PipelineState.start()
+    valid = cutlass.Int32(1)
+    while valid != 0:
+        if cutlass.const_expr(not causal):
+            _credit(bars.sched_empty[sched_state.idx])
+        lo, hi, seq_q, seq_k, q_start = _bounds(block, meta, batch, n_batch, causal)
+        if lo < hi:
+            _stats(slab, lse, delta, row, group, lo * CFG.N, batch, head, scale, q_start, seq_q, origins, stats_origin)
+        for qtile in cutlass.range(lo, hi, 1, unroll=1):
+            _wait_tcgen(bars.s_done, state.phase)
+            p = _p_values(slab, tmem_base, row, group, block, qtile, seq_q, seq_k, scale, causal, dtype)
+            nvvm.tcgen05_wait(kind=nvvm.Tcgen05Wait.STORE)
+            nvvm.tcgen05_fence(nvvm.Tcgen05Fence.BEFORE_THREAD_SYNC)
+            bars.p_ready.arrive()
+            _wait_tcgen(bars.dp_done, state.phase)
+            _ds_values(slab, tmem_base, group, p, scale, dtype)
+            nvvm.tcgen05_wait(kind=nvvm.Tcgen05Wait.STORE)
+            nvvm.tcgen05_fence(nvvm.Tcgen05Fence.BEFORE_THREAD_SYNC)
+            bars.ds_ready.arrive()
+            if qtile + 1 < hi:
+                _stats(slab, lse, delta, row, group, (qtile + 1) * CFG.N, batch, head, scale, q_start, seq_q, origins, stats_origin)
+            state = advance(state, 1)
+        if cutlass.const_expr(causal):
+            _credit(bars.sched_empty[sched_state.idx])
+        block, head, batch, valid, sched_state = _next_tile(sched, bars, sched_state)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _store_words(slab, byte_offset, row, words):
+    for vec in cutlass.range_constexpr(8):
+        off = byte_offset + row * CFG.SWIZZLE_BYTES + ((row % 8) ^ vec) * 16
+        values = cutlass.Vector.from_elements(tuple(words[vec * 4 + k] for k in range(4)), cutlass.Int32)
+        Pointer(slab.data_ptr() + off, dtype=cutlass.Int32).store(values, alignment=16)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _store_dq_slice(slab, row, values, index: cutlass.Constexpr[int]):
+    for vec in cutlass.range_constexpr(8):
+        off = CFG.ALIAS + index * CFG.SLICE_BYTES + row * CFG.SWIZZLE_BYTES + ((row % 8) ^ vec) * 16
+        v = cutlass.Vector.from_elements(tuple(values[index * 32 + vec * 4 + k] for k in range(4)), cutlass.Float32)
+        Pointer(slab.data_ptr() + off, dtype=cutlass.Float32).store(v, alignment=16)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _native_epilogue(slab, tmem_base, bars, row, live, empty_phase, dtype: cutlass.Constexpr, dk: cutlass.Constexpr[bool]):
+    plane = 384 if cutlass.const_expr(dk) else 256
+    base = CFG.ALIAS + (CFG.OPERAND_BYTES if cutlass.const_expr(dk) else 0)
+    last_slice = 3 if cutlass.const_expr(dk) else 1
+    for half in cutlass.range_constexpr(2):
+        vals = cutlass.Vector.from_elements(tuple(cutlass.Float32(0.0) for _ in range(64)), cutlass.Float32)
+        if live:
+            vals = _tmem_load(tmem_base + plane + half * 64, 64)
+            nvvm.tcgen05_wait(kind=nvvm.Tcgen05Wait.LOAD)
+        words = cutlass.Vector.from_elements(tuple(fp32_to_fp16(vals[2 * i], vals[2 * i + 1], dtype=dtype) for i in range(32)), cutlass.Int32)
+        if cutlass.const_expr(half == 0):
+            _wait(bars.dq_empty[last_slice], empty_phase)
+        _store_words(slab, base + half * CFG.SLICE_BYTES, row, words)
+    nvvm.fence_proxy("async.shared", space="cta")
+    nvvm.tcgen05_fence(nvvm.Tcgen05Fence.BEFORE_THREAD_SYNC)
+    if cutlass.const_expr(dk):
+        bars.dk_full.arrive()

+        ds_hi = cutlass.Int32(arith.select((hi - lo > 1).ir_value(), hi.ir_value(), stream_base.ir_value()))
+    else:
+        key = owner_base + tid
+        hi = sq
+        if cutlass.const_expr(causal):
+            lo = key
+        if cutlass.const_expr(window_left > 0):
+            hi = cute.math.min(hi, key + window_left)
+        hi = cutlass.Int32(arith.select((key < skv).ir_value(), hi.ir_value(), stream_base.ir_value()))
+        ds_lo = cute.math.max(lo, cutlass.Int32(1)) if cutlass.const_expr(causal) else lo
+        ds_hi = cutlass.Int32(arith.select((skv > 1).ir_value(), hi.ir_value(), stream_base.ir_value()))
+        if cutlass.const_expr(window_left > 0):
+            # At query skv + W - 2 only the last key remains; its dS is zero.
+            ds_hi = cute.math.min(ds_hi, skv + window_left - 2)
+            if cutlass.const_expr(causal and window_left == 1):
+                ds_hi = stream_base
+    return band_mask_words(lo, hi, stream_base + col, CFG.POINTWISE_COLS), band_mask_words(ds_lo, ds_hi, stream_base + col, CFG.POINTWISE_COLS)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _probability_masked(
+    s,
+    dp,
+    stats,
+    owner_base,
+    stream_base,
+    sq,
+    skv,
+    scale,
+    causal: cutlass.Constexpr[bool],
+    q_owner: cutlass.Constexpr[bool],
+    col: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    window_left: cutlass.Constexpr[int] = 0,
+):
+    tid = cute.arch.thread_idx()[0] % CFG.TILE_M
+    if cutlass.const_expr(q_owner):
+        lse = stats.subview(tid).load()
+        delta = stats.subview(CFG.Q_STATS_DELTA + tid).load()
+    else:
+        lse = cutlass.Vector.from_elements(tuple(stats.subview(col + i).load() for i in range(CFG.POINTWISE_COLS)), cutlass.Float32)
+        delta = cutlass.Vector.from_elements(tuple(stats.subview(CFG.KV_STATS_DELTA + col + i).load() for i in range(CFG.POINTWISE_COLS)), cutlass.Float32)
+    words, ds_words = _probability_words(stats, owner_base, stream_base, sq, skv, causal, q_owner, col, window_left)
+    p = cute.math.exp2((s * scale - lse) * _LOG2E, fastmath=True)
+    p = apply_mask_words(p, words, mask_value=0.0, n_cols=CFG.POINTWISE_COLS)
+    # A row with exactly one legal key has softmax derivative exactly zero.
+    # Select zero rather than retaining dP-versus-delta reduction roundoff;
+    # P remains unchanged because that key still contributes to dV.
+    ds = apply_mask_words((dp - delta) * p * scale, ds_words, mask_value=0.0, n_cols=CFG.POINTWISE_COLS)
+    return p, ds
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _probability_full(s, dp, stats, scale, q_owner: cutlass.Constexpr[bool], col: cutlass.Constexpr[int]):
+    tid = cute.arch.thread_idx()[0] % CFG.TILE_M
+    if cutlass.const_expr(q_owner):
+        lse = stats.subview(tid).load()
+        delta = stats.subview(CFG.Q_STATS_DELTA + tid).load()
+    else:
+        lse = cutlass.Vector.from_elements(tuple(stats.subview(col + i).load() for i in range(CFG.POINTWISE_COLS)), cutlass.Float32)
+        delta = cutlass.Vector.from_elements(tuple(stats.subview(CFG.KV_STATS_DELTA + col + i).load() for i in range(CFG.POINTWISE_COLS)), cutlass.Float32)
+    # Full rectangles exclude SKV1 and causal query0, so both original
+    # masks are all-one. KV keeps its original nonfinite-LSE behavior.
+    p = cute.math.exp2((s * scale - lse) * _LOG2E, fastmath=True)
+    ds = (dp - delta) * p * scale
+    return p, ds
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _probability(
+    s,
+    dp,
+    stats,
+    owner_base,
+    stream_base,
+    sq,
+    skv,
+    scale,
+    causal: cutlass.Constexpr[bool],
+    q_owner: cutlass.Constexpr[bool],
+    col: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    window_left: cutlass.Constexpr[int] = 0,
+):
+    tid = cute.arch.thread_idx()[0] % CFG.TILE_M
+    if cutlass.const_expr(q_owner):
+        full = (owner_base + CFG.TILE_M <= sq) & (stream_base + CFG.TILE_N <= skv)
+        if cutlass.const_expr(causal):
+            full = full & (stream_base + CFG.TILE_N - 1 <= owner_base)
+        lse = stats.subview(tid).load()
+        # All32 lanes participate even on geometric tails. A sentinel in any
+        # lane sends that whole warp through the original zero-masking path.
+        lse_live = nvvm.vote_sync(cute.arch.FULL_MASK, lse != cutlass.Float32(float("-inf")), nvvm.VoteSync.ALL)
+        full = full & lse_live
+    else:
+        full = (owner_base + CFG.TILE_M <= skv) & (stream_base + CFG.TILE_N <= sq)
+        if cutlass.const_expr(causal):
+            full = full & (stream_base >= owner_base + CFG.TILE_M - 1)
+    # Seed staged-control-flow result types; both branches overwrite them.
+    p, ds = s, dp
+    if full & (window_left == 0):
+        p, ds = _probability_full(s, dp, stats, scale, q_owner, col)
+    else:
+        p, ds = _probability_masked(s, dp, stats, owner_base, stream_base, sq, skv, scale, causal, q_owner, col, window_left)
+    return p, ds
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _kv_full(owner_base, stream_base, sq, skv, causal: cutlass.Constexpr[bool], window_left: cutlass.Constexpr[int] = 0):
+    full = (owner_base + CFG.TILE_M <= skv) & (stream_base + CFG.TILE_N <= sq)
+    if cutlass.const_expr(causal):
+        full = full & (stream_base >= owner_base + CFG.TILE_M - 1)
+    return full & (window_left == 0)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _kv_probability_p(
+    s, stats, owner_base, stream_base, sq, skv, scale, causal: cutlass.Constexpr[bool], col: cutlass.Constexpr[int], window_left: cutlass.Constexpr[int] = 0
+):
+    tid = cute.arch.thread_idx()[0] % CFG.TILE_M
+    lse = cutlass.Vector.from_elements(tuple(stats.subview(col + i).load() for i in range(CFG.POINTWISE_COLS)), cutlass.Float32)
+    p = s
+    if _kv_full(owner_base, stream_base, sq, skv, causal, window_left):
+        p = cute.math.exp2((s * scale - lse) * _LOG2E, fastmath=True)
+    else:
+        words, _ = _probability_words(stats, owner_base, stream_base, sq, skv, causal, False, col, window_left)
+        p = cute.math.exp2((s * scale - lse) * _LOG2E, fastmath=True)
+        p = apply_mask_words(p, words, mask_value=0.0, n_cols=CFG.POINTWISE_COLS)
+    return p
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _kv_probability_ds(
+    dp, p, stats, owner_base, stream_base, sq, skv, scale, causal: cutlass.Constexpr[bool], col: cutlass.Constexpr[int], window_left: cutlass.Constexpr[int] = 0
+):
+    tid = cute.arch.thread_idx()[0] % CFG.TILE_M
+    delta = cutlass.Vector.from_elements(tuple(stats.subview(CFG.KV_STATS_DELTA + col + i).load() for i in range(CFG.POINTWISE_COLS)), cutlass.Float32)
+    ds = dp
+    if _kv_full(owner_base, stream_base, sq, skv, causal, window_left):
+        ds = (dp - delta) * p * scale
+    else:
+        _, ds_words = _probability_words(stats, owner_base, stream_base, sq, skv, causal, False, col, window_left)
+        ds = apply_mask_words((dp - delta) * p * scale, ds_words, mask_value=0.0, n_cols=CFG.POINTWISE_COLS)
+    return ds
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _kv_p_chunk(
+    score_base,
+    stats,
+    owner_base,
+    stream_base,
+    sq,
+    skv,
+    scale,
+    causal: cutlass.Constexpr[bool],
+    dtype: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    col: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    window_left: cutlass.Constexpr[int] = 0,
+):
+    s = tmem_load_tile(score_base + CFG.TMEM_S + col, num_elems=CFG.POINTWISE_COLS, ld_num=CFG.POINTWISE_COLS).vec
+    nvvm.tcgen05_wait(kind=nvvm.Tcgen05Wait.LOAD)
+    p = _kv_probability_p(s, stats, owner_base, stream_base, sq, skv, scale, causal, col, window_left)
+    packed_col = (col // CFG.GROUP_COLS) * CFG.GROUP_COLS + (col % CFG.GROUP_COLS) * CFG.BPE // CFG.TMEM_WORD_BYTES
+    nvvm.tcgen05_st("32x32b", nvvm.make_tmem_ptr(score_base + CFG.TMEM_S + packed_col, cutlass.Float32), p.to(dtype))
+    return p  # The original FP32 vector remains live; native conversion is a copy.
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _kv_ds_chunk(
+    score_base,
+    p,
+    stats,
+    owner_base,
+    stream_base,
+    sq,
+    skv,
+    scale,
+    causal: cutlass.Constexpr[bool],
+    dtype: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    col: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    window_left: cutlass.Constexpr[int] = 0,
+):
+    dp = tmem_load_tile(score_base + CFG.TMEM_DP + col, num_elems=CFG.POINTWISE_COLS, ld_num=CFG.POINTWISE_COLS).vec
+    nvvm.tcgen05_wait(kind=nvvm.Tcgen05Wait.LOAD)
+    ds = _kv_probability_ds(dp, p, stats, owner_base, stream_base, sq, skv, scale, causal, col, window_left)
+    packed_col = (col // CFG.GROUP_COLS) * CFG.GROUP_COLS + (col % CFG.GROUP_COLS) * CFG.BPE // CFG.TMEM_WORD_BYTES
+    nvvm.tcgen05_st("32x32b", nvvm.make_tmem_ptr(score_base + CFG.TMEM_DP + packed_col, cutlass.Float32), ds.to(dtype))
+
+
+class Bars(NamedTuple):
+    resident_full: MBarrier
+    q_stats_ready: MBarrier
+    input_full: MBarrier
+    input_empty: MBarrier
+    o_full: MBarrier
+    o_empty: MBarrier
+    stats_full: MBarrier
+    stats_empty: MBarrier
+    s_full: MBarrier
+    dp_full: MBarrier
+    p_full: MBarrier
+    ds_full: MBarrier
+    q_score_empty: MBarrier
+    q_ds_empty: MBarrier

+    out_ready: MBarrier

+    return Bars(

+        make(1, CFG.STATS_ARRIVERS, Producer.THREAD),
+        make(1, CFG.COMPUTE_ARRIVERS, Producer.THREAD),
+        make(1, CFG.ONE_LANE, Producer.MMA_COMMIT),
+        make(1, CFG.ONE_LANE, Producer.MMA_COMMIT),
+        make(1, CFG.COMPUTE_ARRIVERS, Producer.THREAD),
+        make(1, CFG.COMPUTE_ARRIVERS, Producer.THREAD),
+        make(1, CFG.COMPUTE_ARRIVERS, Producer.THREAD),
+        make(1, CFG.ONE_LANE, Producer.MMA_COMMIT),

+
+def _q_ds(slab):
+    return _operand(slab, CFG.AUX, CFG.TILE_M, cols=CFG.TILE_N)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _mma_ts_gapped(desc, plane, desc_b, dest, accumulate):
+    for k in cutlass.range_constexpr(CFG.TILE_N // CFG.TILE_K_HW):
+        # mma_ts_step adds the packed K16 stride. Shift the origin past each
+        # group gap: logical group width minus its native packed width.
+        mma_ts_step(
+            desc,
+            nvvm.make_tmem_ptr(
+                plane + (k // (CFG.GROUP_COLS // CFG.TILE_K_HW)) * (CFG.GROUP_COLS - CFG.GROUP_COLS * CFG.BPE // CFG.TMEM_WORD_BYTES), cutlass.Int8
+            ),
+            desc_b,
+            dest,
+            k_idx=k,
+            accumulate=accumulate if cutlass.const_expr(k == 0) else True,
+        )
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _issue_kv_s(slab, bars, tmem_base, input_state, full_state, dtype: cutlass.Constexpr):
+    _wait_service(bars.input_full, input_state)
+    nvvm.tcgen05_fence(nvvm.Tcgen05Fence.AFTER_THREAD_SYNC)
+    mma_ss(
+        _mma_desc(dtype),
+        _operand(slab, CFG.RESIDENT0, CFG.TILE_M).desc(),
+        _input(slab, input_state.idx, 0).desc(),
+        nvvm.make_tmem_ptr(tmem_base + CFG.TMEM_S, cutlass.Float32),
+    )
+    bars.s_full[full_state.idx].arrive(cta_group=CFG.CTA_MMA, pred=nvvm.elect_sync())
+    return advance(input_state, CFG.INPUT_STAGES), advance(full_state, CFG.SINGLE_STAGE)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _mma_kv(slab, bars, tmem_base, lo, hi, dtype: cutlass.Constexpr):
+    input_state = PipelineState.start()
+    input_empty_state = PipelineState.start()
+    s_state = PipelineState.start()
+    dp_state = PipelineState.start()
+    p_state = PipelineState.start()
+    ds_state = PipelineState.start()
+    score = _mma_desc(dtype)
+    grad = _mma_desc(dtype, gradient=True)
+    if hi > lo:
+        input_state, s_state = _issue_kv_s(slab, bars, tmem_base, input_state, s_state, dtype)
+    for tile in cutlass.range(lo, hi, 1, unroll=1):
+        mma_ss(
+            score,
+            _operand(slab, CFG.RESIDENT1, CFG.TILE_M).desc(),
+            _input(slab, input_empty_state.idx, 1).desc(),
+            nvvm.make_tmem_ptr(tmem_base + CFG.TMEM_DP, cutlass.Float32),
+        )
+        bars.dp_full[dp_state.idx].arrive(cta_group=CFG.CTA_MMA, pred=nvvm.elect_sync())
+        dp_state = advance(dp_state, CFG.SINGLE_STAGE)
+        _wait_service(bars.p_full, p_state)
+        nvvm.tcgen05_fence(nvvm.Tcgen05Fence.AFTER_THREAD_SYNC)
+        p_state = advance(p_state, CFG.SINGLE_STAGE)
+        _mma_ts_gapped(
+            grad,
+            tmem_base + CFG.TMEM_S,
+            _input(slab, input_empty_state.idx, 1, transposed=True).desc(),
+            nvvm.make_tmem_ptr(tmem_base + CFG.TMEM_G1, cutlass.Float32),
+            tile > lo,
+        )
+        if tile + 1 < hi:
+            input_state, s_state = _issue_kv_s(slab, bars, tmem_base, input_state, s_state, dtype)
+        _wait_service(bars.ds_full, ds_state)
+        nvvm.tcgen05_fence(nvvm.Tcgen05Fence.AFTER_THREAD_SYNC)
+        ds_state = advance(ds_state, CFG.SINGLE_STAGE)
+        _mma_ts_gapped(
+            grad,
+            tmem_base + CFG.TMEM_DP,
+            _input(slab, input_empty_state.idx, 0, transposed=True).desc(),
+            nvvm.make_tmem_ptr(tmem_base + CFG.TMEM_G0, cutlass.Float32),
+            tile > lo,
+        )
+        bars.input_empty[input_empty_state.idx].arrive(cta_group=CFG.CTA_MMA, pred=nvvm.elect_sync())
+        input_empty_state = advance(input_empty_state, CFG.INPUT_STAGES)
+    if hi > lo:
+        bars.final_grad.arrive(cta_group=CFG.CTA_MMA, pred=nvvm.elect_sync())
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _mma_q(slab, bars, tmem_base, lo, hi, dtype: cutlass.Constexpr):
+    input_state = PipelineState.start()
+    input_empty_state = PipelineState.start()
+    empty_state = PipelineState.start(phase=1)
+    s_state = PipelineState.start()
+    ds_state = PipelineState.start()
+    ds_empty_state = PipelineState.start()
+    score = _mma_desc(dtype)
+    grad = _mma_desc(dtype, gradient=True)
+    for tile in cutlass.range(lo, hi, 1, unroll=1):
+        _wait_service(bars.input_full, input_state)
+        _wait_service(bars.q_score_empty, empty_state)
+        nvvm.tcgen05_fence(nvvm.Tcgen05Fence.AFTER_THREAD_SYNC)
+        mma_ss(
+            score,
+            _operand(slab, CFG.RESIDENT0, CFG.TILE_M).desc(),
+            _input(slab, input_state.idx, 0).desc(),
+            nvvm.make_tmem_ptr(tmem_base + CFG.TMEM_S, cutlass.Float32),
+        )
+        mma_ss(
+            score,
+            _operand(slab, CFG.RESIDENT1, CFG.TILE_M).desc(),
+            _input(slab, input_state.idx, 1).desc(),
+            nvvm.make_tmem_ptr(tmem_base + CFG.TMEM_DP, cutlass.Float32),
+        )
+        bars.s_full[s_state.idx].arrive(cta_group=CFG.CTA_MMA, pred=nvvm.elect_sync())
+        input_state = advance(input_state, CFG.INPUT_STAGES)
+        empty_state = advance(empty_state, CFG.SINGLE_STAGE)
+        s_state = advance(s_state, CFG.SINGLE_STAGE)
+        _wait_service(bars.ds_full, ds_state)
+        nvvm.tcgen05_fence(nvvm.Tcgen05Fence.AFTER_THREAD_SYNC)
+        mma_ss(
+            grad,
+            _q_ds(slab).desc(),
+            _input(slab, input_empty_state.idx, 0, transposed=True).desc(),
+            nvvm.make_tmem_ptr(tmem_base + CFG.TMEM_G0, cutlass.Float32),
+            accumulate=tile > lo,
+        )
+        bars.input_empty[input_empty_state.idx].arrive(cta_group=CFG.CTA_MMA, pred=nvvm.elect_sync())
+        bars.q_ds_empty[ds_empty_state.idx].arrive(cta_group=CFG.CTA_MMA, pred=nvvm.elect_sync())
+        ds_state = advance(ds_state, CFG.SINGLE_STAGE)
+        input_empty_state = advance(input_empty_state, CFG.INPUT_STAGES)
+        ds_empty_state = advance(ds_empty_state, CFG.SINGLE_STAGE)
+    if hi > lo:
+        bars.final_grad.arrive(cta_group=CFG.CTA_MMA, pred=nvvm.elect_sync())
+    _wait_service(bars.q_score_empty, empty_state)
+    empty_state = advance(empty_state, CFG.SINGLE_STAGE)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _stage_gradient(tmem_base, tmem_offset: cutlass.Constexpr[int], smem, live, dtype: cutlass.Constexpr, group: cutlass.Constexpr[int]):
+    # The second score group still participates in every readiness barrier,
+    # but D64 has no second 64-column gradient slab to read or store.
+    if cutlass.const_expr(group * CFG.GROUP_COLS < CFG.HEAD_DIM):
+        row = cute.arch.thread_idx()[0] % CFG.TILE_M
+        values = cutlass.Vector.from_elements(tuple(cutlass.Float32(0.0) for _ in range(CFG.GROUP_COLS)), cutlass.Float32)
+        if live:
+            values = tmem_load_tile(tmem_base + tmem_offset + group * CFG.GROUP_COLS, num_elems=CFG.GROUP_COLS).vec
+            nvvm.tcgen05_wait(kind=nvvm.Tcgen05Wait.LOAD)
+        smem.base.subview(group * CFG.TILE_M * CFG.GROUP_COLS + row * CFG.GROUP_COLS).data_ptr().store_swizzled(
+            values.to(dtype), alignment=128, swizzle=_SWIZZLE
+        )
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _compute_kv(
+    slab,
+    stats,
+    bars,
+    tmem_base,
+    owner_base,
+    lo,
+    hi,
+    sq,
+    skv,
+    scale,
+    causal: cutlass.Constexpr[bool],
+    dtype: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    group: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    window_left: cutlass.Constexpr[int] = 0,
+):
+    s_state = PipelineState.start()
+    dp_state = PipelineState.start()
+    stats_full_state = PipelineState.start()
+    stats_empty_state = PipelineState.start()
+    p_state = PipelineState.start()
+    ds_state = PipelineState.start()
+    for tile in cutlass.range(lo, hi, 1, unroll=1):
+        bars.s_full[s_state.idx].wait(s_state.phase)
+        bars.stats_full[stats_full_state.idx].wait(stats_full_state.phase)
+        nvvm.tcgen05_fence(nvvm.Tcgen05Fence.AFTER_THREAD_SYNC)
+        p0 = _kv_p_chunk(tmem_base, stats, owner_base, tile * CFG.TILE_N, sq, skv, scale, causal, dtype, group * CFG.GROUP_COLS, window_left)
+        p1 = _kv_p_chunk(
+            tmem_base, stats, owner_base, tile * CFG.TILE_N, sq, skv, scale, causal, dtype, group * CFG.GROUP_COLS + CFG.POINTWISE_COLS, window_left
+        )
+        nvvm.tcgen05_wait(kind=nvvm.Tcgen05Wait.STORE)
+        nvvm.tcgen05_fence(nvvm.Tcgen05Fence.BEFORE_THREAD_SYNC)
+        bars.p_full[p_state.idx].arrive()
+        bars.dp_full[dp_state.idx].wait(dp_state.phase)
+        nvvm.tcgen05_fence(nvvm.Tcgen05Fence.AFTER_THREAD_SYNC)
+        _kv_ds_chunk(tmem_base, p0, stats, owner_base, tile * CFG.TILE_N, sq, skv, scale, causal, dtype, group * CFG.GROUP_COLS, window_left)
+        _kv_ds_chunk(
+            tmem_base, p1, stats, owner_base, tile * CFG.TILE_N, sq, skv, scale, causal, dtype, group * CFG.GROUP_COLS + CFG.POINTWISE_COLS, window_left
+        )
+        nvvm.tcgen05_wait(kind=nvvm.Tcgen05Wait.STORE)
+        nvvm.tcgen05_fence(nvvm.Tcgen05Fence.BEFORE_THREAD_SYNC)
+        bars.stats_empty[stats_empty_state.idx].arrive()
+        bars.ds_full[ds_state.idx].arrive()
+        s_state = advance(s_state, CFG.SINGLE_STAGE)
+        dp_state = advance(dp_state, CFG.SINGLE_STAGE)
+        stats_full_state = advance(stats_full_state, CFG.SINGLE_STAGE)
+        stats_empty_state = advance(stats_empty_state, CFG.SINGLE_STAGE)
+        p_state = advance(p_state, CFG.SINGLE_STAGE)
+        ds_state = advance(ds_state, CFG.SINGLE_STAGE)
+    if hi > lo:
+        bars.final_grad.wait(PipelineState.start().phase)
+        nvvm.tcgen05_fence(nvvm.Tcgen05Fence.AFTER_THREAD_SYNC)

+    nvvm.barrier_cta_sync()

+            do128,
+            o128,
+            k64,
+            v64,
+            dq,
+            dv,
+            lse,
+            slab,
+            stats,
+            bars,
+            tmem_base,

+            head,
+            sq,
+            skv,
+            scale,
+            causal,

+            v128,
+            o64,
+            q64,
+            do64,

+            head,
+            sq,
+            skv,
+            scale,
+            causal,

+Both launches cover dQ's 128-row-rounded sequence: tail rows past S_q zero

+def dot_do_o_kernel(o: cute.Tensor, do: cute.Tensor, delta: cute.Tensor, dq_accum: cute.Tensor, dot_factor: cutlass.Float32):

+    block, batch, head = cute.arch.block_idx()

+    dq_offset = (
+        cutlass.Int64(batch) * cutlass.Int64(dq_accum.stride[0])
+        + row * cutlass.Int64(dq_accum.stride[1])
+        + cutlass.Int64(head) * cutlass.Int64(dq_accum.stride[2])
+        + column
+    )
+    o_offset = (
+        cutlass.Int64(batch) * cutlass.Int64(o.stride[0]) + io_row * cutlass.Int64(o.stride[1]) + cutlass.Int64(head) * cutlass.Int64(o.stride[2]) + column
+    )
+    do_offset = (
+        cutlass.Int64(batch) * cutlass.Int64(do.stride[0]) + io_row * cutlass.Int64(do.stride[1]) + cutlass.Int64(head) * cutlass.Int64(do.stride[2]) + column
+    )
+    delta_offset = (

+    (dq_accum.iterator.raw_ptr() + dq_offset + 4).store(zero4, alignment=16)
+    do_values = (do.iterator.raw_ptr() + do_offset).load(count=ELEMENTS_PER_LANE, alignment=16)
+    o_values = (o.iterator.raw_ptr() + o_offset).load(count=ELEMENTS_PER_LANE, alignment=16)
+    pairs = []
+    for j in cutlass.range_constexpr(ELEMENTS_PER_LANE // 2):
+        high = cute.math.mul(do_values[2 * j + 1].to(cutlass.Float32), o_values[2 * j + 1].to(cutlass.Float32), rounding=RN, ftz=True)
+        pairs.append(cute.math.fma(do_values[2 * j].to(cutlass.Float32), o_values[2 * j].to(cutlass.Float32), high, rounding=RN, ftz=True))
+    dot = cute.math.add(pairs[0], pairs[1], rounding=RN, ftz=True)
+    dot = cute.math.add(dot, pairs[2], rounding=RN, ftz=True)
+    dot = cute.math.add(dot, pairs[3], rounding=RN, ftz=True)
+    for step in cutlass.range_constexpr(4):
+        peer = nvvm.shfl_sync(thread_mask=0xFFFFFFFF, val=dot, offset=1 << (3 - step), mask_and_clamp=0x1F, kind=nvvm.Shfl.BFLY)
+        dot = cute.math.add(dot, peer, rounding=RN, ftz=True)
+    dot = cute.math.mul(dot, dot_factor, rounding=RN, ftz=True)
+    dot = cutlass.Float32(arith.select(valid.ir_value(), dot.ir_value(), cutlass.Float32(0.0).ir_value()))
+    if tid % LANES_PER_ROW == 0:
+        (delta.iterator.raw_ptr() + delta_offset).store(dot)
+
+
+dot_do_o_kernel.set_name_prefix("cudnn", remove_cutlass_symbol=True)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def delta_zero_host(o: cute.Tensor, do: cute.Tensor, delta: cute.Tensor, dq_accum: cute.Tensor, stream: cuda_driver.CUstream):
+    """One dense no-dropout launch over dQ's rounded rows (a multiple of 128)."""
+    dot_do_o_kernel(o, do, delta, dq_accum, cutlass.Float32(1.0)).launch(
+        grid=(dq_accum.shape[1] // ROWS_PER_CTA, o.shape[0], o.shape[2]), block=(THREADS, 1, 1), stream=stream
+    )
+
+
+@cute.kernel
+def cast_dq_d128_kernel(dq_accum: cute.Tensor, dq_out: cute.Tensor, io_dtype: cutlass.Constexpr):
+    """Convert eight FP32 elements per lane without rescaling."""
+    block, batch, head = cute.arch.block_idx()
+    tid, _, _ = cute.arch.thread_idx()
+    row = cutlass.Int64(block) * ROWS_PER_CTA + cutlass.Int64(tid // LANES_PER_ROW)
+    column = cutlass.Int64(tid % LANES_PER_ROW) * ELEMENTS_PER_LANE
+    src_offset = (
+        cutlass.Int64(batch) * cutlass.Int64(dq_accum.stride[0])
+        + row * cutlass.Int64(dq_accum.stride[1])
+        + cutlass.Int64(head) * cutlass.Int64(dq_accum.stride[2])
+        + column
+    )
+    dst_offset = (
+        cutlass.Int64(batch) * cutlass.Int64(dq_out.stride[0])
+        + row * cutlass.Int64(dq_out.stride[1])
+        + cutlass.Int64(head) * cutlass.Int64(dq_out.stride[2])
+        + column
+    )
+    # The accumulator holds the rounded rows, so the load stays in bounds; only
+    # the output store skips the tail past S_q.
+    lo = (dq_accum.iterator.raw_ptr() + src_offset).load(count=4, alignment=16)
+    hi = (dq_accum.iterator.raw_ptr() + src_offset + 4).load(count=4, alignment=16)
+    packed = cutlass.Vector.from_elements(
+        (
+            fp32_to_fp16(lo[0], lo[1], dtype=io_dtype),
+            fp32_to_fp16(lo[2], lo[3], dtype=io_dtype),
+            fp32_to_fp16(hi[0], hi[1], dtype=io_dtype),
+            fp32_to_fp16(hi[2], hi[3], dtype=io_dtype),
+        ),
+        cutlass.Int32,
+    )
+    if row < cutlass.Int64(dq_out.shape[1]):
+        Pointer(cutlass.make_array_view(dq_out).data_ptr() + dst_offset, dtype=cutlass.Int32).store(packed, alignment=16)
+
+
+cast_dq_d128_kernel.set_name_prefix("cudnn", remove_cutlass_symbol=True)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def cast_dq_host(dq_accum: cute.Tensor, dq_out: cute.Tensor, io_dtype: cutlass.Constexpr, stream: cuda_driver.CUstream):
+    """One native vector cast launch; output rows must be 16-byte aligned."""
+    cast_dq_d128_kernel(dq_accum, dq_out, io_dtype).launch(
+        grid=((dq_out.shape[1] + ROWS_PER_CTA - 1) // ROWS_PER_CTA, dq_out.shape[0], dq_out.shape[2]), block=(THREADS, 1, 1), stream=stream
+    )

+def _scratch(payload: cutlass.Int64, region: cutlass.Constexpr):
+    offset, shape, strides = region
+    pointer = cute.make_ptr(cutlass.Float32, payload + cutlass.Int64(offset), cute.AddressSpace.gmem, assumed_align=256)
+    return _view(pointer, (shape, strides))

+    k_ptr: cute.Pointer,
+    v_ptr: cute.Pointer,

+    lse_ptr: cute.Pointer,
+    dq_ptr: cute.Pointer,
+    dk_ptr: cute.Pointer,
+    dv_ptr: cute.Pointer,

+    v = _view(v_ptr, geometry[2])
+    o = _view(o_ptr, geometry[3])
+    do = _view(do_ptr, geometry[4])
+    lse = _view(lse_ptr, geometry[5])
+    dq = _view(dq_ptr, geometry[6])
+    dk = _view(dk_ptr, geometry[7])

+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright (c) 2026 NVIDIA CORPORATION & AFFILIATES. All rights reserved.
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""Pointer entry for the single-launch dense d128 backward kernel."""
+
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import cutlass
+import cutlass.cute as cute
+from cuda.bindings import driver
+
+from cudnn.frost.compiled_cache import compile_cached
+from cudnn.frost.template_loader import load_template
+
+from cudnn.sdpa.bwd.kernels.sm100.bprop_d128_f16 import host as tensor_host
+
+HEAD_DIM = globals().get("FROST_TEMPLATE_PARAMS", 128)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def host(
+    q_ptr: cute.Pointer,
+    k_ptr: cute.Pointer,
+    v_ptr: cute.Pointer,
+    o_ptr: cute.Pointer,
+    do_ptr: cute.Pointer,
+    lse_ptr: cute.Pointer,
+    dq_ptr: cute.Pointer,
+    dk_ptr: cute.Pointer,
+    dv_ptr: cute.Pointer,
+    workspace: cutlass.Int64,
+    scale: cutlass.Float32,
+    geometry: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    causal: cutlass.Constexpr[bool],
+    stream: driver.CUstream,
+    window_left: cutlass.Constexpr[int] = 0,
+):
+    # The shared backward binder carries a workspace address even for a plan
+    # requiring zero bytes. This unused scalar accepts a null address.
+    q = cute.make_tensor(q_ptr, cute.make_layout(geometry[0][0], stride=geometry[0][1]))
+    k = cute.make_tensor(k_ptr, cute.make_layout(geometry[1][0], stride=geometry[1][1]))
+    v = cute.make_tensor(v_ptr, cute.make_layout(geometry[2][0], stride=geometry[2][1]))
+    o = cute.make_tensor(o_ptr, cute.make_layout(geometry[3][0], stride=geometry[3][1]))
+    do = cute.make_tensor(do_ptr, cute.make_layout(geometry[4][0], stride=geometry[4][1]))
+    lse = cute.make_tensor(lse_ptr, cute.make_layout(geometry[5][0], stride=geometry[5][1]))
+    dq = cute.make_tensor(dq_ptr, cute.make_layout(geometry[6][0], stride=geometry[6][1]))
+    dk = cute.make_tensor(dk_ptr, cute.make_layout(geometry[7][0], stride=geometry[7][1]))
+    dv = cute.make_tensor(dv_ptr, cute.make_layout(geometry[8][0], stride=geometry[8][1]))
+    tensor_host(q, k, v, o, do, lse, dq, dk, dv, scale, causal, stream, window_left)
+
+
+def compile_host(geometry, dtype, causal, sm, window_left=0):
+    """Compile only plan-time geometry; bind storage and scale at execution."""
+    global tensor_host
+    head_dim = geometry[0][0][3]
+    if head_dim == 64 and HEAD_DIM != 64:
+        module = load_template(__file__, 64, tag="sdpa_bwd_d64_host")
+        return module.compile_host(geometry, dtype, causal, sm, window_left)
+    if head_dim != HEAD_DIM:
+        raise ValueError("prepared backward head dimension does not match the kernel specialization")
+    if HEAD_DIM == 64:
+        # Load after this specialized module is initialized: load_template
+        # holds a non-reentrant lock while executing module-level code.
+        # Each host module is fixed to one width, so this assignment is invariant.
+        tensor_host = load_template(str(Path(__file__).with_name("bprop_d128_f16.py")), 64, tag="sdpa_bwd_d64").host
+    types = [dtype] * 5 + [cutlass.Float32] + [dtype] * 3
+    args = [cute.runtime.make_ptr(t, 16, cute.AddressSpace.gmem, assumed_align=4 if i == 5 else 16) for i, t in enumerate(types)]
+    return compile_cached(
+        host,
+        *args,
+        cutlass.Int64(0),
+        cutlass.Float32(1),
+        geometry,
+        bool(causal),
+        cute.runtime.make_fake_stream(use_tvm_ffi_env_stream=False),
+        int(window_left),
+        options=f"--enable-tvm-ffi --gpu-arch sm_{sm}a",
+        cache_key=repr(("sdpa_bwd_sm100_d128", geometry, str(dtype), bool(causal), sm, int(window_left), HEAD_DIM)),
+        symbol="frost_sdpa_bwd_sm100_d128_prepared",
+    )

+"""Graphs the SDPA-forward family keeps away from the cuDNN backend's planner
+(``cudnn.engines.manifest.EngineFamily.backend_guard``).

+One documented defect: on cc 10.7 the backend kills the process while planning or building a block-scale MXFP8
+(``sdpa_mxfp8``) forward graph with a single query row and no sink token.  Measured on cuDNN 9.26.0.51 and 9.27.0.28
+over the 21-contract trigger matrix of the detector named below: the heuristics SIGSEGV on every d128 contract (dense
+BSHD and BHSD, THD (ragged) queries, Stats on or off, batch 1 / 2 / 4 and one head, KV length 128 / 2048 / 4096, no
+mask or a causal top-left / bottom-right band, bf16 / f16 / E4M3 / E5M2 O, E4M3 and E5M2 inputs), while the d192x128 /
+d256 / d512 contracts never reach the crash (the backend's engine-config step declines them with "No valid engine
+configs" and the row plans alone).  On cuDNN 9.28.0 (the cc 10.7 CI lane) the heuristics plan every contract, and
+building the backend's plan for the BHSD single-query graph killed the test process instead -- the crash moved from

+    stride; Q/K/O use the full-tile inner extent."""
+    inner = (tile_o // cta_mma) * bpe_val

+        return 128
+    if inner % 64 == 0:
+        return 64
+    if inner % 32 == 0:
+        return 32
+    raise ValueError(f"V inner bytes {inner} is not a multiple of 32/64/128")

+def o_swz_bytes(tile_o: int, bpe_o: int, pack_div: int = 1) -> int:
+    return 128 if (tile_o * bpe_o // pack_div) % 128 == 0 else 64

+def sdpa_smem_bytes(
+    tile_m: int,
+    tile_n: int,
+    tile_k: int,
+    tile_o: int,
+    tiles_q: int,
+    stages_kv: int,
+    cta_mma: int,
+    bpe_qkv: int,
+    bpe_o: int,
+    qo_alias: bool = False,
+    gate_bpe: int = 0,
+    sf_bytes: int = 0,

+    """Q/K/V/O (+ GATE) (+ MXFP8 scale-factor slabs) SMEM footprint for the
+    classic prefill pipeline.
+
+    K (seq rows) and V (d_v cols) shrink by CTA_MMA; Q/O are per-CTA full.
+    ``qo_alias`` = O reuses Q's slab in the epilogue (max instead of sum).
+    ``gate_bpe`` = bytes per element of the fused epilogue gate's staging tile
+    (0 = no gate).  The gate tile is one O-shaped slab per CTA -- full TILE_O
+    width and NOT divided by CTA_MMA, because under cga2 each CTA of the pair
+    owns a distinct 128-row Q block and gates its own full-width O rows.
+    ``sf_bytes`` = the block-scale kernels' scale-factor slabs (Q, K ring, P,
+    V ring; ``d256_mxfp8_sf_smem_bytes``), 0 on the f16 / per-tensor kernels.
+    """
+    s_q = tiles_q * (tile_m * tile_k) * bpe_qkv
+    s_o = tiles_q * (tile_m * tile_o) * bpe_o
+    s_k = stages_kv * (tile_n * tile_k // cta_mma) * bpe_qkv
+    s_v = stages_kv * (tile_o * tile_n // cta_mma) * bpe_qkv
+    s_gate = tiles_q * (tile_m * tile_o) * gate_bpe

+    engine row, the heuristics and the adapter (rule 8b')."""
+    return int(bias_batch_extent) == 1 and int(b_flat) >= 2 and int(cta_mma) == 1

+    tile_k: int,
+    cta_mma: int,
+    *,
+    stages_kv: int,
+    tile_m: int,
+    bpe_val: int = 2,
+    tile_n: int = 128,
+    tiles_q: int = 2,
+    pair: bool = False,
+    qo_alias: bool = False,
+) -> int:
+    """How many ``tile_n``-column bias tiles (``BIAS_BLOCK_ROWS x tile_n`` elements each) the arch's carveout holds beside
+    the d128 family's Q / O slabs and K / V rings at ``tile_k = tile_o``, the given ring depth and Q tile height -- the SAME
+    budget :func:`validate_smem` enforces (``arch.smem_usable_bytes`` minus ``arch.smem_fixed_overhead``).  0 = no resident
+    block fits.  Derived, never a literal.  Rubin at 4 stages: 3 at the 32-wide tile (cga1), 1 / 2 at the 64-wide one (cga1 /
+    cga2), 0 at d128 on the 256-row item; the PAIR item's 128-row block holds twice as many -- 6 / 3.  SM100 (227 KiB) at 4
+    stages: 2 / 4 (one-batch-entry / pair) at the 32-wide tile, **0 at the 64-wide tile's cga1 on either item** (its 192 KiB of
+    operands leave no 32 KiB tile), 1 at its cga2 one-batch-entry item -- the arch is a parameter so that the SM100 numbers come
+    out of the arithmetic and never out of a Rubin threshold."""
+    operands = sdpa_smem_bytes(tile_m, tile_n, tile_k, tile_k, tiles_q, stages_kv, cta_mma, bpe_val, bpe_val, qo_alias=qo_alias)
+    spare = arch.smem_usable_bytes - arch.smem_fixed_overhead - operands
+    tile_bytes = bias_block_rows(tiles_q, tile_m, pair=pair) * tile_n * bpe_val
+    return max(0, spare // tile_bytes)
+
+
+def bias_ring_stages(
+    arch: D128FamilyArch,
+    tile_k: int,
+    cta_mma: int,
+    *,
+    stages_kv: int,
+    tile_m: int,
+    bpe_val: int = 2,
+    tile_n: int = 128,
+    tiles_q: int = 2,
+    pair: bool = False,
+    qo_alias: bool = False,
+) -> int:
+    """The deepest STREAMED bias ring (``BIAS_MODE_STREAMED``) the arch's carveout holds beside the operands at this width:
+    ``min(max(BIAS_RING_STAGES), spare // tile_bytes)`` in whole ``BIAS_BLOCK_ROWS x tile_n`` tiles, **0 when fewer than
+    ``min(BIAS_RING_STAGES)`` fit** (no ring).  The SAME spare the resident budget reads (one arithmetic, rule 8b')."""
+    tiles = bias_resident_tiles(
+        arch, tile_k, cta_mma, stages_kv=stages_kv, tile_m=tile_m, bpe_val=bpe_val, tile_n=tile_n, tiles_q=tiles_q, pair=pair, qo_alias=qo_alias
+    )
+    stages = min(max(BIAS_RING_STAGES), tiles)
+    return stages if stages >= min(BIAS_RING_STAGES) else 0
+
+
+def operand_region_end_bytes(cfg) -> int:
+    """Where the descriptor-fed region of a d128-family kernel ENDS: sQ, sO, sK, sV in the body's declaration order, each a
+    1024-B-aligned slab -- the roots every tcgen05 SMEM descriptor is built from.  The bias block that lanes read directly is declared
+    AFTER them, so with this below ``TCGEN05_V0_ADDR_LIMIT`` every descriptor root stays inside the version-0 window
+    whatever the block's size (the block itself may sit past 256 KiB: no descriptor touches it)."""
+    s_q = _align_slab(cfg.TILES_Q * cfg.TILE_M * cfg.TILE_K * cfg.BPE)
+    s_o = _align_slab(cfg.TILES_Q * cfg.TILE_M * cfg.TILE_O * cfg.BPE_O)
+    s_k = _align_slab(cfg.STAGES_KV * (cfg.TILE_N * cfg.TILE_K // cfg.CTA_MMA) * cfg.BPE)
+    s_v = _align_slab(cfg.STAGES_KV * (cfg.TILE_O * cfg.TILE_N // cfg.CTA_MMA) * cfg.BPE)
+    return s_q + s_o + s_k + s_v
+
+
+def bias_smem_tiles(cfg) -> int:
+    """The bias block's SMEM extent in ``BIAS_BLOCK_ROWS x TILE_N`` tiles, by FORM: ``BIAS_RESIDENT_TILES`` on the resident block
+    (BIAS_MODE 1), ``STAGES_BIAS`` on the streamed ring (BIAS_MODE 2) and its multicast form (BIAS_MODE 3: the same per-CTA ring), 0
+    without the bias.  The kernel hands this to ``tile_dsl.bias.bias_block_geometry(n_tiles=)`` so the TMA box count, the expect_tx
+    and the per-thread read offsets stay one arithmetic."""
+    if cfg.BIAS_MODE == BIAS_MODE_RESIDENT:
+        return cfg.BIAS_RESIDENT_TILES
+    if cfg.BIAS_MODE in BIAS_STREAMED_MODES:
+        return cfg.STAGES_BIAS
+    return 0
+
+
+def bias_resident_block_bytes(cfg) -> int:
+    """SMEM bytes of the bias block in its FORM (0 without the bias): :func:`bias_smem_tiles` tiles of ``BIAS_BLOCK_ROWS x TILE_N``
+    elements in the io dtype -- the resident block's tiles or the streamed ring's stages (the name predates the ring; the
+    ``validate_smem`` term it feeds names the form)."""
+    return bias_smem_tiles(cfg) * cfg.BIAS_BLOCK_ROWS * cfg.TILE_N * cfg.BPE
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# The field block every d128-file Cfg carries (the OFF defaults trace the committed instruction stream byte-for-byte)
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class D128FamilySmallTileFields:
+    """The small-tile seams of the f16/bf16 d128-FILE bodies as Cfg fields.  Every seam in a body folds on
+    ``cutlass.const_expr(CFG.<FIELD>)``, so the defaults below trace the pre-seam instruction stream byte-for-byte (the committed
+    cubin records pin it on both archs).  Mixed into ``config_sm107._CfgSm107`` and ``config_sm100.CfgD128`` (dataclass
+    inheritance: these fields precede the arch's own; every construction site is keyword-only and no cache key hashes a Cfg)."""
+
+    # The padded tail form (TemplateParams.padded_tail_form; the f16/bf16 small tiles' PLAIN padded body, MASK_FLAGS == MASK_PADDED
+    # alone): 0 = the legacy second (software-max) body for the tail kv tile, 1 = the pre-masked tail (one HW-max body; the tail
+    # tile's out-of-range S columns rewritten as -inf in TMEM before the fused max load).  Every kernel seam folds on
+    # cutlass.const_expr(CFG.PADDED_TAIL_FORM == 1); the factory refuses 1 off the eligible set.
+    PADDED_TAIL_FORM: int = 0
+    # The dead-sub-tile quiet body (TemplateParams.dead_subtile_quiet; the one-batch-entry item of the f16/bf16 small tiles, no
+    # bias): 1 = a softmax sub-tile with no live row (its first row >= the batch entry's S_q) runs the kv range through the QUIET
+    # body (the live body's barrier sequence, no math) and the live arms see an empty range; 0 = it runs the full body.  Every
+    # kernel seam folds on cutlass.const_expr(CFG.DEAD_SUBTILE_QUIET == 1); the factory refuses 1 off the eligible set.
+    DEAD_SUBTILE_QUIET: int = 0
+    # --- additive bias (resident row-block) + per-key boolean mask; d128-file f16/bf16 only.  Every seam in the body
+    # folds on cutlass.const_expr(CFG.BIAS_MODE) / (CFG.KV_MASK_FORM), so 0 / 0 traces the pre-bias instruction stream
+    # byte-for-byte.  BIAS_RESIDENT_TILES / BIAS_BLOCK_ROWS size the SMEM block (bias_resident_tiles -- what the
+    # carveout leaves after the operands, in whole TILE_N-column tiles); BIAS_EMPTY_ARRIVERS is the mb_bias_empty init
+    # count = the softmax warps (one elected arrive each per work item).
+    BIAS_MODE: int = 0
+    BIAS_RESIDENT_TILES: int = 0
+    BIAS_BLOCK_ROWS: int = 0
+    BIAS_SWZ_BYTES: int = 128
+    BIAS_BOXES_PER_TILE: int = 0
+    BIAS_EMPTY_ARRIVERS: int = 0
+    KV_MASK_FORM: int = 0
+    # The (n, n+1) PAIR work item (TemplateParams.n_chunk): 0 = the one-batch-entry item; n >= 1 = a work item is (a 128-row
+    # q tile, a head, a chunk of up to n consecutive flattened-batch rows), the two sub-tiles rows (nb, nb+1) of that q tile
+    # sharing the 128-row bias block (BIAS_BLOCK_ROWS = TILE_M).  Every seam folds on cutlass.const_expr(CFG.N_CHUNK > 0).
+    N_CHUNK: int = 0
+    # The STREAMED bias ring's depth (BIAS_MODE == 2; TemplateParams.bias_stages): 2 / 3 stages of BIAS_BLOCK_ROWS x TILE_N bias
+    # tiles, one tile per kv tile, released per kv tile (mb_bias_ring_full / mb_bias_ring_empty, STAGES_BIAS stages each);
+    # 0 on BIAS_MODE 0 / 1 (the resident block sizes itself by BIAS_RESIDENT_TILES).  A pure latency knob: no accumulator
+    # parity is indexed from this ring.
+    STAGES_BIAS: int = 0
+    # The row-max form of the -inf body (TemplateParams.bias_max_form): 0 = the software max tree, 1 = the hardware upper bound
+    # (BIAS_MAX_HW_UPPER_BOUND).  Pure instruction-stream axis: no barrier, no SMEM, no accumulator parity depends on it.
+    BIAS_MAX_FORM: int = 0
+    # The S / P TMEM slot count per softmax sub-tile (TemplateParams.s_slots; d128-file f16/bf16 small tiles at TILE_N 64 only): 1 = the
+    # classic one slot per sub-tile (every seam folds on cutlass.const_expr(CFG.S_SLOTS == 2), so 1 traces the one-slot instruction
+    # stream byte-for-byte), 2 = the double-buffered S -- the TMEM map gains the slot axis (d128_family_tmem_layout: S[qs][p] at
+    # S_OFF[qs] + p * S_SLOT_STRIDE), mb_bmm1_done / mb_bmm2_ready gain a x 2 stage axis (make_classic_bars(s_stages=TILES_Q x S_SLOTS)),
+    # and every role walks a depth-2 PipelineState cursor over the slots, advanced once per non-empty kv tile.  A pure overlap knob:
+    # the same MMAs and softmax steps in the same order -- O and Stats are BITWISE the one-slot kernel's.
+    S_SLOTS: int = 1
+    # The streamed ring's MULTICAST form (BIAS_MODE == 3): the launch's cluster extent along the grid's CHUNK axis (cluster (1, 1, 2)) =
+    # the bias TMA's multicast fan-out = the factor on mb_bias_ring_empty's release count (each CTA's ring is released by BOTH CTAs'
+    # softmax warps).  1 on every other BIAS_MODE (cluster (CTA_MMA, 1, 1), the collective geometry).  The kernel's CGA_SIZE (the
+    # scheduler credit fan-out and the mb_read_tile_id count) multiplies by it; CGA_M / CGA_N / CTA_MMA stay 1 on this form.
+    BIAS_MCAST_CTAS: int = 1
+    # Q resident in TMEM (TemplateParams.q_in_tmem; the f16/bf16 32- / 64-wide d128-file tiles at cga1 / TILE_M 128 / two sub-tiles): 0 = BMM1
+    # reads Q from SMEM through its descriptor on every kv tile (every seam folds on cutlass.const_expr(CFG.Q_IN_TMEM == 1), so 0 traces the
+    # committed instruction stream byte-for-byte), 1 = the MMA warp copies each sub-tile's Q tile SMEM -> TMEM once per n-step (tcgen05.cp
+    # 128x128b, Q_COLS / 4 calls through the same descriptor, one elect block) whose commit releases the Q slab (mb_q_empty) at the START of
+    # the step, and issues every BMM1 as an A-from-TMEM MMA.  The TMEM map gains Q_COLS = TILE_K x BPE / 4 columns per sub-tile after the
+    # last O slot (d128_family_tmem_layout.Q_OFF); no barrier object, no SMEM byte and no init count moves (validate_q_in_tmem).
+    Q_IN_TMEM: int = 0
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# The TMEM column map, derived from the Cfg (ONE formula for the body and the validator)
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+_D128_FAMILY_STATS_REGION_COLS = 32
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class D128FamilyTmemLayout:
+    """Column offsets (fp32 TMEM columns, 128 lanes) of the classic two-sub-tile pipeline, see :func:`d128_family_tmem_layout`."""
+
+    TOTAL_COLS: int
+    S_OFF: Tuple[int, ...]
+    P_OFF: Tuple[int, ...]
+    O_OFF: Tuple[int, ...]
+    STATS_OFF: int
+    STATS_COLS_PER_SUBTILE: int = 8
+    # The S / P slot axis (Cfg.S_SLOTS; 1 on every rendering but the double-buffered small tiles): slot p of sub-tile qs sits at
+    # S_OFF[qs] + p * S_SLOT_STRIDE (its P at P_OFF[qs] + p * S_SLOT_STRIDE); S_OFF / P_OFF name slot 0.
+    S_SLOTS: int = 1
+    S_SLOT_STRIDE: int = 0
+    # The A-from-TMEM Q slot of the TS arm (Cfg.Q_IN_TMEM): Q_COLS = TILE_K x BPE / 4 fp32 columns per sub-tile (two 16-bit elements per
+    # column: 16 / 32 at TILE_K 32 / 64), Q_OFF[qs] after the LAST O slot; computed on every record, read by the body and validated for the
+    # fit (Q end <= STATS_OFF) under the arm only -- STATS_OFF does not move, so every record without the arm keeps its map.
+    Q_OFF: Tuple[int, ...] = ()
+    Q_COLS: int = 0
+
+
+def d128_family_tmem_layout(cfg, *, total_cols: int, stats_cols_per_subtile: int = 8) -> D128FamilyTmemLayout:
+    """Derive the d128-family TMEM map from the Cfg: ``S[qs] = qs * TILE_N`` (the fp32 S accumulator, TILE_N columns per
+    sub-tile); ``P[qs]`` in the TAIL of its own S slot -- the packed BMM2 A operand is ``TILE_N * BPE / 4`` columns wide
+    (bf16 / f16 pack two probabilities per fp32 cell: 64 columns at TILE_N = 128, so P sits at +64; a 4-byte dtype would
+    alias the full slot) and BMM1 has finished with S before P is written; ``O[qs] = TILES_Q * TILE_N + qs * TILE_O`` (the
+    fp32 O accumulator, TILE_O columns per sub-tile: 128 / 64 / 32); STATS at the top of the allocation.  Every term is a
+    Cfg field, never a literal copied from the d128 map (a literal O1 offset of 384 at TILE_O = 32 would leave 352 unused
+    columns and no error; a literal P offset of 64 at a TILE_N of 64 would overlap the live S columns).
+
+    ``total_cols``: the arch's TMEM column total (576 on Rubin, 512 on SM100): STATS_OFF = total - 32 (544 / 480) at the
+    default stats width, so the same Cfg maps to each arch's allocation and the fit predicate reads the arch's number.
+
+    ``stats_cols_per_subtile``: 8 on every rendering today (alpha; the final (max, sum); the score side outputs' true max in
+    columns 2-3).  The 64-row tile's quad-fragment form (``TILE_M64_LANE_FORM = 1``) publishes each value 8 wide through the
+    ``16x256b .x1`` store and takes 24; the region at the top grows by the extra columns per sub-tile, so the default keeps
+    STATS_OFF at total - 32 and every committed record byte-identical."""
+    if stats_cols_per_subtile < 8 or stats_cols_per_subtile % 8:
+        raise ValueError(f"d128_family_tmem_layout: stats_cols_per_subtile must be a multiple of 8, at least 8 (got {stats_cols_per_subtile})")
+    stats_region = _D128_FAMILY_STATS_REGION_COLS + cfg.TILES_Q * (stats_cols_per_subtile - 8)
+    # The slot axis (Cfg.S_SLOTS, 1 on every record but the double-buffered small tiles; read through getattr so the quantized
+    # siblings' Cfg classes, which carry no such field, keep their map): sub-tile qs owns S_SLOTS consecutive TILE_N-column slots,
+    # S[qs][p] = (qs * S_SLOTS + p) * TILE_N, each with its own P tail; O follows the LAST slot.  At S_SLOTS = 1 every value is the map
+    # the kernels always had.
+    n_slots = int(getattr(cfg, "S_SLOTS", 1))
+    s_off = tuple(qs * n_slots * cfg.TILE_N for qs in range(cfg.TILES_Q))
+    p_width = (cfg.TILE_N * cfg.BPE) // 4
+    p_off = tuple(s + cfg.TILE_N - p_width for s in s_off)
+    o_base = cfg.TILES_Q * n_slots * cfg.TILE_N
+    o_off = tuple(o_base + qs * cfg.TILE_O for qs in range(cfg.TILES_Q))
+    # The TS arm's Q slots (Cfg.Q_IN_TMEM; read through getattr so the quantized siblings' Cfg classes keep their map): TILE_K x BPE / 4
+    # columns per sub-tile after the last O slot -- the d512 f16 kernel's Q_TMEM_COLS == TILE_K / 2 at BPE 2.
+    q_cols = (cfg.TILE_K * cfg.BPE) // 4
+    q_base = o_off[-1] + cfg.TILE_O
+    q_off = tuple(q_base + qs * q_cols for qs in range(cfg.TILES_Q))
+    return D128FamilyTmemLayout(
+        TOTAL_COLS=int(total_cols),
+        S_OFF=s_off,
+        P_OFF=p_off,
+        O_OFF=o_off,
+        STATS_OFF=int(total_cols) - stats_region,
+        STATS_COLS_PER_SUBTILE=stats_cols_per_subtile,
+        S_SLOTS=n_slots,
+        S_SLOT_STRIDE=cfg.TILE_N if n_slots > 1 else 0,
+        Q_OFF=q_off,
+        Q_COLS=q_cols,
+    )
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# The d128-file warp table as a function of the softmax WARP-GROUP count
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+#
+# Warp map: 8 softmax (2 warpgroups) + 4 correction + MMA + TMALDG + TMASTG + scheduler.  15 of the 16 warps arrive on the
+# scheduler ring (all but the scheduler warp itself).  2 = the 16-warp body; 3 = the 20-warp body of the TILE_N-64 pair arm
+# (TemplateParams.softmax_wgs): 4 warps per softmax group, 4 correction warps, then the MMA / TMA-LDG / TMA-STG / scheduler
+# warps -- the kernel's role dispatch reads the Cfg ids and derives WG2's first warp as SOFTMAX_WG0_BASE + 2 x SOFTMAX_WG_WARPS.
+D128_SOFTMAX_WG_WARPS = 4
+D128_CORRECTION_WARPS = 4
+D128_OTHER_WARPS = 4
+
+
+def d128_total_warps(softmax_wgs: int) -> int:
+    return softmax_wgs * D128_SOFTMAX_WG_WARPS + D128_CORRECTION_WARPS + D128_OTHER_WARPS
+
+
+def d128_read_tile_arrivers(softmax_wgs: int) -> int:
+    """The per-CTA ``read_tile_id_arrive`` callers of the d128-file body: every softmax warp, every correction warp, the MMA, the TMA-LDG
+    and the TMA-STG warp (the kernel's READ_TILE_ARRIVERS_TOTAL at CGA_SIZE 1: ``(WGS x 4 + 4 + 1 + 1) x CGA_SIZE + CGA_M / CTA_MMA``, the
+    last term the STG warp): 15 at two groups, 19 at three.  A count the body cannot reach is a hang at EVERY shape (the config_sm107
+    module docstring's d256 story)."""
+    return softmax_wgs * D128_SOFTMAX_WG_WARPS + D128_CORRECTION_WARPS + 1 + 1 + 1
+
+
+# The per-role register split (SOFTMAX_REGS, CORRECTION_REGS) of the d128-file body by (softmax warp groups, head-dim tile); the four
+# 40-register roles are fixed.  SUM(role regs x warps) EQUALS the launch's entry pool (reg_entry_pool: 128 x 16 = 2048; 96 x 20 = 1920),
+# as every CUTLASS warp-specialized split does: 8 x 192 + 4 x 88 + 4 x 40 = 2048; 12 x 128 + 4 x 56 + 4 x 40 = 1920 at the 32-wide tile
+# (the correction holds a 32-column O row); 12 x 120 + 4 x 80 + 4 x 40 = 1920 at the 64-wide one (a 64-column O row needs 80 -- 56 spills
+# -- so the softmax gives up 8).  The 128-register softmax of the 3-WG arm holds ONE 64-column chunk: reg_S 64 + the packed P chunk 32 +
+# the loop state, no bias pre-load (the kernel derives _BIAS_PRELOAD_EFF 0 there).  frost-kernels.md s2.  The sm100 d128 FLAVOR runs its
+# own 2 x 184 + 88 + 56 (its MMA warp holds 16 Q descriptors) -- a d128-flavor fact, not a small-tile one; the small tiles run this table.
+D128_REG_SPLIT = {2: (192, 88), (3, 32): (128, 56), (3, 64): (120, 80)}
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Shared validators (each takes the arch BUDGET where a number of the arch enters)
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+
+def validate_regs(cfg, flavor: str) -> None:
+    """The four hardware register constraints. Equality and alignment are HW
+    requirements, not style: violating them gives wrong results or a crash, with
+    no diagnostic."""
+    _check(
+        [
+            (
+                cfg.MMA_REGS == cfg.TMALDG_REGS == cfg.TMASTG_REGS == cfg.SCHEDULER_REGS,
+                f"{flavor}: MMA/TMALDG/TMASTG/SCHEDULER regs must be equal",
+            ),
+            (
+                cfg.MMA_REGS + cfg.CORRECTION_REGS + cfg.SOFTMAX_WARPGROUPS * cfg.SOFTMAX_REGS <= 512,
+                f"{flavor}: register budget over 512",
+            ),
+            (
+                all(r % 8 == 0 for r in (cfg.MMA_REGS, cfg.CORRECTION_REGS, cfg.SOFTMAX_REGS, cfg.OTHER_REGS)),
+                f"{flavor}: every per-role register count must be a multiple of 8",
+            ),
+            (
+                all(24 <= r <= 256 for r in (cfg.MMA_REGS, cfg.SOFTMAX_REGS) if r),
+                f"{flavor}: per-warp register counts must be within 24..256",
+            ),
+        ]
+    )
+
+
+def validate_warp_layout(cfg, flavor: str, *, expect_total: int, expect_arrivers: int) -> None:
+    """Pin the warp population against the count the kernel BODY implements.
+
+    This is the check whose absence hung the d256 FP8 port: the body's role
+    dispatch and its ``read_tile_id_arrive`` call sites are fixed, so a config
+    that disagrees produces an mbarrier init count nothing can reach."""
+    _check(
+        [
+            (cfg.TOTAL_WARPS == expect_total, f"{flavor}: kernel body has {expect_total} warps, config says {cfg.TOTAL_WARPS}"),
+            (cfg.THREADS_PER_CTA == cfg.TOTAL_WARPS * 32, f"{flavor}: THREADS_PER_CTA must be TOTAL_WARPS*32"),
+            (
+                cfg.READ_TILE_ARRIVERS == expect_arrivers,
+                f"{flavor}: READ_TILE_ARRIVERS must be {expect_arrivers} for this body (got {cfg.READ_TILE_ARRIVERS}); "
+                f"a wrong count is an unreachable scheduler mbarrier, i.e. a hang at EVERY shape",
+            ),
+        ]
+    )
+
+
+def validate_swizzles(cfg, flavor: str) -> None:
+    _check(
+        [
+            (cfg.Q_SWZ_BYTES in (64, 128), f"{flavor}: Q swizzle must be 64/128 B"),
+            (cfg.K_SWZ_BYTES in (64, 128), f"{flavor}: K swizzle must be 64/128 B"),
+            (cfg.V_SWZ_BYTES in (32, 64, 128), f"{flavor}: V swizzle must be 32/64/128 B"),
+            (cfg.O_SWZ_BYTES in (64, 128), f"{flavor}: O swizzle must be 64/128 B"),
+        ]
+    )
+
+
+def validate_smem(cfg, flavor: str, *, arch: D128FamilyArch, qo_alias: bool, sf_bytes: int = 0, bias_bytes: int = 0) -> None:
+    """``sf_bytes``: the block-scale kernel's scale-factor slabs (0 on the f16 /
+    per-tensor flavors); ``bias_bytes``: the resident bias row-block of the f16 d128-file
+    tiles (0 without the bias); both named in the message so a reader sees every term.  ``arch``: the budget
+    (``smem_usable_bytes`` / ``smem_fixed_overhead``) and the name the message prints."""
+    gate_bpe = cfg.GATE_BPE if getattr(cfg, "EPILOGUE_GATE", 0) else 0
+    gate_kib = (cfg.TILES_Q * cfg.TILE_M * cfg.TILE_O * gate_bpe) // 1024
+    used = (
+        sdpa_smem_bytes(
+            cfg.TILE_M,
+            cfg.TILE_N,
+            cfg.TILE_K,
+            cfg.TILE_O,
+            cfg.TILES_Q,
+            cfg.STAGES_KV,
+            cfg.CTA_MMA,
+            cfg.BPE,
+            cfg.BPE_O,
+            qo_alias=qo_alias,
+            gate_bpe=gate_bpe,
+            sf_bytes=sf_bytes,
+        )
+        + bias_bytes
+        + arch.smem_fixed_overhead
+    )
+    if used > arch.smem_usable_bytes:
+        gate_term = f" + {gate_kib} KiB GATE staging tile" if gate_bpe else ""
+        sf_term = (
+            f" + {sf_bytes // 1024} KiB MXFP8 scale-factor slabs (Q 1 | K {cfg.STAGES_KV}x1 | P 1 (512 B padded) | V {cfg.STAGES_KV}x1)" if sf_bytes else ""
+        )
+        if bias_bytes:
+            _streamed = getattr(cfg, "BIAS_MODE", 0) in BIAS_STREAMED_MODES
+            gate_term += (
+                f" + {bias_bytes // 1024} KiB {'streamed bias ring' if _streamed else 'resident bias block'} "
+                f"({getattr(cfg, 'STAGES_BIAS', 0) if _streamed else getattr(cfg, 'BIAS_RESIDENT_TILES', 0)} {'stages' if _streamed else 'tiles'} x "
+                f"{getattr(cfg, 'BIAS_BLOCK_ROWS', 0)} rows x {cfg.TILE_N} cols x {cfg.BPE} B)"
+            )
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"{flavor}: SMEM {used // 1024} KiB (Q/K/V/O + {arch.smem_fixed_overhead // 1024} KiB fixed{gate_term}{sf_term}) exceeds the "
+            f"{arch.smem_usable_bytes // 1024} KiB usable {arch.name} carveout at STAGES_KV={cfg.STAGES_KV}, CTA_MMA={cfg.CTA_MMA}"
+            f"{', EPILOGUE_GATE=1' if gate_bpe else ''}. "
+            f"Overflowing it does NOT fail the launch -- it clobbers the last buffer allocated (measured: O came back "
+            f"50 % zeros with an exact LSE), so this must raise here"
+        )
+

+def validate_head_dim_tile(cfg, flavor: str, *, arch: D128FamilyArch) -> None:
+    """The head-dim tile and everything coupled to it (frost-kernels.md s5 "bind the couplings" / s6).
+
+    One Cfg field, ``TILE_K`` / ``TILE_O``, sets a TMA box, an MMA descriptor swizzle, the epilogue's SMEM store swizzle,
+    the TMEM O slot width and the BMM1 k-step count at once; moving it without the rest raises HERE with the failure it
+    would otherwise produce, instead of a numerically perfect slow kernel or a cos ~ 0.006 one."""
+    lay = d128_family_tmem_layout(cfg, total_cols=arch.tmem_total_cols)
+    q_swz, v_swz, o_swz = q_swz_bytes(cfg.TILE_K, cfg.BPE), v_swz_bytes(cfg.TILE_O, cfg.CTA_MMA, cfg.BPE), o_swz_bytes(cfg.TILE_O, cfg.BPE_O, cfg.O_PACK_DIV)
+    _check(
+        [
+            (
+                cfg.TILE_K in (32, 64, 128, 192) and cfg.TILE_O in (32, 64, 128),
+                f"{flavor}: TILE_K must be one of 32/64/128/192 and TILE_O one of 32/64/128 (got {cfg.TILE_K}/{cfg.TILE_O})",
+            ),
+            (
+                cfg.TILE_K == cfg.TILE_O or (cfg.TILE_K, cfg.TILE_O) == (192, 128),
+                f"{flavor}: the d128 family serves TILE_K == TILE_O (32/64/128) or the d192xd128 pair (got {cfg.TILE_K}/{cfg.TILE_O})",
+            ),
+            (
+                cfg.TILE_M in SMALL_D_TILE_MS,
+                f"{flavor}: TILE_M must be one of {sorted(SMALL_D_TILE_MS)} (got {cfg.TILE_M}): the softmax / correction lane mapping and the "
+                f"tcgen05.mma datapath layout (M = 128: one lane per row; M = 64: 16 live rows per 32-lane TMEM sub-partition) exist for these two only",
+            ),
+            (
+                cfg.TILE_M == 128 or (cfg.TILE_K <= 64 and cfg.DTYPE_QKV in (_DTYPE_BF16, _DTYPE_FP16)),
+                f"{flavor}: the 64-row Q tile is wired on the f16/bf16 32- / 64-wide tiles only (TILE_K={cfg.TILE_K}, DTYPE_QKV={cfg.DTYPE_QKV}); the "
+                f"d128 / d192 renderings keep their committed records and the quantized siblings' k_dim / SF geometry is tied to the 128-row tile",
+            ),
+            (
+                cfg.TILE_M == 128 or cfg.CTA_MMA == 1,
+                f"{flavor}: the 64-row Q tile runs cga1 only (CTA_MMA={cfg.CTA_MMA}): a cta_group::2 MMA with a 64-row per-CTA tile has a different "
+                f"TMEM datapath layout than the one the warp-lane -> row mapping was derived for",
+            ),
+            (
+                cfg.TILE_M == 128 or not (cfg.THD_VARLEN or cfg.SPLIT_KV > 1 or cfg.PACK_GQA or getattr(cfg, "EPILOGUE_GATE", 0)),
+                f"{flavor}: the 64-row Q tile serves dense, unsplit, non-PackGQA, ungated graphs only (the small-tile rows' own gates)",
+            ),
+            (
+                cfg.TILE_K > 64 or cfg.STAGES_KV in SMALL_D_STAGES_KV,
+                f"{flavor}: the 32- / 64-wide tiles' K / V ring is validated at STAGES_KV in {sorted(SMALL_D_STAGES_KV)} (got {cfg.STAGES_KV}); the body is "
+                f"depth-generic but the SMEM fit and the ring-wrap census hold for these depths only -- a depth of 1 serialises every kv tile behind "
+                f"its own BMM1 and a depth above 4 was never run",
+            ),
+            (
+                cfg.TILE_K % cfg.TILE_K_HW_BMM1 == 0 and cfg.TILE_O % 16 == 0,
+                f"{flavor}: TILE_K must be whole BMM1 k-steps of {cfg.TILE_K_HW_BMM1} and TILE_O a multiple of the correction warps' 16-column O chunk",
+            ),
+            (
+                cfg.Q_SWZ_BYTES == q_swz and cfg.K_SWZ_BYTES == q_swz,
+                f"{flavor}: Q/K swizzle {cfg.Q_SWZ_BYTES}/{cfg.K_SWZ_BYTES} B must follow the tile width ({q_swz} B rows at TILE_K={cfg.TILE_K}, BPE={cfg.BPE}): "
+                f"the TMA descriptor and the MMA descriptor read the same atom, and a mismatch is cos ~ 0.006 on every output, not a slow kernel",
+            ),
+            (
+                cfg.V_SWZ_BYTES == v_swz,
+                f"{flavor}: V swizzle {cfg.V_SWZ_BYTES} B must follow the per-CTA d_v extent ({v_swz} B at TILE_O={cfg.TILE_O}, CTA_MMA={cfg.CTA_MMA})",
+            ),
+            (
+                cfg.O_SWZ_BYTES == o_swz,
+                f"{flavor}: O swizzle {cfg.O_SWZ_BYTES} B must follow the O row ({o_swz} B at TILE_O={cfg.TILE_O}): the epilogue's swizzled SMEM store and the O TMA descriptor are ONE unit",
+            ),
+            (
+                (cfg.TILE_K * cfg.BPE) % cfg.Q_SWZ_BYTES == 0
+                and (cfg.TILE_O * cfg.BPE) % cfg.V_SWZ_BYTES == 0
+                and (cfg.TILE_O * cfg.BPE_O // cfg.O_PACK_DIV) % cfg.O_SWZ_BYTES == 0,
+                f"{flavor}: every TMA inner extent must be whole swizzle atoms (TMA_QK/VO/O iteration counts are integers)",
+            ),
+            (
+                cfg.N_BMM2_CHUNKS * cfg.BMM2_CHUNK_SIZE == cfg.TILE_N,
+                f"{flavor}: the softmax chunking is TILE_N-derived (the KV axis), never TILE_O's: N_BMM2_CHUNKS x BMM2_CHUNK_SIZE must equal TILE_N "
+                f"(got {cfg.N_BMM2_CHUNKS} x {cfg.BMM2_CHUNK_SIZE} vs {cfg.TILE_N}); a TILE_O-scaled chunk reads half of S and signals half the bmm2_ready barriers -- a silent NaN or a hang",
+            ),
+            (
+                lay.O_OFF[-1] + cfg.TILE_O <= lay.STATS_OFF,
+                f"{flavor}: TMEM map S {lay.S_OFF} | P {lay.P_OFF} | O {lay.O_OFF} (+{cfg.TILE_O}) must end at or before the STATS region (column {lay.STATS_OFF} of {lay.TOTAL_COLS}); "
+                f"an overlap accumulates the next KV tile's O under the softmax stats",
+            ),
+            (
+                all(o % 32 == 0 for o in lay.O_OFF)
+                and all(sv % 32 == 0 for sv in lay.S_OFF)
+                and all(pv % 8 == 0 for pv in lay.P_OFF)
+                and lay.STATS_OFF % 8 == 0,
+                f"{flavor}: accumulator slot bases must be 32-column aligned and P / STATS bases 8-column aligned (S {lay.S_OFF}, P {lay.P_OFF}, O {lay.O_OFF}, STATS {lay.STATS_OFF})",
+            ),
+        ]
+    )

+def validate_tile_n(cfg, flavor: str, *, arch: D128FamilyArch) -> None:
+    """The KV tile width and what it couples to (M-2: TILE_N as a Cfg field).  The S accumulator takes TILE_N fp32 columns
+    per sub-tile and P half of them in its tail; with two sub-tiles the TMEM map must still end under the STATS region, so
+    256 is served only at ONE sub-tile -- a predicate, not a comment."""
+    lay = d128_family_tmem_layout(cfg, total_cols=arch.tmem_total_cols)
+    _check(
+        [
+            (cfg.TILE_N in (64, 128, 256), f"{flavor}: TILE_N must be one of 64 / 128 / 256 (got {cfg.TILE_N})"),
+            (
+                cfg.TILE_N != 256 or cfg.TILES_Q == 1,
+                f"{flavor}: TILE_N = 256 needs ONE softmax sub-tile: {cfg.TILES_Q} sub-tiles x 256 S columns + the O slots + STATS exceed the "
+                f"{lay.TOTAL_COLS}-column TMEM allocation (the body indexes its S / P parity slots per sub-tile)",
+            ),
+            (
+                cfg.N_BMM2_CHUNKS * cfg.BMM2_CHUNK_SIZE == cfg.TILE_N and cfg.BMM2_CHUNK_SIZE == 64,
+                f"{flavor}: the softmax chunking is TILE_N / 64 chunks of 64 (got {cfg.N_BMM2_CHUNKS} x {cfg.BMM2_CHUNK_SIZE} vs TILE_N={cfg.TILE_N})",
+            ),
+            (
+                getattr(cfg, "S_SLOTS", 1) in SMALL_D_S_SLOTS,
+                f"{flavor}: the S / P slot count per sub-tile is validated at S_SLOTS in {sorted(SMALL_D_S_SLOTS)} (got {getattr(cfg, 'S_SLOTS', 1)}): a 3-slot S "
+                f"fits no TMEM map at two sub-tiles (3 x 2 x 128 = 768 > {lay.TOTAL_COLS}) and the body walks a depth-S_SLOTS cursor validated at 1 / 2",
+            ),
+            (
+                getattr(cfg, "S_SLOTS", 1) == 1 or cfg.TILE_N == 64,
+                f"{flavor}: the double-buffered S (S_SLOTS = {getattr(cfg, 'S_SLOTS', 1)}) is the TILE_N 64 form: at TILE_N {cfg.TILE_N} the map "
+                f"{cfg.TILES_Q} sub-tiles x {getattr(cfg, 'S_SLOTS', 1)} slots x {cfg.TILE_N} S columns + the O slots ends at {lay.O_OFF[-1] + cfg.TILE_O}, past the "
+                f"STATS region at {lay.STATS_OFF} of the {lay.TOTAL_COLS}-column allocation -- the next kv tile's BMM1 would overwrite the softmax stats",
+            ),
+            (
+                getattr(cfg, "S_SLOTS", 1) == 1
+                or ((cfg.TILE_K <= 64 or (arch.name == "Rubin" and cfg.TILE_K == cfg.TILE_O == 128)) and cfg.DTYPE_QKV > _DTYPE_E5M2),
+                f"{flavor}: the double-buffered S requires f16/bf16 small tiles or native Rubin D128 (TILE_K={cfg.TILE_K}, DTYPE_QKV={cfg.DTYPE_QKV}): the "
+                f"quantized d128 files keep one slot per sub-tile",
+            ),
+            (
+                getattr(cfg, "S_SLOTS", 1) == 1 or getattr(cfg, "SOFTMAX_WARPGROUPS", 2) == 2,
+                f"{flavor}: the double-buffered S (S_SLOTS = {getattr(cfg, 'S_SLOTS', 1)}) is served with two softmax warp groups only (got "
+                f"SOFTMAX_WARPGROUPS={getattr(cfg, 'SOFTMAX_WARPGROUPS', 2)}): the two-slot MMA issue order (BMM1(k) of both sub-tiles ahead of BMM2(k - 1) of "
+                f"both) hand-unrolls the two-sub-tile body and its barrier audit is the two-group one; the third softmax warp group keeps one slot per sub-tile",
+            ),
+            (
+                lay.O_OFF[-1] + cfg.TILE_O <= lay.STATS_OFF,
+                f"{flavor}: TILES_Q x S_SLOTS x TILE_N + TILES_Q x TILE_O = {lay.O_OFF[-1] + cfg.TILE_O} TMEM columns must end at or before STATS ({lay.STATS_OFF})",
+            ),
+        ]
+    )
