+
+    # -- environment ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def check_environment() -> None:
+        cfg = os.environ.get("CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG")
+        if cfg not in DETERMINISTIC_CUBLAS_CONFIGS:
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                f"CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG must name a deterministic cuBLAS workspace ({' or '.join(DETERMINISTIC_CUBLAS_CONFIGS)}) and be set "
+                f"before the process's first cuBLAS call; got {cfg!r}.  torch.use_deterministic_algorithms(True) refuses cuBLAS GEMMs without it."
+            )
+
+    # -- the block call (the model's attention sub-layer) ---------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+    def block(self, l: int, h16: torch.Tensor, w_qkvg32, w_o32, wq32, wk32) -> torch.Tensor:
+        w_qkvg16, w_o16, wq16, wk16 = w_qkvg32.to(_BF16), w_o32.to(_BF16), wq32.to(_BF16), wk32.to(_BF16)  # tracked casts
+        if self.arm.family == "torch":
+            return gated_attention_block_reference(h16, w_qkvg16, wq16, wk16, self.cos, self.sin, w_o16, geom=self.ref_geom).out
+        return GatedBlockFn.apply(h16, w_qkvg16, w_o16, wq16, wk16, self, l)
+
+    # -- forward ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+    def _activation_scales(self, st: _LayerState) -> Dict[str, float]:
+        if self.calibrating or self.arm.act_window == 0:
+            return {f"scale_{x}": 1.0 for x in _ACTS}
+        for x in _ACTS:
+            if not st.act_hist[x]:
+                raise RuntimeError(f"layer {st.layer}: no activation amax history for {x} -- the step-0 calibration forward did not run")
+        return {f"scale_{x}": grad_scale_from_amax(max(st.act_hist[x]), self.arm.margin_log2) for x in _ACTS}
+
+    def _quantize_layer_inputs(self, st: _LayerState, h16, w_qkvg16, w_o16, wq16, wk16):
+        """The arm's quantization of this layer's bf16 operands -> ``(inputs, spec)``; ``inputs`` carries ``h`` / ``w_qkvg`` / ``w_o``
+        in the block's dtypes, the MXFP8 blobs under ``sf`` and the backward's artifacts under ``art``."""
+        fam = self.arm.family
+        if fam == "fp8":
+            amax = torch.stack([h16.detach().abs().amax(), w_qkvg16.detach().abs().amax(), w_o16.detach().abs().amax()]).float()
+            s_h, s_wq, s_wo = (E4M3_MAX / amax.clamp_min(1e-8)).tolist()  # the test tree's amax_scale, three tensors in ONE sync
+            act = self._activation_scales(st)
+            st.act_scales = act
+            spec = QuantSpec(descale_h=1.0 / s_h, descale_w_qkvg=1.0 / s_wq, descale_w_o=1.0 / s_wo, **act)
+            inputs = dict(h=quant_e4m3(h16, s_h), w_qkvg=quant_e4m3(w_qkvg16, s_wq), w_o=quant_e4m3(w_o16, s_wo), sf={}, art={})
+        elif fam == "mxfp8":
+            # the MXFP8 arm and the fp4 weight modes on it: the codes + blobs of this step's bf16 tensors (row-wise for the forward,
+            # the transposed artifacts re-quantized along the other axis for the backward, the test tree's builder); under an fp4 W_o
+            # the forward also takes the W_o blob (``sample_w_o_sf`` / ``w_o_sf``) and the backward the two w_o_t artifacts
+            src = dict(h=h16.detach(), w_qkvg=w_qkvg16.detach(), w_o=w_o16.detach(), w_q_norm=wq16, w_k_norm=wk16, cos=self.cos, sin=self.sin)
+            mx, desc = quantize_block_inputs_mxfp8(src, backward=True, o_fp4=self.arm.o_fp4_format, w_qkvg_fp4=self.arm.w_qkvg_fp4)
+            spec = MxQuantSpec(descale_w_o=desc["descale_w_o"], scale_o=1.0, w_qkvg_dtype=_FP4X2 if self.arm.w_qkvg_fp4 else _E4M3, o_fp4=self.arm.o_fp4_format)
+            sf = dict(h_sf=mx["h_sf"], w_qkvg_sf=mx["w_qkvg_sf"])
+            art = {k: mx[k] for k in _MX_ARTIFACTS}
+            if self.arm.o_fp4 is not None:
+                sf["w_o_sf"] = mx["w_o_sf"]
+                art.update({k: mx[k] for k in _FP4_O_ARTIFACTS})
+            inputs = dict(h=mx["h"], w_qkvg=mx["w_qkvg"], w_o=mx["w_o"], sf=sf, art=art)
+        else:
+            spec = None
+            inputs = dict(h=h16, w_qkvg=w_qkvg16, w_o=w_o16, sf={}, art={})
+        inputs.update(w_q_norm=wq16, w_k_norm=wk16)
+        return inputs, spec
+
+    def _declare_fwd(self, inputs: dict, spec, out: torch.Tensor) -> None:
+        kw: dict = dict(save_for_backward=True)
+        if spec is not None:
+            kw["quant"] = spec
+        if self.arm.family == "mxfp8":
+            kw.update({"sample_" + k: v for k, v in inputs["sf"].items()})  # h_sf / w_qkvg_sf (+ w_o_sf under an fp4 W_o)
+        self.fwd = GatedAttentionBlockFwd(
+            inputs["h"], inputs["w_qkvg"], inputs["w_q_norm"], inputs["w_k_norm"], self.cos, self.sin, inputs["w_o"], out, self.block_geom, **kw
+        )
+        self.fwd.check_support()
+        self.fwd.compile()
+        self.ws_fwd = torch.empty(self.fwd.get_workspace_size(), dtype=torch.uint8, device=self.device)
+        if self.arm.family == "fp8":
+            g, t = self.block_geom, self.geom.tokens_per_step
+            self._replay = (
+                torch.empty(t, g.h_q, g.d_head, dtype=_BF16, device=self.device),
+                torch.empty(t, g.h_kv, g.d_head, dtype=_BF16, device=self.device),
+                torch.empty(t, g.h_q, dtype=torch.float32, device=self.device),
+                torch.empty(t, g.h_kv, dtype=torch.float32, device=self.device),

+
+    def _forward_layer(self, l: int, h16, w_qkvg16, w_o16, wq16, wk16):
+        st = self.layers[l]
+        if self.arm.family == "torch_fn":
+            with torch.no_grad():

+        inputs, spec = self._quantize_layer_inputs(st, h16, w_qkvg16, w_o16, wq16, wk16)

+            self._record_activation_amax(st, wq16, wk16)
+        return st.out, spec
+
+    def _record_activation_amax(self, st: _LayerState, wq16, wk16) -> None:
+        """This step's activation amax of the record -- the forward's OWN norm+RoPE stage replayed out of place over the slab's
+        pre-norm Q / K bands (bitwise the tensors the quantize launches read), the slab's V band, and the torch gated O -- plus
+        the clipped-element counts at this step's scales, into the layer's metrics tensor (read back once per step)."""
+        nq, nk, rq, rk = self._replay
+        st_fwd = self.fwd._norm_rope
+        st_fwd.execute(st.q_pre, st.k_pre, wq16, wk16, self.cos, self.sin, q_out=nq, k_out=nk, rstd_q=rq, rstd_k=rk)
+        og = st.o.float() * torch.sigmoid(st.gate.float())
+        for x, ten in (("q", nq), ("k", nk), ("v", st.v), ("o", og)):
+            a = ten.float().abs()
+            st.met[_MET[f"amax_{x}"]] = a.amax()
+            st.met[_MET[f"n_clip_{x}"]] = (a * st.act_scales[f"scale_{x}"] > E4M3_MAX).sum().float()
+
+    # -- backward ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+    def _declare_bwd(self, dy: torch.Tensor, st: _LayerState) -> None:
+        inp, kw = st.inputs, {k: True for k in self.arm.bwd_knobs}
+        if st.spec is not None:
+            kw.update(quant=st.spec, grad_scaling=self.arm.grad_scaling)
+            if self.arm.grad_scaling == "current":
+                kw["grad_scale_margin_log2"] = self.arm.margin_log2
+        self.bwd = GatedAttentionBlockBwd(dy, st.saved, inp["w_qkvg"], inp["w_q_norm"], inp["w_k_norm"], self.cos, self.sin, inp["w_o"], self.block_geom, **kw)
+        self.bwd.check_support()
+        self.bwd.compile()
+        for other in self.layers:
+            other.ws_bwd = torch.empty(self.bwd.get_workspace_size(), dtype=torch.uint8, device=self.device)
+
+    def _bwd_kwargs(self, st: _LayerState) -> dict:
+        kw: dict = {}
+        if self.arm.family == "fp8":
+            kw["scale_dp"] = st.scale_dp
+        if self.arm.grad_scaling == "delayed":
+            kw.update(st.grad_scales)
+        if self.arm.family == "mxfp8":
+            kw.update(st.inputs["art"])
+        return kw
+
+    def _execute_bwd(self, st: _LayerState, dy: torch.Tensor) -> None:
+        inp = st.inputs
+        self.bwd.execute(
+            dy,
+            st.saved,
+            inp["w_qkvg"],
+            inp["w_q_norm"],
+            inp["w_k_norm"],
+            self.cos,
+            self.sin,
+            inp["w_o"],
+            workspace=st.ws_bwd,
+            **st.grads,
+            **self._bwd_kwargs(st),
+        )
+
+    def _next_scale_dp(self, amax_dp: float) -> float:
+        """The fp8 SDPA row's dP scale for the NEXT execute from this execute's ``amax_dp`` (``Arm.dp_scale_rule``)."""
+        if self.arm.dp_scale_rule == "helper":
+            return float(get_fp8_scale_factor(amax_dp, _E4M3))
+        return float(grad_scale_from_amax(amax_dp, self.arm.dp_margin_log2))
+
+    def _read_scalars(self, st: _LayerState) -> Dict[str, float]:
+        d = self.bwd.quant_scalars(st.ws_bwd)
+        return dict(zip(d.keys(), torch.cat(list(d.values())).tolist()))
+
+    def bootstrap_rungs(self) -> List[str]:
+        """The scales the arm seeds at step 0 from DISCARDED backward passes, in dependency order -- one pass per rung, each at the
+        scales seeded so far (unit elsewhere), because a gradient's published amax is valid only once every scale UPSTREAM of it is:
+        dY's is scale-independent (dY is the backward's INPUT, ``dL/dout`` -- nothing quantized precedes it; the block's input gradient
+        is ``dh``), dO's needs ``scale_dy`` (dO is computed from the quantized dY), dP's needs ``scale_do``, dQKVG's needs ``scale_dp``
+        (its dQ / dK come from the quantized dS).  A unit scale flushes a training
+        gradient (amax ~ 1e-3) to zero in e4m3 (subnormal 2^-9), so a downstream amax read at unit upstream scales is garbage --
+        seeding ``scale_dqkvg`` from it saturates the first logged pass by orders of magnitude.  "current" fp8: ``scale_dp`` alone (the
+        kernel derives the three gradient scales from the same step's amax); "delayed" without a feed: the gradient scales too (fp8:
+        dy, do, dp, dqkvg; MXFP8: dy); a feed supplies them from step 0."""
+        seed = self.arm.grad_scaling == "delayed" and self.scale_feed is None
+        if self.arm.family == "fp8":
+            return (["scale_dy", "scale_do"] if seed else []) + ["scale_dp"] + (["scale_dqkvg"] if seed else [])
+        if self.arm.family == "mxfp8" and seed:
+            return ["scale_dy"]
+        return []
+
+    def _backward_layer(self, l: int, dy: torch.Tensor, spec) -> dict:
+        st = self.layers[l]
+        if self.arm.family == "torch_fn":
+            return self._torch_fn_backward(st, dy)
+        dy = dy.contiguous()
+        st.dy_ref = dy
+        if self.bwd is None:
+            self._declare_bwd(dy, st)
+        if spec is not None:
+            self.bwd.update_quant_scales(spec)
+        if self.step == 0:
+            # the step-0 bootstrap ladder (``bootstrap_rungs``): one DISCARDED backward per rung, its published amax seeding that
+            # rung's scale for every later pass; the gradients are overwritten by the logged pass below; one host sync per rung,
+            # step 0 only.  The seeded amax enters the gradient histories through the logged pass's readback, not here.
+            rungs = self.bootstrap_rungs()
+            if rungs and self.arm.family == "fp8":
+                st.scale_dp.fill_(1.0)
+                st.scale_dp_host = 1.0
+            for rung in rungs:
+                self._execute_bwd(st, dy)
+                torch.cuda.synchronize()
+                sc = self._read_scalars(st)
+                if rung == "scale_dp":
+                    st.scale_dp_host = self._next_scale_dp(sc["amax_dp"])
+                    st.scale_dp.fill_(st.scale_dp_host)
+                else:
+                    self._set_delayed_scales(st, {rung: grad_scale_from_amax(sc["amax_" + rung[len("scale_") :]], self.arm.margin_log2)})
+            self._calib_bwd = len(rungs)
+        self._execute_bwd(st, dy)
+        for name in _GRAD_NAMES:
+            st.met[_MET[f"norm_{name}"]] = st.grads[name].float().norm()
+        return st.grads
+
+    def _torch_fn_backward(self, st: _LayerState, dy: torch.Tensor) -> dict:
+        """The reference block's gradients through autograd, into the layer's buffers (the trainer plumbing on any CUDA device)."""
+        inp = st.inputs
+        with torch.enable_grad():
+            leaves = {k: inp[k].detach().requires_grad_(True) for k in ("h", "w_qkvg", "w_o", "w_q_norm", "w_k_norm")}
+            ref = gated_attention_block_reference(
+                leaves["h"], leaves["w_qkvg"], leaves["w_q_norm"], leaves["w_k_norm"], self.cos, self.sin, leaves["w_o"], geom=self.ref_geom
+            )
+            g = torch.autograd.grad(ref.out, list(leaves.values()), dy)
+        for name, src in zip(("dh", "dw_qkvg", "dw_o", "dw_q_norm", "dw_k_norm"), g):
+            st.grads[name].copy_(src)
+        for name in _GRAD_NAMES:
+            st.met[_MET[f"norm_{name}"]] = st.grads[name].float().norm()
+        return st.grads
+
+    # -- the step ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+    def _set_delayed_scales(self, st: _LayerState, vals: Dict[str, float]) -> None:
+        for n, v in vals.items():
+            st.grad_scales[n].fill_(float(v))
+            st.grad_scales_host[n] = float(v)
+
+    def _begin_step(self, step: int) -> None:
+        self.step = step
+        self._calib_bwd = 0
+        self._grad_sat = {n: [] for n in self.arm.grad_scale_names} if self.arm.grad_scaling == "delayed" else None
+        if self.arm.grad_scaling != "delayed":
+            return
+        for st in self.layers:
+            if self.scale_feed is not None:
+                vals = self.scale_feed(step, st.layer)
+                missing = [n for n in self.arm.grad_scale_names if n not in vals]
+                if missing:
+                    raise ValueError(f"scale_feed(step={step}, layer={st.layer}) lacks {missing}")
+                self._set_delayed_scales(st, {n: vals[n] for n in self.arm.grad_scale_names})
+            elif step > 0:
+                self._set_delayed_scales(st, {n: grad_scale_from_amax(max(st.grad_hist[n]), self.arm.margin_log2) for n in self.arm.grad_scale_names})
+            # step 0 without a feed: the bootstrap ladder in _backward_layer seeds each scale from a discarded pass (bootstrap_rungs)
+
+    def _needs_activation_calibration(self) -> bool:
+        return self.arm.family == "fp8" and self.arm.act_window > 0
+
+    def _seed_activation_histories(self) -> None:
+        torch.cuda.synchronize()
+        for st in self.layers:
+            met = st.met.tolist()
+            for x in _ACTS:
+                st.act_hist[x].append(met[_MET[f"amax_{x}"]])
+
+    def _grad_norm(self) -> float:
+        sq = torch.stack([p.grad.float().pow(2).sum() for p in self.model.params.values()]).sum()
+        return float(sq.sqrt().item())
+
+    def _torch_arm_metrics(self) -> None:
+        """The ``torch`` arm runs no Function: its gradient norms are those of the fp32 master gradients of the block's parameters
+        (``dh`` has no master and stays NaN), written into the metrics tensor the readback reads."""
+        p = self.model.params
+        for st in self.layers:
+            st.met[_MET["norm_dh"]] = float("nan")
+            for name, key in (("dw_qkvg", "w_qkvg"), ("dw_o", "w_o"), ("dw_q_norm", "w_q_norm"), ("dw_k_norm", "w_k_norm")):
+                st.met[_MET[f"norm_{name}"]] = p[f"{key}.{st.layer}"].grad.float().norm()
+
+    def _grad_hash_tensors(self, st: _LayerState) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+        """What ``grad_sha256`` hashes for one layer: the block's bf16 ``dw_qkvg`` / ``dw_o`` buffers, or the fp32 master gradients of
+        those two weights for the ``torch`` arm (no block buffers there)."""
+        if self.arm.family == "torch":
+            p = self.model.params
+            return p[f"w_qkvg.{st.layer}"].grad, p[f"w_o.{st.layer}"].grad
+        return st.grads["dw_qkvg"], st.grads["dw_o"]
+
+    def _clip(self, total_norm: float) -> None:
+        coef = self.cfg.clip_norm / (total_norm + 1e-6)
+        if coef < 1.0:
+            for p in self.model.params.values():
+                p.grad.mul_(coef)
+
+    def _fp4_stats_of(self, st: _LayerState, sc: Dict[str, float]) -> Dict[str, Optional[float]]:
+        """The fp4 arms' code statistics of this step and layer (``_FP4_STAT_KEYS``): the e2m1 zero / saturated-code shares of the
+        re-quantized transposed weights, and under an NVFP4 ``W_o`` those of the two-level NVFP4 cast of ``scale_dy x dY`` (the host
+        twin of the backward's own cast: ``fp4_quantize_rowwise_2d(dY, "nvfp4", global_scale=scale_dy)``, bitwise the oracle) plus the
+        share of its 16-blocks that are all zero -- the dynamic-range floor of the 4-bit gradient operand."""
+        out: Dict[str, Optional[float]] = {k: None for k in _FP4_STAT_KEYS}
+        art = st.inputs["art"]
+        if self.arm.w_qkvg_fp4:
+            out["w_qkvg_t_zero"], out["w_qkvg_t_sat"] = _e2m1_shares(art["w_qkvg_t"])
+        if self.arm.o_fp4 is not None:
+            out["w_o_t_zero"], out["w_o_t_sat"] = _e2m1_shares(art["w_o_t"])
+            if self.arm.o_fp4 == "nvfp4" and st.dy_ref is not None:
+                t, dm = self.geom.tokens_per_step, self.geom.d_model
+                packed, _ = fp4_quantize_rowwise_2d(st.dy_ref.reshape(t, dm), "nvfp4", global_scale=sc["scale_dy"])
+                out["dy4_zero"], out["dy4_sat"] = _e2m1_shares(packed)
+                mag = packed.view(torch.uint8) & 0x77  # both nibbles' magnitude bits; a 16-code block is 8 bytes
+                out["dy4_zero_blocks"] = float((mag.reshape(t, dm // 16, 8).amax(-1) == 0).float().mean())
+        return out
+
+    def _read_back(self) -> Tuple[List[list], Optional[List[Dict[str, float]]]]:
+        """After the step's backward: ONE sync, every layer's metrics and scalar block; the gradient-scale check (asserted under
+        "current", counted under "delayed") and the dP check; the next step's ``scale_dp``; the activation and gradient amax
+        histories; the fp4 arms' code statistics every ``fp4_stats_every`` steps."""
+        torch.cuda.synchronize()
+        mets = torch.stack([st.met for st in self.layers]).tolist()
+        scalars = None
+        self._fp4_stats = None
+        fp4_now = self.arm.fp4 and self.fp4_stats_every > 0 and self.step % self.fp4_stats_every == 0
+        if self.arm.quantized:
+            scalars = []
+            for st, met in zip(self.layers, mets):
+                sc = self._read_scalars(st)
+                for n in self.arm.grad_scale_names:
+                    what = n[len("scale_") :]
+                    amax = sc["amax_" + what]
+                    if amax != amax:
+                        raise RuntimeError(f"step {self.step} layer {st.layer}: the published amax of {what} is NaN")
+                    sat = not (amax * sc[n] <= E4M3_MAX)
+                    if self.arm.grad_scaling == "current":
+                        if sat:
+                            raise RuntimeError(
+                                f"step {self.step} layer {st.layer}: amax * {n} = {amax:.6g} * {sc[n]:.6g} > {E4M3_MAX}: the e4m3 gradient would "
+                                f"saturate -- under grad_scaling='current' the kernel derives {n} from this step's amax, so this is a bug"
+                            )
+                    else:
+                        self._grad_sat[n].append(bool(sat))  # the lagged recipe's cost (zero headroom at margin 0): reported, never asserted
+                    st.grad_hist[n].append(amax)
+                if self.arm.family == "fp8":
+                    prod = sc["amax_dp"] * st.scale_dp_host
+                    if not (prod <= E4M3_MAX) or prod != prod:
+                        raise RuntimeError(
+                            f"step {self.step} layer {st.layer}: amax_dp * scale_dp = {sc['amax_dp']:.6g} * {st.scale_dp_host:.6g} > {E4M3_MAX}: the e4m3 dS would saturate"
+                        )
+                    st.scale_dp_host = self._next_scale_dp(sc["amax_dp"])
+                    st.scale_dp.fill_(st.scale_dp_host)
+                    for x in _ACTS:
+                        st.act_hist[x].append(met[_MET[f"amax_{x}"]])
+                scalars.append(sc)
+            if fp4_now:
+                self._fp4_stats = [self._fp4_stats_of(st, sc) for st, sc in zip(self.layers, scalars)]
+        return mets, scalars
+
+    def _row(
+        self, step: int, loss: float, lr: float, grad_norm: float, mets: List[list], scalars, calib_fwd: bool, wall_ms: float, val_loss: Optional[float] = None
+    ) -> dict:
+        g, arm = self.geom, self.arm
+        layers = self.layers
+        row: dict = dict(
+            step=step,
+            tokens_seen=(step + 1) * g.tokens_per_step,
+            loss=loss,
+            val_loss=val_loss,
+            lr=lr,
+            grad_norm_total=grad_norm,
+            calib_fwd=calib_fwd,
+            calib_bwd=bool(self._calib_bwd),
+            grad_norms={name: [m[_MET[f"norm_{name}"]] for m in mets] for name in _GRAD_NAMES},
+            arm=arm.name,
+            recipe=dict(
+                family=arm.family,
+                grad_scaling=arm.grad_scaling,
+                grad_window=arm.grad_window,
+                margin_log2=arm.margin_log2,
+                act_window=arm.act_window,
+                bwd_knobs=list(arm.bwd_knobs),
+                dp_scale_rule=arm.dp_scale_rule,
+                dp_margin_log2=arm.dp_margin_log2,
+                w_qkvg_fp4=arm.w_qkvg_fp4,
+                o_fp4=arm.o_fp4,
+            ),
+            geometry=dataclasses.asdict(g),
+            seed=self.seed,
+            data_seed=self.data_seed,
+        )
+        if arm.quantized:
+            fields = [f.name for f in dataclasses.fields(type(layers[0].spec)) if isinstance(getattr(layers[0].spec, f.name), float)]
+            row["spec"] = {f: [float(getattr(st.spec, f)) for st in layers] for f in fields}
+            row["quant_scalars"] = {k: [sc[k] for sc in scalars] for k in scalars[0]}
+            if arm.family == "fp8":
+                # the scale_dp the logged backward RAN at (the next step's is set at readback), the activation amax of this step's
+                # record and the saturation counters at this step's scales
+                row["scale_dp"] = [sc["descale_dp"] and 1.0 / sc["descale_dp"] for sc in scalars]
+                row["act_amax"] = {x: [m[_MET[f"amax_{x}"]] for m in mets] for x in _ACTS}
+                row["sat"] = {x: [bool(m[_MET[f"amax_{x}"]] * st.act_scales[f"scale_{x}"] > E4M3_MAX) for m, st in zip(mets, layers)] for x in _ACTS}
+                row["n_clip"] = {x: [int(round(m[_MET[f"n_clip_{x}"]])) for m in mets] for x in _ACTS}
+            if arm.grad_scaling == "delayed":
+                row["given_scales"] = {n: [st.grad_scales_host.get(n) for st in layers] for n in arm.grad_scale_names}
+                row["grad_sat"] = dict(self._grad_sat)  # per gradient scale and layer: amax * scale > 448 this step (reported)
+            if arm.fp4:
+                row["fp4_stats"] = self._fp4_stats  # per layer (``_FP4_STAT_KEYS``) on the sampled steps, null elsewhere
+        if step % self.grad_hash_every == 0:
+            h = hashlib.sha256()
+            for st in layers:
+                for ten in self._grad_hash_tensors(st):
+                    h.update(_tensor_bytes(ten))
+            row["grad_sha256"] = h.hexdigest()
+        else:
+            row["grad_sha256"] = None
+        row["grad_sha256_of"] = "master_fp32_w_qkvg_w_o" if arm.family == "torch" else "block_bf16_dw_qkvg_dw_o"
+        row["row_digest"] = row_digest(row)
+        row.update(
+            replica=self.replica, wall_ms=wall_ms, timestamp=time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", time.gmtime()), host=socket.gethostname(), pid=os.getpid()
+        )
+        return row
+
+    # -- evaluation and the tethered gradient evaluation ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+    def evaluate(self) -> Optional[float]:
+        """The mean loss over the validation windows with THIS arm's own forward (its deployed numerics: the current weights
+        quantized the arm's way, the fp8 activation scales as the next training step would use them); no record, history or
+        counter of the trajectory is touched (the forward's amax recording is skipped)."""
+        if self.val_windows is None:
+            return None
+        self.evaluating = True
+        try:
+            with torch.no_grad():
+                losses = []
+                for b in self.val_windows.batches:
+                    tokens = b.to(self.device)
+                    losses.append(self.model.forward(tokens[:, :-1].contiguous(), tokens[:, 1:].contiguous(), self.block))
+                return float(torch.stack(losses).mean().item())
+        finally:
+            self.evaluating = False
+
+    def grads_on(self, inp: torch.Tensor, tgt: torch.Tensor, params: Dict[str, torch.Tensor]):
+        """This arm's forward + backward on ANOTHER run's fp32 masters ``params`` (aliased, never updated) and its batch, with NO lag
+        in any scale -- the tethered gradient-fidelity evaluation: the fp8 activation scales come from a calibration forward on this
+        very batch (window 1 over an emptied history), ``descale_h / descale_w_*`` from the tensors being evaluated, ``scale_dp`` and
+        the delayed recipe's gradient scales from the step-0 bootstrap ladder (discarded passes on this batch).  Returns ``(loss,
+        master gradients by name, per-layer block gradients dh / dw_qkvg / dw_o, the backward's quant_scalars per layer)``; the
+        other run's ``.grad`` tensors are set aside and restored, so its own step is untouched."""
+        own = self.model.params
+        self.model.params = params
+        saved = {k: p.grad for k, p in params.items()}
+        try:
+            for p in params.values():
+                p.grad = None
+            for st in self.layers:
+                for d in list(st.act_hist.values()) + list(st.grad_hist.values()):
+                    d.clear()
+            self.step = 0
+            if self._needs_activation_calibration():
+                self.calibrating = True
+                with torch.no_grad():
+                    self.model.forward(inp, tgt, self.block)
+                self._seed_activation_histories()
+                self.calibrating = False
+            self._begin_step(0)
+            loss = self.model.forward(inp, tgt, self.block)
+            loss.backward()
+            if self.arm.family == "torch":
+                self._torch_arm_metrics()
+            _, scalars = self._read_back()
+            master = {k: p.grad.detach().clone() for k, p in params.items()}
+            block = [{n: st.grads[n].detach().clone() for n in _TETHER_GRADS} for st in self.layers] if self.arm.uses_block else None
+            return float(loss.item()), master, block, scalars
+        finally:
+            for k, p in params.items():
+                p.grad = saved[k]
+            self.model.params = own
+
+    def run(self, steps: int, *, jsonl_path: Optional[str] = None, keep_grads_at: Tuple[int, ...] = ()) -> RunResult:
+        """Train ``steps`` steps (``steps >= 1``: a run with no step has no row to digest and is refused); returns the rows (and the
+        fp32 master gradients, pre-clip, of the steps in ``keep_grads_at``).  Deterministic algorithms are forced for the duration and
+        restored after."""
+        if steps < 1:
+            raise ValueError(f"steps must be >= 1 (a run with no step has no row to digest), got {steps}")
+        self.check_environment()
+        prev_det = torch.are_deterministic_algorithms_enabled()
+        prev_tf32 = torch.backends.cuda.matmul.allow_tf32
+        torch.use_deterministic_algorithms(True)
+        torch.backends.cuda.matmul.allow_tf32 = False
+        try:
+            return self._run(steps, jsonl_path, set(keep_grads_at))
+        finally:
+            torch.use_deterministic_algorithms(prev_det)
+            torch.backends.cuda.matmul.allow_tf32 = prev_tf32
+
+    def _run(self, steps: int, jsonl_path: Optional[str], keep: set) -> RunResult:
+        rows: List[dict] = []
+        kept: Dict[int, Dict[str, torch.Tensor]] = {}
+        started = time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", time.gmtime())
+        f = open(jsonl_path, "w") if jsonl_path else None
+        params = self.model.params
+        try:
+            for step in range(steps):
+                t0 = time.perf_counter()
+                tokens = self.data.batch().to(self.device)
+                inp, tgt = tokens[:, :-1].contiguous(), tokens[:, 1:].contiguous()
+                calib_fwd = False
+                if step == 0 and self._needs_activation_calibration():
+                    self.calibrating = True
+                    self.step = 0
+                    with torch.no_grad():
+                        self.model.forward(inp, tgt, self.block)
+                    self._seed_activation_histories()
+                    self.calibrating = False
+                    calib_fwd = True
+                self._begin_step(step)
+                for p in params.values():
+                    p.grad = None
+                loss = self.model.forward(inp, tgt, self.block)
+                loss.backward()
+                if self.arm.family == "torch":
+                    self._torch_arm_metrics()
+                mets, scalars = self._read_back()
+                loss_val = float(loss.item())
+                if not math.isfinite(loss_val):
+                    raise RuntimeError(f"step {step}: non-finite loss {loss_val}")
+                grad_norm = self._grad_norm()
+                if not math.isfinite(grad_norm):
+                    raise RuntimeError(f"step {step}: non-finite gradient norm {grad_norm}")
+                for name, vals in ((n, [m[_MET[f"norm_{n}"]] for m in mets]) for n in _GRAD_NAMES):
+                    if not all(math.isfinite(v) for v in vals) and not (name == "dh" and self.arm.family == "torch"):
+                        raise RuntimeError(f"step {step}: non-finite block gradient {name}: {vals}")
+                if self.on_grads is not None:
+                    self.on_grads(self, step, inp, tgt)
+                if step in keep:
+                    kept[step] = {k: p.grad.detach().clone() for k, p in params.items()}
+                self._clip(grad_norm)
+                lr = self.cfg.lr_at(step, steps)
+                for grp in self.opt.param_groups:
+                    grp["lr"] = lr
+                self.opt.step()
+                torch.cuda.synchronize()
+                wall_ms = (time.perf_counter() - t0) * 1e3
+                # The row is built from the TRAINING step's layer state -- its ``spec`` and activation scales -- BEFORE the arm's
+                # evaluation forward, which rewrites every layer's ``spec`` / ``act_scales`` with the validation windows' descales and
+                # the next step's scales; ``val_loss`` is attached afterwards and the digest re-sealed over the row as written.
+                row = self._row(step, loss_val, lr, grad_norm, mets, scalars, calib_fwd, wall_ms)
+                val_loss = None
+                if self.val_windows is not None and ((step + 1) % self.val_every == 0 or step == steps - 1):
+                    val_loss = self.evaluate()
+                    row["val_loss"] = val_loss
+                    row["row_digest"] = row_digest(row)
+                rows.append(row)
+                if f is not None:
+                    f.write(json.dumps(row, sort_keys=True) + "\n")
+                    f.flush()
+                if step % self.log_every == 0 or step == steps - 1 or val_loss is not None or step == 1:
+                    self.log(
+                        f"[{self.name}] step {step:5d} loss {loss_val:.5f} lr {lr:.3e} |g| {grad_norm:.4f} wall {wall_ms:8.1f} ms"
+                        f"{'  (calib fwd)' if calib_fwd else ''}{f'  (calib bwd x{self._calib_bwd} per layer)' if self._calib_bwd else ''}"
+                        f"{f'  val {val_loss:.5f}' if val_loss is not None else ''}"
+                    )
+        finally:
+            if f is not None:
+                f.close()
+        walls = sorted(r["wall_ms"] for r in rows[1:])
+        median_ms = walls[len(walls) // 2] if walls else None
+        manifest = dict(
+            name=self.name,
+            arm=self.arm.as_dict(),
+            geometry=dataclasses.asdict(self.geom),
+            config=dataclasses.asdict(self.cfg),
+            data=self.data.as_dict(),
+            seed=self.seed,
+            replica=self.replica,
+            steps=steps,
+            n_rows=len(rows),
+            bootstrap_rungs=self.bootstrap_rungs(),
+            validation=self.val_windows.as_dict() if self.val_windows is not None else None,
+            val_every=self.val_every,
+            fp4_stats_every=self.fp4_stats_every,
+            grad_hash_every=self.grad_hash_every,
+            val_losses={r["step"]: r["val_loss"] for r in rows if r.get("val_loss") is not None},
+            run_digest=run_digest(rows),
+            first_row_digest=rows[0]["row_digest"] if rows else None,
+            last_loss=rows[-1]["loss"] if rows else None,
+            ms_per_step_median_steps_ge_1=median_ms,
+            deterministic_algorithms=True,
+            cublas_workspace_config=os.environ.get("CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG"),
+            torch=torch.__version__,
+            cudnn_module=sys.modules["cudnn"].__file__,
+            device=torch.cuda.get_device_name(self.device),
+            compute_capability=list(torch.cuda.get_device_capability(self.device)),
+            sm_count=torch.cuda.get_device_properties(self.device).multi_processor_count,
+            host=socket.gethostname(),
+            pid=os.getpid(),
+            started=started,
+            finished=time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", time.gmtime()),
+        )
+        return RunResult(rows=rows, manifest=manifest, kept_grads=kept, run=self)
+

+def run_training(

+        return _assert_grad_close(got, ref64, what)  # (0): the identical path -- print, cosine floor, assert_close, return
+    worst = (diff / bound).max().item()
+    cos = _cos(got64, ref64)
+    stats = (
+        f"{what}: max|diff|={diff.max().item():.4g} max|ref|={ref_max:.4g} worst cell {worst:.3f} of the bound "
+        f"(rtol={rtol}, atol={atol_frac}*max|ref|) cos={cos:.6f} {got.dtype}"
+    )
+    print(stats)
+    assert cos >= _COS_MIN, stats
+    budget = _row_budget(n_rows, keys)
+    rows = torch.nonzero(rows_out).flatten()
+    coords = [tuple(int(x) for x in torch.unravel_index(r, got.shape[:-1])) for r in rows[:8]]
+    which = "P" if kind == "dV" else "dS"
+    print(
+        f"{what} (flip-structured form): {n_out} of {n_rows} d-rows outside the bf16 bound {coords}{' ...' if n_out > 8 else ''} "
+        f"(row budget {budget:.3g} = max(1, 1e-5 x {n_rows} x {keys})); every one must be ONE proven {fp8_dtype} {which} flip"
+    )
+    assert (
+        n_out <= budget
+    ), f"{stats} -- {n_out} of {n_rows} d-rows outside the bf16 bound, over the row budget {budget:.3g} (1e-5 x rows x keys, at least 1): not the flip class"
+    fits = flip_evidence(
+        got.float(),
+        ref.float(),
+        rows_out,
+        atol,
+        rtol,
+        tag=what,
+        kind=kind,
+        operand=operand,
+        flip_unit=flip_unit,
+        fp8_dtype=fp8_dtype,
+        out_dtype=out_dtype,
+        intermediates=intermediates,
+    )
+    assert (
+        fits is not None
+    ), f"{stats} -- a d-row outside the bf16 bound is NOT one {fp8_dtype} {which} flip of the reference's own intermediates (the diagnosis is printed above)"
+    term = torch.zeros_like(got64)
+    op64 = operand.detach().double().to(got64.device)
+    for f in fits:
+        print(describe_flip(what, f, fp8_dtype, flip_unit))
+        b_, s_, h_ = f["operand_row"]
+        term[f["row"]] += f["u"] * float(flip_unit) * f["gain"] * op64[b_, s_, h_]
+    residual = (got64 - ref64 - term).abs()
+    res_worst = (residual / bound).max().item()
+    n_after = int((residual > bound).sum())
+    print(
+        f"{what} (flip-structured form): the flip term reaches {(term.abs() / bound).max().item():.3f} of the bound; "
+        f"the residual after it {res_worst:.3f} ({n_after} cells outside after)"
+    )
+    assert n_after == 0, (
+        f"{stats} -- after removing the proven flip's exact rank-1 term the residual is {res_worst:.3f} of the bf16 bound on {n_after} cells: "
+        f"the flip does not explain the row"
+    )
+    return worst

+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# The SDPA-stage flip-structured form's host pins (CPU, no device): a seeded fixture of the stage's own reduction with the reference's
+# intermediates PLANTED -- one e4m3 midpoint flip at a known position -- and the mutants each condition of the form was built to reject.
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+_SDPA_FLIP_POS = (1, 3, 5)  # (q head, query i, key j) of the planted flip
+_SDPA_FLIP_MIDPOINT = 12.5  # the midpoint of the adjacent e4m3 codes 12 and 13 (spacing 1 in [8, 16)): torch's RNE rounds it to 12
+_SDPA_FLIP_KINDS = ("dV", "dK", "dQ")
+_SDPA_FLIP_MATRIX = pytest.mark.parametrize("kind", _SDPA_FLIP_KINDS)
+
+
+def _sdpa_flip_fixture(
+    kind: str, *, factor=1.0, op_amp=2.0, midpoint=True, off_midpoints=False, garbage=0.0, second_flip=None, seed=0, s=32, h_q=2, h_kv=1, d=256
+):
+    """A CPU fixture of the SDPA stage's reduction for ``_assert_sdpa_stage_flip_structured`` (no device, no reference run): the
+    DEQUANTIZED operand as e4m3-exact values (``dO [1, s, h_q, d]`` for dV, ``Q`` for dK, ``K [1, s, h_kv, d]`` for dQ; the row the flip
+    multiplies set to ``+-op_amp``, an e4m3-exact amplitude), the reference's SCALED fp32 intermediate ``x [1, h_q, s, s]`` (``softmax *
+    2^FP8_SCALE_S_LOG2`` for P, ``randn * 6`` for dS at a ``scale_dp`` of 64) with the planted position ``(0, *_SDPA_FLIP_POS)`` set to
+    ``_SDPA_FLIP_MIDPOINT`` (``12.25``, a quarter spacing off, with ``midpoint=False``; ``off_midpoints=True`` moves EVERY other value a
+    quarter spacing off its own midpoint so no tie exists anywhere), ``valid`` all True (dense).  The reference's codes are torch's
+    cast of ``x``; the kernel's are the same with the planted code moved by ``factor x u`` (1 = one flip, 3 = three, 1.6 = a fraction),
+    ``second_flip = (q head, i, j)`` plants a second midpoint flip (its operand row amplified too).  ``ref`` is the stage's own
+    contraction of the reference's codes in fp64 rounded to bf16 (held fp32 like ``_row_reference`` returns it), ``got`` the kernel's
+    codes' contraction rounded to bf16, ``garbage`` added to the first three cells of the flipped row.  ``intermediates(selection)``
+    slices the planted ``x`` / ``valid`` into the reference's gathered layout (``kv_cols`` -> ``[n, g, s_q]`` per ``(b, kv head, j)``,
+    ``q_rows`` -> ``[n, s_kv]`` per ``(b, q head, i)``).  Returns a namespace with ``got / ref / operand / flip_unit / intermediates /
+    keys``, the planted ``row`` (of the output) and ``pos`` (b, hq, i, j), the exact one-flip ``term`` on that row, ``factor``, ``seed``."""
+    _test_python_root()
+    from sdpa.fp8 import _fp8_codes_around  # the proof's own code-neighbour arithmetic: the fixture plants what it will be asked to find
+
+    assert float(torch.tensor(op_amp).to(_E4M3)) == op_amp, f"op_amp {op_amp} is not e4m3-exact"
+    g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(seed)
+    grp = h_q // h_kv
+    hq, i, j = _SDPA_FLIP_POS
+    by_q_row = kind == "dQ"
+    s_scale, scale_dp = 2.0 ** _api_const("FP8_SCALE_S_LOG2"), 64.0
+    if kind == "dV":
+        op = (torch.randn(1, s, h_q, d, generator=g) * 0.5).to(_E4M3).float()
+        x, unit = torch.softmax(torch.randn(1, h_q, s, s, generator=g), dim=-1) * s_scale, 1.0 / s_scale
+    elif kind == "dK":
+        op = (torch.randn(1, s, h_q, d, generator=g) * 0.5).to(_E4M3).float()
+        x, unit = torch.randn(1, h_q, s, s, generator=g) * 6.0, 1.0 / scale_dp
+    else:
+        op = (torch.randn(1, s, h_kv, d, generator=g) * 0.5).to(_E4M3).float()
+        x, unit = torch.randn(1, h_q, s, s, generator=g) * 6.0, 1.0 / scale_dp
+    flips = [(hq, i, j)] + ([tuple(second_flip)] if second_flip is not None else [])
+    for fh, fi, fj in flips:  # the operand row the flip multiplies: +-op_amp (K row j of the kv head for dQ; the dO / Q row i of q head fh otherwise)
+        signs = torch.sign(torch.randn(d, generator=g))
+        if by_q_row:
+            op[0, fj, fh // grp] = (op_amp * signs).to(_E4M3).float()
+        else:
+            op[0, fi, fh] = (op_amp * signs).to(_E4M3).float()
+    if off_midpoints:
+        c_ref0, c_alt0, u0 = _fp8_codes_around(x, _E4M3)
+        x = torch.where(u0 != 0, c_ref0 + 0.25 * (c_alt0 - c_ref0), x)
+    for fh, fi, fj in flips:
+        x[0, fh, fi, fj] = _SDPA_FLIP_MIDPOINT if midpoint else _SDPA_FLIP_MIDPOINT - 0.25
+    c_ref, c_alt, u = _fp8_codes_around(x, _E4M3)
+    valid = torch.ones_like(x, dtype=torch.bool)
+    codes_k = c_ref.clone()
+    for fh, fi, fj in flips:
+        codes_k[0, fh, fi, fj] = c_ref[0, fh, fi, fj] + factor * u[0, fh, fi, fj]
+
+    def reduce(codes):  # the stage's own contraction, in fp64 (exact: e4m3 codes times e4m3-exact operands)
+        if by_q_row:
+            out = torch.zeros(1, s, h_q, d, dtype=torch.float64)
+            for q_ in range(h_q):
+                out[0, :, q_, :] = codes[0, q_].double() @ op[0, :, q_ // grp, :].double()
+        else:
+            out = torch.zeros(1, s, h_kv, d, dtype=torch.float64)
+            for hk in range(h_kv):
+                for q_ in range(hk * grp, (hk + 1) * grp):
+                    out[0, :, hk, :] += codes[0, q_].double().t() @ op[0, :, q_, :].double()
+        return out * unit
+
+    ref64, got64 = reduce(c_ref), reduce(codes_k)
+    row = (0, i, hq) if by_q_row else (0, j, hq // grp)
+    if garbage:
+        got64[row][:3] += garbage
+    ref, got = ref64.to(torch.bfloat16).float(), got64.to(torch.bfloat16)
+    key = "p_scaled" if kind == "dV" else "ds_scaled"
+
+    def intermediates(selection):
+        mode, coords = next(iter(selection.items()))
+        coords = torch.as_tensor(coords).reshape(-1, 3).tolist()
+        if mode == "kv_cols":
+            xs = torch.stack([x[b_, hk * grp : (hk + 1) * grp, :, jj] for b_, hk, jj in coords])
+            vs = torch.stack([valid[b_, hk * grp : (hk + 1) * grp, :, jj] for b_, hk, jj in coords])
+        else:
+            xs = torch.stack([x[b_, q_, ii, :] for b_, q_, ii in coords])
+            vs = torch.stack([valid[b_, q_, ii, :] for b_, q_, ii in coords])
+        return {key: xs, "valid": vs, "gain": None, "h_q": h_q, "h_kv": h_kv, "mode": mode}
+
+    op_row = op[0, j, hq // grp] if by_q_row else op[0, i, hq]
+    term = (u[0, hq, i, j] * unit * op_row).double()
+    operand_row = (0, j, hq // grp) if by_q_row else (0, i, hq)
+    return SimpleNamespace(
+        kind=kind, got=got, ref=ref, operand=op, flip_unit=unit, intermediates=intermediates, keys=s, row=row, pos=(0, hq, i, j), operand_row=operand_row,
+        term=term, factor=factor, seed=seed, what=f"{kind} fixture (seed {seed})"
+    )  # fmt: skip
+
+
+def _sdpa_flip_preconditions(f) -> tuple:
+    """What the fixture must satisfy for a pin to mean what it says (the fp8 self-tests' ``_is_bad_row`` / ``_decisive`` pattern):
+    ``visible`` -- ONE flip puts a cell of the planted row outside the bf16 bound; ``hidden`` -- the ``(factor - 1)`` residual against
+    one flip is inside the bound AND inside ``atol`` + half a bf16 spacing from each side on every cell (so only the flip COUNT can
+    reject it).  Also returns the one-flip term and that residual as fractions of the row's bound."""
+    _test_python_root()
+    from sdpa.fp8 import _grid_spacing
+
+    ref64 = f.ref.double()
+    atol = _ATOL_FRAC[torch.bfloat16] * ref64.abs().max().item()
+    bound_row = atol + _RTOL[torch.bfloat16] * ref64[f.row].abs()
+    one = f.term.abs()
+    resid = ((f.factor - 1.0) * f.term).abs()
+    a_row, e_row = f.got[f.row].float(), f.ref[f.row]
+    tol_out = atol + (_grid_spacing(a_row, torch.bfloat16) + _grid_spacing(e_row, torch.bfloat16)).double() / 2
+    visible = bool((one > bound_row).any())
+    hidden = bool((resid <= bound_row).all() and (resid <= tol_out).all())
+    return visible, hidden, (one / bound_row).max().item(), (resid / bound_row).max().item()
+
+
+def _sdpa_flip_case(kind: str, *, want_visible=True, want_hidden=None, seeds=range(16), **kw):
+    """The first seed whose fixture satisfies the pin's preconditions (``_sdpa_flip_preconditions``), printed; a torch RNG-stream change
+    surfaces here as a precondition failure with every tried seed listed, never as a pin that passes for the wrong reason."""
+    tried = []
+    for seed in seeds:
+        f = _sdpa_flip_fixture(kind, seed=seed, **kw)
+        visible, hidden, one_r, res_r = _sdpa_flip_preconditions(f)
+        tried.append((seed, visible, hidden, round(one_r, 3), round(res_r, 3)))
+        if visible == want_visible and (want_hidden is None or hidden == want_hidden):
+            print(f"{f.what}: one flip {one_r:.3f} of the bound (visible={visible}); the (factor - 1) residual {res_r:.3f} (hidden={hidden}); {kw}")
+            return f
+    raise AssertionError(
+        f"no seed in {list(seeds)} builds the {kind} fixture with visible={want_visible} hidden={want_hidden} for {kw}: (seed, visible, hidden, one, resid) {tried}"
+    )
+
+
+def _run_sdpa_flip_form(f, what_suffix="(the bf16 bound form)") -> float:
+    return _assert_sdpa_stage_flip_structured(
+        f.got, f.ref, f"{f.what} {what_suffix}", kind=f.kind, keys=f.keys, operand=f.operand, flip_unit=f.flip_unit, intermediates=f.intermediates
+    )
+

+@_SDPA_FLIP_MATRIX
+def test_sdpa_stage_flip_form_accepts_one_proven_flip(kind, capsys):
+    """The control, with its RED half: one planted e4m3 midpoint flip (``x = 12.5``, codes ``+12 -> +13``, step ``+1 x flip_unit``) times an
+    operand row of amplitude 2 puts ONE d-row outside the bf16 bound -- the plain bound form (``_assert_grad_close``, the pin as it
+    stood) REJECTS it with the statistics line -- and the flip-structured form PROVES it: the printed attribution names the planted
+    position, the two codes and the operand row, fits it as one flip within 5 %, and the residual after the exact term leaves no cell
+    outside; the returned worst is the magnitude the plain form judged (> 1)."""
+    f = _sdpa_flip_case(kind, want_visible=True)
+    with pytest.raises(AssertionError, match=r"worst cell [1-9][0-9]*\.[0-9]+ of the bound") as red:
+        _assert_grad_close(f.got, f.ref.double(), f"{f.what} (the bf16 bound form, plain)")
+    print(f"RED half (the plain bound form): {red.value}")
+    capsys.readouterr()
+    worst = _run_sdpa_flip_form(f)
+    out = capsys.readouterr().out
+    assert worst > 1.0, worst
+    assert "(flip-structured form): 1 of" in out and "d-rows outside the bf16 bound" in out and "(row budget 1 =" in out, out
+    assert f"is ONE flipped fp8 intermediate at (b, hq, i, j)={f.pos}: x=+12.5 rounds to {_E4M3} code +12, the kernel to +13" in out, out
+    assert f"x operand row {f.operand_row} reproduces the row" in out, out
+    fit = float(re.search(r"and fits it as ([0-9.]+) flips", out).group(1))
+    assert abs(fit - 1.0) < 0.05, fit
+    assert re.search(r"the residual after it 0\.[0-9]+ \(0 cells outside after\)", out), out

+def test_both_sdpa_stage_pins_take_the_flip_structured_form():
+    """The dense and the packed suites hold the SDPA stage's bf16 output to ONE form: each stage block calls
+    ``_assert_sdpa_stage_flip_structured`` with ``kind=`` and ``keys=``, and no plain ``_assert_grad_close`` on the ``(the bf16 bound
+    form)`` string survives in either (host, no device: reads both modules' source)."""
+    here = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
+    for module, head in (
+        ("test_block_backward_fp8.py", "def test_fp8_stage_localised_bounds("),
+        ("test_block_thd_backward_fp8.py", "def _assert_sdpa_stage_per_sequence("),
+    ):
+        src = open(os.path.join(here, module)).read()
+        start = src.index("\n" + head) + 1  # the column-0 definition, not this test's own mention of it
+        end = src.find("\ndef ", start + 1)

+"""The block's forward kernels through the persistent compiled-plan cache.
+
+Every compile site of ``kernels/elementwise.py``, ``kernels/qk_norm_rope_tma.py``, ``kernels/cache_write.py`` (the serving
+write-through) and the three forks of the rendered GEMM template (``kernels/proj_gemm_norm_rope.py`` + ``_fp8`` / ``_mxfp8``) goes
+through ``cudnn.frost.compiled_cache.compile_cached``:
+the module dict each site already kept stays the in-process memo, and behind it the on-disk cache hands the next process the
+exported object instead of re-tracing and re-running ptxas.  Keys follow ``compiled_cache.template_key``: the module's source
+digest (the template loader's file + params digest for the forks, a file digest for the three plainly imported modules) joined with
+the function tag and the dict key's plain values (``None`` -- not cacheable -- for a tensor / device / stream, so the keys stay the
+Constexpr tuples the dicts use).
+
+The host tests pin the keys, the memo and the two documented switches with ``cute.compile`` stubbed; the Rubin test runs
+every site in a second process and asserts it reloads every kernel and writes the same bytes.
+"""
+
+import hashlib
+import importlib
+import importlib.util
+import json
+import os
+import subprocess
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from cudnn.frost.buffers import cutedsl_requirement_error
+
+requirement_error = cutedsl_requirement_error("Gated attention block tests")
+if requirement_error:
+    pytest.skip(requirement_error, allow_module_level=True)
+
+from cudnn.frost import compiled_cache as cc  # noqa: E402
+from cudnn.gated_attention_block.kernels import elementwise as kern_ew  # noqa: E402
+from cudnn.gated_attention_block.kernels import proj_gemm as kern_pg  # noqa: E402
+from cudnn.gated_attention_block.kernels import qk_norm_rope_tma as kern_tma  # noqa: E402
+
+pytestmark = pytest.mark.L0
+requires_rubin = pytest.mark.requires_rubin  # the suite conftest's registered marker: an accept test, skipped off SM107
+
+# The serving cache-write kernel (``kernels/cache_write.py``, the paged-KV serving form's write-through) is a separate change: its
+# site is pinned here exactly where the module is in the tree and skipped BY NAME where it is not -- the pins turn on the day the
+# kernel lands and never leave this suite red on a tree without it.  The probe is the module's PRESENCE (``find_spec``), never a
+# swallowed ImportError: a tree that carries the kernel but cannot import it fails here loudly instead of skipping.
+_CACHE_WRITE_MODULE = "cudnn.gated_attention_block.kernels.cache_write"
+kern_cw = importlib.import_module(_CACHE_WRITE_MODULE) if importlib.util.find_spec(_CACHE_WRITE_MODULE) is not None else None
+requires_cache_write_kernel = pytest.mark.skipif(kern_cw is None, reason="kernels/cache_write.py (the serving cache-write kernel) is not in this tree")
+
+_KERNELS = Path(kern_ew.__file__).parent
+# file -> (the function tag template_key joins, the exported symbol)
+_SITES = {
+    "elementwise.py": ("compile_elementwise_gate", "cudnn_block_elementwise_gate"),
+    "qk_norm_rope_tma.py": ("compile_qk_norm_rope_tma", "cudnn_block_qk_norm_rope_tma"),
+    "proj_gemm_norm_rope.py": ("compile", "frost_gemm_norm_rope"),

+if kern_cw is not None:

+_CHILD = str(Path(__file__).with_name("block_compiled_cache_child.py"))
+# every arm the child runs; the elementwise, TMA and cache-write arms share their module's symbol, each is its own compiled object
+_CHILD_SITES = (

+    "elementwise_copy",
+    "qk_tma_norm",

+@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
+def _fresh_memo():
+    """Every test starts from an empty in-process memo (and leaves one): an object memoised under a stubbed compile must not
+    reach a later test, and an earlier test's real object must not serve a stubbed key here."""
+    cc.clear_memo()
+    cc.reset_stats()
+    yield
+    cc.clear_memo()

+def _recorder(calls):
+    """A stand-in for ``compile_cached`` that records its call and mints a fresh object (no trace, no files)."""
+
+    def fake(fn, *args, cache_key, symbol="kernel", **kwargs):
+        calls.append(dict(fn=fn, args=args, cache_key=cache_key, symbol=symbol, options=kwargs.get("options")))
+        return object()
+
+    return fake
+
+
+def _stub_cute_compile(monkeypatch, calls):
+    import cutlass.cute as cute
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(cute, "compile", lambda fn, *a, **k: calls.append((fn, a, k)) or object())
+

+def test_every_block_compile_site_goes_through_the_compiled_plan_cache():
+    """No bare ``cute.compile(`` is left in the kernel files (the five develop sites, plus the cache write where its module is in the
+    tree); each passes ``compile_cached`` its key and symbol."""
+    for name, (tag, symbol) in _SITES.items():
+        src = (_KERNELS / name).read_text()
+        assert "cute.compile(" not in src, f"{name}: a bare cute.compile( site bypasses the compiled-plan cache"
+        assert "compile_cached(" in src and f'symbol="{symbol}"' in src and f'"{tag}")' in src, f"{name}: the site must pass cache_key= and symbol={symbol!r}"
+    for mod in (m for m in (kern_ew, kern_tma, kern_cw) if m is not None):
+        # imported normally, so each names its own source identity (the loader stamps the forks')
+        assert mod.FROST_SOURCE_DIGEST == hashlib.sha256(Path(mod.__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest()[:16]
+

+    row per token, K at ``+0``, V at ``+D``).  NaN-filled (an e4m3 NaN is the code 0x7f): a gathered unwritten row poisons O."""
+    mk = lambda *shape: torch.full(shape, fill, device=device, dtype=torch.float32).to(dtype)  # noqa: E731

+    assert layout == "unified"

+    inv = torch.reciprocal(scale.float())

+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Rubin: the oracle on the dequantized pool
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+
+def _rope_tables(n_pos, dtype, ref_geom):
+    cos, sin = build_rope_tables(n_pos, ROPE, base=ref_geom.rope_base, batch=1, device=_DEV, dtype=dtype)
+    return cos, sin  # [1, n_pos, ROPE]
+
+
+class _Fp8Case:
+    """One e4m3-cache sparse DECODE step over a batch of sequences with lengths ``kv_lens`` (0 = a dead entry; a length below ``s_q``
+    leaves the rows with a negative position dead): the whole-sequence bf16 reference per entry, per-tensor DEscales calibrated on
+    the reference K / V of every live entry, the NaN-filled e4m3 pools holding the torch-quantized PREFIX rows, the block table (page
+    0 = the NULL block), the slot mapping of the step's tokens, ONE list per sequence at the step-0 position, and two fp32 oracles
+    of the step's gated O and ``out``: on the DEQUANTIZED rows (the gate) and on the pre-quantization bf16 rows (reported)."""
+
+    def __init__(self, geom_kw, s_q, kv_lens, *, page=16, layout="hnd", seed=0, top_k=512, block_lens=True, fuse_gate=False, index_band=False, n_pages=None):
+        self.s_q, self.kv_lens, self.page, self.layout, self.top_k = int(s_q), [int(x) for x in kv_lens], page, layout, top_k
+        self.block_lens_given, self.fuse_gate, self.index_band = bool(block_lens), bool(fuse_gate), bool(index_band)
+        self.geom, self.ref_geom = _geom(geom_kw, top_k=top_k, index_band=index_band)
+        geom, ref_geom, dtype = self.geom, self.ref_geom, BF16
+        self.dtype = dtype
+        h_q, h_kv, d_model = geom.h_q, geom.h_kv, geom.d_model
+        G = h_q // h_kv
+        B = len(self.kv_lens)
+        g = torch.Generator(device=_DEV).manual_seed(seed)
+        self.gen = g
+
+        def randn(*shape, std=0.02):
+            return (torch.randn(*shape, generator=g, device=_DEV, dtype=torch.float32) * std).to(dtype)
+
+        n_dense = sum(geom.qkvg_block_widths[:4])
+        w_qkvg = randn(geom.n_qkvg, d_model)
+        self.w = dict(
+            w_qkvg=w_qkvg, w_q_norm=torch.ones(D, dtype=dtype, device=_DEV), w_k_norm=torch.ones(D, dtype=dtype, device=_DEV), w_o=randn(d_model, h_q * D)
+        )
+        L_max = max(max(self.kv_lens), s_q)
+        cos_t, sin_t = _rope_tables(L_max, dtype, ref_geom)
+        scale = geom.scale
+        self.h = torch.zeros(B, s_q, d_model, dtype=dtype, device=_DEV)
+        self.cos = cos_t[0, :1].expand(s_q, ROPE).clone()[None].expand(B, s_q, ROPE).clone()
+        self.sin = sin_t[0, :1].expand(s_q, ROPE).clone()[None].expand(B, s_q, ROPE).clone()
+        self.live_rows = torch.zeros(B, s_q, dtype=torch.bool, device=_DEV)
+        refs, ids_rows, lens_rows = {}, [], []
+        for b, L in enumerate(self.kv_lens):
+            pos = torch.arange(s_q, device=_DEV) + (L - s_q)
+            live = pos >= 0
+            self.live_rows[b] = live
+            pos0 = torch.tensor([L - s_q], device=_DEV)
+            ids_b, lens_b = random_block_ids(pos0, top_k, BS, generator=g, kv_lens=torch.tensor([L], device=_DEV), shuffle=True)
+            ids_rows.append(ids_b)
+            lens_rows.append(lens_b)
+            if L == 0:
+                continue  # a dead entry: no sequence, no reference, block 0, slots -1
+            h_full = randn(1, L, d_model, std=1.0)
+            ref = gated_attention_block_reference(
+                h_full, w_qkvg[:n_dense], self.w["w_q_norm"], self.w["w_k_norm"], cos_t[:, :L], sin_t[:, :L], self.w["w_o"], ref_geom
+            )
+            refs[b] = (ref, pos, live, ids_b, lens_b)
+            p_live = pos[live]
+            self.h[b, live] = h_full[0, p_live]
+            self.cos[b, live] = cos_t[0, p_live]
+            self.sin[b, live] = sin_t[0, p_live]
+        # the per-tensor DEscales, calibrated on every live entry's whole-sequence K / V (a static serving calibration)
+        all_k = torch.cat([r[0].k[0].reshape(-1) for r in refs.values()]) if refs else torch.ones(1, device=_DEV)
+        all_v = torch.cat([r[0].v[0].reshape(-1) for r in refs.values()]) if refs else torch.ones(1, device=_DEV)
+        self.k_scale, self.v_scale = _scale_of(all_k), _scale_of(all_v)
+        # the two oracles per entry: on the DEQUANTIZED rows (prefix AND step rows through the e4m3 codes) and on the bf16 rows
+        self.ref_out = torch.zeros(B, s_q, d_model, dtype=dtype, device=_DEV)
+        self.ref_o_gated = torch.zeros(B, s_q, h_q, D, dtype=dtype, device=_DEV)
+        self.ref_o_gated_bf16 = torch.zeros(B, s_q, h_q, D, dtype=dtype, device=_DEV)
+        self.ref_codes = {}  # b -> (K codes [L, h_kv, D], V codes): the prefix rows go into the pools; the step rows pin the write-through
+        for b, (ref, pos, live, ids_b, lens_b) in refs.items():
+            L = self.kv_lens[b]
+            k_codes, v_codes = _quantize(ref.k[0], self.k_scale), _quantize(ref.v[0], self.v_scale)
+            self.ref_codes[b] = (k_codes, v_codes)
+            kd, vd = _dequantize(k_codes, self.k_scale), _dequantize(v_codes, self.v_scale)
+            p_live = pos[live]
+            rows = ids_b.expand(s_q, top_k)
+            lens_arg = lens_b.expand(s_q) if block_lens else None
+            allowed = qsa_visible_mask(rows, lens_arg, pos, L, L, BS, top_k=top_k, pos0=L - s_q)[live]
+            q_rows = ref.q[0][p_live].float()
+            gate_rows = ref.gate[0][p_live].float()
+            for which, (kk_all, vv_all, o_dst) in (("deq", (kd, vd, self.ref_o_gated)), ("bf16", (ref.k[0], ref.v[0], self.ref_o_gated_bf16))):
+                o = torch.zeros(int(live.sum()), h_q, D, dtype=torch.float32, device=_DEV)
+                for hh in range(h_q):
+                    kk, vv = kk_all[:, hh // G].float(), vv_all[:, hh // G].float()
+                    sc = (q_rows[:, hh] @ kk.t()) * scale
+                    sc = sc.masked_fill(~allowed, float("-inf"))
+                    rmax = sc.amax(dim=-1)
+                    dead = torch.isinf(rmax) & (rmax < 0)
+                    safe = torch.where(dead, torch.zeros_like(rmax), rmax)
+                    p = torch.where(allowed, torch.exp(sc - safe[:, None]), torch.zeros_like(sc))
+                    den = p.sum(dim=-1)
+                    den_safe = torch.where(dead, torch.ones_like(den), den)
+                    oc = (p @ vv) / den_safe[:, None]
+                    o[:, hh] = torch.where(dead[:, None], torch.zeros_like(oc), oc)
+                o16 = o.to(dtype)  # the oracle's single rounding of O, then the gate in fp32, then one rounding
+                og = (o16.float() * torch.sigmoid(gate_rows)).to(dtype)
+                o_dst[b, live] = og
+                if which == "deq":
+                    self.ref_out[b, live] = (og.reshape(-1, h_q * D).float() @ self.w["w_o"].float().t()).to(dtype)
+        self.block_ids = torch.stack([x.reshape(top_k) for x in ids_rows]).contiguous()
+        self.block_lens = torch.stack([x.reshape(()) for x in lens_rows]).contiguous()
+        assert self.block_ids.dtype == torch.int32 and self.block_lens.dtype == torch.int32
+        # pages: block 0 reserved (NULL); each live entry gets ceil(L / P) pages from a permutation of 1 .. n_pages - 1; -1 past them
+        need = sum(-(-L // page) for L in self.kv_lens)
+        self.n_pages = n_pages if n_pages is not None else need + 1 + 2
+        assert self.n_pages >= need + 1, (self.n_pages, need)
+        perm = (torch.randperm(self.n_pages - 1, generator=g, device=_DEV) + 1).tolist()
+        self.max_pages = max(-(-L_max // page), 1)
+        self.block_table = torch.full((B, self.max_pages), -1, dtype=torch.int32, device=_DEV)
+        it = iter(perm)
+        slots = torch.full((B * s_q,), -1, dtype=torch.int32, device=_DEV)
+        self.k_cache, self.v_cache = _pools(self.n_pages, h_kv, page, layout, E4M3)
+        self.index_cache = torch.full((self.n_pages, page, geom.qsa.index_head_dim), float("nan"), dtype=dtype, device=_DEV) if index_band else None
+        for b, L in enumerate(self.kv_lens):
+            if L == 0:
+                self.block_table[b] = 0  # the dead entry: the NULL block, slots -1
+                continue
+            pages = [next(it) for _ in range(-(-L // page))]
+            self.block_table[b, : len(pages)] = torch.tensor(pages, dtype=torch.int32, device=_DEV)
+            k_codes, v_codes = self.ref_codes[b]
+            for p in range(max(L - s_q, 0)):  # the PREFIX: the torch-quantized codes into the pools
+                pg, off = pages[p // page], p % page
+                self.k_cache[pg, :, off] = k_codes[p]
+                self.v_cache[pg, :, off] = v_codes[p]
+            for j in range(s_q):  # the step's live tokens: written through (and quantized) by the block
+                p = L - s_q + j
+                if p >= 0:
+                    slots[b * s_q + j] = pages[p // page] * page + p % page
+        self.slot_mapping = slots
+        self.kv_lens_t = torch.tensor(self.kv_lens, dtype=torch.int32, device=_DEV)
+        self.prefix_bits = (_bits(self.k_cache).clone(), _bits(self.v_cache).clone())
+        self.blk_kw = dict(
+            paged_kv_page_size=page,
+            kv_source=KV_SOURCE_PAGED,
+            sample_k_cache=self.k_cache,
+            sample_v_cache=self.v_cache,
+            sample_block_table=self.block_table,
+            fuse_gate=fuse_gate,
+            kv_cache_dtype=E4M3,
+        )
+        self.out = torch.empty(B, s_q, d_model, dtype=dtype, device=_DEV)
+        self.blk = GatedAttentionBlockFwd(
+            self.h, self.w["w_qkvg"], self.w["w_q_norm"], self.w["w_k_norm"], self.cos, self.sin, self.w["w_o"], self.out, self.geom, **self.blk_kw
+        )
+        assert isinstance(self.blk._sdpa, _UpcastSparseSdpa) and self.blk.upcast_decode and self.blk.inplace_qkv is False and self.blk.gate_fused is False
+        self.ws = None
+
+    def compile(self):
+        assert self.blk.check_support()
+        self.blk.compile()
+        self.ws = torch.full((self.blk.get_workspace_size(),), 0x7F, dtype=torch.uint8, device=_DEV)
+        return self
+
+    def execute(
+        self,
+        *,
+        out=None,
+        ws=None,
+        h=None,
+        cos=None,
+        sin=None,
+        kv_lens=None,
+        block_table=None,
+        slot_mapping=None,
+        ids=None,
+        lens=None,
+        k_scale=None,
+        v_scale=None,
+        stream=None,
+    ):
+        out = self.out if out is None else out
+        self.blk.execute(
+            self.h if h is None else h,
+            self.w["w_qkvg"],
+            self.w["w_q_norm"],
+            self.w["w_k_norm"],
+            self.cos if cos is None else cos,
+            self.sin if sin is None else sin,
+            self.w["w_o"],
+            out,
+            self.ws if ws is None else ws,
+            block_ids=self.block_ids if ids is None else ids,
+            block_lens=(self.block_lens if lens is None else lens) if self.block_lens_given else None,
+            k_cache=self.k_cache,
+            v_cache=self.v_cache,
+            block_table=self.block_table if block_table is None else block_table,
+            kv_lens=self.kv_lens_t if kv_lens is None else kv_lens,
+            slot_mapping=self.slot_mapping if slot_mapping is None else slot_mapping,
+            index_k_raw=self.index_cache,
+            current_stream=stream,
+            k_scale=self.k_scale if k_scale is None else k_scale,
+            v_scale=self.v_scale if v_scale is None else v_scale,
+        )
+        return out
+
+    def run(self):
+        if self.ws is None:
+            self.compile()
+        self.out.fill_(_sentinel(self.dtype))
+        self.execute()
+        torch.cuda.synchronize()
+        return self.out
+
+    def views(self, ws=None):
+        """The compact normed Q and K (out of place), the slab's GATE and V bands, the O slot, the slab -- what the e4m3 mode writes."""
+        ws = self.ws if ws is None else ws
+        g, lay = self.geom, self.blk._ws
+        B, S = self.blk.batch, self.blk.seq_len
+        t = B * S
+        proj = _view(ws, lay.proj, (t, g.n_qkvg), self.dtype)
+        _o_q, o_g, _o_k, o_v = g.qkvg_offsets[:4]
+        q = _view(ws, lay.q, (t, g.h_q, g.d_head), self.dtype).view(B, S, g.h_q, g.d_head)
+        k = _view(ws, lay.k, (t, g.h_kv, g.d_head), self.dtype).view(B, S, g.h_kv, g.d_head)
+        gate = _cols(proj, o_g, g.h_q, g.d_head).view(B, S, g.h_q, g.d_head)
+        v = _cols(proj, o_v, g.h_kv, g.d_head).view(B, S, g.h_kv, g.d_head)
+        o = _view(ws, lay.o, (t, g.h_q, g.d_head), self.dtype).view(B, S, g.h_q, g.d_head)
+        return q, gate, k, v, o, proj
+
+    def label(self):
+        return f"[{self.geom.h_q}/{self.geom.h_kv} S_q={self.s_q} e4m3 p{self.page} {self.layout} gate={'fused->launch' if self.fuse_gate else 'launch'} lens={self.kv_lens}]"
+
+    def check(self, out=None, ws=None, *, what="out"):
+        """The standard assertions: finite, no sentinel, dead rows exact, within the budget vs the oracle on the DEQUANTIZED pool (out, the
+        gated O slot), the pools' step rows BITWISE torch's quantization of the block's own K rows and V band, the prefix rows and
+        the NULL block untouched; the distance to the bf16 oracle printed (no gate)."""
+        out = self.out if out is None else out
+        ws = self.ws if ws is None else ws
+        sent = _sentinel(self.dtype)
+        live = self.live_rows
+        dead = ~live
+        q, gate, k, v, o, proj = self.views(ws)
+        assert torch.isfinite(out.float()).all(), f"{what}: non-finite out"
+        assert not (out.float() == sent).any(), f"{what}: a sentinel survived in out"
+        assert torch.isfinite(o.float()).all(), f"{what}: non-finite gated O (a row the decode tile never wrote keeps the workspace fill)"
+        if dead.any():
+            assert (out[dead] == 0).all() and (o[dead] == 0).all(), f"{what}: a dead row's out and O must be exactly 0"
+        c = _cos(out[live], self.ref_out[live])
+        d_out = float((out[live].float() - self.ref_out[live].float()).abs().max())
+        d_o = float((o[live].float() - self.ref_o_gated[live].float()).abs().max())
+        d_o_bf16 = float((o[live].float() - self.ref_o_gated_bf16[live].float()).abs().max())
+        assert c > COS_OUT, f"{what}: cos(out) {c} <= {COS_OUT}"
+        assert d_o <= ATOL, f"{what}: gated O off the oracle on the dequantized pool by {d_o} (budget {ATOL})"
+        # the quantizing write-through: the step's live rows are torch's e4m3 codes of the block's own normed K rows / V band, bitwise
+        slot = self.slot_mapping
+        lv = slot >= 0
+        s_ = slot[lv].long()
+        kf, vf = k.reshape(-1, self.geom.h_kv, D), v.reshape(-1, self.geom.h_kv, D)
+        assert torch.equal(
+            _bits(self.k_cache[s_ // self.page, :, s_ % self.page, :]), _bits(_quantize(kf[lv], self.k_scale))
+        ), f"{what}: the K pool rows are not the quantized K rows"
+        assert torch.equal(
+            _bits(self.v_cache[s_ // self.page, :, s_ % self.page, :]), _bits(_quantize(vf[lv], self.v_scale))
+        ), f"{what}: the V pool rows are not the quantized V rows"
+        for pool, before in zip((self.k_cache, self.v_cache), self.prefix_bits):
+            now = _bits(pool)
+            touched = (now != before).any(dim=-1).any(dim=1)  # [n_pages, page] rows whose bits moved
+            rows_moved = touched.nonzero()
+            written = set((int(p) for p in (s_ // self.page * self.page + s_ % self.page).tolist()))
+            assert all(int(pg) * self.page + int(off) in written for pg, off in rows_moved), f"{what}: a pool row outside the step's slots moved"
+            assert not touched[0].any(), f"{what}: the NULL block moved"
+        if self.index_cache is not None:
+            raw = index_k_raw_view(proj, self.geom, self.blk.batch, self.blk.seq_len)  # [B, S, 1, index_head_dim]
+            assert torch.equal(_bits(self.index_cache[s_ // self.page, s_ % self.page, :]), _bits(raw.reshape(-1, raw.shape[-1])[lv]))
+            assert (~torch.isnan(self.index_cache.float())).all(-1).sum().item() == int(lv.sum())
+        print(
+            f"\n{self.label()} {what}: cos(out) {c:.6f} max|d out| {d_out:.4e} max|d O_gated| vs the DEQUANTIZED oracle {d_o:.4e} (budget {ATOL}); "
+            f"vs the PRE-quantization bf16 oracle {d_o_bf16:.4e} (reported, no gate); dead rows {int(dead.sum())}; k_scale {float(self.k_scale):.4e} v_scale {float(self.v_scale):.4e}"
+        )
+        return dict(cos=c, d_out=d_out, d_o=d_o, d_o_bf16=d_o_bf16, dead=int(dead.sum()))
+

+    error raised inside it: ``capture_end`` runs in ``__exit__`` whatever happened (the body's exception is kept -- with
+    ``torch.cuda.graph`` a ``capture_end`` error would REPLACE it), and the graph is reset explicitly (an instantiated graph left
+    to the cyclic GC can invalidate a LATER test's capture).  ``torch.cuda.graph`` is used where a REPLAY is wanted."""
+
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.stream = torch.cuda.Stream()
+        self.graph = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph()
+        self._buf = torch.zeros(1, device="cuda")
+        self._ctx = None
+
+    def __enter__(self):
+        torch.cuda.synchronize()
+        self._ctx = torch.cuda.stream(self.stream)
+        self._ctx.__enter__()
+        self.graph.capture_begin()
+        self._buf.add_(1)  # a node of this capture's own: never an empty capture
+        return self
+
+    def __exit__(self, exc_type, exc, tb):
+        try:
+            self.graph.capture_end()
+        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 -- the body's error is the one under test; a capture_end error must not replace it
+            if exc is None:
+                raise
+        finally:
+            self._ctx.__exit__(None, None, None)
+            self.graph.reset()
+        return False
+
