+"""The surface FlashInfer consumes, pinned name by name with its signature (host-only: no GPU, no DSL needed).
+
+FlashInfer's cuDNN backend (``flashinfer/cudnn/{prefill,decode,utils}.py``) reads a handful of frontend facts before it
+routes work to this package: the native SDPA binder's ``supports_*`` flags, ``graph.selected_engine`` (and its ``.name``
+against the FROST engine names), ``graph.backend_plan_entries()``, the CuTe DSL gate in ``cudnn.frost.buffers``, the
+torch dtype mapping, the unified attention implementation, the graph helpers and the two ``pygraph`` caller hints.
+Every one of those is a caller boundary whatever its spelling (python/cudnn/AGENTS.md Rule 9), so this module asserts
+each still resolves AS SPELLED and that its public twin exists -- a rename fails here, in this repository's CI, instead
+of silently degrading FlashInfer to its fallback path.
+
+The arch-aware probe gets the cell that motivated it: on a cc 10.7 part with a 4.7.x public DSL (no ``sm_107a`` target)
+every FROST row declines, so ``cutedsl_runtime_available((10, 7))`` must read False while the device-blind form -- the
+check FlashInfer spells today -- reads True.  Modelled by pinning the DSL state exactly where the engines read it;
+nothing is imported from the DSL.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import inspect
+import json
+import pathlib
+import subprocess
+import sys
+
+import pytest
+
+import cudnn
+import cudnn.frost
+from cudnn import datatypes
+from cudnn.engines import manifest
+from cudnn.frost import buffers
+
+pytestmark = pytest.mark.L0
+
+# The binder flags FlashInfer reads by name today (flashinfer/cudnn/prefill.py), then the rest the build declares.
+BINDER_FLAGS_READ_BY_FLASHINFER = ("supports_stats_stride_override", "supports_nonpaged_packed_split")
+BINDER_FLAGS = BINDER_FLAGS_READ_BY_FLASHINFER + (
+    "supports_paged_packed_split",
+    "supports_paged_split_sink",
+    "supports_paged_d64_packed_split",
+    "supports_paged_d256_packed_split",
+    "supports_nonpaged_d256_packed_split",
+    "supports_nonpaged_d128_packed_split",
+)
+# The engine names FlashInfer compares ``selected_engine.name`` against -> their manifest slots (forever: slots are
+# append-only, never renumbered or reused).
+ENGINE_NAMES = {"sdpa_fwd_prefill_sm100": 11, "sdpa_fwd_prefill_sm107": 15, "sdpa_fwd_prefill_sm120": 5}
+PUBLIC_DSL = "nvidia-cutlass-dsl"
+
+
+def _binder():
+    binder = getattr(cudnn._pybind_module, "_SdpaThdBinder", None)
+    assert binder is not None, "cudnn._pybind_module._SdpaThdBinder is gone: FlashInfer reads its supports_* flags by name"
+    return binder
+
+
+# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# The binder flags and their public spelling
+# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("flag", BINDER_FLAGS)
+def test_binder_flag_resolves_as_spelled(flag):
+    """A static read-only property reading True on the CLASS (FlashInfer never instantiates the binder for it)."""
+    binder = _binder()
+    assert getattr(binder, flag, None) is True, f"{flag} is not a True static property of _SdpaThdBinder"
+    assert getattr(binder, flag, False) is True  # the getattr(..., False) spelling FlashInfer uses
+
+
+def test_sdpa_capabilities_is_the_public_spelling_of_the_binder_flags():
+    caps = cudnn.sdpa_capabilities()
+    assert isinstance(caps, frozenset)
+    pinned = {flag[len("supports_") :] for flag in BINDER_FLAGS}
+    missing = pinned - caps
+    assert not missing, f"capabilities renamed or removed (append-only contract): {sorted(missing)}"
+    binder = _binder()
+    for cap in caps:
+        assert isinstance(cap, str) and cap and not cap.startswith("supports_"), cap
+        assert getattr(binder, "supports_" + cap, None) is True, f"{cap!r} has no True supports_{cap} twin on the binder"
+    assert "sdpa_capabilities" in cudnn.__all__
+    assert list(inspect.signature(cudnn.sdpa_capabilities).parameters) == []
+
+
+def test_sdpa_capabilities_is_empty_without_the_binder(monkeypatch):
+    """A build without the native binder reports no capability instead of raising."""
+
+    class _NoBinder:
+        pass
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(cudnn, "_pybind_module", _NoBinder())
+    assert cudnn.sdpa_capabilities() == frozenset()
+
+
+# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# pygraph: selected_engine, backend_plan_entries, the two caller hints, the graph helpers
+# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+
+def test_selected_engine_is_a_property_and_backend_plan_entries_a_query():
+    assert isinstance(inspect.getattr_static(cudnn.pygraph, "selected_engine"), property)
+    assert list(inspect.signature(cudnn.pygraph.backend_plan_entries).parameters) == ["self"]
+    assert list(inspect.signature(cudnn.pygraph.get_plan_name_at_index).parameters) == ["self", "index"]
+    assert list(inspect.signature(cudnn.pygraph.get_engine_and_knobs_at_index).parameters) == ["self", "index"]
+    # The two names FlashInfer's utils probe with hasattr() before it builds a graph.
+    assert hasattr(cudnn.pygraph, "backend_plan_entries")
+    assert hasattr(cudnn.pygraph, "selected_engine")
+
+
+def test_pygraph_takes_the_two_caller_hints_and_the_graph_helper_forwards_them():
+    ctor = inspect.signature(cudnn.pygraph.__init__).parameters
+    override = ctor["is_override_shape_enabled"]
+    assert override.kind is inspect.Parameter.POSITIONAL_OR_KEYWORD and override.default is False
+    replay = ctor["is_cuda_graph_replay_expected"]
+    assert replay.kind is inspect.Parameter.KEYWORD_ONLY and replay.default is False
+    # FlashInfer's cudnn_frontend_accepts_cuda_graph_replay_hint(): the keyword on the ctor AND **kwargs on cudnn.graph.
+    helper = inspect.signature(cudnn.graph).parameters
+    assert any(p.kind is inspect.Parameter.VAR_KEYWORD for p in helper.values()), "cudnn.graph no longer forwards graph kwargs"
+    assert "handle" in helper and "io_data_type" in helper
+    assert "heur_modes" in inspect.signature(cudnn.jit).parameters
+    assert list(inspect.signature(cudnn.graph_cache).parameters) == ["key_fn", "maxsize"]
+
+
+def test_the_engine_names_flashinfer_compares_against_are_stable_identifiers():
+    family = next(f for f in manifest.MANIFEST if f.name == "frost_sdpa_fwd")
+    for name, slot in ENGINE_NAMES.items():
+        assert name in family.slots, f"{name} left the manifest: FlashInfer compares selected_engine.name against it"
+        assert family.slots[name].slot == slot, f"{name} moved from slot {slot}: manifest slots are forever"
+        engine = manifest.engine_for_id(family.engine_id + slot)
+        assert engine is not None and engine.name == name, (name, engine)
+
+
+def test_unified_implementation_graph_helpers_and_decline_type_resolve():
+    assert cudnn.attention_implementation.UNIFIED is not None
+    assert cudnn.heur_mode.A is not None
+    assert issubclass(cudnn.cudnnGraphNotSupportedError, Exception)
+    assert callable(cudnn.graph_cache) and callable(cudnn.jit) and callable(cudnn.graph)
+    for name in ("graph_cache", "jit", "graph", "pygraph", "attention_implementation", "heur_mode", "cudnnGraphNotSupportedError"):
+        assert name in cudnn.__all__, name
+
+
+# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# The CuTe DSL gate: the names FlashInfer reads today and the arch-aware public probe
+# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+
+def test_dsl_gate_names_resolve_as_spelled():
+    assert buffers.CUTEDSL_MIN_VERSION == (4, 7, 0)
+    assert list(inspect.signature(buffers.cutedsl_state).parameters) == []
+    assert list(inspect.signature(buffers.cutedsl_too_old).parameters) == ["version"]
+    assert list(inspect.signature(buffers.cutedsl_arch_requirement_error).parameters) == ["device_cc"]
+    assert list(inspect.signature(buffers.cutedsl_requirement_error).parameters) == ["what"]
+    installed, version = buffers.cutedsl_state()
+    assert isinstance(installed, bool)
+    assert version is None or (isinstance(version, tuple) and len(version) == 2)
+
+
+def test_cutedsl_runtime_available_signature_and_export():
+    params = inspect.signature(cudnn.frost.cutedsl_runtime_available).parameters
+    assert list(params) == ["device_cc"] and params["device_cc"].default is None
+    assert "cutedsl_runtime_available" in cudnn.frost.__all__
+
+
+def test_device_blind_probe_equals_the_version_gate_flashinfer_spells_today():
+    """On this install, the device-blind form is exactly FlashInfer's current formula over the frontend's own gate."""
+    installed, version = buffers.cutedsl_state()
+    assert cudnn.frost.cutedsl_runtime_available() is (bool(installed) and not buffers.cutedsl_too_old(version))
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def dsl_state(monkeypatch):
+    """Pin the DSL state where the engines read it: the metadata pair and the sm_107a target probe."""
+
+    def pin(installed, version, has_sm107):
+        monkeypatch.setattr(buffers, "_DSL_STATE", (installed, version))
+        monkeypatch.setattr(buffers, "_cutedsl_has_sm107", lambda: has_sm107)
+
+    return pin
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "label, installed, version, has_sm107, blind, cc100, cc107",
+    [
+        ("dsl absent", False, None, False, False, False, False),
+        ("4.6.2 (the downstream floor, below ours)", True, (PUBLIC_DSL, "4.6.2"), False, False, False, False),
+        ("4.7.1 without sm_107a", True, (PUBLIC_DSL, "4.7.1"), False, True, True, False),
+        ("4.7.0rc1 without sm_107a", True, (PUBLIC_DSL, "4.7.0rc1"), False, True, True, False),
+        ("4.8.0 with sm_107a", True, (PUBLIC_DSL, "4.8.0"), True, True, True, True),
+        ("internal build without sm_107a", True, ("nvidia-cutlass-dsl-internal", "0.3.0+2026"), False, True, True, False),
+    ],
+)
+def test_cutedsl_runtime_available_is_arch_aware(dsl_state, label, installed, version, has_sm107, blind, cc100, cc107):
+    """The floor is 4.7.0 everywhere and 4.8.0 on cc 10.7: the (10, 7) + 4.7.x row is the cell a device-blind probe
+    cannot see -- it reads True there while every FROST row declines."""
+    dsl_state(installed, version, has_sm107)
+    probe = cudnn.frost.cutedsl_runtime_available
+    assert probe() is blind, label
+    assert probe(None) is blind, label
+    assert probe((8, 0)) is cc100, label  # no target gate below cc 10.7
+    assert probe((10, 0)) is cc100, label
+    assert probe((10, 7)) is cc107, label
+    assert probe([10, 7]) is cc107, label  # a list spells the same part
+
+
+def test_the_blind_spot_cell_cc107_with_a_47x_dsl(dsl_state):
+    dsl_state(True, (PUBLIC_DSL, "4.7.1"), False)
+    assert cudnn.frost.cutedsl_runtime_available() is True
+    assert cudnn.frost.cutedsl_runtime_available((10, 7)) is False
+    # The same install answers the engines' own gate the same way: the probe IS their decision.
+    assert buffers.cutedsl_arch_requirement_error((10, 7)) is not None
+    assert buffers.cutedsl_arch_requirement_error((10, 0)) is None
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("bad", [(10, 7, 0), (10,), 107, "10.7", (10.5, 7)])
+def test_cutedsl_runtime_available_refuses_a_malformed_cc(dsl_state, bad):
+    """A cc that is not a pair of integers is refused, never silently read as 'not cc 10.7'."""
+    dsl_state(True, (PUBLIC_DSL, "4.7.1"), False)
+    with pytest.raises(TypeError):
+        cudnn.frost.cutedsl_runtime_available(bad)
+
+
+def test_arch_aware_probe_touches_the_dsl_only_for_a_cc107_part(dsl_state, monkeypatch):
+    dsl_state(True, (PUBLIC_DSL, "4.7.1"), False)
+    calls = []
+    monkeypatch.setattr(buffers, "_cutedsl_has_sm107", lambda: calls.append(1) or False)
+    assert cudnn.frost.cutedsl_runtime_available() is True
+    assert cudnn.frost.cutedsl_runtime_available((10, 0)) is True
+    assert calls == []  # neither the blind form nor another part asks the DSL
+    assert cudnn.frost.cutedsl_runtime_available((10, 7)) is False
+    assert calls == [1]
+
+
+# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# The torch dtype mapping
+# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+
+def test_torch_dtype_mapping_public_and_private_spellings_are_one_function():
+    assert datatypes.torch_to_cudnn_data_type is datatypes._torch_to_cudnn_data_type
+    assert list(inspect.signature(datatypes.torch_to_cudnn_data_type).parameters) == ["torch_data_type"]
+    assert datatypes.torch_to_cudnn_data_type(object()) is None  # an unmapped dtype is None, not an exception
+
+
+def test_torch_dtype_mapping_values():
+    torch = pytest.importorskip("torch")
+    f = datatypes.torch_to_cudnn_data_type
+    assert f(torch.bfloat16) is cudnn.data_type.BFLOAT16
+    assert f(torch.float16) is cudnn.data_type.HALF
+    assert f(torch.float32) is cudnn.data_type.FLOAT
+    assert f(torch.int32) is cudnn.data_type.INT32
+    assert f(torch.float8_e4m3fn) is cudnn.data_type.FP8_E4M3
+    assert f(torch.complex64) is None
+
+
+# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# import cudnn stays cheap; the docs name every public spelling
+# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+_HEAVY = ("torch", "cutlass", "nvidia_cutlass_dsl")
+
+
+def _modules_after(code: str) -> set:
+    probe = code + "\nimport json, sys; print('@@' + json.dumps(sorted(sys.modules)))"
+    run = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-c", probe], capture_output=True, text=True)
+    assert run.returncode == 0, f"probe failed: {run.stderr.strip()[-600:]}"
+    line = next(ln for ln in run.stdout.splitlines() if ln.startswith("@@"))
+    return set(json.loads(line[2:]))
+
+
+def test_import_cudnn_and_the_public_probes_pull_no_framework():
+    """The new public names cost no torch / DSL import: the capability set is read off the binder, the device-blind
+    probe and a non-cc-10.7 part read package metadata only (the cc 10.7 target check is the one DSL import)."""
+    code = (
+        "import cudnn\nimport cudnn.frost\ncudnn.sdpa_capabilities()\ncudnn.frost.cutedsl_runtime_available()\ncudnn.frost.cutedsl_runtime_available((10, 0))\n"
+    )
+    added = _modules_after(code) - _modules_after("")
+    present = sorted(m for m in _HEAVY if m in added)
+    assert not present, f"the public probes imported {present}; they must not"
+
+
+def test_the_docs_name_every_public_spelling():
+    docs = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[4] / "docs" / "utilities" / "python_graph_and_execution_backends.md"
+    if not docs.is_file():
+        pytest.skip("the docs tree is not part of this checkout")
+    text = docs.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+    assert "### Consumed by FlashInfer" in text
+    for name in (
+        "cudnn.sdpa_capabilities()",
+        "cudnn.frost.cutedsl_runtime_available(device_cc=None)",
+        "cudnn.datatypes.torch_to_cudnn_data_type",
+        "graph.selected_engine",
+        "graph.backend_plan_entries()",
+        "is_cuda_graph_replay_expected",
+        "4.8.0 on cc 10.7",
+    ):
+        assert name in text, name

+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright (c) 2026 NVIDIA CORPORATION & AFFILIATES. All rights reserved.
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+
+"""FlashInfer's paged cuDNN DECODE graph, re-declared byte for byte, against FE's DEFAULT placement on cc 10.7.
+
+FlashInfer's ``cudnn_batch_decode_with_kv_cache`` builds one FE graph per (shape, flags): a dense 4-D Q ``(b, h_qo, q_len, d)`` --
+``(b, h, d)`` for a single token, the ``(b, q_len, h, d)`` view transposed for a multi-token (speculative / MTP) step -- over the
+page pools ``[pages, H_kv, page, D]`` bound by ``tensor_like`` (any in-page layout), the block tables as ``(b, 1, max_pages, 1)``
+``tensor_like`` tensors, the per-request KV lengths as a ``(b, 1, 1, 1)`` int32 ``tensor_like`` with ``set_is_pass_by_value(False)``
+(the padding mask), the Q lengths likewise, ``paged_attention_max_seq_len_kv``, no Stats, the bottom-right causal diagonal when
+``q_len > 1``, and the CUDA-graph replay hint when its caller captures.  The decode twin of ``test_flashinfer_shaped_sdpa.py``.
+
+What it pins (the decode-tile placement bands of ``placement._place_sm107_f16``, the MEASURED frontier of the tile against the backend's
+default plan on this very graph): on every LEAD cell FE's DEFAULT plan is the FROST row ``sdpa_fwd_prefill_sm107`` served by the Rubin
+d256 decode tile (the route readback: the kernel template is ``decode_d256_f16``); on every TRAIL cell the default is the backend's
+plan, by name.  Both regimes (the replay hint set and unset) agree on the verdict.  The default plan is also EXECUTED under the D2H
+detector and compared with the backend's plan pinned on the SAME graph (the numbers, not only the name); a padded entry (``kv_len = 0``
+over the NULL block ``0``) inside a LEAD cell keeps the verdict and writes exactly ``0``; one MTP cell per routed ``q_len`` (2: one
+token unit, 3 / 4: two) rides the 32-column tile.  Skips off cc 10.7 and below the DSL floor (the arch-aware probes).
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import math
+import zlib
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+import cudnn
+from frost_test_utils import _SM, requires_dsl
+from test_sdpa_fwd_decode_d256_sm100 import _pools, _served_by
+from test_sdpa_fwd_decode_d256_sm107 import requires_sm107_dsl
+
+requires_cc107 = pytest.mark.skipif(
+    _SM != 107, reason="the Rubin paged d256 decode-tile default placement exists on cc 10.7 only; have " + ("none" if _SM is None else f"sm_{_SM}")
+)
+pytestmark = [pytest.mark.L0, requires_dsl, requires_cc107, requires_sm107_dsl]
+
+# flashinfer/cudnn/decode.py UIDs, kept identical.
+Q_UID, K_UID, V_UID = 1, 2, 3
+ACTUAL_SEQ_LENS_Q_UID, ACTUAL_SEQ_LENS_KV_UID = 100, 101
+BLOCK_TABLES_K_UID, BLOCK_TABLES_V_UID = 201, 202
+O_UID = 1000
+FROST_PREFIX = "sdpa_fwd_prefill_sm107["
+FROST_ENGINE = "frost:sdpa_fwd_prefill_sm107"
+DECODE_TILE = "decode_d256_f16"
+D = 256
+
+
+class _DecodeCase:
+    """One FlashInfer decode call: the buffers, the graph it builds and the two plans of interest (FE's default, the backend's)."""
+
+    def __init__(self, *, heads, b, kv, q_len=1, page=16, hnd=False, dtype=torch.bfloat16, dead_entry=None, seed=0):
+        torch.manual_seed(seed)
+        dev = torch.device("cuda")
+        self.h_q, self.h_kv = (int(x) for x in heads.split("/"))
+        self.b, self.kv, self.q_len, self.page, self.dtype = b, kv, q_len, page, dtype
+        self.scale = 1.0 / math.sqrt(D)
+        # the per-request KV lengths: random inside the declared KV, at least q_len (the diagonal needs them); the dead entry 0 over the NULL block
+        lens = torch.randint(max(q_len, 1), kv + 1, (b,), generator=torch.Generator().manual_seed(seed)).tolist()
+        self.dead = dead_entry
+        if dead_entry is not None:
+            lens[dead_entry] = 0
+        self.lens = lens
+        k_dense = torch.randn(b, kv, self.h_kv, D, device=dev, dtype=dtype)
+        v_dense = torch.randn(b, kv, self.h_kv, D, device=dev, dtype=dtype)
+        self.k_cache, self.v_cache, bt = _pools(k_dense, v_dense, page, hnd, seed)  # [pages, H_kv, page, D] containers (HND compact or NHD by strides)
+        self.max_pages = int(bt.shape[2])
+        self.block_tables = bt.view(b, self.max_pages).contiguous()
+        if dead_entry is not None:
+            self.block_tables[dead_entry] = 0  # the serving stacks' NULL block for a padded entry
+        self.seq_lens_kv = torch.tensor(lens, dtype=torch.int32, device=dev).view(b, 1, 1, 1)
+        self.seq_lens_q = torch.full((b, 1, 1, 1), q_len, dtype=torch.int32, device=dev)
+        # FlashInfer's q: (b * q_len, h, d) rows; the graph sees (b, h, q_len, d) at the view's strides ((h*d, d, h*d, 1) for q_len 1)
+        self.q_rows = torch.randn(b * q_len, self.h_q, D, device=dev, dtype=dtype)
+        self.q_graph = self.q_rows.view(b, q_len, self.h_q, D).transpose(1, 2)
+        self.io = cudnn.data_type.HALF if dtype == torch.float16 else cudnn.data_type.BFLOAT16
+
+    def build(self, handle, *, replay):
+        b, h, s, d = self.q_graph.shape
+        kw = dict(is_cuda_graph_replay_expected=True) if replay else {}
+        g = cudnn.pygraph(handle=handle, io_data_type=self.io, intermediate_data_type=cudnn.data_type.FLOAT, compute_data_type=cudnn.data_type.FLOAT, **kw)
+        q = g.tensor(name="q", dim=(b, h, s, d), stride=tuple(self.q_graph.stride()), data_type=self.io)
+        k = g.tensor_like(self.k_cache)
+        v = g.tensor_like(self.v_cache)
+        q.set_uid(Q_UID)
+        k.set_uid(K_UID)
+        v.set_uid(V_UID)
+        nd_bt = self.block_tables.reshape(b, 1, self.max_pages, 1)
+        tk = g.tensor_like(nd_bt)
+        tk.set_uid(BLOCK_TABLES_K_UID)
+        tv = g.tensor_like(nd_bt)
+        tv.set_uid(BLOCK_TABLES_V_UID)
+        slq = g.tensor_like(self.seq_lens_q)
+        slq.set_uid(ACTUAL_SEQ_LENS_Q_UID)
+        slk = g.tensor_like(self.seq_lens_kv)
+        slk.set_uid(ACTUAL_SEQ_LENS_KV_UID)
+        slk.set_is_pass_by_value(False)
+        mask = dict(use_causal_mask_bottom_right=True) if s > 1 else {}
+        o, _ = g.sdpa(
+            name="sdpa",
+            q=q,
+            k=k,
+            v=v,
+            seq_len_q=slq,
+            seq_len_kv=slk,
+            use_padding_mask=True,
+            generate_stats=False,
+            attn_scale=self.scale,
+            paged_attention_k_table=tk,
+            paged_attention_v_table=tv,
+            paged_attention_max_seq_len_kv=self.kv,
+            compute_data_type=cudnn.data_type.FLOAT,
+            **mask,
+        )
+        o.set_uid(O_UID).set_output(True).set_dim([b, h, s, d]).set_stride([s * h * d, d, h * d, 1]).set_data_type(self.io)
+        g.validate()
+        g.build_operation_graph()
+        g.create_execution_plans([cudnn.heur_mode.A])
+        return g
+
+    def pack(self, out):
+        return {
+            Q_UID: self.q_rows,
+            K_UID: self.k_cache,
+            V_UID: self.v_cache,
+            O_UID: out,
+            ACTUAL_SEQ_LENS_Q_UID: self.seq_lens_q,
+            ACTUAL_SEQ_LENS_KV_UID: self.seq_lens_kv,
+            BLOCK_TABLES_K_UID: self.block_tables.reshape(self.b, 1, self.max_pages, 1),
+            BLOCK_TABLES_V_UID: self.block_tables.reshape(self.b, 1, self.max_pages, 1),
+        }

+    def run_default(self, *, replay):
+        """FE's DEFAULT plan: name, the engine that serves it, the kernel template (the route readback) and its output."""
+        handle = cudnn.create_handle()
+        g = self.build(handle, replay=replay)
+        g.check_support()
+        g.build_plans()
+        idx = int(g._plan_index)
+        eng = g.selected_engine
+        facts = dict(
+            plan_name=g.get_plan_name_at_index(idx),
+            served_by=("frost:" + eng.name) if eng is not None else "cudnn-backend",
+            template=_served_by(g, idx) if eng is not None else None,
+            replay_hint=bool(getattr(g, "is_cuda_graph_replay_expected", False)),
+        )
+        out = torch.full((self.b * self.q_len, self.h_q, D), float("nan"), device="cuda", dtype=self.dtype)
+        ws = torch.empty(max(g.get_workspace_size(), 1), dtype=torch.uint8, device="cuda")
+        torch.cuda.set_sync_debug_mode("error")  # Rule 3: the lengths and page tables are read on device
+        try:
+            g.execute(self.pack(out), ws, handle=handle)
+        finally:
+            torch.cuda.set_sync_debug_mode("default")
+        torch.cuda.synchronize()

+    def run_backend(self):
+        """The backend's plan pinned by name on the SAME graph (the first non-FROST entry of the ranked list)."""
+        from cudnn.engines import is_python_engine

+        handle = cudnn.create_handle()
+        g = self.build(handle, replay=False)
+        idx = next(
+            i
+            for i in range(g.get_execution_plan_count())
+            if not is_python_engine(g.get_engine_and_knobs_at_index(i)[0]) and g.get_plan_name_at_index(i) != "backend_heuristics"
+        )
+        g.select_plan(idx)
+        g.check_support()
+        g.build_plans()
+        out = torch.full((self.b * self.q_len, self.h_q, D), float("nan"), device="cuda", dtype=self.dtype)
+        ws = torch.empty(max(g.get_workspace_size(), 1), dtype=torch.uint8, device="cuda")
+        g.execute(self.pack(out), ws, handle=handle)
+        torch.cuda.synchronize()
+        return g.get_plan_name_at_index(idx), out

+    backend_name, out_ref = case.run_backend()
+    assert not backend_name.startswith(FROST_PREFIX)
+    live = torch.ones(case.b, dtype=torch.bool)

+"""The SDPA-forward family's backend planning guard (``sdpa/fwd/backend_guard.py``, declared through
+``manifest.EngineFamily.backend_guard``): on cc 10.7 the cuDNN backend crashes the process while planning (9.26 / 9.27:
+the heuristics) or building (9.28: the plan build) a single-query MXFP8 graph without a sink token, so planning records a
+backend decline instead of asking.  Host-only: the
+facts are synthetic, or the device is modelled as cc 10.7 with the sm_107a DSL target (``rubin_host``, the way
+test_sdpa_fwd_heuristics.py::sm107_metadata_target models it), and nothing is ever built or executed."""

+_ROW = "sdpa_fwd_prefill_sm107_mxfp8"

+_TAIL = "the backend is not consulted for this graph"

+    modelled on any host.  The guard reads ``cudnn.backend_version()`` at call time and the CI lanes run a newer cuDNN (9.28)
+    than the login box (9.26), so every test of the ARMED guard pins the version instead of inheriting the installed
+    library's: the day a fix version is recorded these tests keep describing the armed regime (test_version_bound covers the

+def _mxfp8_graph(b=4, hq=8, hk=2, sq=1, skv=2048, d=128, dv=128, bshd=True, stats=False, sink=False):
+    """A dense graph.sdpa_mxfp8 forward declared as test/python/sdpa/mxfp8.py declares it (BSHD or BHSD strides)."""
+    ceil_div = lambda a, m: -(-a // m)  # noqa: E731
+    itype = cudnn.data_type.FP8_E4M3
+    g = pygraph(io_data_type=itype, intermediate_data_type=cudnn.data_type.FLOAT, compute_data_type=cudnn.data_type.FLOAT)
+    d_scale_pad = ceil_div(ceil_div(d, 32), 4) * 4
+    dv_pad = ceil_div(dv, 128) * 128
+    s_q_pad, s_kv_pad, s_kv_scale_pad = ceil_div(sq, 128) * 128, ceil_div(skv, 128) * 128, ceil_div(ceil_div(skv, 32), 4) * 4
+
+    def sf(dims, name):
+        return g.tensor(
+            dim=dims,
+            stride=(dims[1] * dims[2] * dims[3], dims[2] * dims[3], dims[3], 1),
+            data_type=cudnn.data_type.FP8_E8M0,
+            reordering_type=cudnn.tensor_reordering.F8_128x4,
+            name=name,
+        )
+
+    q_stride = (sq * hq * d, d, hq * d, 1) if bshd else (hq * sq * d, sq * d, d, 1)
+    o_stride = (sq * hq * dv, dv, hq * dv, 1) if bshd else (hq * sq * dv, sq * dv, dv, 1)
+    k_stride = (skv * hk * d, d, hk * d, 1) if bshd else (hk * skv * d, skv * d, d, 1)
+    v_stride = (skv * hk * dv, dv, hk * dv, 1) if bshd else (hk * skv * dv, skv * dv, dv, 1)
+    q = g.tensor(dim=(b, hq, sq, d), stride=q_stride, data_type=itype, name="q")
+    k = g.tensor(dim=(b, hk, skv, d), stride=k_stride, data_type=itype, name="k")
+    v = g.tensor(dim=(b, hk, skv, dv), stride=v_stride, data_type=itype, name="v")
+    kw = dict(
+        q=q,
+        k=k,
+        v=v,
+        descale_q=sf((b, hq, s_q_pad, d_scale_pad), "sf_q"),
+        descale_k=sf((b, hk, s_kv_pad, d_scale_pad), "sf_k"),
+        descale_v=sf((b, hk, s_kv_scale_pad, dv_pad), "sf_v"),
+        attn_scale=1.0 / math.sqrt(d),
+        generate_stats=stats,
+    )
+    if sink:
+        kw["sink_token"] = g.tensor(dim=(1, hq, 1, 1), stride=(hq, 1, 1, 1), data_type=cudnn.data_type.FLOAT, name="sink")
+    o, st, amax = g.sdpa_mxfp8(**kw)
+    o.set_output(True).set_dim((b, hq, sq, dv)).set_stride(o_stride).set_data_type(cudnn.data_type.BFLOAT16)
+    if stats:
+        st.set_output(True).set_dim((b, hq, sq, 1)).set_stride((hq * sq, sq, 1, 1)).set_data_type(cudnn.data_type.FLOAT)
+    amax.set_output(True).set_dim((1, 1, 1, 1)).set_stride((1, 1, 1, 1)).set_data_type(cudnn.data_type.FLOAT)
+    return g
+
+
+def _plan_names(g):

+def _slack(q, k, bias, scale, kv_mask=None, tile_n=128):
+    """Host model of the bound: per (row, kv tile) ``m_upper - m_true`` in log2 units -- the hardware raw max + the per-row bias-tile max
+    against the true max of the biased (and masked) scores.  Returns (max slack, the raw range it is bounded by)."""
+    k_ref = k.repeat_interleave(q.shape[1] // k.shape[1], dim=1) if k.shape[1] != q.shape[1] else k  # GQA: the shared KV head per Q head
+    s = torch.matmul(q.double(), k_ref.double().transpose(-1, -2))  # (b, h, s_q, s_kv) raw
+    b_ = (bias.double() if bias is not None else torch.zeros_like(s)).expand_as(s)
+    worst, worst_range = 0.0, 0.0
+    for t0 in range(0, s.shape[-1], tile_n):
+        sr, br = s[..., t0 : t0 + tile_n], b_[..., t0 : t0 + tile_n]
+        m_upper = sr.max(-1).values * scale + br.max(-1).values
+        true = sr * scale + br
+        if kv_mask is not None:
+            true = true.masked_fill(~kv_mask.view(kv_mask.shape[0], 1, 1, -1)[..., t0 : t0 + tile_n], float("-inf"))
+        m_true = true.max(-1).values
+        live = torch.isfinite(m_true)
+        if live.any():
+            worst = max(worst, float(((m_upper - m_true)[live] * math.log2(math.e)).max()))
+            worst_range = max(worst_range, float(((sr.max(-1).values - sr.min(-1).values) * scale)[live].max() * math.log2(math.e)))

+def _spy_row_picks(monkeypatch):
+    """Record every ``sm107_bias_mode_pick`` call the ENGINE ROW makes (it imports the name at call time) with its result."""
+    from cudnn.sdpa.fwd import config_sm107 as c
+
+    seen = []
+    orig = c.sm107_bias_mode_pick
+
+    def spy(*a, **kw):
+        r = orig(*a, **kw)
+        seen.append((a, kw, r))
+        return r
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(c, "sm107_bias_mode_pick", spy)
+    return seen

+    "RELEASE_CTA_CLUSTER_ARRIVE": r"mbarrier\.arrive\.release\.cta\.shared::cluster\.b64",

+    token (the form whose bytes land on the pair leader only -- a peer waiting its own barrier under it hangs); exactly the fill
+    sites x the boxes of a tile (3 sites: the prologue, the mainloop, the ghost loop); the cluster rank is read; the peer release is
+    the .release.cta cluster arrive (a READ-then-credit across CTAs: zero relaxed cluster arrives, zero .release.cluster); a cluster
+    barrier pair exists.  The cga1 ring's rendering carries none of them."""
+    from frost_test_utils import arch_known_to_the_dsl

+    if not arch_known_to_the_dsl("sm_107a"):

+# is 64, so that cell wraps the 16 KiB stage ring instead -- both widths covered); one cell per handshake class.  ``mode`` 3 = the seam;

+    "pick_n_chunk_S896_b8": dict(b=8, h=2, h_kv=2, s_q=896, s_kv=896),  # KNOB-LESS: the heuristics' chunk pick AND the pick's form (multicast)

+# one oracle cell per handshake class; the rows left out run under the bitwise / compose pins below
+_ORACLE_CASES = [c for c in _CASES if c not in ("nkv4_S512_b8_even", "nkv8_S1024_b12_odd_padded_peer", "nkv8_S1024_b8_2_stages")]

+# (bias_mode 2) serves the same cell, and it is what the KNOB-LESS default picks there (the graph-path cell below).  Not in _CASES: a decline is

+def _run(q, k, v, kw, c, _pins, *, mode=None, stages=None, n_chunk=None):

+        mode=c.get("mode") if mode is None else mode,
+        stages=c.get("stages") if stages is None else stages,

+def _spy_adapter_modes(monkeypatch):
+    """Record the bias FORM the adapter builds for every plan (``_resident_arm_bias_mode`` on the Blackwell / Rubin adapter class, where the
+    Rubin small tiles' arms live) with the length facts it saw: the compiled record is not on the graph's public surface, so a KNOB-LESS
+    cell reads the form it ran here."""
+    from cudnn.sdpa.fwd import api_dsl
+
+    modes = []
+    orig = api_dsl.SdpaFwdDslSm100._resident_arm_bias_mode
+
+    def spy(self):
+        m = orig(self)
+        modes.append((m, bool(self.seq_kv_lens_present), bool(self.seq_q_lens_present), self.bias_desc is not None, bool(self._kv_padded())))
+        return m
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(api_dsl.SdpaFwdDslSm100, "_resident_arm_bias_mode", spy)
+    return modes

+def _run_knob_less_multicast(q, k, v, kw, c, _pins, monkeypatch):

+    assert c.get("mode") is None and c.get("n_chunk") is None, "a knob-less cell carries no seam pin"
+    modes = _spy_adapter_modes(monkeypatch)

+    assert modes and {m for m, *_ in modes} == {_MCAST}, ("the knob-less plan did not take the multicast ring", modes)

+"""The (n, n+1) PAIR work item of the resident-bias arm on the Rubin (SM107) f16/bf16 small head-dim tiles --
+``TemplateParams.n_chunk >= 1`` on ``sm107/prefill_d128_f16.py``.
+
+A work item is (a 128-row q tile, a head, a CHUNK of up to ``n_chunk`` consecutive entries of the flattened batch axis); the two
+softmax sub-tiles are rows nb / nb + 1 of the SAME q tile, so the bias row-block shrinks to the q tile's 128 rows (twice the kv
+columns fit: S_kv <= 768 at the 32-wide tile, <= 384 at the 64-wide one, from 384 / 128) and is loaded ONCE per item for every
+row of the chunk -- the per-item fixed cost and the bias feed divided by ``n_chunk``.  The form needs a batch-BROADCAST bias
+(``[1, 1|H, S_q, S_kv]``: two rows share one block), at least two rows and cga1; a per-batch bias, a single row or a cga2 plan keeps
+the one-batch-entry item (``n_chunk = 0``, every one-batch-entry cell and cubin record unchanged).  Nothing numerically changes: every row's
+kv loop runs the same tiles in the same order, so O / Stats are BITWISE identical across ``n_chunk`` values, against the
+one-batch-entry item and (bias = 0) against the plain kernel.

+Three tiers: (1) CPU contract -- the derived pair budget and the form predicate, the chunk-length rule, the engine row's
+accept / decline table (the widened cells and the cells that keep the one-batch-entry budget), the config factory's couplings,
+the adapter twin; (2) host rendering pins -- every pair rendering keeps the register split, no cluster drain, no spills above
+the one-batch-entry bias rendering, the packed bias add and the bit-word mask where a mask is on; (3) GPU cells on a Rubin

+of the tile, a zero-length row inside a chunk, mixed lengths, the padded-Q trim, the band + padding, the budget edges of both tiles, the
+sink, the rule's own pick; the magnitude / head-broadcast forms are pinned on the one-batch-entry arm), the bitwise pins across n_chunk in

+def _api(d=32, *, s_q=256, s_kv=256, b=2, h=4, h_kv=None, dtype=torch.bfloat16, bias=None, kv_mask=None, kv_mask_dtype=torch.bool, **kw):
+    from cudnn.sdpa.fwd.api_dsl import SdpaFwdDslSm100
+
+    h_kv = h if h_kv is None else h_kv
+    q, o = (_t7._desc((b, h, s_q, d), dtype, n) for n in ("q", "o"))
+    k, v = (_t7._desc((b, h_kv, s_kv, d), dtype, n) for n in ("k", "v"))
+    if bias is not None:
+        kw["sample_bias"] = _t7._desc(bias, dtype, "bias")
+    if kv_mask is not None:
+        kw["sample_kv_mask"] = _t7._desc(kv_mask, kv_mask_dtype, "kv_mask")
+    return SdpaFwdDslSm100(q, k, v, o, None, **kw)

+def test_adapter_check_support_is_the_rows_twin(_sm100_device_for_the_adapter, name, kw, accept, flavor, bias_mode, kv_mask_form, cta_mma):
+    """The standalone adapter's ``check_support`` on a cc 10.0 device (rule 8b twin): the same cells accept with the compile-time record
+    carrying ``bias_mode`` / ``kv_mask_form`` on the expected flavor at the budget's width, or decline with one of the two TYPED exceptions."""

+    _want_stages = 0 if bias_mode != 2 else (3 if _want_tile_n == 64 else 2)  # the derived deepest ring: 3 stages at the 64-wide KV tile, 2 at the 128-wide

+def _paged_d64_api(**kw):
+    """A paged (64, 64) plan on the standalone adapter: K / V as page pools (pages, H_kv, page, D), the padding mask on (paged KV requires it)."""
+    from cudnn.sdpa.fwd.api_dsl import SdpaFwdDslSm100
+
+    page, pages = 128, 4
+    q, o = (_t7._desc((2, 4, 256, 64), torch.bfloat16, n) for n in ("q", "o"))

+    return SdpaFwdDslSm100(q, k, v, o, None, seq_kv_lens_present=True, paged_page_size=page, paged_max_seq_len_kv=pages * page, **kw)

+def _run(
+    q,
+    k,
+    v,
+    *,
+    scale,
+    bias=None,
+    kv_mask=None,
+    sdpa_kwargs=None,
+    seq_len_kv=None,
+    seq_len_q=None,
+    sink=None,
+    stats=True,
+    cga=None,
+    tile_n=None,
+    two_launch_assert=True,
+):
+    """The Rubin module's ``_run`` against the SM100 row: build the graph, pin the row's unsplit plan (the heuristics' pick; a cga / tile_n
+    request through the public autotune record), launch TWICE on sentinel-filled outputs (the two-launch delta) and return O, Stats and
+    the plan's knobs.  ``two_launch_assert=False`` leaves the two-launch identity to the caller (the first launch rides along as
+    ``o_first`` / ``stats_first``), so a cell can report a NaN residue as what it is before the identity check."""
+    import cudnn
+    from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+    g, vp, o, o_gpu, stats_gpu = _t7._build(
+        q, k, v, scale=scale, bias=bias, kv_mask=kv_mask, sdpa_kwargs=sdpa_kwargs, seq_len_kv=seq_len_kv, seq_len_q=seq_len_q, sink=sink, stats=stats
+    )
+    g.create_execution_plans([cudnn.heur_mode.A])
+    names = [g.get_plan_name_at_index(i) for i in range(len(g.plans))]
+    ours = [i for i, n in enumerate(names) if n == _ROW or n.startswith(_ROW + "[")]
+    idx = next((i for i in ours if g.plans[i].knobs.split_kv in (None, 1)), None)
+    assert idx is not None, f"no unsplit {_ROW} plan in {names}"
+    picked = g.plans[idx].knobs
+    picked_cga, picked_tile_n = picked.cga, picked.tile_n
+    want_cga = picked_cga if cga is None else cga
+    want_tile_n = picked_tile_n if tile_n is None else tile_n
+    if (want_cga, want_tile_n) != (picked_cga, picked_tile_n):
+        engine_id, record = g.get_engine_and_knobs_at_index(idx)
+        record = dict(record)
+        if want_cga != picked_cga:
+            record[cudnn.knob_type.TILE_CGA_M] = want_cga
+        if want_tile_n != picked_tile_n:
+            record[cudnn.knob_type.TILE_N] = want_tile_n
+        g.create_execution_plan(engine_id, record)
+        idx = g.get_execution_plan_count() - 1
+        picked_cga, picked_tile_n = want_cga, want_tile_n
+    g.select_plan(idx)
+    g.check_support()
+    g.build_plans()
+    vp[o] = o_gpu
+    ws = torch.empty(max(g.get_workspace_size(), 1), device="cuda", dtype=torch.uint8)
+
+    def launch():
+        o_gpu.fill_(float("nan"))  # sentinel: an unwritten live row stays NaN
+        if stats_gpu is not None:
+            stats_gpu.fill_(float("nan"))
+        g.execute(vp, ws)
+        torch.cuda.synchronize()
+        return o_gpu.clone(), (stats_gpu.clone() if stats_gpu is not None else None)
+
+    o1, st1 = launch()
+    o2, st2 = launch()
+    if two_launch_assert:
+        assert torch.equal(o1, o2) and (st1 is None or torch.equal(st1, st2)), "two-launch delta on O / Stats"
+    return dict(o=o_gpu, stats=stats_gpu, knobs=SimpleNamespace(cga=picked_cga, tile_n=picked_tile_n), names=names, o_first=o1, stats_first=st1)
+

+def _frost_plan_names(q, k, v, kw):
+    import cudnn
+
+    g, *_ = _t7._build(
+        q,
+        k,
+        v,
+        scale=kw["scale"],
+        bias=kw["bias"],
+        kv_mask=kw["kv_mask"],
+        sdpa_kwargs=kw["sdpa_kwargs"],
+        seq_len_kv=kw["seq_len_kv"],
+        seq_len_q=kw["seq_len_q"],
+        sink=kw["sink"],
+    )
+    try:
+        g.create_execution_plans([cudnn.heur_mode.A])

+        if type(exc).__name__ == "cudnnGraphNotSupportedError":
+            # no engine at all proposed a plan (a kv_mask graph has no backend lowering): the row's decline IS the whole answer
+            return []
+        raise
+    return [g.get_plan_name_at_index(i) for i in range(len(g.plans))]

+def _resolve_dtypes(kw):
+    import cudnn
+
+    names = {"FLOAT": cudnn.data_type.FLOAT, "BF16": cudnn.data_type.BFLOAT16, "INT8": cudnn.data_type.INT8}
+    out = dict(kw)
+    for key in ("bias_dtype", "kv_mask_dtype"):
+        if isinstance(out.get(key), str):
+            out[key] = names[out[key]]
+    for key in ("bias_t", "kv_mask_t"):
+        t = out.get(key)
+        if t is not None and isinstance(t._dt, str):
+            out[key] = _IrTensor(names[t._dt])
+    return out

+def _desc(shape, dtype, name, stride=None):
+    """A standalone-adapter descriptor.  The ACTIVATIONS (``q`` / ``k`` / ``v`` / ``o``, shape (B, H, S, D)) default to the row's
+    envelope, BSHD-physical (stride order 3, 1, 2, 0) -- the layout the prepared launch binds zero-copy, so the adapter cells are the
+    row's twin; a (B, H, S, D)-contiguous activation would take the adapter's staging-copy path, which carries neither the bias nor the
+    kv_mask and is therefore a typed decline in ``check_support`` with a resident-arm operand bound.  Every other tensor (the bias, the
+    kv_mask, the lengths) defaults to its contiguous strides."""
+    from cudnn.api_base import TensorDesc
+
+    if stride is None and name in ("q", "k", "v", "o") and len(shape) == 4:
+        b, h, s, d = (int(x) for x in shape)
+        stride = (s * h * d, d, h * d, 1)
+    stride = tuple(int(x) for x in torch.empty(shape).stride()) if stride is None else tuple(stride)
+    return TensorDesc(
+        dtype=dtype, shape=tuple(shape), stride=stride, stride_order=TensorDesc._compute_stride_order(tuple(shape), stride), device="cuda", name=name
+    )

+def test_kernel_module_constants_and_mask_sites(monkeypatch):
+    """The per-kernel constant ``BIAS_PRELOAD_CHUNKS`` is in its domain, the bias barriers ride ``make_classic_bars(bias_resident=,
+    bias_ring_stages=)`` (the two bias FORMS fold on CFG.BIAS_MODE), every mask site of the file calls ``apply_mask_chunk`` directly

+        "BIAS_PRELOAD_CHUNKS: int = sm107_bias_preload_chunks(CFG.TILE_N)" in src

+    # bias + kv_mask body -- the chooser's pick for a masked bias graph -- loses 2.5..2.7 % without it; the other 64-wide forms are mixed);
+    # every value in the kernel's domain; an unrelated width keeps the one-chunk default
+    assert cfg107.SM107_BIAS_PRELOAD_CHUNKS_BY_TILE_N == {128: 0, 64: 1}

+    # the bias barriers ride the factory's appended keywords; the multi-line call carries the S / P slot ring and the multicast ring's release count
+    assert (
+        "s_stages=CFG.TILES_Q * CFG.S_SLOTS,\n        bias_resident=_BIAS_RESIDENT,\n        bias_ring_stages=CFG.STAGES_BIAS if _BIAS_STREAMED else 0," in src

+# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- tier 3: GPU cells (a Rubin device)
+
+_DTYPES = [torch.float16, torch.bfloat16]
+_DTYPE_IDS = ["fp16", "bf16"]
+# The existing f16 row tolerances (test_sdpa_fwd_dsl_sm107.py / test_sdpa_fwd_head_dim_sm107.py): O against the fp64 oracle (an
+# fp32 accumulation, one 16-bit rounding at the store), the LSE pair at 1e-4 / 1e-4 (the bias enters the fp32 score by ONE
+# FFMA of bias * (1 / scale), then the scale multiply: one more fp32 rounding than the eager s * scale + bias -- pinned by the
+# bias-magnitude cells, not widened for them).
+_TOL_O = dict(atol=5e-2, rtol=3e-2)
+_TOL_LSE = dict(atol=1e-4, rtol=1e-4)
+
+
+def _bhsd(b, h, s, d, dtype):
+    return torch.randn(b, s, h, d, device="cuda", dtype=dtype).transpose(1, 2)
+
+
+def _ref(
+    q,
+    k,
+    v,
+    *,
+    scale,
+    bias=None,
+    kv_mask=None,
+    causal=False,
+    bottom_right=False,
+    seq_q_lens=None,
+    seq_kv_lens=None,
+    sinks=None,
+    window_left=None,
+    right_bound=None,
+):
+    """fp64 oracle of the whole contract: softmax_k(scale * q.k + bias + maskbias) with the key mask, the padding and the band;
+    a row without a live key reads O = 0 / LSE = -inf (the empty-row contract); the bias enters in its 16-bit value."""
+    b, h_q, s_q, _ = q.shape
+    _, h_kv, s_kv, _ = v.shape
+    dev = q.device
+    g = h_q // h_kv
+    k_ref = k.repeat_interleave(g, dim=1).double()
+    v_ref = v.repeat_interleave(g, dim=1).double()
+    scores = torch.matmul(q.double(), k_ref.transpose(-1, -2)) * scale
+    if bias is not None:
+        scores = scores + bias.double()  # broadcast over the dims declared 1
+    q_lens = seq_q_lens.flatten().to(device=dev, dtype=torch.int64) if seq_q_lens is not None else torch.full((b,), s_q, dtype=torch.int64, device=dev)
+    kv_lens = seq_kv_lens.flatten().to(device=dev, dtype=torch.int64) if seq_kv_lens is not None else torch.full((b,), s_kv, dtype=torch.int64, device=dev)
+    i = torch.arange(s_q, device=dev).view(1, 1, s_q, 1)
+    j = torch.arange(s_kv, device=dev).view(1, 1, 1, s_kv)
+    diag = i + (kv_lens - q_lens).view(b, 1, 1, 1) if bottom_right else i
+    dead_q = i >= q_lens.view(b, 1, 1, 1)
+    masked = dead_q | (j >= kv_lens.view(b, 1, 1, 1))
+    if kv_mask is not None:
+        masked = masked | (~kv_mask.view(kv_mask.shape[0], 1, 1, s_kv))
+    if causal:
+        masked = masked | (j > diag)
+    if right_bound is not None:
+        masked = masked | (j > diag + right_bound)
+    if window_left is not None:
+        masked = masked | (j < diag - window_left)
+    scores = scores.masked_fill(masked, float("-inf"))
+    full = scores if sinks is None else torch.cat([scores, sinks.view(1, h_q, 1, 1).double().expand(b, h_q, s_q, 1)], dim=-1)
+    smax = full.max(dim=-1).values
+    ssum = torch.exp(full - smax.unsqueeze(-1)).sum(dim=-1).nan_to_num(0.0)
+    lse = smax + torch.log(ssum)
+    o = torch.matmul(torch.softmax(full, dim=-1).nan_to_num(0.0)[..., :s_kv], v_ref)
+    dead = dead_q.squeeze(-1)
+    return dict(o=o, lse=lse.masked_fill(dead, float("-inf")), empty=torch.isneginf(lse) | dead)
+
+
+def _build(q, k, v, *, scale, bias=None, kv_mask=None, sdpa_kwargs=None, seq_len_kv=None, seq_len_q=None, sink=None, stats=True):
+    """The graph with its variant pack (bias / kv_mask bound through ``tensor_like``: the bias as the classic ``bias`` operand,
+    the mask as the python-only ``kv_mask`` input)."""
+    import cudnn
+
+    b, h_q, s_q, _ = q.shape
+    d_v = v.shape[-1]
+    dtype = q.dtype
+    o_gpu = torch.empty(b, s_q, h_q, d_v, device="cuda", dtype=dtype).transpose(1, 2)
+    io = cudnn.data_type.HALF if dtype == torch.float16 else cudnn.data_type.BFLOAT16
+    g = cudnn.pygraph(io_data_type=io, intermediate_data_type=cudnn.data_type.FLOAT, compute_data_type=cudnn.data_type.FLOAT)
+    tq, tk, tv = g.tensor_like(q), g.tensor_like(k), g.tensor_like(v)
+    kw = dict(name="sdpa", q=tq, k=tk, v=tv, generate_stats=stats, attn_scale=scale)
+    vp = {tq: q, tk: k, tv: v}
+    if bias is not None:
+        tb = g.tensor_like(bias)
+        kw["bias"] = tb
+        vp[tb] = bias
+    if kv_mask is not None:
+        tm = g.tensor_like(kv_mask)
+        kw["kv_mask"] = tm
+        vp[tm] = kv_mask
+    if seq_len_kv is not None:
+        slk = g.tensor_like(seq_len_kv)
+        kw.update(seq_len_kv=slk, use_padding_mask=True)
+        vp[slk] = seq_len_kv
+        slq_t = seq_len_q if seq_len_q is not None else torch.full((b, 1, 1, 1), s_q, dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda")
+        slq = g.tensor_like(slq_t)
+        kw["seq_len_q"] = slq
+        vp[slq] = slq_t
+    if sink is not None:
+        st = g.tensor_like(sink)
+        kw["sink_token"] = st
+        vp[st] = sink
+    kw.update(sdpa_kwargs or {})
+    o, stats_t = g.sdpa(**kw)
+    o.set_output(True).set_dim(o_gpu.shape).set_stride(o_gpu.stride())
+    stats_gpu = None
+    if stats:
+        stats_gpu = make_dense_stats(b, h_q, s_q, "contiguous")
+        stats_t.set_output(True).set_dim(stats_gpu.shape).set_stride(stats_gpu.stride()).set_data_type(cudnn.data_type.FLOAT)
+        vp[stats_t] = stats_gpu
+    g.validate()
+    g.build_operation_graph()
+    return g, vp, o, o_gpu, stats_gpu
+
+
+def _frost_plans(g):
+    names = [g.get_plan_name_at_index(i) for i in range(len(g.plans))]
+    return names, [i for i, n in enumerate(names) if n == _ROW or n.startswith(_ROW + "[")]
+
+
+def _run(q, k, v, *, scale, bias=None, kv_mask=None, sdpa_kwargs=None, seq_len_kv=None, seq_len_q=None, sink=None, stats=True, cga=None, tile_n=None):
+    """Build the graph, pin the Rubin f16 row (optionally a cga and / or a KV tile width through the public autotune record;
+    ``tile_n=None`` keeps the heuristics' pick), launch TWICE on sentinel-filled outputs (the two-launch delta) and return O,
+    Stats and the plan's knobs (``knobs.tile_n`` = the width the executed plan carries)."""
+    import cudnn
+
+    g, vp, o, o_gpu, stats_gpu = _build(
+        q, k, v, scale=scale, bias=bias, kv_mask=kv_mask, sdpa_kwargs=sdpa_kwargs, seq_len_kv=seq_len_kv, seq_len_q=seq_len_q, sink=sink, stats=stats
+    )
+    g.create_execution_plans([cudnn.heur_mode.A])
+    names, ours = _frost_plans(g)
+    idx = next((i for i in ours if g.plans[i].knobs.split_kv in (None, 1)), None)
+    assert idx is not None, f"no unsplit {_ROW} plan in {names}"
+    picked = g.plans[idx].knobs
+    picked_cga, picked_tile_n = picked.cga, picked.tile_n
+    want_cga = picked_cga if cga is None else cga
+    want_tile_n = picked_tile_n if tile_n is None else tile_n
+    if (want_cga, want_tile_n) != (picked_cga, picked_tile_n):
+        engine_id, record = g.get_engine_and_knobs_at_index(idx)
+        record = dict(record)
+        if want_cga != picked_cga:
+            record[cudnn.knob_type.TILE_CGA_M] = want_cga
+        if want_tile_n != picked_tile_n:
+            record[cudnn.knob_type.TILE_N] = want_tile_n
+        g.create_execution_plan(engine_id, record)
+        idx = g.get_execution_plan_count() - 1
+        picked_cga, picked_tile_n = want_cga, want_tile_n
+    g.select_plan(idx)
+    g.check_support()
+    g.build_plans()
+    assert (g.plans[idx].knobs.cga, g.plans[idx].knobs.tile_n) == (picked_cga, picked_tile_n), (g.plans[idx].knobs, picked_cga, picked_tile_n)
+    vp[o] = o_gpu
+    ws = torch.empty(max(g.get_workspace_size(), 1), device="cuda", dtype=torch.uint8)
+
+    def launch():
+        o_gpu.fill_(float("nan"))  # sentinel: an unwritten live row stays NaN
+        if stats_gpu is not None:
+            stats_gpu.fill_(float("nan"))
+        g.execute(vp, ws)
+        torch.cuda.synchronize()
+        return o_gpu.clone(), (stats_gpu.clone() if stats_gpu is not None else None)
+
+    o1, st1 = launch()
+    o2, st2 = launch()
+    assert torch.equal(o1, o2) and (st1 is None or torch.equal(st1, st2)), "two-launch delta on O / Stats"
+    return dict(o=o_gpu, stats=stats_gpu, knobs=SimpleNamespace(cga=picked_cga, tile_n=picked_tile_n), names=names)
+
+
+def _check(out, ref, *, has_stats=True):
+    """Keyless rows EXACTLY 0 / -inf (never NaN, never a residue); live rows against the fp64 oracle."""
+    empty = ref["empty"]
+    o = out["o"]
+    assert torch.isfinite(o).all(), "O has a non-finite (an unwritten sentinel or a NaN residue)"
+    assert (o[empty] == 0).all(), "a keyless row's O must be exactly 0 (a SELECT, never a multiply by zero)"
+    torch.testing.assert_close(o[~empty].double(), ref["o"][~empty], **_TOL_O)
+    if has_stats:

+def _ref_of(c, q, k, v, kw):
+    """The oracle under exactly the graph's conditions (sdpa-invariants s8): every flag of the case has its reference branch."""
+    return _ref(

+        sinks=kw["sink"].flatten() if kw["sink"] is not None else None, window_left=c.get("window_left"), right_bound=c.get("right_bound"),

+def _case_inputs(case, dtype, *, seed=0, kv_mask_p=None, table=None):
+    torch.manual_seed(seed)
+    c = (_CASES if table is None else table)[case]
+    d = c.get("d", 32)
+    q = _bhsd(c["b"], c["h"], c["s_q"], d, dtype)
+    k = _bhsd(c["b"], c["h_kv"], c["s_kv"], d, dtype)
+    v = _bhsd(c["b"], c["h_kv"], c["s_kv"], d, dtype)
+    form = c.get("bias", "h")
+    bb = c["b"] if form in ("b", "b1") else 1
+    bh = c["h"] if form in ("h", "b") else 1
+    # A padded row stride (`bias_row_stride`: the TMA 16-byte rule at an S_kv % 8 != 0) makes the bias a strided VIEW; compact otherwise.
+    row = c.get("bias_row_stride", c["s_kv"])
+    bias = (torch.randn(bb, bh, c["s_q"], row, device="cuda", dtype=torch.float32) * c.get("bias_scale", 1.0)).to(dtype)[..., : c["s_kv"]]
+    if c.get("neg_fold"):
+        # the models' finite key fold: 0 on a live key, -1e9 on a masked one (rounded to the io dtype like the models' bias)
+        keep = torch.rand(bb, 1, 1, c["s_kv"], device="cuda") > 0.3
+        bias = torch.where(keep, torch.zeros_like(bias), torch.full_like(bias, -1e9))
+    kv_mask = None
+    if kv_mask_p is not None:
+        kv_mask = torch.rand(c["b"], 1, 1, c["s_kv"], device="cuda") > kv_mask_p
+    kv_lens = torch.tensor(c["kv_lens"], dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda").view(c["b"], 1, 1, 1) if "kv_lens" in c else None
+    q_lens = torch.tensor(c["q_lens"], dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda").view(c["b"], 1, 1, 1) if "q_lens" in c else None
+    sink = torch.randn(1, c["h"], 1, 1, dtype=torch.float32, device="cuda") if c.get("sink") else None
+    causal = bool(c.get("causal") or c.get("bottom_right"))
+    sdpa_kwargs = dict(use_causal_mask_bottom_right=True) if c.get("bottom_right") else (dict(use_causal_mask=True) if causal else {})
+    window_left = c.get("window_left")
+    if window_left is not None:
+        sdpa_kwargs["sliding_window_length"] = window_left + 1  # the graph's length L keeps L keys up to the diagonal: W = L - 1
+    right_bound = c.get("right_bound")
+    if right_bound is not None:
+        sdpa_kwargs["diagonal_band_right_bound"] = right_bound
+    scale = 1.0 / math.sqrt(d) if not c.get("bottom_right") else 0.75
+    run_kw = dict(scale=scale, bias=bias, kv_mask=kv_mask, sdpa_kwargs=sdpa_kwargs, seq_len_kv=kv_lens, seq_len_q=q_lens, sink=sink, cga=c.get("cga"))

+# The SIGN of attn_scale against the additive arms: a plan with a NEGATIVE attn_scale runs with
+# negate_scores (#1435) -- BMM1 negates S and the kernel runs at |scale| -- and the pre-scale additive FMA of the bias / kv_mask arms
+# (``S_raw + bias * inv_scale``, then the exp2 scale) must take the SAME effective positive magnitude.  The prepared dense template used to
+# bind the SIGNED 1 / scale in that slot, so on such a plan the bias entered with its sign flipped (scale * Q.K - bias) on the graph route
+# (the standalone adapter re-derives the slot per call from |scale| and was right).  The inputs make the whole answer one number: Q = K = 0
+# (the scale multiplies nothing but the additive term), +2 on the first half of the keys and -2 on the other half -- per key, in the io
+# dtype, as the resident [1, H, S, S] block or as the ADDITIVE kv_mask vector [1, 1, 1, S] -- and V = +1 / -1 on the same halves, so
+# softmax_k(bias) . V = tanh(2) on every row and lane at EITHER sign of the scale; the flipped binding reads -tanh(2).  The signed fp64
+# oracle is the detector, and the NEGATED oracle (what the flipped binding computes) is pinned to be what the plan does NOT compute.  Both
+# arch modules run the cells on their row; the HOST pin below reads the template itself off ``build_dense_spec`` without a device.
+_SIGNED_SCALE_S, _SIGNED_SCALE_D, _SIGNED_SCALE_MAG = 128, 32, 0.125
+_SIGNED_SCALE_FORMS = ("bias", "additive_kv_mask")
+
+
+def _signed_scale_inputs(sign, form, dtype):
+    """``(q, k, v, run_kw, ref)`` of the signed-scale cell: ``form`` = "bias" (the resident block) or "additive_kv_mask" (the per-key additive
+    vector through the python-only kv_mask input); ``sign`` = +1 / -1 picks attn_scale = sign * 0.125."""
+    assert form in _SIGNED_SCALE_FORMS, form
+    b, h, s, d = 1, 2, _SIGNED_SCALE_S, _SIGNED_SCALE_D
+    q = torch.zeros(b, s, h, d, device="cuda", dtype=dtype).transpose(1, 2)
+    k = torch.zeros(b, s, h, d, device="cuda", dtype=dtype).transpose(1, 2)
+    v = torch.empty(b, s, h, d, device="cuda", dtype=dtype).transpose(1, 2)
+    v[:, :, : s // 2] = 1.0
+    v[:, :, s // 2 :] = -1.0
+    additive = torch.full((1, h, s, s) if form == "bias" else (b, 1, 1, s), -2.0, device="cuda", dtype=dtype)
+    additive[..., : s // 2] = 2.0
+    scale = sign * _SIGNED_SCALE_MAG
+    run_kw = dict(
+        scale=scale,
+        bias=additive if form == "bias" else None,
+        kv_mask=None if form == "bias" else additive,
+        sdpa_kwargs={},
+        seq_len_kv=None,
+        seq_len_q=None,
+        sink=None,
+    )
+    return q, k, v, run_kw, _ref(q, k, v, scale=scale, bias=additive)  # the vector broadcasts over (B, H, S_q) in the oracle like a bias
+

+def _check_signed_scale(out, ref):
+    """O and Stats against the signed oracle, the closed form tanh(2) on every lane, and the negated oracle rejected."""
+    _check(out, ref)
+    o = out["o"].double()
+    torch.testing.assert_close(o, torch.full_like(o, math.tanh(2.0)), **_TOL_O)
+    assert not torch.allclose(
+        o, -ref["o"], **_TOL_O
+    ), "the NEGATED oracle (the flipped-bias binding, scale * Q.K - bias) must be what the plan does NOT compute"
+

+@requires_rubin
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("form", _SIGNED_SCALE_FORMS)
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("sign", [1.0, -1.0], ids=["positive_scale", "negative_scale"])
+def test_signed_attn_scale_keeps_the_additive_arms_sign(sign, form):
+    """attn_scale = +0.125 and -0.125 on the Rubin row's resident bias and on its additive kv_mask vector, on the public graph route: the
+    negated plan (BMM1 negates S, |scale| in the kernel) must bind the additive arms' 1 / scale at the same effective magnitude -- O = tanh(2)
+    on every lane at either sign; the positive cell is the control."""
+    q, k, v, kw, ref = _signed_scale_inputs(sign, form, torch.bfloat16)
+    _check_signed_scale(_run(q, k, v, **kw), ref)

+def _dense_plan_stand_in(kernel_file, *, scale):
+    """A device-free stand-in for what ``prepared.build_dense_spec`` reads off an adapter: the host slot order parsed from the kernel file's
+    ``_host`` signature (as the native-binding fixtures read it), a positional entry that launches nothing, and the declared facts of a dense
+    unsplit bf16 [1, 2, 128, 32] plan with the resident bias; ``_score_negated`` follows the scale's sign exactly as the adapter sets it."""
+    import ast
+    import inspect
+    import types
+
+    host = next(n for n in ast.parse(kernel_file.read_text()).body if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name == "_host")
+    order = [a.arg for a in host.args.args if a.annotation is None or "Constexpr" not in ast.unparse(a.annotation)]
+
+    def entry(*args):
+        raise AssertionError("the host pin never launches")
+
+    entry.__signature__ = inspect.Signature([inspect.Parameter(n, inspect.Parameter.POSITIONAL_OR_KEYWORD) for n in order])
+    km = types.ModuleType(f"stand_in_{kernel_file.parent.name}_prefill_d128_f16")
+    km._host = entry
+
+    def desc():
+        return SimpleNamespace(dtype="torch.bfloat16", device=SimpleNamespace(index=0))
+
+    return SimpleNamespace(
+        _k_mod=km, _compiled_kernel=SimpleNamespace(_compiled_cache_raw=entry),
+        batch_size=1, h_q=2, h_kv=2, head_dim_qk=_SIGNED_SCALE_D, head_dim_v=_SIGNED_SCALE_D, s_q_max=_SIGNED_SCALE_S, s_k_max=_SIGNED_SCALE_S,
+        paged=False, paged_page_size=None, split_kv=1, q_desc=desc(), k_desc=desc(), v_desc=desc(), o_desc=desc(), lse_desc=None, has_sink=False,
+        bias_desc=desc(), kv_mask_desc=None, seq_kv_lens_present=False, seq_q_lens_present=False, gate_desc=None,
+        is_causal=False, window_size_right=0, causal_bottom_right=False, scale_softmax=float(scale), _score_negated=float(scale) < 0,
+    )  # fmt: skip
+

+def test_prepared_dense_template_binds_the_additive_arms_inverse_scale_at_the_effective_magnitude(arch, sign):
+    """HOST pin, no device: the argument template ``build_dense_spec`` writes for a resident-bias plan at attn_scale = sign * 0.125 -- the
+    template every graph-route launch copies (``PreparedDenseLaunch.execute`` -> ``bind_dense`` -> ``spec.frame()``).  On the negated plan
+    ``scale_softmax_log2`` AND ``inv_scale_softmax`` are both bound at |scale| -- the exp2 scale 0.125 log2 e and the FMA's 1 / 0.125 = +8 --
+    so the kernel's ``S_raw + bias * inv_scale`` keeps the bias's sign; the signed 1 / scale (-8) is pinned absent."""
+    from cudnn.sdpa.fwd import prepared as prep
+
+    scale = sign * _SIGNED_SCALE_MAG
+    spec = prep.build_dense_spec(_dense_plan_stand_in(_D128_HOST_FILES[arch], scale=scale), scale_softmax=None)
+    assert spec.has_bias and spec.native is None, "a bias plan binds through the python frame (no native binder): the template IS the launch's constants"
+    t, ix = spec.template, spec.index
+    assert t[ix["scale_softmax_log2"]] == pytest.approx(abs(scale) * math.log2(math.e))
+    assert t[ix["inv_scale_softmax"]] == pytest.approx(1.0 / abs(scale)), (arch, sign, t[ix["inv_scale_softmax"]])
+    # the per-call frame copies the slot unchanged: the graph route binds no scale of its own

+"""Shared backward dot helper: physical strides, alignment, rebinding and replay.
+
+These tests call the helper directly; they do not expand graph engine eligibility.
+The large declarations reproduce CP8 AllGather's O/dO storage on both Q halves.
+"""
+
+import re
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from frost_test_utils import _SM, arch_known_to_the_dsl, requires_dsl
+
+pytestmark = [requires_dsl, pytest.mark.skipif(_SM is None or not 100 <= _SM < 130, reason="Shared Blackwell backward helper")]
+
+
+def _case(dim, dtype, layout, origin=0):
+    smoke = dim == 256 and dtype == torch.bfloat16 and layout in ("pitched", "base2", "compact_base2", "compact_o_base2", "compact_do_base2")
+    level = pytest.mark.L0 if smoke else pytest.mark.L1
+    return pytest.param(dim, dtype, layout, origin, id=f"d{dim}-{str(dtype).split('.')[-1]}-{layout}-{origin}", marks=level)
+
+
+_CASES = [_case(dim, dtype, layout) for dim, dtype in ((128, torch.bfloat16), (256, torch.float16), (256, torch.bfloat16)) for layout in ("compact", "pitched")]
+_CASES += [_case(256, torch.bfloat16, layout) for layout in ("asymmetric", "batch_odd", "row_odd", "head_odd", "base2", "padded")]
+_CASES += [_case(256, torch.bfloat16, layout) for layout in ("compact_base2", "compact_o_base2", "compact_do_base2")]
+_CASES += [_case(256, torch.bfloat16, "cp8", origin) for origin in (0, 512)]
+
+
+def _compile(shape, strides, dtype, dim, alignment, arch, dump_dir=None):
+    import cutlass
+    import cutlass.cute as cute
+    from cutlass.cute.runtime import make_fake_stream, make_fake_tensor
+    from cudnn.sdpa.bwd.kernels.bprop_chain_common import dot_do_o_host
+
+    batch, seqlen, heads, _ = shape
+    rounded = ((seqlen + 127) // 128) * 128
+    scalar = cutlass.BFloat16 if dtype == torch.bfloat16 else cutlass.Float16
+    alignments = (alignment, alignment) if isinstance(alignment, int) else alignment
+    operands = [make_fake_tensor(scalar, shape, stride, assumed_align=align) for stride, align in zip(strides, alignments)]
+    delta = make_fake_tensor(cutlass.Float32, (batch, heads, rounded), (heads * rounded, rounded, 1), assumed_align=16)
+    options = f"--enable-tvm-ffi --gpu-arch {arch}"
+    if dump_dir is not None:
+        options += f" --keep-ptx --dump-dir={dump_dir}"
+    return cute.compile(
+        dot_do_o_host, *operands, delta, None, None, 128, dim, dim, 64, False, False, make_fake_stream(use_tvm_ffi_env_stream=False), options=options
+    )
+
+
+def _reference(operands):
+    """Full CPU FP64 row sums, with bounded scratch even for the real CP8 shape."""
+    batch, seqlen, heads, _ = operands[0].shape
+    result = torch.empty((batch, heads, seqlen), dtype=torch.float64)
+    for b in range(batch):
+        for begin in range(0, seqlen, 64):
+            left, right = [value[b, begin : begin + 64].cpu().double() for value in operands]
+            result[b, :, begin : begin + 64] = (left * right).sum(-1).transpose(0, 1)
+    return result
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("dim,dtype,layout,origin", _CASES)
+def test_backward_dot_physical_layout(dim, dtype, layout, origin):
+    batch, seqlen, heads = (64, 512, 32) if layout == "cp8" else (2, 257, 4)
+    width = 192 if layout == "padded" else dim
+    pitch = seqlen if layout.startswith("compact") else 1024 if layout == "cp8" else seqlen + 127
+    head_stride = width + int(layout == "head_odd")
+    row_stride = heads * head_stride + int(layout == "row_odd")
+    strides = [(pitch * row_stride + int(layout == "batch_odd"), row_stride, head_stride, 1)] * 2
+    if layout == "asymmetric":
+        strides[1] = ((pitch + 128) * row_stride, row_stride, head_stride, 1)
+    alignment = {
+        "base2": (2, 2),
+        "compact_base2": (2, 2),
+        "compact_o_base2": (2, 16),
+        "compact_do_base2": (16, 2),
+    }.get(layout, (16, 16))
+    shape = (batch, seqlen, heads, width)
+    arch = f"sm_{_SM}a"
+    if not arch_known_to_the_dsl(arch):
+        pytest.skip(f"Installed CuTe DSL cannot compile {arch}")
+    torch.manual_seed(358)
+
+    def inputs(extra=0):
+        try:
+            storage, views = [], []
+            for stride, align in zip(strides, alignment):
+                offset = 16 + extra + int(align == 2) + origin * row_stride
+                span = (batch - 1) * stride[0] + (seqlen - 1) * stride[1] + (heads - 1) * stride[2] + width
+                raw = torch.full((offset + span + 16,), 4096.0, dtype=dtype, device="cuda")
+                view = raw.as_strided(shape, stride, offset)
+                view.copy_(torch.randn(shape, dtype=dtype, device="cuda"))
+                storage.append(raw)
+                views.append(view)
+            return storage, views, [raw.clone() for raw in storage]

+            if layout != "cp8":
+                raise
+            pytest.skip("Insufficient free memory for complete CP8 physical input and read-only canaries")

+    storage, operands, snapshots = inputs()
+    rounded = ((seqlen + 127) // 128) * 128
+    count = batch * heads * rounded
+    raw_delta = torch.full((count + 32,), 12345.0, device="cuda", dtype=torch.float32)
+    delta = raw_delta[16 : 16 + count].view(batch, heads, rounded)
+    fn = _compile(shape, strides, dtype, dim, alignment, arch)
+    stream = torch.cuda.Stream()
+
+    def launch():
+        # Both optional tensors remain runtime ABI slots, even when specialized None.
+        fn(*operands, delta, None, None, stream.cuda_stream)
+
+    def check(reference):
+        torch.cuda.current_stream().wait_stream(stream)
+        actual = delta[:, :, :seqlen].cpu().double()
+        scale = max(float(reference.abs().max()), 1.0)
+        torch.testing.assert_close(actual, reference, rtol=0, atol=2e-5 * scale)
+        assert torch.count_nonzero(delta[:, :, seqlen:]) == 0
+        assert torch.all(raw_delta[:16] == 12345.0) and torch.all(raw_delta[-16:] == 12345.0)
+        assert all(torch.equal(raw, saved) for raw, saved in zip(storage, snapshots))

+    reference = _reference(operands)
+    stream.wait_stream(torch.cuda.current_stream())
+    with torch.cuda.stream(stream):
+        launch()

+    graph = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph()
+    try:
+        stream.wait_stream(torch.cuda.current_stream())
+        with torch.cuda.graph(graph, stream=stream):
+            launch()

+            if zero:
+                operands[1].zero_()
+            else:
+                operands[0].neg_()
+                operands[1].mul_(0.5)

+            reference = _reference(operands)
+            delta.fill_(float("nan"))
+            stream.wait_stream(torch.cuda.current_stream())
+            with torch.cuda.stream(stream):
+                graph.replay()
+            check(reference)
+    finally:
+        graph.reset()
+    # Keep old storage alive so the allocator cannot give the rebound frame the same addresses.
+    old_storage = storage
+    storage, operands, snapshots = inputs(extra=16)
+    assert all(new.data_ptr() != old.data_ptr() for new, old in zip(storage, old_storage))
+    reference = _reference(operands)
+    delta.fill_(float("nan"))
+    stream.wait_stream(torch.cuda.current_stream())
+    with torch.cuda.stream(stream):
+        launch()
+    check(reference)

+"""SM100 D256 THD backward: actual graph/standalone contracts and independent physical origins.
+

+    data = {}
+    starts = {}
+    offsets = {}
+    spec = {}
+    live = {}
+    for row, port in enumerate(THD_ORIGIN_PORTS):
+        kv = port in ("k", "v", "dk", "dv")
+        lens = lk if kv else lq
+        cap = 1500 if kv else 1000
+        heads = hkv if kv else hq
+        org = [13 + 3 * row + phase * 7 + i * ((383 if kv else 257) + 17 + row * 5) for i in range(3)]

+        mask = torch.zeros(cap, dtype=torch.bool, device="cuda")
+        for start, n in zip(org, lens):
+            mask[start : start + n] = True
+        live[port] = mask
+        if port == "stats":
+            t = torch.full((cap, hq) if token_major else (1, hq, cap), float("nan"), device="cuda", dtype=torch.float32)
+            for i, (start, n) in enumerate(zip(org, lens)):
+                values = c.lse[0, :, c.cu_q[i] : c.cu_q[i] + n]
+                if token_major:
+                    t[start : start + n] = values.T
+                else:
+                    t[0, :, start : start + n] = values

+    g = _graph()
+    dims, strides = (B, H, S, d), _strides(H, S, d)
+    q, k, v = (g.tensor(dim=dims, stride=strides, data_type=DTYPE, name=n) for n in ("q", "k", "v"))
+    o, stats = g.sdpa(name="sdpa", q=q, k=k, v=v, attn_scale=1 / math.sqrt(d), generate_stats=True, **mask)
+    o.set_output(True).set_dim(dims).set_stride(strides).set_data_type(DTYPE)
+    stats.set_output(True).set_dim((B, H, S, 1)).set_stride((H * S, S, 1, 1)).set_data_type(cudnn.data_type.FLOAT)
+    return g, (q, k, v, o, stats)

+def _bwd_graph(d=D, **mask):
+    g = _graph()
+    dims, strides = (B, H, S, d), _strides(H, S, d)
+    q, k, v, o, do = (g.tensor(dim=dims, stride=strides, data_type=DTYPE, name=n) for n in ("q", "k", "v", "o", "dO"))

+    for t in (dq, dk, dv):
+        t.set_output(True).set_dim(dims).set_stride(strides).set_data_type(DTYPE)
+    return g, (q, k, v, o, do, stats, dq, dk, dv)

+def _reference(q, k, v, right_bound, *, need_grad=False):
+    """FP64 attention over (B, H, S, D) views with a top-left band ``j <= i + right_bound``."""
+    q64, k64, v64 = (t.double().requires_grad_(need_grad) for t in (q, k, v))
+    scores = q64 @ k64.transpose(-1, -2) / math.sqrt(q.shape[-1])
+    i = torch.arange(S, device=q.device).view(S, 1)
+    j = torch.arange(S, device=q.device).view(1, S)
+    if right_bound is not None:
+        scores = scores.masked_fill(j > i + right_bound, float("-inf"))
+    lse = scores.logsumexp(-1)
+    out = (scores - lse[..., None]).exp() @ v64
+    return out, lse, (q64, k64, v64)
+
+
+def _bshd(d, seed):
+    torch.manual_seed(seed)
+    return torch.randn(B, S, H, d, device="cuda", dtype=torch.float16).transpose(1, 2)
+
+
+def _run(graph, engine, pack):
+    graph.validate()
+    graph.build_operation_graph()
+    graph.create_execution_plans([cudnn.heur_mode.A])
+    select_engine(graph, engine)
+    graph.check_support()
+    graph.build_plans()
+    workspace = torch.empty(max(graph.get_workspace_size(), 1), device="cuda", dtype=torch.uint8)
+    graph.execute(pack, workspace)
+    torch.cuda.synchronize()
+

+def _cpu_oracle(q, k, v, scale, mask, sinks):
+    """Independent FP64 reference using bounded ordinary CPU matrix products."""
+    import numpy as np
+    import torch
+
+    q, k, v = (tensor.double().numpy() for tensor in (q, k, v))
+    mask = None if mask is None else mask.numpy()
+    sinks = None if sinks is None else sinks.double().numpy()
+    batch, heads, sq, dim = q.shape
+    group = heads // k.shape[1]
+    out = np.empty_like(q)
+    lse = np.empty((batch, heads, sq), dtype=np.float64)
+    for b in range(batch):
+        for kv_head in range(k.shape[1]):
+            for first in range(kv_head * group, (kv_head + 1) * group, 8):
+                last = min(first + 8, (kv_head + 1) * group)
+                scores = (q[b, first:last].reshape(-1, dim) @ k[b, kv_head].T) * scale
+                if mask is not None:
+                    scores = np.where(np.broadcast_to(mask, (last - first, *mask.shape)).reshape(scores.shape), -np.inf, scores)
+                full = scores if sinks is None else np.concatenate((scores, np.repeat(sinks[first:last], sq)[:, None]), axis=1)
+                maximum = full.max(axis=1, keepdims=True)
+                safe_maximum = np.where(np.isfinite(maximum), maximum, 0)
+                weights = np.exp(full - safe_maximum)
+                denominator = weights.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
+                probabilities = np.divide(weights, denominator, out=np.zeros_like(weights), where=denominator != 0)
+                out[b, first:last] = (probabilities[:, : k.shape[2]] @ v[b, kv_head]).reshape(last - first, sq, dim)
+                with np.errstate(divide="ignore"):
+                    lse[b, first:last] = (safe_maximum + np.log(denominator)).reshape(last - first, sq)
+    return torch.from_numpy(out), torch.from_numpy(lse)
+

+the P region of the S slot holds (the S accumulator's fp32 bits read as bf16 pairs: NaN / Inf in roughly one low half per 256).  Without
+per-batch Q lengths every dead row is at or past S_q and the O descriptor clips it; WITH them (``SEQ_Q_LENS_PRESENT``, the padded-Q trim),
+and under bottom-right causal -- the only form under which the per-batch length reaches the softmax's dead-sub-tile decision

+trim must write them as EXACT zeros through a SELECT after the scale (``NaN * 0 = NaN``: a zero folded into ``inv_sum`` is not a zero
+in O; the Stats are ``-inf`` by the same contract).
+

+the kernel source's select at the ``* inv_sum`` site); the GPU cells on a cc 10.0 / 10.3 device (the dev box is SHARED: functional only),

+against the fp64 oracle, two launches bitwise -- RED on the tree before the select (NaN in O's dead rows) and GREEN with it; and the

+def test_the_epilogue_selects_the_trimmed_rows_after_the_scale():
+    """Static detector (sdpa-invariants s 2): the SM100 d128 file's O store multiplies ``o_chunk * inv_sum`` exactly once, and the
+    per-batch-Q-length arm SELECTS ``row_trim | row_dead`` to zero right after it (``vec_select_zero``), before the cast -- never a
+    zero folded into the scale alone."""
+    from cudnn.sdpa.fwd.kernels.sm100 import prefill_d128_f16 as kmod
+    from cudnn.frost.tile_dsl import pointwise

+    assert len(sites) == 1, sites
+    tail = "\n".join(src.splitlines()[sites[0] : sites[0] + 16])
+    assert "if cutlass.const_expr(CFG.SEQ_Q_LENS_PRESENT):" in tail and "vec_select_zero(row_trim | row_dead, o_scaled, O_CHUNK)" in tail, tail
+    assert tail.index("vec_select_zero(") < tail.index("o_fp16 = o_scaled.to(STORAGE_DTYPE)"), "the select precedes the cast"
+    assert "arith.select(" in inspect.getsource(pointwise.vec_select_zero), "a select, not a multiply"

+def _run_twice(
+    row, q, k, v, *, scale, bias=None, kv_mask=None, sdpa_kwargs=None, seq_len_kv=None, seq_len_q=None, sink=None, stats=True, cga=None, tile_n=None
+):
+    """Build the graph, pin the row's unsplit plan (a cga / tile_n request through the public autotune record), launch TWICE on
+    SENTINEL-filled outputs (NaN: an unwritten row fails the finiteness check exactly like a residue does) and return both launches
+    -- the two-launch identity is asserted by the caller AFTER the dead-row contract, so a NaN residue is reported as what it is."""
+    import cudnn
+
+    g, vp, o, o_gpu, stats_gpu = _t7._build(
+        q, k, v, scale=scale, bias=bias, kv_mask=kv_mask, sdpa_kwargs=sdpa_kwargs, seq_len_kv=seq_len_kv, seq_len_q=seq_len_q, sink=sink, stats=stats
+    )
+    g.create_execution_plans([cudnn.heur_mode.A])
+    names = [g.get_plan_name_at_index(i) for i in range(len(g.plans))]
+    ours = [i for i, n in enumerate(names) if n == row or n.startswith(row + "[")]
+    idx = next((i for i in ours if g.plans[i].knobs.split_kv in (None, 1)), None)
+    assert idx is not None, f"no unsplit {row} plan in {names}"
+    picked = g.plans[idx].knobs
+    picked_cga, picked_tile_n = picked.cga, picked.tile_n
+    want_cga = picked_cga if cga is None else cga
+    want_tile_n = picked_tile_n if tile_n is None else tile_n
+    if (want_cga, want_tile_n) != (picked_cga, picked_tile_n):
+        engine_id, record = g.get_engine_and_knobs_at_index(idx)
+        record = dict(record)
+        if want_cga != picked_cga:
+            record[cudnn.knob_type.TILE_CGA_M] = want_cga
+        if want_tile_n != picked_tile_n:
+            record[cudnn.knob_type.TILE_N] = want_tile_n
+        g.create_execution_plan(engine_id, record)
+        idx = g.get_execution_plan_count() - 1
+    g.select_plan(idx)
+    g.check_support()
+    g.build_plans()
+    vp[o] = o_gpu
+    ws = torch.empty(max(g.get_workspace_size(), 1), device="cuda", dtype=torch.uint8)
+
+    def launch():
+        o_gpu.fill_(float("nan"))
+        if stats_gpu is not None:
+            stats_gpu.fill_(float("nan"))
+        g.execute(vp, ws)
+        torch.cuda.synchronize()
+        return o_gpu.clone(), (stats_gpu.clone() if stats_gpu is not None else None)
+
+    o1, st1 = launch()
+    o2, st2 = launch()
+    return dict(o=o1, stats=st1, o2=o2, stats2=st2, knobs=SimpleNamespace(cga=want_cga, tile_n=want_tile_n), names=names)
+

+def _assert_dead_rows_contract(out, ref, c, case):
+    """The contract, most specific first: the quiet sub-tile's stored rows finite and exactly +0 (the N1 rows), every trimmed row 0 / -inf,
+    the whole-tensor contract against the oracle (keyless rows 0 / -inf, live rows within tolerance), two launches bitwise."""
+    o, st = out["o"], out["stats"].squeeze(-1)
+    if c["dead"] is not None:
+        b, lo, hi = c["dead"]
+        rows = o[b, :, lo:hi, :]
+        n_nan = int((~torch.isfinite(rows)).sum())
+        assert n_nan == 0, f"{case}: {n_nan} non-finite elements in the quiet sub-tile's stored rows O[{b}, :, {lo}:{hi}] (a residue reached the store)"
+        assert bool((rows.view(torch.int16) == 0).all()), f"{case}: the quiet sub-tile's stored rows O[{b}, :, {lo}:{hi}] are not exactly +0"
+        assert bool(torch.isneginf(st[b, :, lo:hi]).all()), f"{case}: Stats of the quiet sub-tile's stored rows are not -inf"
+    for b, lo, hi in _dead_rows(c):
+        assert bool(torch.isfinite(o[b, :, lo:hi, :]).all()) and bool(
+            (o[b, :, lo:hi, :].view(torch.int16) == 0).all()
+        ), f"{case}: trimmed rows O[{b}, :, {lo}:{hi}] != +0"
+        assert bool(torch.isneginf(st[b, :, lo:hi]).all()), f"{case}: Stats of the trimmed rows [{lo}, {hi}) of batch {b} are not -inf"
+    _t7._check(out, ref)
+    assert torch.equal(out["o"], out["o2"]) and torch.equal(out["stats"], out["stats2"]), f"{case}: two-launch delta on O / Stats"
