+def _fp8_d128_leading_tile_operands(b, hq, hkv, s_q, s_kv, d, *, seed=0):
+    """Q / K / V drawn INSIDE the fp8 range (std 1.5 / 1.5 / 1.0) and bound with UNIT descales -- the operating point at which the
+    per-tensor kernel's folded scale_log2 = attn_scale * log2 e overflows a finite mask sentinel to -inf at attn_scale 1 (the
+    quantizer's amax / 448 descales keep it finite).  BSHD-physical storage under BHSD views; the float64 copies for the oracle."""
+    import torch
+
+    gen = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(seed)
+
+    def draw(h, s, std):
+        x8 = (torch.randn(b, s, h, d, device="cuda", generator=gen) * std).to(torch.float8_e4m3fn).transpose(1, 2)
+        return x8, x8.double()

+def _fp8_d128_leading_tile_oracle(qd, kd, vd, *, scale, bottom_right, window_left, q_lens=None, kv_lens=None):
+    """float64 softmax(scale * Q K^T) V and the natural-log LSE composing the kernel's mask: the causal diagonal (top-left, or
+    bottom-right anchored at (q_len[b], kv_len[b])), a left window of ``window_left`` past keys riding it, and per-batch Q / KV
+    padding.  Dead (row >= q_len[b]) and keyless rows come out as O = 0 / LSE = -inf."""
+    import torch
+
+    b, hq, s_q, _ = qd.shape
+    hkv, s_kv = kd.shape[1], kd.shape[2]
+    rep = hq // hkv
+    logits = (qd @ kd.repeat_interleave(rep, 1).transpose(-1, -2)) * scale
+    i = torch.arange(s_q, device=qd.device).view(1, 1, s_q, 1)
+    j = torch.arange(s_kv, device=qd.device).view(1, 1, 1, s_kv)
+    ql = (q_lens.to(torch.int64) if q_lens is not None else torch.full((b,), s_q, dtype=torch.int64, device=qd.device)).view(b, 1, 1, 1)
+    kl = (kv_lens.to(torch.int64) if kv_lens is not None else torch.full((b,), s_kv, dtype=torch.int64, device=qd.device)).view(b, 1, 1, 1)
+    diag = i + (kl - ql) if bottom_right else i
+    masked = (i >= ql) | (j >= kl) | (j > diag) | (j < diag - window_left)
+    logits = logits.masked_fill(masked, float("-inf"))
+    lse = torch.logsumexp(logits, dim=-1)
+    o = torch.softmax(logits, dim=-1).nan_to_num(0.0) @ vd.repeat_interleave(rep, 1)
+    return o, lse

+def _reference(values, bottom_right, scale):
+    q, k, v = (values[n].double() for n in ("q", "k", "v"))
+    k = k.repeat_interleave(q.shape[1] // k.shape[1], 1)
+    v = v.repeat_interleave(q.shape[1] // v.shape[1], 1)
+    scores = q @ k.transpose(-1, -2) * scale
+    i = torch.arange(q.shape[2], device=q.device)[:, None]
+    j = torch.arange(k.shape[2], device=q.device)[None, :]
+    scores.masked_fill_(j > i + (k.shape[2] - q.shape[2] if bottom_right else 0), -torch.inf)
+    if "sink" in values:
+        scores = torch.cat([scores, values["sink"].double().expand(*scores.shape[:-1], 1)], -1)
+    probs = scores.softmax(-1).nan_to_num(0.0)[..., : k.shape[2]]
+    return probs @ v, scores.logsumexp(-1).unsqueeze(-1)
+

+        result = {
+            n: (torch.randn(b, s, h, d, device="cuda") * (2.0 if n != "v" else 0.5)).bfloat16().transpose(1, 2)
+            for n, s, h in (("q", sq, hq), ("k", sk, hk), ("v", sk, hk))

+        if with_sink:

+        graph = cudnn.pygraph(

+            intermediate_data_type=cudnn.data_type.FLOAT,
+            compute_data_type=cudnn.data_type.FLOAT,
+            handle=cudnn_handle,
+        )
+        nodes = {n: graph.tensor_like(t) for n, t in values.items()}
+        kwargs = dict(q=nodes["q"], k=nodes["k"], v=nodes["v"], attn_scale=scale, generate_stats=True)
+        kwargs["use_causal_mask_bottom_right" if bottom_right else "use_causal_mask"] = True
+        if with_sink:
+            kwargs["sink_token"] = nodes["sink"]
+        out, stats = graph.sdpa(**kwargs)
+        o = torch.empty_like(values["q"])
+        lse = torch.empty((b, sq, hq, 1), device="cuda", dtype=torch.float32).transpose(1, 2)
+        out.set_output(True).set_dim(o.shape).set_stride(o.stride())
+        stats.set_output(True).set_dim(lse.shape).set_stride(lse.stride()).set_data_type(cudnn.data_type.FLOAT)
+        graph.validate()
+        graph.build_operation_graph()
+        engine = next(f for f in MANIFEST if f.name == "frost_sdpa_fwd").offered_ids()["sdpa_fwd_prefill_sm100"]
+        knobs = {
+            getattr(cudnn.knob_type, n): v for n, v in dict(TILE_M=128, TILE_N=128, TILE_CGA_M=cga, PACK_GQA=int(packed), SPLIT_KV=1, SCHED_POLICY=1).items()

+        graph.select_plan(graph.get_execution_plan_count() - 1)
+        graph.check_support()
+        graph.build_plans()

+            lse.fill_(torch.nan)

+        stream.wait_stream(torch.cuda.current_stream())

+        capture = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph()

+            poison()
+            capture.replay()
+            check()
+    finally:
+        try:
+            if capture is not None:
+                capture.reset()
+        finally:
+            cudnn.set_stream(cudnn_handle, original_stream)

+"""``cudnn.sdpa.fwd.config_sm107.make_cfg_d256_sparse`` -- the Rubin index-list sparse d256 forward config, host-only.
+
+The config is a set of CLAIMS about a kernel body (warp count, arriver counts, ring depths, SMEM starts, the register split);
+the body cannot check them at run time, so a disagreement is undefined behaviour: an unreachable mbarrier init HANGS at every
+shape, a stale ring slot is a SILENT wrong answer, an SMEM overflow clobbers the last buffer with an exact LSE.  Every
+REACHABLE predicate of ``_validate_cfg_d256_sparse`` therefore gets ONE raising case here (``pytest.raises(ValueError,
+match=...)`` on the failure signature its message carries), the three predicates that are unreachable by construction get a
+simulated one (a misaligned layout; the whole predicate table on an oversized box), an in-module coverage check pins that the
+rows reach EVERY predicate (a row pre-empted by an earlier predicate is not coverage), and the accepting record is pinned
+VALUE by VALUE against the kernel header's tables -- the issuing-lane ledger (``SUM(issuing lanes) == init``), the byte-exact SMEM table, the box-bytes rule for every
+``expect_tx``, the register arithmetic ``SUM(role regs x warps) == entry x warps``, the descriptor version derived from the
+last K/V stage's start.
+
+Also pinned: the four index-list ``TemplateParams`` fields are appended with inert defaults (every existing forward config
+renders identically whether or not they are passed), every DENSE factory declines a record that sets them, the kernel
+module's prologue takes its geometry from the config (DESC_VERSION derived, the spin constant a module literal), and
+``_item_bounds`` is the kernel file's only source of ``n_tiles`` (a pin that ARMS with the body: a module with any function
+definition must define the helper and bind ``n_tiles`` from a call to it).

+def test_sparse_smem_layout_is_the_header_table():
+    """Declaration order = address order, descriptor-read operands first; sKV[2] at 152 KiB keeps the version-0 descriptor."""
+    cfg, _ = make_cfg_d256_sparse(_sparse())
+    lay = d256_sparse_smem_layout(cfg)
+    assert lay["starts"] == {"sQ": 0, "sP": 16384, "sKV": 24576, "sKV_last": 155648, "sIds": 221184, "red": 225408, "misc": 226176}
+    assert lay["total"] == 226688 and lay["carveout"] == SMEM_STANDARD_CARVEOUT_BYTES and lay["desc_version"] == 0
+    assert all(lay["starts"][k] % 1024 == 0 for k in ("sQ", "sP", "sKV")) and lay["starts"]["sIds"] % 16 == 0
+    assert lay["starts"]["sKV_last"] < TCGEN05_V0_ADDR_LIMIT
+    # depth 4 and depth 5: the layout grows by one 64 KiB stage each, into the oversized carveout, and the last stage crosses the
+    # version-0 window only at depth 5 (221,184 at depth 4 is still under it)
+    d4 = d256_sparse_smem_layout(dataclasses.replace(cfg, STAGES_KV=4))
+    assert d4["total"] == 226688 + 65536 and d4["carveout"] == SMEM_USABLE_BYTES and d4["desc_version"] == 0 and d4["starts"]["sKV_last"] == 221184
+    d5 = d256_sparse_smem_layout(dataclasses.replace(cfg, STAGES_KV=5))
+    assert d5["starts"]["sKV_last"] == 286720 >= TCGEN05_V0_ADDR_LIMIT and d5["desc_version"] == 1
+    # ... but depth 5 is 357,760 B > the 320 KiB usable carveout: no K/V depth that FITS crosses the version-0 window, so every
+    # expressible record of this kernel is DESC_VERSION 0 (the validator's version predicate is a tripwire for a layout change,
+    # not an arm the body carries)
+    assert d5["total"] == 357760 > SMEM_USABLE_BYTES
+    assert all(d256_sparse_smem_layout(dataclasses.replace(cfg, STAGES_KV=d))["desc_version"] == 0 for d in (2, 3, 4))
+    # the misc reserve covers what the body declares: tmem_ptr 16 B + 15 mbarrier arrays (29 stages, 16-B padded) + the payload ring
+    n_bar_arrays = 15
+    stage_counts = (2, 2, 2, 2, 3, 3, 2, 2, 2, 2, 1, 1, 1, 2, 2)

+    padded = sum(-(-(n * 8) // 16) * 16 for n in stage_counts)

+def _predicate_table(monkeypatch, cfg):
+    """The validator's WHOLE predicate table on ``cfg`` as ``[(ok, message)]``: ``_check`` is captured instead of raising at the
+    first failure, so a test sees which predicate reports first AND whether a later one would have fired too."""
+    seen = []
+    monkeypatch.setattr(c107, "_check", lambda preds: seen.extend(preds))
+    _validate_cfg_d256_sparse(cfg)
+    return seen

+    "must fit the aliased slot",  # Q_TX / GATE_TX <= Q_SLOT: implied by Q_BOX_ROWS == QH_PER_KH <= N_Q, and the box-bytes rules report first
+    "must start 1024-B aligned",  # d256_sparse_smem_layout aligns every slab start by construction (_align_slab)
+    "sIds must start 16-B aligned",  # idem (_align16)

+def test_every_validator_predicate_is_reached_by_a_red_row_or_is_an_enumerated_tripwire(monkeypatch):
+    """The "one RED row per predicate" claim, enforced in-module: for every row of _RED_ROWS the FIRST failing predicate's message
+    matches the row's pattern, the first-failing predicates cover every predicate of the table except the enumerated tripwires, and
+    every tripwire is indeed unreached (a tripwire a row reaches must leave the list).  A new predicate without a row, or a row an
+    earlier predicate pre-empts, fails here -- the counts never have to be quoted by hand."""
+    cfg, _ = make_cfg_d256_sparse(_sparse())
+    table = _predicate_table(monkeypatch, cfg)
+    assert table and all(ok for ok, _ in table), "the factory's record must be green on every predicate"
+    reached = {}
+    for bad, pattern in _RED_ROWS:
+        row = _predicate_table(monkeypatch, dataclasses.replace(cfg, **bad))
+        first = next((i for i, (ok, _) in enumerate(row) if not ok), None)
+        assert first is not None, f"{bad}: no predicate fails"
+        assert re.search(pattern, row[first][1]), f"{bad}: the first failing predicate says {row[first][1]!r}, the row expects {pattern!r}"
+        reached.setdefault(first, []).append(bad)
+    tripwires = {i for i, (_, msg) in enumerate(table) if any(t in msg for t in _TRIPWIRES)}
+    assert len(tripwires) == len(_TRIPWIRES), "every enumerated tripwire names exactly one predicate"
+    unreached = set(range(len(table))) - set(reached)
+    assert unreached == tripwires, (
+        f"predicates no RED row reaches: {[table[i][1] for i in sorted(unreached - tripwires)]}; "
+        f"tripwires a row reaches (drop them from _TRIPWIRES): {[table[i][1] for i in sorted(tripwires & set(reached))]}"

+def _n_tiles_bindings(tree: ast.AST):
+    """Every binding of a name ``n_tiles`` in the module: (line, inside a def named _item_bounds?, bound from a call to _item_bounds?)."""
+    out = []
+    for node in ast.walk(tree):
+        if not isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef):
+            continue
+        for sub in ast.walk(node):
+            if isinstance(sub, (ast.Assign, ast.AnnAssign, ast.AugAssign)):
+                targets = sub.targets if isinstance(sub, ast.Assign) else [sub.target]
+                names = []
+                for t in targets:
+                    for n in ast.walk(t):
+                        if isinstance(n, ast.Name) and n.id == "n_tiles":
+                            names.append(n)
+                if not names:
+                    continue
+                value = sub.value
+                from_helper = isinstance(value, ast.Call) and getattr(value.func, "id", None) == "_item_bounds"
+                out.append((sub.lineno, node.name == "_item_bounds", from_helper))
+    return out
+

+def test_item_bounds_is_the_only_n_tiles_source_in_the_kernel():
+    """``n_tiles`` (with ``count`` / ``has_open`` / ``dead``) comes from ONE pure helper called by every role over the same inputs; a
+    second source (a count word staged through SMEM, a role-local recomputation) is a disagreement between roles = an unreachable or
+    over-run barrier.  Every binding of ``n_tiles`` in the file is either inside ``_item_bounds`` itself or unpacked from a call to it
+    -- and the pin ARMS with the body: a module that defines any function must define ``_item_bounds`` and bind ``n_tiles`` from a
+    call to it at least once (a body that never calls the helper, or names the variable differently, fails); the header-only module
+    is asserted as such (no function, no binding), never read as a vacuous pass."""
+    src = _KERNEL.read_text()
+    assert "_item_bounds" in src, "the kernel header names the one helper"
+    tree = ast.parse(src)
+    bindings = _n_tiles_bindings(tree)
+    offenders = [(ln, in_helper, from_helper) for ln, in_helper, from_helper in bindings if not (in_helper or from_helper)]
+    assert not offenders, f"n_tiles bound outside _item_bounds and not from a call to it: {offenders}"
+    defs = {node.name for node in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef)}
+    if defs:
+        assert "_item_bounds" in defs, f"the body defines {len(defs)} functions but no _item_bounds"
+        assert any(from_helper for _, _, from_helper in bindings), "no role binds n_tiles from a call to _item_bounds"
+    else:
+        assert not bindings, "a header-only module binds n_tiles"
+    # the detector itself is live: a synthetic module with a role-local recomputation is caught
+    probe = ast.parse("def _mma_warp_group(hi, lo):\n    n_tiles = hi - lo\n    return n_tiles\n")
+    assert any(not (a or b) for _, a, b in _n_tiles_bindings(probe))
+    ok = ast.parse("def _item_bounds(p):\n    n_tiles = 1\n    return n_tiles\n\ndef _mma(p):\n    lo, n_tiles, dead = _item_bounds(p)\n    return n_tiles\n")
+    assert all(a or b for _, a, b in _n_tiles_bindings(ok))

+def test_native_d576_prepared_replay(heads, kh, page, hnd, v_hnd, split, dtype, mask, sink, log2, packed, optional_stats):
+    from cudnn.sdpa.fwd.api_dsl import SdpaFwdDslSm100
+
+    torch.manual_seed(20261026 + heads + page)
+    b, sq, skv = (9, 65, 513) if mask == "multiwave" else (3, 4, 257)
+    group = heads // kh
+    qbase = torch.randn(b, sq, heads, 640, device="cuda", dtype=dtype)
+    q = qbase[..., :576]
+    pages = (skv + page - 1) // page if page else 0
+    npool = b * pages + 3
+    if page:
+        k = torch.randn((npool, kh, page, 576) if hnd else (npool, page, kh, 576), device="cuda", dtype=dtype)
+        if hnd:
+            k = k.permute(0, 2, 1, 3)
+        if hnd == v_hnd:
+            v = k[..., :512]  # Actual absorbed-MLA shared record, with a 576-element row stride.
+        else:
+            v = torch.randn((npool, kh, page, 576) if v_hnd else (npool, page, kh, 576), device="cuda", dtype=dtype)[..., :512]
+            if v_hnd:
+                v = v.permute(0, 2, 1, 3)
+        table = torch.arange(b * pages, device="cuda", dtype=torch.int32).reshape(b, pages).contiguous()
+        table_base_v = torch.full((b, pages * 2 + 3), -1, device="cuda", dtype=torch.int32)
+        table_v = table_base_v[:, 1 : 1 + pages * 2 : 2]
+        table_v.copy_((table + 2) % npool)
+    else:
+        k = torch.randn(b, skv, kh, 576, device="cuda", dtype=dtype)
+        v = k[..., :512]
+        table = table_v = None
+    obase = torch.full((b, sq, heads, 576), float("nan"), device="cuda", dtype=dtype)
+    o = obase[..., :512]
+    lse = None if optional_stats else torch.empty(b, heads, sq, device="cuda", dtype=torch.float32)
+    qlens = torch.tensor(([sq, sq - 1, 1] * ((b + 2) // 3))[:b], device="cuda", dtype=torch.int32)
+    klens = torch.tensor(([skv, skv // 2, 0] * ((b + 2) // 3))[:b], device="cuda", dtype=torch.int32)
+    sinks = torch.linspace(-0.5, 0.5, heads, device="cuda") if sink else None
+    causal = mask in ("br", "br_window", "tl")
+    br = mask in ("br", "br_window")
+    left = 17 if mask == "br_window" else None
+    scale = 1 / math.sqrt(192)
+    qh, khv, vh, oh = (t.transpose(1, 2) for t in (q, k, v, o))
+    api = SdpaFwdDslSm100(
+        sample_q=qh,
+        sample_k=khv,
+        sample_v=vh,
+        sample_o=oh,
+        sample_lse=lse,
+        is_causal=causal,
+        causal_bottom_right=br,
+        window_size_left=left,
+        scale_softmax=scale,
+        seq_kv_lens_present=True,
+        seq_q_lens_present=True,
+        has_sink=sink,
+        stats_log2=log2,
+        split_kv=split,
+        pack_gqa=packed,
+        paged_page_size=page,
+        paged_max_seq_len_kv=pages * page if page else None,
+        paged_table_stride=tuple(table.stride()) if page else None,
+        paged_table_v_stride=tuple(table_v.stride()) if page else None,
+    )
+    api.check_support()
+    api.compile()
+    assert api.flavor == (576, 512)
+    assert api._k_mod.CFG.TILE_K == 576 and api._k_mod.CFG.N_BMM1_CHUNKS == 3
+    assert api._k_mod.CFG.PACK_G == (math.gcd(group, 64) if packed else 1)
+    assert api._dense_spec.native is not None
+    workspace = torch.empty(max(1, api.scratch_workspace_bytes()), device="cuda", dtype=torch.uint8)
+
+    def launch():
+        api.execute(
+            qh, khv, vh, oh, lse_tensor=lse, sinks=sinks, seq_q_lens=qlens, seq_kv_lens=klens, block_table=table, block_table_v=table_v, workspace=workspace
+        )
+
+    def check():
+        torch.cuda.synchronize()
+        assert torch.isnan(obase[..., 512:]).all(), "output head padding overwritten"
+        for bi, (nq, nk) in enumerate(zip(qlens.cpu().tolist(), klens.cpu().tolist())):
+            if not nq:
+                continue
+            if page:
+                rk = k.index_select(0, table[bi].long()).reshape(-1, kh, 576)[:nk]
+                rv = v.index_select(0, table_v[bi].long()).reshape(-1, kh, 512)[:nk]
+            else:
+                rk, rv = k[bi, :nk], v[bi, :nk]
+            rk = rk.double().repeat_interleave(group, dim=1)
+            rv = rv.double().repeat_interleave(group, dim=1)
+            score = torch.einsum("qhd,khd->hqk", q[bi, :nq].double(), rk) * scale
+            row = torch.arange(nq, device="cuda")[:, None]
+            col = torch.arange(nk, device="cuda")[None, :]
+            diag = row + (nk - nq if br else 0)
+            if causal:
+                score = score.masked_fill((col > diag)[None], float("-inf"))
+            if left is not None:
+                # The standalone API takes an inclusive left offset, not a window length.
+                score = score.masked_fill((col < diag - left)[None], float("-inf"))
+            if sink:
+                score = torch.cat((score, sinks.double()[:, None, None].expand(heads, nq, 1)), dim=-1)
+            weights = score.softmax(-1).nan_to_num()[..., :nk]
+            ref = torch.einsum("hqk,khd->qhd", weights, rv)
+            ref_s = score.logsumexp(-1) * (math.log2(math.e) if log2 else 1)
+            torch.testing.assert_close(
+                o[bi, :nq].double(), ref, atol=0.005 if dtype == torch.bfloat16 else 0.002, rtol=0.02 if dtype == torch.bfloat16 else 0.005
+            )
+            if lse is not None:
+                torch.testing.assert_close(lse[bi, :, :nq].double(), ref_s, atol=0.003, rtol=0)
+
+    launch()
+    check()
+    stream = torch.cuda.Stream()
+    stream.wait_stream(torch.cuda.current_stream())
+    graph = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph()
+    try:
+        with torch.cuda.graph(graph, stream=stream):
+            old_debug = torch.cuda.get_sync_debug_mode()
+            torch.cuda.set_sync_debug_mode("error")
+            try:
+                launch()
+            finally:
+                torch.cuda.set_sync_debug_mode(old_debug)
+        graph.replay()
+        check()
+        q.mul_(0.5)
+        k.mul_(0.75)
+        if page and hnd != v_hnd:
+            v.mul_(0.6)
+        qlens.copy_(torch.tensor(([sq - 1, sq, 1] * ((b + 2) // 3))[:b], device="cuda", dtype=torch.int32))
+        klens.copy_(torch.tensor(([0, skv, 65] * ((b + 2) // 3))[:b], device="cuda", dtype=torch.int32))
+        if page:
+            table.copy_((table + 1) % npool)
+            table_v.copy_((table_v + 3) % npool)
+        o.fill_(float("nan"))
+        if lse is not None:
+            lse.fill_(float("nan"))
+        graph.replay()
+        check()
+    finally:
+        graph.reset()

+"""The SM120 half DECODE tile (``sm120/decode_f16.py``, ``tile_m`` 16 / 32).
+
+KNOB ROUTE: the adapter runs the decode tile when the plan's ``tile_m`` names
+it, exactly as ``lower_dsl_prefill`` forwards a plan's knobs; the kernel tests
+pass the knobs explicitly and compare against an fp32 oracle bounded to one
+query head. The facts-only tests check knob admission and rejection and the
+validity of the heuristics' proposals; the graph test at the bottom runs a
+decode-tile plan through CUDA Graph capture with changed inputs and storage.
+"""
+
+import math
+from typing import NamedTuple, Optional
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from frost_test_utils import requires_blackwell_geforce, requires_dsl
+
+pytestmark = [requires_dsl]
+
+_SM120_ROW = "sdpa_fwd_prefill_sm120"
+
+
+def _reference(q, k, v, *, causal, bottom_right=True, window_left=None, window_right=0, scale=None, sinks=None, seq_q=None, seq_kv=None):
+    """fp32 O and natural-log LSE of BHSD q/k/v, one query head at a time.
+
+    ``causal`` keeps keys up to the diagonal plus ``window_right``, anchored
+    bottom-right by default (the decode convention: the query rows are the
+    last ``S_q`` positions of the sequence) or top-left; ``window_left`` is the
+    inclusive left bound; ``scale`` defaults to 1/sqrt(D); ``sinks`` (fp32
+    [H_q]) join the softmax denominator; ``seq_q`` / ``seq_kv`` (int [B]) bound
+    each batch's queries and keys, and a padded query row is O := 0 / LSE := -inf.
+    """
+    b, h_q, s_q, d = q.shape
+    h_kv, s_kv = k.shape[1:3]
+    scale = 1.0 / math.sqrt(d) if scale is None else scale
+    out = torch.zeros((b, h_q, s_q, v.shape[-1]), device=q.device, dtype=torch.float32)
+    lse = torch.full((b, h_q, s_q), float("-inf"), device=q.device, dtype=torch.float32)
+    for batch in range(b):
+        kv_len = s_kv if seq_kv is None else int(seq_kv[batch])
+        q_len = s_q if seq_q is None else int(seq_q[batch])
+        i = torch.arange(s_q, device=q.device).view(s_q, 1) + ((kv_len - q_len) if bottom_right else 0)
+        j = torch.arange(s_kv, device=q.device).view(1, s_kv)
+        visible = j < kv_len
+        if causal:
+            visible = visible & (j <= i + window_right)
+        if window_left is not None:
+            visible = visible & (j >= i - window_left)
+        for head in range(h_q):
+            kv_head = head // (h_q // h_kv)
+            scores = torch.matmul(q[batch, head].float(), k[batch, kv_head].float().transpose(0, 1)) * scale
+            scores = scores.masked_fill(~visible, float("-inf"))
+            m = scores.amax(-1, keepdim=True)
+            if sinks is not None:
+                m = torch.maximum(m, sinks[head].view(1, 1))
+            m_safe = torch.where(torch.isfinite(m), m, torch.zeros_like(m))
+            p = torch.exp(scores - m_safe)
+            den = p.sum(-1, keepdim=True)
+            if sinks is not None:
+                den = den + torch.exp(sinks[head].view(1, 1) - m_safe)
+            out[batch, head] = torch.where(den > 0, torch.matmul(p, v[batch, kv_head].float()) / den.clamp_min(1e-30), torch.zeros_like(out[batch, head]))
+            lse[batch, head] = torch.where(den[:, 0] > 0, (m_safe + torch.log(den.clamp_min(1e-30)))[:, 0], torch.full_like(den[:, 0], float("-inf")))
+        out[batch, :, q_len:] = 0
+        lse[batch, :, q_len:] = float("-inf")
+    return out, lse
+
+
+class _DecodeRun(NamedTuple):
+    """One explicit plan's outputs, its fp32 oracle and the adapter that ran it."""
+
+    o: torch.Tensor
+    lse: Optional[torch.Tensor]
+    ref_o: torch.Tensor
+    ref_lse: torch.Tensor
+    api: object
+    q: torch.Tensor
+    k: torch.Tensor
+    v: torch.Tensor
+
+
+def _decode_case(
+    h_q: int,
+    h_kv: int,
+    s_q: int,
+    s_kv: int,
+    *,
+    d: int = 128,
+    d_v: Optional[int] = None,
+    tile_m: int = 16,
+    tile_n: Optional[int] = None,
+    pack_gqa: bool = True,
+    split_kv: int = 1,
+    sink: bool = False,
+    sink_off: tuple = (),
+    causal: Optional[bool] = None,
+    bottom_right: bool = True,
+    window_left: Optional[int] = None,
+    window_right: Optional[int] = None,
+    scale: Optional[float] = None,
+    with_lse: bool = False,
+    stats_log2: bool = False,
+    dtype=torch.float16,
+    batch: int = 1,
+    seq_q: Optional[list] = None,
+    seq_kv: Optional[list] = None,
+    nan_kv_tail: bool = False,
+) -> _DecodeRun:
+    """Run one explicit plan through SdpaFwdDslSm120 over the serving layout
+    (BSHD storage viewed as BHSD). ``sink_off`` lists query heads whose sink
+    logit is -inf (a disabled sink). ``nan_kv_tail`` hands the kernel K / V whose
+    rows past each batch's ``seq_kv`` length are NaN; the oracle reads the
+    finite originals."""
+    from cudnn.sdpa.fwd.api_dsl import SdpaFwdDslSm120
+
+    d_v = d if d_v is None else d_v
+    causal = s_q > 1 if causal is None else causal
+    torch.manual_seed(0)
+    q = (torch.randn(batch, s_q, h_q, d, device="cuda", dtype=dtype) * 0.5).transpose(1, 2)
+    k = (torch.randn(batch, s_kv, h_kv, d, device="cuda", dtype=dtype) * 0.5).transpose(1, 2)
+    v = (torch.randn(batch, s_kv, h_kv, d_v, device="cuda", dtype=dtype) * 0.5).transpose(1, 2)
+    o = torch.full((batch, s_q, h_q, d_v), float("nan"), device="cuda", dtype=dtype).transpose(1, 2)
+    lse = torch.full((batch, h_q, s_q), float("nan"), device="cuda", dtype=torch.float32) if with_lse else None
+    sinks = torch.randn(h_q, device="cuda", dtype=torch.float32) if sink else None
+    if sink_off:
+        sinks[list(sink_off)] = float("-inf")
+    seq_q_t = None if seq_q is None else torch.tensor(seq_q, device="cuda", dtype=torch.int32)
+    seq_kv_t = None if seq_kv is None else torch.tensor(seq_kv, device="cuda", dtype=torch.int32)
+    api = SdpaFwdDslSm120(
+        sample_q=q,
+        sample_k=k,
+        sample_v=v,
+        sample_o=o,
+        sample_lse=lse,
+        is_causal=causal,
+        causal_bottom_right=causal and bottom_right,
+        window_size_left=window_left,
+        window_size_right=window_right,
+        scale_softmax=scale,
+        has_sink=sink,
+        seq_q_lens_present=seq_q is not None,
+        seq_kv_lens_present=seq_kv is not None,
+        stats_log2=stats_log2,
+        tile_m=tile_m,
+        tile_n=tile_n,
+        pack_gqa=pack_gqa,
+        split_kv=split_kv,
+        sched_policy=0,
+    )
+    assert api.check_support()
+    api.compile()
+    ws_bytes = api.scratch_workspace_bytes()
+    ws = torch.empty(ws_bytes, dtype=torch.uint8, device="cuda") if ws_bytes else None
+    k_run, v_run = k, v
+    if nan_kv_tail:
+        k_run, v_run = k.clone(), v.clone()
+        for batch_idx, kv_len in enumerate(seq_kv):
+            k_run[batch_idx, :, kv_len:] = float("nan")
+            v_run[batch_idx, :, kv_len:] = float("nan")
+    api.execute(q_tensor=q, k_tensor=k_run, v_tensor=v_run, o_tensor=o, lse_tensor=lse, sinks=sinks, seq_q_lens=seq_q_t, seq_kv_lens=seq_kv_t, workspace=ws)
+    torch.cuda.synchronize()
+    ref_o, ref_lse = _reference(
+        q,
+        k,
+        v,
+        causal=causal,
+        bottom_right=bottom_right,
+        window_left=window_left,
+        window_right=window_right or 0,
+        scale=scale,
+        sinks=sinks,
+        seq_q=seq_q,
+        seq_kv=seq_kv,
+    )
+    if stats_log2:
+        ref_lse = ref_lse * math.log2(math.e)
+    return _DecodeRun(o, lse, ref_o, ref_lse, api, q, k, v)
+
+
+def _assert_close(run: _DecodeRun, dtype=torch.float16):
+    assert not torch.isnan(run.o).any(), "a live O element was never written"
+    atol = 2e-2 if dtype == torch.float16 else 4e-2
+    torch.testing.assert_close(run.o.float(), run.ref_o, rtol=0, atol=atol)
+    if run.lse is not None:
+        finite = torch.isfinite(run.ref_lse)
+        assert torch.equal(torch.isfinite(run.lse), finite), "LSE is -inf exactly on rows without a visible key or sink"
+        torch.testing.assert_close(run.lse[finite], run.ref_lse[finite], rtol=0, atol=2e-2)
+

+def _facts(**over):
+    """Dense SM120 decode facts (no GPU): GQA 4 at d128 over 8K keys unless overridden."""
+    import cudnn
+    from cudnn.sdpa.graph_analyzer import SdpaGraphFacts
+
+    base = dict(b=1, h_q=32, h_kv=8, s_q=1, s_kv=8192, d_qk=128, d_v=128, dtype=cudnn.data_type.HALF, device_cc=(12, 0), device_sm_count=188)
+    base.update(over)
+    if base["s_q"] > 1:
+        base.setdefault("causal", True)
+        base.setdefault("bottom_right", True)

+
+sm100/prefill_d128_fp8.py runs its second Q sub-tile as a second KV stream over
+the first sub-tile's 128 rows: stream 0 takes the even KV tiles, stream 1 the
+odd ones, each with its own running max / sum and O accumulator, merged once in
+the correction epilogue.  The routing is the adapter's (``_fp8_dual_kv_stream``),
+on by default behind ``config_sm100.FP8_DUAL_KV_STREAM_ROUTED``; these tests pin
+it on and check every shape family the merge has to get right: an even and an odd tile
+count (stream 1's phantom step), one and two tiles, a KV split whose chunks are
+odd, bottom-right causal multi-query, an unpacked 64-row Q tile, fp8 and bf16 O,
+and paged K/V with unaligned lengths.

+D = 128
+F8 = torch.float8_e4m3fn

+def _rand(shape, scale=0.5, seed=0):

+        (1, 8, 8, 128, 2048, 1, True),  # unpacked, one full Q tile
+        (1, 8, 8, 129, 2048, 1, False),  # one row too many for a single tile

+def _reference(q, k, v, lens, s_q, causal_br):
+    """fp32 reference from the fp8 values; K/V as [B, KH, S_kv, D] with per-batch live lengths."""
+    b, h = q.shape[0], q.shape[1]
+    g = h // k.shape[1]
+    ref = torch.zeros(b, h, s_q, D, device="cuda", dtype=torch.float32)
+    for bi in range(b):
+        kb = k[bi, :, : lens[bi]].float().repeat_interleave(g, dim=0)
+        vb = v[bi, :, : lens[bi]].float().repeat_interleave(g, dim=0)
+        s = (q[bi].float() @ kb.transpose(-1, -2)) * D**-0.5
+        if causal_br:
+            i = torch.arange(s_q, device="cuda")[:, None]
+            j = torch.arange(lens[bi], device="cuda")[None, :]
+            s = s.masked_fill(j > i + (lens[bi] - s_q), float("-inf"))
+        ref[bi] = torch.softmax(s, dim=-1) @ vb
+    return ref

+    tq, tk, tv = g.tensor_like(q), g.tensor_like(k), g.tensor_like(v)
+    sc = {n: g.tensor_like(t) for n, t in ones.items()}
+    kw = dict(use_causal_mask_bottom_right=True) if causal_br else {}
+    ret = g.sdpa_fp8(
+        q=tq,
+        k=tk,
+        v=tv,
+        descale_q=sc["dq"],
+        descale_k=sc["dk"],
+        descale_v=sc["dv"],
+        descale_s=sc["ds"],

+    lead = select_engine(g, ENGINE)

+        g.create_execution_plan(ENGINE_ID, SdpaFwdKnobs(sched_policy=0, tile_m=kn.tile_m, tile_n=kn.tile_n, cga=1, pack_gqa=kn.pack_gqa, split_kv=split))

+"""FROST SDPA forward past 65535 heads or batch (#1573).
+
+The NATURAL scheduler launches heads and batch on gridDim.y/z, which CUDA caps
+at 65535, so a pinned NATURAL plan is declined when it is built and the
+recommended plans ride the flat LPT grid.
+"""
+
+import math
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+import cudnn
+from cudnn.engines import is_python_engine
+
+pytestmark = pytest.mark.L1
+
+
+def _frost_shape():
+    """(S, D) a FROST forward row serves on this device; the SM90 row serves d512 only."""
+    if not torch.cuda.is_available():
+        return None
+    major, minor = torch.cuda.get_device_capability(0)
+    if (major, minor) == (9, 0):
+        return 64, 512
+    if (major, minor) == (8, 0) or (major == 10 and minor <= 6):
+        return 128, 64
+    return None
+
+
+if _frost_shape() is None:
+    pytest.skip("needs an A100, H100 or SM100 device for the FROST forward rows", allow_module_level=True)
+S, D = _frost_shape()
+SCALE = 1.0 / math.sqrt(D)
+
+
+def _graph(b, h):
+    g = cudnn.pygraph(io_data_type=cudnn.data_type.HALF, intermediate_data_type=cudnn.data_type.FLOAT, compute_data_type=cudnn.data_type.FLOAT)
+    stride = [S * h * D, D, h * D, 1]
+    q, k, v = (g.tensor(name=n, dim=[b, h, S, D], stride=stride, data_type=cudnn.data_type.HALF) for n in "qkv")
+    o, _ = g.sdpa(q, k, v, is_inference=True, attn_scale=SCALE)
+    o.set_output(True).set_data_type(cudnn.data_type.HALF).set_dim([b, h, S, D]).set_stride(stride)
+    g.validate()
+    g.build_operation_graph()
+    g.create_execution_plans([cudnn.heur_mode.A, cudnn.heur_mode.FALLBACK])
+    return g, (q, k, v, o)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("b,h", [(65536, 1), (1, 65536)], ids=["batch", "heads"])
+def test_frost_forward_past_65535_runs_on_the_flat_grid(monkeypatch, b, h):
+    monkeypatch.setenv("CUDNN_FRONTEND_ENABLE_FROST_ENGINES", "1")
+    g, ports = _graph(b, h)
+    frost = [i for i, plan in enumerate(g.plans) if is_python_engine(plan.engine_id)]
+    if not frost:
+        pytest.skip("no FROST forward row claims this graph here")
+    engine_id, knobs = g.get_engine_and_knobs_at_index(frost[0])
+    assert knobs[cudnn.knob_type.SCHED_POLICY] != 0
+
+    natural = {**knobs, cudnn.knob_type.SCHED_POLICY: 0}
+    g.create_execution_plan(engine_id, natural)
+    g.select_plan(g.get_execution_plan_count() - 1)
+    with pytest.raises(Exception, match="65535"):
+        g.check_support()
+        g.build_plans()
+
+    g.select_plan(frost[0])
+    g.check_support()
+    g.build_plans()
+    torch.manual_seed(0)
+    q, k, v = (torch.randn(b, S, h, D, dtype=torch.float16, device="cuda").transpose(1, 2) for _ in range(3))
+    o = torch.full_like(q, float("nan"))
+    workspace = torch.empty(max(int(g.get_workspace_size()), 1), dtype=torch.uint8, device="cuda")
+    g.execute(dict(zip(ports, (q, k, v, o))), workspace)
+    torch.cuda.synchronize()
+    for bi, hi in ((0, 0), (b - 1, h - 1), (b // 2, h // 2)):
+        p = torch.softmax((q[bi, hi].double() @ k[bi, hi].double().T) * SCALE, dim=-1)
+        torch.testing.assert_close(o[bi, hi].float(), (p @ v[bi, hi].double()).float(), atol=2e-3, rtol=1e-2)

+"""The small head-dim tiles of the Rubin (SM107) f16/bf16 forward row: ``TILE_K = TILE_O`` in {32, 64} as Cfg flavors of the d128 file.
+
+``sm107/prefill_d128_f16.py`` is one body with three head-dim geometries (``TemplateParams.d_flavor`` 32 / 64 / 128 ->
+``config_sm107.make_cfg_d32`` / ``make_cfg_d64`` / ``make_cfg_d128``).  A graph's head dim lands on the SMALLEST width covering
+max(d_qk, d_v) -- 8 / 16 / 24 -> 32, 40 / 48 / 56 -> 64, the natives on themselves -- and the TMA load zero-fills the columns
+past D (exact zero terms in QK^T and in P.V's padded V columns; the ``expect_tx`` count is the FULL box; the O store clips at
+d_v).  D % 8 != 0 is a typed decline (the TMA 16-byte global-stride rule at 2 B/elem).  Everything coupled to the tile -- the
+swizzle atoms, the TMA iteration counts, the TMEM O slot width, the BMM1 k-step count -- is derived from ``CFG.*`` and pinned by
+``_validate_head_dim_tile``; the d128 rendering is byte-identical to the one-geometry file (``test_sdpa_fwd_score_stats.py``
+holds the cubin md5 records).
+
+The small tiles carry the row's DENSE leg only (``Capabilities.dense_only_d_shapes``): a graph that asks for split-KV, the score
+side outputs, THD, paged KV, PackGQA or a cga outside the tile's domain is selected PAST them onto the flavor that carries the leg
+-- the d128 flavor it rode before the tiles existed (a cga2 request at D <= 32: the 64-wide tile) -- so nothing the row served
+before the tiles is withdrawn, and THD / paged KV / PackGQA at D <= 64 keep exactly their pre-tile typed declines.
+
+Three tiers: (1) CPU contract -- the row's accept / decline table per D, the ROUTE table per (D, leg) with the three pick
+implementations agreeing on every cell (the row's envelope walk, the adapter's flavor pool, ``sm107_f16_tile_width(leg=, cga=)``),
+the one constant feeding the row's cga domain, the adapter's cga twin and the config factory, the factories' derived facts and
+raising couplings, the loader binding ``d_flavor`` to the flavor, the static expect_tx pin; (2) host rendering pins -- an sm_107a
+trace-compile of each new rendering keeps the register split (``USETMAXREG`` > 0) and spills no more than the d128 rendering of
+the same mask arm; (3) GPU cells on a Rubin device -- the fp64 oracle over the degenerate-input matrix (the shared ``small_tile_cells``,
+one matrix for both arch lines) on the 32- and 64-wide tiles in bf16 with the fp16 member on the degenerate trio, one accept cell at
+D = 16 and at D = 56, the bitwise pin D = 8 / 24 vs an explicitly zero-padded D = 32 (40 / 48 vs 64: the zero-fill contract, one
+TMA mechanism), the d64 tile at cga2, the routed legs (split-KV and the score outputs at D = 24 / 64 on the d128 flavor, cga2 at

+    """Static pin of the zero-fill contract (frost-tile-dsl.md s5: an overshooting TMA box delivers the FULL box's bytes): every
+    per-tile element count is a TILE product, every transaction byte count is that count x BPE x CTA_MMA, and no head-dim
+    EXTENT (d_qk / d_v) reaches a byte count or a box -- the extents live in the descriptors only."""
+    code = "\n".join(ln for ln in _KERNEL.read_text().splitlines() if not ln.lstrip().startswith("#"))
+    for line in (
+        "qBufferElems = CFG.TILE_M * CFG.TILE_K",
+        "kBufferElems = CFG.TILE_N * CFG.TILE_K // CFG.CTA_MMA",
+        "vBufferElems = CFG.TILE_O * CFG.TILE_N // CFG.CTA_MMA",
+        "qTmaTransactionBytes = qBufferElems * CFG.BPE * CFG.CTA_MMA",
+        "kTmaTransactionBytes = kBufferElems * CFG.BPE * CFG.CTA_MMA",
+        "vTmaTransactionBytes = vBufferElems * CFG.BPE * CFG.CTA_MMA",
+        "HEADS_PER_TILE = CFG.PACK_G if CFG.PACK_GQA else 1",
+        "TOKENS_PER_TILE = CFG.TILE_M // HEADS_PER_TILE",
+        "qk_box_q = (1, TOKENS_PER_TILE, HEADS_PER_TILE, TMA_QK_GRANU_ELEMS)",
+        "qk_box_k = (1, CFG.TILE_N // CFG.CTA_MMA, 1, TMA_QK_GRANU_ELEMS)",
+        "vo_box_v = (1, CFG.TILE_N, 1, TMA_VO_GRANU_ELEMS)",
+        "vo_box_o = (1, TOKENS_PER_TILE, HEADS_PER_TILE, _O_GRANU_ELEMS)",
+    ):
+        assert line in code, line
+    # Evaluate the kernel's box expressions: packing trades token rows for
+    # heads without changing the transfer volume or the unpacked geometry.
+    names = ("HEADS_PER_TILE", "TOKENS_PER_TILE", "qk_box_q", "vo_box_o")
+    expressions = {
+        target.id: node.value
+        for node in ast.walk(ast.parse(code))
+        if isinstance(node, ast.Assign)
+        for target in node.targets
+        if isinstance(target, ast.Name) and target.id in names
+    }
+    for packed, pack_g in ((False, 1), (True, 1), (True, 2), (True, 4), (True, 8), (True, 16)):
+        for granularity in (16, 32, 64):
+            env = dict(CFG=SimpleNamespace(TILE_M=128, PACK_GQA=packed, PACK_G=pack_g), TMA_QK_GRANU_ELEMS=granularity, _O_GRANU_ELEMS=granularity)
+            for name in names:
+                env[name] = eval(compile(ast.Expression(expressions[name]), str(_KERNEL), "eval"), {"__builtins__": {}}, env)
+            for name in ("qk_box_q", "vo_box_o"):

+    for bad in (r"TransactionBytes\s*=.*\bd_(qk|v)\b", r"box_[qkvo]\s*=.*\bd_(qk|v)\b", r"BufferElems\s*=.*\bd_(qk|v)\b"):
+        assert not re.search(bad, code), bad
+    assert "_MAKE_CFG = {32: make_cfg_d32, 64: make_cfg_d64, 128: make_cfg_d128}" in code
+    assert "d128_family_tmem_layout(CFG)" in code and not re.search(r"^\s*(S1|O0|O1|STATS)_OFF: int = \d+\s*$", code, re.M), "no TMEM literal survives"

+def _desc(shape, dtype, name):
+    from cudnn.api_base import TensorDesc

+    b, h, s, d = shape
+    stride = (s * h * d, d, h * d, 1)
+    return TensorDesc(
+        dtype=dtype, shape=tuple(shape), stride=stride, stride_order=TensorDesc._compute_stride_order(tuple(shape), stride), device="cuda", name=name

+"""End-to-end tests for the FROST SM120 block-scaled MXFP8 SDPA-forward engine.
+
+Drives ``graph.sdpa_mxfp8`` (FP8 E4M3/E5M2 Q/K/V + per-32-block E8M0 scale
+factors in cuDNN's F8_128x4 order) routed to ``sdpa_fwd_prefill_sm120_mxfp8``,
+and validates O, Stats and Amax_O against an fp32 reference over the
+dequantized inputs; Amax_O goes through ``sdpa.fp8.assert_amax_o`` (the
+reference's pre-cast amax and the kernel's own stored O), with O and Amax_O
+NaN-prefilled so an output never written fails. Inputs are quantized with the
+torch-only quantizer in ``test/python/sdpa/mxfp8_quant.py``.
+
+By default every 32-element block of Q, K (along D) and V (along S) is scaled
+by its own power of two before quantization, so the stored block scales differ
+strongly from block to block: a scale read for the wrong row, column, block or
+plane changes O by up to the spread factor instead of hiding behind
+near-uniform scales.
+
+SM120 envelope (see engines._sm120_mxfp8_spec): E4M3/E5M2 in, FP16/BF16/FP8
+out, head tiles any multiple of 32 up to 256 with independent QK^T and P@V
+sides, head dims any multiple of 16 via TMA zero-padding, causal /
+bottom-right / SWA / right-band / KV-padding masks, the per-batch seq_len_q
+trim, attention sinks, GQA/MQA with PackGQA, dense split-KV, any dense
+B/H/S storage order with the head dim innermost, THD (ragged) with
+token- or head-major Stats, and the block-scaled MXFP8 O (E4M3 + UE8M0
+per 32 in sf_o) at d = 128. Both head dims in (256, 512] ride the d512
+flavor (``sm120/prefill_d512_mxfp8.py``, 64 x 64 CTA), covered by its own
+section. The NVFP4 O is declined. Base-2 Stats are exercised through the direct adapter: the
+``sdpa_mxfp8`` graph op has no ``stats_use_log2`` argument.
+
+Requires: an SM120-line GPU (cc 12.x), cutlass-dsl. Skips otherwise.
+"""
+
+import math
+from dataclasses import replace
+from typing import NamedTuple, Optional
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from test_utils import torch_fork_set_rng
+
+from cudnn.sdpa.fwd.engines import engine_name
+from frost_test_utils import make_dense_stats, offers_engine, requires_blackwell_geforce, requires_dsl, select_engine as _select_engine
+from sdpa.fp8 import assert_amax_o

+pytestmark = [requires_blackwell_geforce, requires_dsl]
+
+_ENGINE = engine_name(arch="sm120", mxfp8=True)
+_BLOCK = 32
+_FP8 = {"e4m3": torch.float8_e4m3fn, "e5m2": torch.float8_e5m2}
+_CUDNN_ITYPE = {"e4m3": "FP8_E4M3", "e5m2": "FP8_E5M2"}
+_CUDNN_OTYPE = {torch.float16: "HALF", torch.bfloat16: "BFLOAT16", torch.float8_e4m3fn: "FP8_E4M3", torch.float8_e5m2: "FP8_E5M2"}
+_MASKS = {
+    "none": {},
+    "causal": dict(use_causal_mask=True),
+    "causal_br": dict(use_causal_mask_bottom_right=True),
+    "swa": dict(use_causal_mask=True, diagonal_band_left_bound=65),  # window = 64
+    "right_band": dict(diagonal_band_right_bound=48),
+}
+
+
+class _RunResult(NamedTuple):
+    output: torch.Tensor  # O as stored: a BHSD view, or packed (T, H, D) under THD; a block-scaled O dequantized and divided by scale_o
+    reference: torch.Tensor  # fp32 reference O, dead rows zero
+    input_dtype: torch.dtype  # FP8 Q/K/V element type
+    amax_o: torch.Tensor  # the graph's Amax_O buffer (NaN-prefilled)
+    stats: Optional[torch.Tensor]  # (B, H, S_q), or (T, H) under THD
+    reference_stats: Optional[torch.Tensor]
+    sf_o_pad_ok: Optional[bool] = None  # block-scaled O: every kernel-owned SF_O pad row came back zero
+
+
+class _Quantized(NamedTuple):
+    """One MXFP8-quantized operand."""
+
+    data: torch.Tensor  # fp8 [b, h, s, d]
+    sf: torch.Tensor  # swizzled F8_128x4 scale bytes, shaped by ``sf_dims``
+    dequant: torch.Tensor  # fp32 [b, h, s, d], data times its block scales
+    sf_dims: tuple  # logical dims of the graph's scale tensor
+
+
+def _cdiv(a, b):
+    return (a + b - 1) // b
+
+
+def _block_spread(shape, axis, lo, hi, generator):
+    """Per-32-element-block power-of-two factors along ``axis`` (every other index varies freely)."""
+    blocks = list(shape)
+    blocks[axis] = _cdiv(shape[axis], _BLOCK)
+    exps = torch.randint(lo, hi + 1, blocks, device="cuda", generator=generator).float()
+    return torch.exp2(exps).repeat_interleave(_BLOCK, dim=axis).narrow(axis, 0, shape[axis])
+
+
+def _qk_sf_cols(d):
+    """Columns of a Q/K scale tensor: ceil(D / 32) blocks, padded to a multiple of 4."""
+    return _cdiv(_cdiv(d, _BLOCK), 4) * 4
+
+
+def _quantize(t, fp8, *, columnwise) -> _Quantized:
+    """MXFP8-quantize ``t`` [b, h, s, d] fp32; ``columnwise`` scales along S (V), else along D (Q/K)."""
+    from sdpa.mxfp8_quant import quantize_to_mxfp8
+
+    b, h, s, d = t.shape
+    data_d, dq_d, swz_d, data_s, dq_s, swz_s = quantize_to_mxfp8(t, b, h, s, d, _BLOCK, fp8, with_ref=True)
+    if columnwise:
+        dims = (b, h, _cdiv(_cdiv(s, _BLOCK), 4) * 4, _cdiv(d, 128) * 128)
+        return _Quantized(data_s, swz_s.view(torch.uint8).reshape(dims).contiguous(), data_s.float() * dq_s.reshape(b, h, s, d), dims)
+    dims = (b, h, _cdiv(s, 128) * 128, _qk_sf_cols(d))
+    return _Quantized(data_d, swz_d.view(torch.uint8).reshape(dims).contiguous(), data_d.float() * dq_d.reshape(b, h, s, d), dims)
+
+
+def _draw(B, H_q, H_kv, S_q, S_kv, d_qk, d_v, fp8):
+    """Random Q/K/V, each 32-element block scaled by its own power of two, quantized: (Q, K, V) as ``_Quantized``."""
+    gen = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(torch.initial_seed() % (2**31))
+    qf = torch.randn(B, H_q, S_q, d_qk, device="cuda", generator=gen) * 0.5
+    kf = torch.randn(B, H_kv, S_kv, d_qk, device="cuda", generator=gen) * 0.5
+    vf = torch.randn(B, H_kv, S_kv, d_v, device="cuda", generator=gen) * 0.5
+    qf = qf * _block_spread(qf.shape, 3, -2, 2, gen)
+    kf = kf * _block_spread(kf.shape, 3, -2, 2, gen)
+    vf = vf * _block_spread(vf.shape, 2, -3, 3, gen)
+    return _quantize(qf, fp8, columnwise=False), _quantize(kf, fp8, columnwise=False), _quantize(vf, fp8, columnwise=True)
+
+
+def _bshd(x):
+    """A BHSD view over BSHD storage."""
+    return x.permute(0, 2, 1, 3).contiguous().transpose(1, 2)
+
+
+def _nan_output(shape, dtype):
+    """Output storage prefilled with NaN, so an element never written fails the finiteness check."""
+    return torch.full(shape, float("nan"), device="cuda").to(dtype)
+
+
+def _padded_pitch(x):
+    """A BHSD view over BSHD storage whose head pitch is D + 1 elements: BSHD order, but strides the
+    prepared binder cannot address, so the plan stages compact copies."""
+    b, h, s, d = x.shape
+    view = torch.full((b, s, h, d + 1), float("nan"), device=x.device).to(x.dtype)[..., :d].transpose(1, 2)
+    view.copy_(x)
+    return view
+
+
+# Storage orders for Q/K/V/O: a BHSD view holding ``x``'s values.
+_LAYOUTS = {"bshd": lambda x: x, "padded_pitch": _padded_pitch, "bhsd": lambda x: x.contiguous()}
+
+
+def _sf_tensor(g, dims):
+    """A compact graph E8M0 scale tensor in the F8_128x4 order."""
+    import cudnn
+
+    return g.tensor(
+        dim=list(dims),
+        stride=[dims[1] * dims[2] * dims[3], dims[2] * dims[3], dims[3], 1],
+        data_type=cudnn.data_type.FP8_E8M0,
+        reordering_type=cudnn.tensor_reordering.F8_128x4,
+    )
+
+
+def _rowwise_sf_offsets(b, h, s, d, rows, blocks):
+    """Flat byte offsets of the rowwise (Q/K) scales of ``rows`` x ``blocks`` for every (batch, head):
+    atoms ordered (b, h, s-tile, d-plane), byte ``(r % 32) * 16 + ((r // 32) % 4) * 4 + c % 4``."""
+    s_tiles, planes = _cdiv(s, 128), _cdiv(_cdiv(d, _BLOCK), 4)
+    bh = torch.arange(b * h, device="cuda").view(-1, 1, 1)
+    r = torch.as_tensor(rows, device="cuda").view(1, -1, 1)
+    c = torch.as_tensor(blocks, device="cuda").view(1, 1, -1)
+    atom = (bh * s_tiles + r // 128) * planes + c // 4
+    return (atom * 512 + (r % 32) * 16 + ((r // 32) % 4) * 4 + c % 4).view(b, h, len(rows), len(blocks))
+
+
+def _columnwise_sf_offsets(b, h, s, d, blocks, cols):
+    """Flat byte offsets of the columnwise (V) scales of key ``blocks`` x D ``cols``: atoms ordered
+    (d-plane, b, h, s-tile), byte ``(n % 32) * 16 + ((n // 32) % 4) * 4 + j % 4``."""
+    s_tiles = _cdiv(_cdiv(_cdiv(s, _BLOCK), 4) * 4 * _BLOCK, 128)
+    bh = torch.arange(b * h, device="cuda").view(-1, 1, 1)
+    j = torch.as_tensor(blocks, device="cuda").view(1, -1, 1)
+    n = torch.as_tensor(cols, device="cuda").view(1, 1, -1)
+    atom = (n // 128) * (b * h * s_tiles) + bh * s_tiles + j // 4
+    return (atom * 512 + (n % 32) * 16 + ((n // 32) % 4) * 4 + j % 4).view(b, h, len(blocks), len(cols))
+
+
+def _ref(qd, kd, vd, *, scale, is_causal=False, bottom_right=False, swa_window=None, right_bound=0, sinks=None, seq_lens_q=None, seq_lens_kv=None):
+    """fp32 reference with the kernel's mask / sink / trim semantics (BHSD, GQA-aware); returns (O, LSE)."""
+    b, h_q, s_q, _ = qd.shape
+    _, h_kv, s_kv, _ = vd.shape
+    dev = qd.device
+    g = h_q // h_kv
+    k_e = kd.repeat_interleave(g, dim=1)
+    v_e = vd.repeat_interleave(g, dim=1)
+    scores = torch.matmul(qd, k_e.transpose(-1, -2)) * scale
+    i = torch.arange(s_q, device=dev).view(1, 1, s_q, 1)
+    j = torch.arange(s_kv, device=dev).view(1, 1, 1, s_kv)
+    masked = torch.zeros(1, 1, s_q, s_kv, dtype=torch.bool, device=dev)
+    diag = 0
+    if bottom_right:
+        # The diagonal anchors at each batch's (seq_len_q, seq_len_kv) corner.
+        slq_d = torch.as_tensor(seq_lens_q if seq_lens_q is not None else [s_q] * b, device=dev).view(b, 1, 1, 1)
+        slk_d = torch.as_tensor(seq_lens_kv if seq_lens_kv is not None else [s_kv] * b, device=dev).view(b, 1, 1, 1)
+        diag = slk_d - slq_d
+    if is_causal:
+        masked = masked | (j > i + diag + right_bound)
+    if swa_window is not None:
+        masked = masked | (j < i + diag - swa_window)
+    if seq_lens_kv is not None:
+        masked = masked | (j >= torch.as_tensor(seq_lens_kv, device=dev).view(b, 1, 1, 1))
+    scores = scores.masked_fill(masked, float("-inf"))
+    if sinks is not None:
+        scores = torch.cat([scores, sinks.float().view(1, h_q, 1, 1).expand(b, h_q, s_q, 1)], dim=-1)
+    lse = torch.logsumexp(scores, dim=-1)
+    probs = torch.softmax(scores, dim=-1).nan_to_num(0.0)[..., :s_kv]
+    out = torch.matmul(probs, v_e)
+    if seq_lens_q is not None:
+        dead = i >= torch.as_tensor(seq_lens_q, device=dev).view(b, 1, 1, 1)
+        out = torch.where(dead, torch.zeros((), device=dev), out)
+        lse = lse.masked_fill(dead.squeeze(-1), float("-inf"))

+
+
+def _ref_kwargs(sdpa_kwargs):
+    out = {}
+    if sdpa_kwargs.get("use_causal_mask"):
+        out["is_causal"] = True
+    if sdpa_kwargs.get("use_causal_mask_bottom_right"):
+        out.update(is_causal=True, bottom_right=True)

+        out["swa_window"] = sdpa_kwargs["diagonal_band_left_bound"] - 1

+def _run(
+    B,
+    H_q,
+    H_kv,
+    S_q,
+    S_kv,

+    d_v=None,

+    requests the block-scaled MXFP8 O (E4M3 + UE8M0 per 32 d in ``sf_o``), with the optional global ``scale_o``."""
+    import cudnn
+
+    dev = "cuda"

+    scale = d_qk**-0.5 if scale is None else scale

+    fp8 = _FP8[in_key]

+    Qb, Kb, Vb = _bshd(q_op.data), _bshd(k_op.data), _bshd(v_op.data)
+    sfq, sfk, sfv = q_op.sf, k_op.sf, v_op.sf

+        # Pad storage past each batch's length carries NaN data and NaN (0xFF)
+        # scale encodings; the reference reads the clean tensors, the kernel must
+        # keep the pad rows and wholly-padded scale blocks out of O and Stats.
+        assert seq_lens_kv is not None

+            Kb[b, :, n:, :].view(torch.uint8).fill_(nan8)
+            Vb[b, :, n:, :].view(torch.uint8).fill_(nan8)
+            rows = list(range(n, S_kv))
+            if rows:
+                off = _rowwise_sf_offsets(B, H_kv, S_kv, d_qk, rows, list(range(_cdiv(d_qk, _BLOCK))))[b]
+                sfk.view(-1)[off.reshape(-1)] = 0xFF
+            dead_blocks = list(range(_cdiv(n, _BLOCK), _cdiv(S_kv, _BLOCK)))
+            if dead_blocks:
+                off = _columnwise_sf_offsets(B, H_kv, S_kv, d_v, dead_blocks, list(range(d_v)))[b]
+                sfv.view(-1)[off.reshape(-1)] = 0xFF
+        for b, n in enumerate(seq_lens_q or []):
+            Qb[b, :, n:, :].view(torch.uint8).fill_(nan8)
+            rows = list(range(n, S_q))
+            if rows:
+                off = _rowwise_sf_offsets(B, H_q, S_q, d_qk, rows, list(range(_cdiv(d_qk, _BLOCK))))[b]
+                sfq.view(-1)[off.reshape(-1)] = 0xFF
+    if poison_v_sf_pad_cols:
+        # V-scale rows past d_v inside its last 128-row atom carry the NaN encoding (caller-owned pad bytes).
+        sfv = sfv.clone()
+        off = _columnwise_sf_offsets(B, H_kv, S_kv, d_v, list(range(_cdiv(S_kv, _BLOCK))), list(range(d_v, _cdiv(d_v, 128) * 128)))
+        sfv.view(-1)[off.reshape(-1)] = 0xFF
+    if poison_qk_sf_pad_blocks:
+        # Q/K-scale blocks past d_qk inside the last plane carry the NaN encoding (caller-owned pad bytes).
+        pad_blocks = list(range(_cdiv(d_qk, _BLOCK), _qk_sf_cols(d_qk)))
+        if pad_blocks:
+            sfq, sfk = sfq.clone(), sfk.clone()
+            sfq.view(-1)[_rowwise_sf_offsets(B, H_q, S_q, d_qk, list(range(S_q)), pad_blocks).reshape(-1)] = 0xFF

+    Ob = _nan_output((B, S_q, H_q, d_v), out_dt).transpose(1, 2)

+    lse = make_dense_stats(B, H_q, S_q, "contiguous") if with_stats else None

+    g = cudnn.pygraph(
+        io_data_type=getattr(cudnn.data_type, _CUDNN_ITYPE[in_key]),
+        intermediate_data_type=cudnn.data_type.FLOAT,
+        compute_data_type=cudnn.data_type.FLOAT,
+    )
+    q, k, v = g.tensor_like(Qb), g.tensor_like(Kb), g.tensor_like(Vb)
+    dq, dk, dv = (_sf_tensor(g, op.sf_dims) for op in (q_op, k_op, v_op))
+    kw = dict(q=q, k=k, v=v, descale_q=dq, descale_k=dk, descale_v=dv, attn_scale=scale, generate_stats=with_stats)
+    vp = {q: Qb, k: Kb, v: Vb, dq: sfq, dk: sfk, dv: sfv}
+    if sinks is not None:
+        st = g.tensor_like(sinks)
+        kw["sink_token"] = st
+        vp[st] = sinks
+    if seq_lens_q is not None and seq_lens_kv is None:
+        seq_lens_kv = [S_kv] * B
+    if seq_lens_kv is not None:
+        slq = torch.tensor(seq_lens_q if seq_lens_q is not None else [S_q] * B, dtype=torch.int32, device=dev).reshape(B, 1, 1, 1)
+        slk = torch.tensor(seq_lens_kv, dtype=torch.int32, device=dev).reshape(B, 1, 1, 1)
+        sq_h = g.tensor(dim=[B, 1, 1, 1], stride=[1, 1, 1, 1], data_type=cudnn.data_type.INT32)
+        skv_h = g.tensor(dim=[B, 1, 1, 1], stride=[1, 1, 1, 1], data_type=cudnn.data_type.INT32)
+        kw.update(use_padding_mask=True, seq_len_q=sq_h, seq_len_kv=skv_h)
+        vp.update({sq_h: slq, skv_h: slk})
+    if sf_o_layout is not None:
+        from sdpa.block_scale_o_ref import round_up
+
+        # SF_O pre-filled with 0xAA (scale bytes never written stay visible); token-major rows past B*S_q are caller-owned.
+        C = max(4, round_up(d_v // _BLOCK, 4))
+        if sf_o_layout == "planes":
+            R = round_up(S_q, 128)
+            sf_o_buf = torch.full((B, H_q, R, C), 0xAA, device=dev, dtype=torch.uint8)
+            sf_o_stride = [H_q * R * C, R * C, C, 1]
+        else:
+            R = S_q
+            sf_o_buf = torch.full((round_up(B * S_q, 128), H_q * C), 0xAA, device=dev, dtype=torch.uint8)
+            sf_o_buf[B * S_q :] = 0
+            sf_o_stride = [R * H_q * C, C, H_q * C, 1]
+        kw["sf_o"] = g.tensor(dim=[B, H_q, R, C], stride=sf_o_stride, data_type=cudnn.data_type.FP8_E8M0)
+        vp[kw["sf_o"]] = sf_o_buf
+        if scale_o is not None:
+            kw["scale_o"] = g.tensor(dim=[1, 1, 1, 1], stride=[1, 1, 1, 1], data_type=cudnn.data_type.FLOAT)
+            vp[kw["scale_o"]] = torch.full((1,), scale_o, device=dev)
+    kw.update(sdpa_kwargs)
+    o, stats_t, amax_o = g.sdpa_mxfp8(**kw)
+    o.set_output(True).set_dim(list(Ob.shape)).set_stride(list(Ob.stride())).set_data_type(getattr(cudnn.data_type, _CUDNN_OTYPE[out_dt]))
+    if with_stats:
+        stats_t.set_output(True).set_dim([B, H_q, S_q, 1]).set_stride(list(lse.stride())).set_data_type(cudnn.data_type.FLOAT)
+        vp[stats_t] = lse
+    amax_o.set_output(True).set_dim([1, 1, 1, 1]).set_stride([1, 1, 1, 1]).set_data_type(cudnn.data_type.FLOAT)
+    vp[amax_o] = amax_buf
+
+    g.validate()
+    g.build_operation_graph()
+    g.create_execution_plans([cudnn.heur_mode.A])
+    chosen = _select_engine(g, _ENGINE, tiles=tiles, pack_gqa=pack_gqa, sched_policy=sched_policy)
+    if split_kv is not None and (chosen.knobs.split_kv or 1) != split_kv:
+        # The ranked plans need not carry this split count: re-plan the engine's own knob set with it.
+        g.create_execution_plan(chosen.engine_id, replace(chosen.knobs, split_kv=split_kv, sched_policy=0))
+        g.select_plan(len(g.plans) - 1)
+    assert split_kv is None or (g.plans[g._plan_index].knobs.split_kv or 1) == split_kv
+    g.check_support()
+    g.build_plans()
+    vp[o] = Ob
+    ws = torch.empty(max(g.get_workspace_size(), 1), device=dev, dtype=torch.uint8)
+    if sync_debug:
+        g.execute(vp, ws)  # warm the plan's lazy state outside the probe
+        torch.cuda.synchronize()
+        prev = torch.cuda.get_sync_debug_mode()
+        torch.cuda.set_sync_debug_mode("error")
+    try:
+        g.execute(vp, ws)
+    finally:
+        if sync_debug:
+            torch.cuda.set_sync_debug_mode(prev)
+    torch.cuda.synchronize()
+
+    o_ref, lse_ref = _ref(
+        q_op.dequant, k_op.dequant, v_op.dequant, scale=scale, sinks=sinks, seq_lens_q=seq_lens_q, seq_lens_kv=seq_lens_kv, **_ref_kwargs(sdpa_kwargs)
+    )
+    stats = lse.squeeze(-1) if with_stats else None
+    if sf_o_layout is not None:
+        from sdpa.block_scale_o_ref import dequant_block_scaled_o
+
+        o_deq, pad_ok = dequant_block_scaled_o(Ob, sf_o_buf, _BLOCK, sf_o_layout, B, H_q, S_q, d_v, C)
+        return _RunResult(o_deq / (1.0 if scale_o is None else scale_o), o_ref, fp8, amax_buf, stats, lse_ref if with_stats else None, pad_ok)
+    return _RunResult(Ob, o_ref, fp8, amax_buf, stats, lse_ref if with_stats else None)

+def _o_tol(res: _RunResult, d_qk=128):
+    """Half-output tolerance relative to the reference's magnitude; FP8 outputs add three times the
+    output dtype's own quantization floor of the reference."""
+    e5m2 = res.input_dtype == torch.float8_e5m2
+    base = 8e-2 if e5m2 and d_qk > 128 else 7e-2 if e5m2 else 5e-2
+    tol = base * max(1.0, res.reference.abs().max().item())
+    if res.output.dtype in (torch.float8_e4m3fn, torch.float8_e5m2):
+        floor = (res.reference - res.reference.to(res.output.dtype).float()).abs().max().item()
+        tol = max(tol, 3.0 * floor)
+    return tol
+
+
+def _check(res: _RunResult, d_qk=128):
+    out = res.output.float()
+    assert torch.isfinite(out).all(), "non-finite O (NaN = an element never written)"
+    diff = (out - res.reference).abs().max().item()
+    tol = _o_tol(res, d_qk)
+    assert diff <= tol, f"max|O-ref|={diff:.4f} > {tol:.4f}"
+    assert_amax_o(res.amax_o, res.reference.abs().max().item(), torch_itype=res.input_dtype, torch_otype=res.output.dtype, o_gpu=res.output)
+    if res.stats is not None:
+        finite = torch.isfinite(res.reference_stats)
+        assert torch.equal(torch.isfinite(res.stats), finite), "Stats -inf pattern differs from the reference"
+        d = (res.stats[finite] - res.reference_stats[finite]).abs().max().item() if finite.any() else 0.0
+        assert d <= 3e-2, f"max|LSE-ref|={d:.4f} > 0.03"

+    q = g.tensor(dim=[B, H, S, d_qk], stride=[S * H * d_qk, d_qk, H * d_qk, 1], data_type=cudnn.data_type.FP8_E4M3)

+# --- THD (ragged) ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

+class _SeqQuantized(NamedTuple):
+    """One sequence's MXFP8-quantized operand for the THD packing."""
+
+    data: torch.Tensor  # fp8 [1, h, s, d]
+    dequant: torch.Tensor  # fp32 [1, h, s, d]
+    sf_tiles: torch.Tensor  # [h, ceil(s / 128), tile_bytes], every tile's planes contiguous
+
+
+class _SeqOperands(NamedTuple):
+    q: _SeqQuantized
+    k: _SeqQuantized
+    v: _SeqQuantized
+
+
+def _poison_sf_tail(sf_tiles, s, *, columnwise):
+    """Write the NaN encoding 0xFF into the scales of a sequence's last tile that lie past its length ``s``:
+    rowwise (Q/K) rows ``s .. tiles * 128``, columnwise (V) 32-key blocks wholly past ``s``."""
+    _, tiles, size = sf_tiles.shape
+    dev = sf_tiles.device
+    plane = (torch.arange(size // 512, device=dev) * 512).view(1, -1, 1)
+    if columnwise:
+        blocks = torch.arange(_cdiv(s, _BLOCK), tiles * 4, device=dev)
+        n = torch.arange(128, device=dev)
+        tile = (blocks // 4).view(-1, 1, 1)
+        byte = plane + ((n % 32) * 16 + ((n // 32) % 4) * 4).view(1, 1, -1) + (blocks % 4).view(-1, 1, 1)
+    else:
+        rows = torch.arange(s, tiles * 128, device=dev)
+        rr = rows % 128
+        tile = (rows // 128).view(-1, 1, 1)
+        byte = plane + ((rr % 32) * 16 + ((rr // 32) % 4) * 4).view(-1, 1, 1) + torch.arange(4, device=dev).view(1, 1, -1)
+    sf_tiles[:, tile.expand_as(byte), byte] = 0xFF
+
+
+def _quantize_seq(t, fp8, *, columnwise, poison_tail=False) -> _SeqQuantized:
+    """Per-sequence quantization for the THD packing. Columnwise F8_128x4 is plane-major across a tensor,
+    so its [planes, h, tiles, 512] atoms are regrouped to keep every tile's planes contiguous.
+    ``poison_tail`` writes 0xFF scales past the sequence's length (``_poison_sf_tail``)."""
+    _, h, s, d = t.shape
+    if s == 0:
+        planes = _cdiv(d, 128)
+        return _SeqQuantized(
+            t.new_zeros((1, h, 0, d)).to(fp8), t.new_zeros((1, h, 0, d)), torch.zeros((h, 0, 512 * planes), dtype=torch.uint8, device=t.device)
+        )
+    op = _quantize(t, fp8, columnwise=columnwise)
+    tiles, planes = _cdiv(s, 128), _cdiv(d, 128)
+    sf = op.sf.reshape(planes, h, tiles, 512).permute(1, 2, 0, 3) if columnwise else op.sf
+    sf = sf.contiguous().reshape(h, tiles, -1)
+    if poison_tail:
+        _poison_sf_tail(sf, s, columnwise=columnwise)
+    return _SeqQuantized(op.data, op.dequant, sf)
+

+def _run_thd(
+    seq_lens_q,
+    seq_lens_kv,

+    H_kv,

+    d_qk=128,

+    in_key="e4m3",
+    out_dt=torch.float16,
+    sdpa_kwargs=None,

+slot 0 at the top of every tile, but slot 0's producer chain -- MMA ``bmm2_done[0]`` -> correction qs=0 epilogue (SM0's stats) ->
+``o_full[0]`` -> TMA-STG -> ``o_empty[0]`` -- never passes through warpgroup 1.  Any delay of warpgroup 1 across a tile boundary longer
+than that chain (shortest on an EMPTY (q-tile, split) unit, supplied by a spinning sibling or GPU time-slicing) let TMA-STG complete a
+second phase before warpgroup 1's parity wait; the wait aliased, warpgroup 1 never published that tile's stats, and the correction

+cc 10.3 at ~80 % of launches on square bottom-right-causal split-KV graphs (#1532) and intermittently on the cc 10.0 paged-THD
+capture/replay CI case (#1525).  Fix: each warpgroup waits ITS OWN slot, whose chain runs through its own stats publish.

+def test_scheduler_and_credit_target_select_the_same_layouts():
+    """A local scheduler cannot wait for credits routed only to the CLC leader.
+
+    Inspect the layout guards, independently of warp-role dispatch and source
+    formatting. This is a protocol invariant, not a heuristic or timing pin.
+    """
+    import ast
+    from pathlib import Path
+
+    def layouts(node, parents):
+        allowed = {False, True}
+        while node in parents:
+            parent = parents[node]
+            if isinstance(parent, ast.If):
+                test = parent.test
+                if isinstance(test, ast.Call) and ast.unparse(test.func) == "cutlass.const_expr":
+                    test = test.args[0]
+                negate = isinstance(test, ast.UnaryOp) and isinstance(test.op, ast.Not)
+                value = test.operand if negate else test
+                if ast.unparse(value) in ("CFG.THD_VARLEN", "_THD"):
+                    allowed &= {(node in parent.body) != negate}
+            node = parent
+        return allowed
+
+    scanned = []
+    for path in (Path(_KERNELS).parents[1]).rglob("*.py"):
+        tree = ast.parse(path.read_text())
+        aliases = [n for n in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(n, ast.ImportFrom) and any(a.name == "read_tile_id_arrive_on_leader" for a in n.names)]
+        clc = [n for n in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(n, ast.Call) and isinstance(n.func, ast.Name) and n.func.id == "scheduler_warp_loop"]
+        if not (aliases or clc):
+            continue
+        parents = {child: node for node in ast.walk(tree) for child in ast.iter_child_nodes(node)}
+        if not aliases:
+            # A literal single-CTA caller has no peers: both helpers elect
+            # one local arrival. It may also use the persistent THD scheduler.
+            credits = [n for n in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(n, ast.Call) and isinstance(n.func, ast.Name) and n.func.id == "read_tile_id_arrive"]
+            assert credits and all(len(n.args) >= 2 and isinstance(n.args[1], ast.Constant) and n.args[1].value == 1 for n in credits), str(path)
+            assert all(len(n.args) >= 4 and isinstance(n.args[3], ast.Constant) and n.args[3].value == 1 for n in clc), str(path)
+            scanned.append(path)
+            continue
+        assert len(aliases) == len(clc) == 1, str(path)
+        assert layouts(aliases[0], parents) == layouts(clc[0], parents), f"{path}: scheduler/credit layout mismatch"
+        # The default import must still supply broadcasts on the other arm.
+        if layouts(aliases[0], parents) != {False, True}:
+            broadcasts = [
+                n for n in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(n, ast.ImportFrom) and any(a.name == "read_tile_id_arrive" and a.asname is None for a in n.names)
+            ]
+            assert any(layouts(n, parents) == {False, True} for n in broadcasts), f"{path}: missing default broadcast credits"
+        scanned.append(path)
+    assert scanned, "no common CLC callers were checked"

+def _run(B, H, KH, P, max_pages, lens, hnd, *, sched=None, **build_kw):
+    """Build, pin the cc 10.7 MXFP8 row (optionally one scheduler policy), execute under Rule 3 and check O / LSE / Amax_O
+    against the pool reference; -> (plan, O, LSE or None).  Empty sequences write O := 0 and LSE := sink (-inf without one)."""
+    import cudnn
+    import cudnn.sdpa  # noqa: F401 -- registers the FROST engines
+    from cudnn.sdpa.fwd.engines import engine_name
+
+    g, vp, Ob, stats_gpu, amax, ref_in = _build_mxfp8(B, H, KH, P, max_pages, lens, hnd, **build_kw)
+    name = engine_name(arch="sm107", mxfp8=True)
+    g.validate()
+    g.build_operation_graph()
+    g.create_execution_plans([cudnn.heur_mode.A])
+    plan = select_engine(g, name)
+    if sched is not None:  # pin one scheduler policy of the row's plans explicitly
+        names = [g.get_plan_name_at_index(i) for i in range(len(g.plans))]
+        idx = next((i for i, n in enumerate(names) if n.startswith(name) and g.plans[i].knobs.sched_policy == sched), None)
+        assert idx is not None, f"no {name} plan with sched_policy={sched}; knobs={[p.knobs for p in g.plans]}"
+        g.select_plan(idx)
+        plan = g.plans[idx]
+    g.check_support()
+    g.build_plans()
+    ws = torch.empty(max(g.get_workspace_size(), 1), device="cuda", dtype=torch.uint8)
+    torch.cuda.set_sync_debug_mode("error")  # Rule 3: any blocking D2H in the FROST execute path is a bug
+    try:
+        g.execute(vp, ws)
+    finally:
+        torch.cuda.set_sync_debug_mode("default")
+    torch.cuda.synchronize()
+
+    ref_o, ref_lse = _ref_mxfp8(**ref_in)
+    out = Ob.float()

+    atol = _check_o(out, ref_o, build_kw.get("out_dt", torch.bfloat16), build_kw.get("in_key", "e4m3"))
+    assert abs(amax.item() - ref_o.abs().max().item()) <= atol, f"amax {amax.item()} vs ref {ref_o.abs().max().item()}"

+unpaged plans of the 2-CTA tile; every other selection is a typed decline (the engine row's ``mismatch`` and the standalone
+adapter's ``check_support`` read ONE shape constant per arch line).

+def _desc(shape, dtype, name, stride=None):
+    """A BSHD-physical (BHSD-logical) TensorDesc with no storage behind it."""
+    from cudnn.api_base import TensorDesc
+
+    b, h, s, d = shape
+    stride = tuple(stride) if stride is not None else (s * h * d, d, h * d, 1)
+    return TensorDesc(
+        dtype=dtype, shape=tuple(shape), stride=stride, stride_order=TensorDesc._compute_stride_order(tuple(shape), stride), device="cuda", name=name

+def _fake_cc(monkeypatch, cc):
+    """check_support reads the LIVE device; pin it so both arch arms run on any host."""
+    monkeypatch.setattr(torch.cuda, "is_available", lambda: True)

+def _api(
+    *,
+    b=1,
+    h=8,
+    h_kv=None,
+    s=512,
+    d=128,
+    d_v=None,
+    dtype=torch.float16,
+    fp8=False,
+    score_max=True,
+    score_sum_exp=True,
+    score_stride=None,
+    score_dtype=torch.float32,
+    **kw,
+):
+    """A d128-shaped SdpaFwdDslSm100 built from descriptors only, the score samples declared like Stats."""
+    from cudnn.sdpa.fwd.api_dsl import SdpaFwdDslSm100
+
+    h_kv = h if h_kv is None else h_kv
+    d_v = d if d_v is None else d_v
+    qkv_dtype = torch.float8_e4m3fn if fp8 else dtype
+    o_dtype = torch.bfloat16 if fp8 else dtype
+    q = _desc((b, h, s, d), qkv_dtype, "q")
+    k = _desc((b, h_kv, s, d), qkv_dtype, "k")
+    v = _desc((b, h_kv, s, d_v), qkv_dtype, "v")
+    o = _desc((b, h, s, d_v), o_dtype, "o")
+    # The Stats geometry: compact (b, h, s, 1) unless a declared (padded / permuted) stride is given.
+    score_stride = score_stride if score_stride is not None else (h * s, s, 1, 1)
+    if score_max:

+    if score_sum_exp:

+# The probe body: TemplateParams from the arm's kwargs (the compile() keys travel as `__has_*` and are popped), the d128
+# module of the arch, compile(...) with only the keys the module accepts -- so the SAME body renders the pre-edit tree
+# (whose compile() had no score keys) and this tree.  Keep byte-identical to the renderer that produced the records.
+_PROBE_BODY = """
+import inspect
+from cudnn.frost.buffers import cutedsl_state
+_installed, _version = cutedsl_state()
+print("DSL", " ".join(_version) if _version else "unknown")
+has_lse = params_kw.pop("__has_lse", True)
+score_kw = {k[2:]: params_kw.pop(k) for k in ("__has_score_max", "__has_score_sum_exp") if k in params_kw}
+params = TemplateParams(**params_kw)
+mod = _load_sm100_kernel_module((128, 128), params, rubin=(arch == "sm_107a"))
+accepted = inspect.signature(mod.compile).parameters
+compile_kw = dict(has_lse=has_lse, lse_kind="dense")
+compile_kw.update({k: v for k, v in score_kw.items() if k in accepted})
+print("COMPILE_KW", sorted(compile_kw.items()))
+mod.compile(**compile_kw)

+_COUNTS = {
+    "STG": (" STG",),
+    "LDTM": ("LDTM",),
+    "FSEL": (" FSEL",),
+    "STL": (" STL",),
+    "LDL": (" LDL",),
+    "USETMAXREG": ("USETMAXREG",),
+}
+_RECORDS = {"dense_bf16": {"dtype_qkv": 2}, "causal_f16": {"dtype_qkv": 3, "window_right": 0}, "dense_bf16_nolse": {"dtype_qkv": 2, "__has_lse": False}}
+_SCORE_ARM = {"dtype_qkv": 2, "__has_score_max": True, "__has_score_sum_exp": True}
+_RENDERINGS = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "renderings"

+def _record(arch):
+    """(dsl line, {record: md5}) of the committed pre-edit record ``renderings/md5_fwd_d128_f16_score_stats_off_<arch>.txt``."""
+    f = _RENDERINGS / f"md5_fwd_d128_f16_score_stats_off_{arch}.txt"

+        if m:

+# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- tier 3: GPU cells (the row of the device present)
+
+# Tolerances DERIVED from the kernel's arithmetic, not from the first passing run:
+#   score_max: S is the fp32 tcgen05 accumulation of exact bf16/f16 products over d = 128 (|err| <= 128 * 2^-24 * sum|q k|,
+#              ~2e-4 at these magnitudes), then one FMUL by scale*log2(e) and one by ln 2 (2 roundings, ~1e-7 relative):
+#              atol 1e-3 is >= 5x that bound; rtol 1e-5 covers the two roundings.
+#   score_sum_exp: a sum of up to S_kv ex2.approx terms (2^-22 relative each) plus the per-KV-tile rescales (one more
+#              ex2.approx each) and the fp32 accumulation (S_kv * 2^-24): < 2e-4 relative at S_kv <= 512, < 4e-4 at the
+#              n_kv = 8 cell's S_kv = 1024 (1024 * 2^-22 + 1024 * 2^-24 + 8 rescales, every term one-sided); rtol 1e-3.
+#   Stats == score_max + ln(score_sum_exp): the kernel evaluates exactly that with lg2.approx (2 ulp): 2e-5 absolute.
+_TOL_MAX = dict(atol=1e-3, rtol=1e-5)
+_TOL_SUM = dict(atol=0.0, rtol=1e-3)
+_TOL_LSE_CONSISTENCY = dict(atol=2e-5, rtol=2e-6)
+_TOL_O = dict(atol=5e-2, rtol=3e-2)  # the suite's half-precision O bound

+def _bhsd(b, h, s, d, dtype):
+    return torch.randn(b, s, h, d, device="cuda", dtype=dtype).transpose(1, 2)
+
+
+def _ref(q, k, v, *, scale, causal=False, bottom_right=False, seq_q_lens=None, seq_kv_lens=None, sinks=None, window_left=None):
+    """fp64 oracle of the whole contract: O, the natural-log LSE, score_max and score_sum_exp per row class."""
+    b, h_q, s_q, _ = q.shape
+    _, h_kv, s_kv, _ = v.shape
+    dev = q.device
+    g = h_q // h_kv
+    k_ref = k.repeat_interleave(g, dim=1).double()
+    v_ref = v.repeat_interleave(g, dim=1).double()
+    scores = torch.matmul(q.double(), k_ref.transpose(-1, -2)) * scale
+    q_lens = seq_q_lens.flatten().to(device=dev, dtype=torch.int64) if seq_q_lens is not None else torch.full((b,), s_q, dtype=torch.int64, device=dev)
+    kv_lens = seq_kv_lens.flatten().to(device=dev, dtype=torch.int64) if seq_kv_lens is not None else torch.full((b,), s_kv, dtype=torch.int64, device=dev)
+    i = torch.arange(s_q, device=dev).view(1, 1, s_q, 1)
+    j = torch.arange(s_kv, device=dev).view(1, 1, 1, s_kv)
+    diag = i + (kv_lens - q_lens).view(b, 1, 1, 1) if bottom_right else i
+    dead_q = i >= q_lens.view(b, 1, 1, 1)
+    masked = dead_q | (j >= kv_lens.view(b, 1, 1, 1))
+    if causal:
+        masked = masked | (j > diag)
+    if window_left is not None:
+        # The left window rides the diagonal: keys j < diag - W are masked, W keys below the diagonal stay (the kernel's
+        # WINDOW_LEFT = W = the graph's sliding_window_length - 1; the same convention as the sm107 suite's references).
+        masked = masked | (j < diag - window_left)
+    scores = scores.masked_fill(masked, float("-inf"))
+    full = scores if sinks is None else torch.cat([scores, sinks.view(1, h_q, 1, 1).double().expand(b, h_q, s_q, 1)], dim=-1)
+    smax = full.max(dim=-1).values  # -inf on a row with no finite column
+    ssum = torch.exp(full - smax.unsqueeze(-1)).sum(dim=-1).nan_to_num(0.0)  # exp(-inf - -inf) = NaN on an empty row -> 0
+    lse = smax + torch.log(ssum)  # -inf + -inf on an empty row
+    o = torch.matmul(torch.softmax(full, dim=-1).nan_to_num(0.0)[..., :s_kv], v_ref)
+    dead = dead_q.squeeze(-1)
+    return dict(o=o, lse=lse.masked_fill(dead, float("-inf")), smax=smax.masked_fill(dead, float("-inf")), ssum=ssum.masked_fill(dead, 0.0))

+def _run(
+    q,
+    k,
+    v,
+    *,
+    scale,
+    sdpa_kwargs=None,
+    seq_len_kv=None,
+    seq_len_q=None,
+    sink=None,
+    stats=True,
+    outputs=("score_max", "score_sum_exp"),
+    layout="contiguous",
+    stats_log2=False,
+):
+    """Build the graph with the requested side outputs, pin the arch's f16 row, launch TWICE (sentinel-filled outputs, the
+    two-launch delta) and return the buffers."""
+    import cudnn
+
+    b, h_q, s_q, _ = q.shape
+    d_v = v.shape[-1]
+    dtype = q.dtype
+    o_gpu = torch.empty(b, s_q, h_q, d_v, device="cuda", dtype=dtype).transpose(1, 2)
+    io = cudnn.data_type.HALF if dtype == torch.float16 else cudnn.data_type.BFLOAT16
+    g = cudnn.pygraph(io_data_type=io, intermediate_data_type=cudnn.data_type.FLOAT, compute_data_type=cudnn.data_type.FLOAT)
+    tq, tk, tv = g.tensor_like(q), g.tensor_like(k), g.tensor_like(v)
+    kw = dict(name="sdpa", q=tq, k=tk, v=tv, generate_stats=stats, attn_scale=scale, stats_use_log2=stats_log2)
+    vp = {tq: q, tk: k, tv: v}
+    side = {}
+    for name in outputs:
+        buf = make_dense_stats(b, h_q, s_q, layout)
+        t = g.tensor(dim=list(buf.shape), stride=list(buf.stride()), data_type=cudnn.data_type.FLOAT, name=name)
+        kw[name] = t
+        vp[t] = buf
+        side[name] = buf
+    if seq_len_kv is not None:
+        slk = g.tensor_like(seq_len_kv)
+        kw.update(seq_len_kv=slk, use_padding_mask=True)
+        vp[slk] = seq_len_kv
+        slq_t = seq_len_q if seq_len_q is not None else torch.full((b, 1, 1, 1), s_q, dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda")
+        slq = g.tensor_like(slq_t)
+        kw["seq_len_q"] = slq
+        vp[slq] = slq_t
+    if sink is not None:
+        st = g.tensor_like(sink)
+        kw["sink_token"] = st
+        vp[st] = sink
+    kw.update(sdpa_kwargs or {})
+    o, stats_t = g.sdpa(**kw)
+    o.set_output(True).set_dim(o_gpu.shape).set_stride(o_gpu.stride())
+    stats_gpu = None
+    if stats:
+        stats_gpu = make_dense_stats(b, h_q, s_q, "contiguous")

+        vp[stats_t] = stats_gpu
+    g.validate()
+    g.build_operation_graph()
+    g.create_execution_plans([cudnn.heur_mode.A])
+    # The plan: the row's unsplit, unpacked 2-CTA prefill tile -- the tile the score arm is wired on -- PINNED, never inferred from the
+    # ranking: with the ports off the heuristics may rank another tile of the row first (the PackGQA cga1 plan on a 148 / 152-SM part for
+    # the GQA shapes), and the bitwise comparisons below must be like for like.  A cga2 plan not in the ranked list is replayed through the
+    # public autotune record (the way an autotuner replays it).
+    names = [g.get_plan_name_at_index(i) for i in range(len(g.plans))]
+    ours = [i for i, n in enumerate(names) if n == _ROW or n.startswith(_ROW + "[")]
+    assert ours, f"no {_ROW} plan in {names}"
+
+    def _prefill_tile(i):
+        kn = g.plans[i].knobs
+        return (kn.split_kv or 1) == 1 and not kn.pack_gqa and kn.cga in (None, 2)
+
+    idx = next((i for i in ours if _prefill_tile(i)), None)

+        record = dict(record)
+        record[cudnn.knob_type.TILE_CGA_M] = 2

+        record[cudnn.knob_type.SPLIT_KV] = 1
+        g.create_execution_plan(engine_id, record)
+        idx = g.get_execution_plan_count() - 1
+    g.select_plan(idx)
+    plan = g.plans[idx]
+    assert (plan.knobs.split_kv or 1) == 1 and not plan.knobs.pack_gqa and plan.knobs.cga in (None, 2), plan.knobs

+        for buf in side.values():

+    first, o1, st1 = launch()
+    second, o2, st2 = launch()
